Job Summary
The Customer Service Associate III handles moderate to complex inquiries, addresses various types of policies and billing inquiries from internal or external customers in an efficient, professional and accurate manner and resolves service concerns while documenting customer requests, and completing changes to policies. Remain current on new marketing campaigns in order to respond appropriately to marketing related inquiries using all available resource tool.

Working knowledge of insurance policies and related processes and procedures.
Demonstrates accuracy in processing changes to customer policies based on the information provided and identifies opportunities for cross sales (if applicable).
Employs probing questions and actively listens to customer issues or questions, showing interest and compassion and displaying empathy for the callers situation.
Ensure facilitation of first call resolution and customer satisfaction on all transactions handled.
Resolve routine, complex, and unique questions / issues.

Education Experience (in lieu)

Description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Process all guest check-ins, check-outs, room assignments, and room change/late check-out requests. Secure payment; activate/reissue room keys. Ensure rates match market codes, document exceptions. Verify/adjust billing for guests. Communicate to appropriate staff when guests are waiting for an available room. Advise guest of messages. Clear departures in computer system. Coordinate with Housekeeping to track room status and guest concerns. File guest paperwork or documentation. Operate telephone switchboard station. Run and check daily reports, contingency lists, and credit card authorization reports. Supply guests with directions and information. Answer, record, and process all guest calls, requests, questions, or concerns; follow up to ensure each has been met to guests satisfaction. Arrange transportation for guests/visitors. Count and secure bank at beginning and end of shift. Cash-guests checks, process all payment types, vouchers, paid-outs, charges, and provide change. Notify Loss Prevention/Security of any reports of theft.
Follow company policies and procedures; report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge guests according to company standards; anticipate and address guests service needs; assist individuals with disabilities; thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speak using clear and professional language; answer telephones using appropriate etiquette. Develop and maintain positive working relationships; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of employees. Comply with quality assurance standards. Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: No related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None

Description:
Job Summary
Accounting Analyst II is responsible for supporting core accounting processes, financial reporting, account reconciliations, and transaction analysis to ensure the accuracy and integrity of financial records. Assists in preparing journal entries, maintaining accounting records, reconciling balance sheet accounts, investigating variances, and supporting month-end close activities. Reconciliations are a key subset of the broader General Accounting function and contribute to maintaining strong financial controls and compliance.
Key Responsibilities
Support day-to-day general accounting activities, including journal entry preparation, account analysis, and financial transaction validation.
Perform assigned balance sheet and bank reconciliations, ensuring timely identification and resolution of discrepancies.
Investigate accounting variances and support the resolution of reconciling items.
Prepare, maintain, and analyze accounting reports, schedules, and supporting documentation.
Ensure compliance with accounting policies, standard operating procedures, and internal control requirements.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams and business partners to resolve accounting exceptions and data discrepancies.
Maintain complete and audit-ready documentation for assigned accounting processes.
Support internal and external audit requests by providing accurate and timely information.
Contribute to process improvement initiatives aimed at enhancing accuracy, efficiency, and control effectiveness.
Skills and Abilities
Basic understanding of Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) and core accounting concepts.
Knowledge of general ledger accounting and account reconciliations.
Ability to analyze financial data and identify discrepancies or unusual transactions.
Strong attention to detail with a focus on accuracy and quality.
Effective written and verbal communication skills, including professional email communication.
Good organizational and time management skills with the ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other accounting systems or ERP platforms.
Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and build effective working relationships.
Positive attitude, adaptability, and eagerness to learn and develop professionally.
Education
CA / CMA / CIMA Qualified
Experience
0-2 years of experience in General Accounting, Financial Accounting, Reconciliations, or related accounting functions.
Supervisory Responsibilities
This position does not have supervisory responsibilities.
Education Experience (in lieu)
In lieu of the above education requirements, an equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered
Primary Skills
Accounting
Corporate Accounting
Financial Accounting
Preparation of Financial Reports

POSITION SUMMARY
Complete closing duties, including storing all reusable goods, breaking down goods, cleaning all equipment and areas, returning equipment to proper locations, locking refrigerators, restocking items, turning off lights, locking doors, and completing daily cleaning checklist. Set up, stock, and maintain work areas. Inspect the cleanliness and presentation of all china, glass, and silver prior to use. Maintain cleanliness of work areas throughout the day, practicing clean-as-you-go procedures.
Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; and complete safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional, maintain confidentiality of proprietary information, and protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards. Speak with others using clear and professional language, and answer telephones using appropriate etiquette. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others, support team to reach common goals, and listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Read and visually verify information in a variety of formats (e.g., small print). Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time or for an entire work shift. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance. Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Move over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces as well as up and down stairs and/or service ramps. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.

Semi Technical Customer Support Associate Voice Process

Job Title: Semi Technical Customer Support Associate

Locations: Pune / Noida

Experience: 6 Months – 5 Years
Process: Semi Technical Voice Customer Support
Work Model: 100% Work from Office
Process Type: US Process
Shift: Night Shifts Only
Working Days: 5 Days Working | 2 Rotational Offs
Training: No leaves allowed during training

Job Summary

We are hiring Semi Technical Customer Support Associates for our US Voice Process in Pune and Noida.

The ideal candidate should have excellent English communication skills, strong customer service abilities, and basic technical troubleshooting knowledge. The candidate should be comfortable working in a high-volume customer support environment and willing to work in night shifts.

Key Responsibilities

* Handle inbound and outbound customer interactions through voice support.
* Resolve customer queries, complaints, and basic technical issues effectively.
* Troubleshoot basic to intermediate technical issues using available knowledge bases.
* Provide accurate information and appropriate resolutions to customers.
* Handle approximately 40–50 calls per shift while maintaining service quality.
* Document customer interactions, resolutions, and follow-up actions in CRM/ticketing tools.
* Escalate unresolved issues to the appropriate teams as per process guidelines.
* Coordinate with internal teams for timely issue resolution.
* Maintain professionalism, empathy, and a customer-focused approach.
* Follow company policies, compliance requirements, and operational procedures.
* Maintain required productivity, quality, attendance, and schedule adherence.
* Candidates must be comfortable working on Indian holidays.

Key Performance Metrics

Candidates will be measured on:

* AHT – Average Handle Time
* CSAT / CCR – Customer Satisfaction
* FCR – First Call Resolution
* Quality Score
* Schedule Adherence
* Attendance & Productivity

Salary

* 6–12 Months Experience: Up to 4.5 LPA
* 12–18 Months Experience: Up to 5 LPA
* 18+ Months Experience: Up to 6 LPA

Important: Salary will be offered with a maximum 25% hike on the candidate’s last drawn salary, subject to eligibility and company norms.

Required Skills

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Strong customer service and problem-solving skills.
* Basic technical troubleshooting knowledge.
* Good listening and analytical abilities.
* Basic computer knowledge.
* Experience with CRM/ticketing tools is preferred.
* Ability to handle multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
* Comfortable handling high-volume calls.
* Basic typing skills.
* Positive attitude and willingness to learn.
* Willingness to work in night shifts.

Eligibility

* Graduate / Undergraduate candidates can apply.
* Minimum 6 months of relevant experience in Customer Care, Customer Support, Contact Center, Voice Process, or Technical Support.
* Overall experience considered: 6 months to 5 years.
* Candidates should have a proven ability to meet productivity and SLA targets.
* Strong customer-centric approach.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Candidates with experience in international voice customer support / technical support.
* Experience handling US customers will be an added advantage.
* Comfortable working in a high-pressure, target-driven environment.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities.
* Team player with a professional and customer-focused approach.

Important Information

Location: Pune / Noida Sector 62
Work Mode: Work from Office – 100%
Shift: Night Shift – US Process
Working: 5 Days Working | 2 Rotational Offs
Training: No leaves during training
Process: Semi Technical Voice Customer Support

We are currently hiring for Sales Specialist for our Apple Retail Stores in India.


Do you love how it feels to encourage others? As a Part-Time Specialist, you help create the energy and excitement around Apple products, providing the right solutions and getting products into customers hands. Role & responsibilities

Contribute to an inclusive environment by respecting each others differences and having the curiosity to learn.
Demonstrate Apples values of inclusion and diversity in daily activities.



Preferred candidate profile

Demonstrate knowledge of Apple products and services.
Personalise solutions based on customer needs, and effectively communicate them.
Work in a fast-paced environment, often supporting multiple customers at the same time.
Work in a team environment, demonstrating shared responsibility and accountability with other team members.
Be curious and open to learning from others and helping each other grow.
Learn about and deepen your understanding of Apple products and services, and third-party products, to enhance the customer experience.
Be trusted with sensitive or confidential information, keeping with Apples core values.
You should have availability to work a schedule based on business needs that may include nights, weekends and public holidays in the retail store, and reliably attend work as scheduled, in line with local laws and subject to any approved accommodations.

Key Deliverables (Essential functions & Responsibilities of the Job):
As a Stock Room Assistant, your key responsibilities include:

Manage Stockroom: Ensure the stockroom runs smoothly according to M&S procedures.

Handle Deliveries: Check and unpack deliveries, match them with paperwork, and highlight any issues like shortages or damage.

Organize Stock: Store stock in the correct locations and keep it accessible and safe. Ensure the physical stock matches the quantity on cartons.

Track Stock: Keep track of stock levels and locations. Rotate and replenish stock regularly.

Complete Paperwork: Fill out and file paperwork accurately and on time.

Maintain Cleanliness: Keep the stockroom organized and tidy, and manage non-saleable items like POS materials.

Assist with Stock Takes: Help with stock counts and preparation.

Improve Systems: Contribute to improving stock storage and control systems.

Physical Work: Be prepared for physical tasks, including lifting heavy boxes and performing various movements.

Key Skills:

Experience: Previous experience in stockroom or warehouse work is helpful. Basic IT skills are a plus.

Physical Requirements:

Physical Tasks: Must handle merchandise and materials, including climbing ladders, bending, reaching, and moving heavy items. Be able to stand or walk for long periods.

Job Summary
Fellow, English, Pratham-Shah PraDigi Innovation Center
This is a 10-month, field-based fellowship for young people who want to improve how children learn English in government schools. Fellows will teach Grades 3 to 8 in 2 to 4 schools. They will be supported through training, mentoring and regular reviews by the Pratham team.


What Fellows Will Gain
Hands-on experience in teaching English and foundational literacy.
Training and mentoring from Pratham s program team.
Skills in facilitation, communication, planning and digital tools.
Exposure to working with government schools and communities.
A monthly stipend.


Key Responsibilities
Understand the Step by Step English program its curriculum, teaching approach, resources, and implementation model.
Teach English to Grades 3 to 8 in 2 to 4 assigned schools over 10 months, covering two schools a day on designated days.
Plan and deliver engaging, activity-based lessons in reading, comprehension, speaking, and writing, using session plans, teaching-learning materials, and digital resources.
Assess students learning levels, conduct periodic assessments, track progress, and support students in closing learning gaps.
Coordinate with school heads and teachers to align sessions with school schedules and ensure continuity.
Engage students, teachers, parents and community members to build awareness, participation and ownership of learning.
Keep accurate records of classes, attendance, assessments and progress, and share regular updates and reports with the program team.
Document classroom experiences, challenges, success stories and good practices.
Attend trainings, review meetings and mentoring sessions, and work with the team to apply feedback and improve programme quality.
Represent Pratham and PraDigi professionally, and complete tasks on time as per Pratham s policies, child safeguarding practices and values.


Requirements
Graduate or postgraduate in English, Education, Social Sciences or a related field. Candidates from other disciplines with a strong interest in education may also apply.
Strong interest in English language teaching, foundational literacy and improving learning outcomes in government schools.
Excellent spoken and written English, with strong classroom facilitation, presentation and communication skills for working with students, teachers, school leaders and community members.
Ability to engage students from diverse learning backgrounds in an inclusive, participatory classroom.
Good planning, time management, coordination and problem-solving skills.
Comfortable using smartphones, digital learning resources, and basic Microsoft Word and Excel.
Ability to read and speak Hindi and the regional language of the assigned schools.
Willingness to travel regularly between schools, and commitment to the full 10-month fellowship, including training, mentoring, review meetings and community activities.
Openness to feedback, continuous learning and teamwork, with a commitment to child safeguarding, professional conduct and Pratham s values.


Locations
Maharashtra Satara, Chh. Sambhaji Nagar, Ahilyanagar,
Madhya Pradesh Sehore,
Karnataka Bangalore/Mysore,
Chhattisgarh, Bihar and Delhi


Duration
10 months


Process for Selection
All participants will go through an interview.
Participants who meet the criteria for each competency will be selected.

Job Description Mega Walk-in drive only for Freshers.

Key Responsibilities:

Content Analysis: Review and categorize high volumes of user reviews to determine sentiment, relevance, and compliance with global policies.
Spam Detection: Identify patterns of "Non-Genuine" content, including bot-generated reviews, promotional spam, and "Blanket Negativity" (e.g., "they are good at nothing") that lacks context.
Nuance Mapping: Distinguish between a "Subjective Opinion" (which stays) and "Harassment or Hate Speech" (which must be removed).
Contextual Auditing: Verify if a review is "Out of Sight/View" due to a technical mapping error or if it is a legitimate complaint about a physical business location.
Data Labeling: Maintain high-precision labeling to help train AI models in recognizing spam patterns across multiple languages and regions.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

High Reading Comprehension: Ability to interpret subtext, sarcasm, and cultural nuances in written English (and/or local languages).
Critical Thinking: You must be able to ask, "Does this review actually describe a consumer experience, or is it noise?"
Attention to Detail: Ability to spot repetitive phrasing or "copy-paste" patterns that signal a coordinated spam campaign.
Policy Adherence: Ability to set aside personal bias and follow a strict set of "Source of Truth" guidelines for content removal.
Efficiency: Comfortable working in a high-volume, fast-paced environment with specific daily throughput targets.

Job Description:

Working on the moderation of the listings and making sure > 98% accuracy is maintained
Making sure the listing are completed within the defined SLA/TAT time
Should be able to work independently and understand his/her performance metrics
Track his/her own performance need improvise based on the business requirement
Should be able to manage his / her own performance

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone s day. When you join our Hotels team, that s exactly what you ll do every time you come to work! Long Description: You will be the first point of contact for guests, responsible for ensuring smooth check-ins, check-outs, and addressing guest inquiries throughout their stay. What It Takes to Make the Stay
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. Previous experience in a guest service or front office role within the hospitality industry.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to handle guest inquiries and complaints professionally.
Proficiency in hotel property management systems (PMS) and general front office procedures.
Excellent multitasking skills and the ability to remain calm and professional in a fast-paced environment.
Proficiency in English; additional languages are a plus.
Ability to work flexible hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays.
A positive attitude and a genuine passion for providing exceptional guest service.

Deliver a warm welcome: Greet guests upon arrival and complete the check-in process, including verifying details, assigning rooms, issuing keys, and providing welcome materials or bell service assistance

Provide hotel and local knowledge: Demonstrate comprehensive knowledge of hotel offerings, room types, rates, promotions, and local area information to assist with guest inquiries
Promote hotel services: Use up-selling techniques to recommend hotel amenities and maximize room and service revenue
Delight our guests: Respond to guest requests, resolve concerns with care and urgency, and effectively manage messages and communications

Description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Our jobs aren t just about putting food on the table that our guests will enjoy until they ask for their bill. Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique - with food and drinks on the side. Our Guest Service Experts take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure that guests enjoy their meal. Whether setting tables, communicating with the kitchen, interacting and serving guests, or cleaning work areas and supplies, the Guest Service Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe workplace, following company policies and procedures, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional. Guest Service Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time; moving over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces), managing the menu (read and visually verify information), and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance and 50 pounds with assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping). Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Service Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: Less than 1 year related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Job Description Domestic IT RecruiterJob Title: Domestic IT Recruiter Experience: 1–5 Years Location: Hyderabad Employment Type: Full-Time Work Mode: Work From OfficeJob SummaryWe are looking for a dynamic and result-oriented Domestic IT Recruiter to join our recruitment team. The candidate will be responsible for handling end-to-end recruitment for IT positions across India, including sourcing, screening, interview coordination, offer negotiation, and candidate onboarding.Key Responsibilities
Understand client/hiring requirements and identify suitable candidates.
Source candidates through Naukri, LinkedIn, job portals, referrals, databases, and social media.
Use Boolean search and advanced sourcing techniques to identify relevant IT candidates.
Screen resumes and conduct initial telephonic/HR screening.
Evaluate candidates based on technical skills, experience, communication, location, CTC, and notice period.
Handle hiring for technologies such as Java, .NET, Python, React, Angular, DevOps, Cloud, Testing, Data, SAP, Salesforce, ServiceNow, etc.
Coordinate technical and HR interviews with candidates and clients.
Maintain regular follow-ups with candidates throughout the recruitment process.
Handle salary negotiation, offer discussion, and joining follow-ups.
Maintain a strong candidate pipeline for current and future requirements.
Maintain recruitment trackers, candidate databases, and daily/weekly MIS.
Meet defined submission, interview, closure, and joining targets.
Work closely with hiring managers, clients, and internal teams to ensure timely closures.
Ensure a positive candidate experience throughout the recruitment lifecycle.
Required Skills
1–4 years of experience in Domestic IT Recruitment / IT Staffing.
Hands-on experience with Naukri and LinkedIn.
Good knowledge of IT technologies and technical job requirements.
Strong sourcing and resume-screening skills.
Knowledge of Boolean search.
Good communication and interpersonal skills.
Strong candidate follow-up and negotiation skills.
Ability to handle multiple requirements simultaneously.
Target-oriented and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
Basic knowledge of MS Excel / Google Sheets / ATS.
Good to Have
Experience in Permanent, Contract, or C2H hiring.
Experience with IT staffing/recruitment consultancy.
Exposure to client/vendor coordination.
Immediate joiners or candidates with short notice period preferred.
Key Performance Indicators
Quality profiles submitted
Number of submissions and interviews
Interview-to-selection ratio
Offer-to-joining ratio
TAT for requirements
Monthly closures
Candidate follow-up and retention

Zydus MedTech is the WOS of Zydus Lifesciences, focused on transforming healthcare through innovative medical technologies. With a legacy of over 70 years, Zydus group has established its presence in more than 85 countries.
At Zydus MedTech, our manufacturing is built on precision, quality, and sustainability. Our state-of-the-art facilities, ISO 13485-certified and equipped with advanced automation, ensure seamless production of next-generation medical technologies. Within our clean rooms where the highest sterility standards prevail-every product is forged with integrity, safeguarding patient safety and redefining reliability.
Zydus Lifesciences Limited (Formerly known as Cadila Healthcare Limited), a leading Indian Pharmaceutical company is a fully integrated, global healthcare provider. With in-depth domain expertise in the field of healthcare, it has strong capabilities across the spectrum of the pharmaceutical value chain. From formulations to active pharmaceutical ingredients and animal healthcare products to wellness products, Zydus has earned a reputation amongst Indian pharmaceutical companies for providing comprehensive and complete healthcare solutions.

In 1995, the group was restructured and thus was formed Cadila Healthcare under the aegis of the Zydus group. From a humble turnover Rs. 250 crores in 1995 the group witnessed a significant financial growth and registered a turnover of over Rs. 17,000 crores in FY-21.
Adhering to its brand promise of being dedicated to life in all its dimensions, Zydus continues to innovate with an unswerving focus to address the unmet healthcare needs. Simultaneously it rededicates itself to its mission of creating healthier, happier communities across the globe.

Engagement Service Centres - Associate Senior Assistant

Position Summary
As an Associate Senior Assistant, you will support the audit team by performing a range of administrative tasks within the ESC group. Your responsibilities will include drafting engagement letters, monitoring audit client compliance with SEC independence rules and Deloitte policies and managing client acceptance and continuation processes. Additionally, you will coordinate group audits and provide support for various audit tools, such as audit confirmations, trial balance support, and financial statement tie-outs.

Work You'll Do
Take ownership of assigned tasks and deliverables, with the ability to understand implications of findings, next steps, and project deadlines.
Follow the agreed process in the development of deliverables and adopt a structured approach.
Provide regular updates to team lead about the progress of assigned tasks.
Ensure the executed work meets the Firm's quality standards.
Should learn the various tools and templates used by ESCs.
Hiring location would be Hyderabad

The Team
Engagement Service Centres (ESCs) is a shared services group that provides dedicated administrative support to the Audit function. The group serves as hubs of skilled, dedicated resources who support engagement teams and work in multiple audit areas. Some services from this group include Engagement Letter ESC (ELESC), Client Acceptance ESC (CAESC), Digital Services COE and Independence Support ESC (ISESC). Activities performed by the ESC group are not audit-related.

Location : Hyderabad
Shift Time : 9 AM to 6 PM

Qualifications

Required
MBA Finance with 0-1 year experience.
Should be proficient in the use of Microsoft Office products, especially Microsoft Word and Microsoft Excel.

Preferred Qualifications
Should be self-motivated, with a results-oriented mindset and strong analytical skills. Must have problem-solving skills and the ability to learn quickly. High attention to
detail and the capacity to meet tight deadlines are required.
Should possess excellent written and oral communication skills, along with good interpersonal skills.
Should possess good interpretation skills to read, understand and apply rules, regulations, policies and procedures....Less

Job Description Domestic IT RecruiterJob Title: Domestic IT Recruiter Experience: 1–5 Years Location: Hyderabad Employment Type: Full-Time Work Mode: Work From OfficeJob SummaryWe are looking for a dynamic and result-oriented Domestic IT Recruiter to join our recruitment team. The candidate will be responsible for handling end-to-end recruitment for IT positions across India, including sourcing, screening, interview coordination, offer negotiation, and candidate onboarding.Key Responsibilities
Understand client/hiring requirements and identify suitable candidates.
Source candidates through Naukri, LinkedIn, job portals, referrals, databases, and social media.
Use Boolean search and advanced sourcing techniques to identify relevant IT candidates.
Screen resumes and conduct initial telephonic/HR screening.
Evaluate candidates based on technical skills, experience, communication, location, CTC, and notice period.
Handle hiring for technologies such as Java, .NET, Python, React, Angular, DevOps, Cloud, Testing, Data, SAP, Salesforce, ServiceNow, etc.
Coordinate technical and HR interviews with candidates and clients.
Maintain regular follow-ups with candidates throughout the recruitment process.
Handle salary negotiation, offer discussion, and joining follow-ups.
Maintain a strong candidate pipeline for current and future requirements.
Maintain recruitment trackers, candidate databases, and daily/weekly MIS.
Meet defined submission, interview, closure, and joining targets.
Work closely with hiring managers, clients, and internal teams to ensure timely closures.
Ensure a positive candidate experience throughout the recruitment lifecycle.
Required Skills
1–4 years of experience in Domestic IT Recruitment / IT Staffing.
Hands-on experience with Naukri and LinkedIn.
Good knowledge of IT technologies and technical job requirements.
Strong sourcing and resume-screening skills.
Knowledge of Boolean search.
Good communication and interpersonal skills.
Strong candidate follow-up and negotiation skills.
Ability to handle multiple requirements simultaneously.
Target-oriented and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
Basic knowledge of MS Excel / Google Sheets / ATS.
Good to Have
Experience in Permanent, Contract, or C2H hiring.
Experience with IT staffing/recruitment consultancy.
Exposure to client/vendor coordination.
Immediate joiners or candidates with short notice period preferred.
Key Performance Indicators
Quality profiles submitted
Number of submissions and interviews
Interview-to-selection ratio
Offer-to-joining ratio
TAT for requirements
Monthly closures
Candidate follow-up and retention

Description:
Role Summary

The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given
territory to grow the Dine-out business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise
Value (GMV) per month.
The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and
specific geographies assigned

Responsibilities

Account & Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders.
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high.
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions for month-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.

Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:
Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner.
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale,conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts,
commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.

Interaction with Stakeholders:
Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations(competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).

Functional Competencies
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition

Desired Skills

Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working
knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude & Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative & Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness
and success of campaigns.
Creativity & Initiative: Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal
drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.
AboutCompany: Swiggy is an Indian online food ordering and delivery company. Primary skill; Procure to Pay, Accounts Payable (invoice processing), freshers are welcome
Basic understanding of accounting concepts (debit, credit, invoices, payments)
Working knowledge of MS Excel and MS Office
Attention to detail and willingness to learn
Good written and verbal communication skills
Ability to work well in a team
Based in or willing to relocate to Jaipur and work from the JPDC3 office
Flexible working in the time zone of the supported country

Roles and Responsibilities:
In this role you are required to solve routine problems, largely through precedent and referral to general guidelines.
Your primary interaction is within your own team and your direct supervisor.
In this role you will be given detailed instructions on all tasks.
The decisions that you make impact your own work and are closely supervised.
You will be an individual contributor as a part of a team with a predetermined, narrow scope of work.
Please note that this role may require you to work in rotational shifts

Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique - with food and drinks on the side. Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: Less than 1 year related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.

Description:
Job Description
Overview
A Grwoth Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative & On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience & Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Description:
Role Summary

The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given
territory to grow the Dine-out business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise
Value (GMV) per month.
The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and
specific geographies assigned

Responsibilities

Account & Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is
correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions for month-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.

Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:
Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale,conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts,
commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.

Interaction with Stakeholders:
Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations(competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).

Functional Competencies
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition

Desired Skills

Graduate with 0-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working
knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude & Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative & Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness
and success of campaigns.
Creativity & Initiative: Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal
drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

Description:
Skill required: Order to Cash - Accounts Receivable Ledger Maintenance

Designation: Order to Cash Operations New Associate

Qualifications:Any Graduation

Years of Experience:0 to 1 years

What would you do The New Associate Order to Cash is responsible for supporting end-to-end O2C operations including Billing, Accounts Receivable (AR), Cash Applications, and Reconciliations. The role ensures timely and accurate processing of customer transactions, adherence to SLAs, and compliance with internal controls while delivering high-quality service to clients

What are we looking for Qualifications: Bachelor - degree with Finance specialization
Years of Experience :0 to 1 years

Roles and Responsibilities:
Key responsibilities
Order to Cash Operations
Execute day-to-day Order to Cash (O2C) activities in line with defined processes and service level agreements (SLAs).
Understand end-to-end O2C flow from order booking to cash realization.
Billing
Perform accurate and timely invoice generation as per customer contracts and pricing terms.
Validate billing data, resolve billing discrepancies, and coordinate with upstream/downstream teams.
Ensure compliance with client-specific billing guidelines and tax requirements.
Accounts Receivable (AR)
Maintain customer accounts and monitor open receivables and aging.
Support AR activities including posting, adjustments, credit/debit notes, and write-offs as per policy.
Assist in reducing Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) by following standard AR processes.
Cash Applications
Apply customer payments accurately against open invoices using remittance advice.
Handle lockbox, bank transfers, and electronic payments.
Identify and resolve unapplied and unidentified cash in a timely manner.
Reconciliations
Perform bank, cash, and AR reconciliations to ensure ledger accuracy.
Investigate and resolve reconciliation differences and mismatches.
Support period-end and month-end close activities.
Key Skills Competencies
Strong attention to detail and analytical skills
Ability to work independently with limited supervision
Effective communication with internal teams and clients
Time management and SLA-driven mindset
Willingness to support 247 rotational shift operations as required
Complete Work from office

Job Level/ Designation

Function / Department

Sales
Location
Job Purpose

To manage and drive sales through distribution in order to attain market leadership in the given territory, through growth in gross numbers and revenues

Sales

Competition Tracking & reporting schemes & programs

Execute promotional activities for channel partners to drive sales and build market credibility
Revenue

Distribution expansion and extraction

People
DSE Management
Target Setting – DSE
DSE Beat Plan adherence
Systems/formats at DSE end
Drive Distribution KPIs delivery
MD/AD/SD Management
DSE Availability monitoring
Monitor Stock holding
Day to day Performance Review & discussions
Problem Solving
Load Out monitoring
Systems/formats at MD point
HSW compliance
Core Competencies, Knowledge, Experience

Good communication skills
Sales Planning & Forecasting
Products Services & Technology Knowledge - Consumer
Leads Decision Making & Delivering Results
Analytical Thinking
Building Team Commitment
Must have technical / professional qualifications

Essential : Graduation - Regular
Desired : post - graduation in business management/MBA
work ex: 1 - 4 years
Experience with distribution planning and channel implementation.

Automated systems and software are often employed to streamline and expedite the invoice processing workflow, improving efficiency and reducing the likelihood of errors.

What are we looking for?
Primary skill - Invoice Processing - P3

Roles and Responsibilities:
In this role you are required to solve routine problems, largely through precedent and referral to general guidelines.
Your expected interactions are within your own team and direct supervisor.
You will be provided detailed to moderate level of instruction on daily work tasks and detailed instruction on new assignments.
The decisions that you make would impact your own work.
You will be an individual contributor as a part of a team, with a predetermined, focused scope of work.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
Conduct in-process quality inspections (PQC) and final product inspections (OQC) for LT Power/Export Cables to ensure compliance with customer specifications and applicable standards.
Monitor manufacturing processes and verify adherence to approved Quality Plans, Inspection Plans, and Testing Procedures.
Perform stage-wise inspection and maintain complete product traceability from raw material receipt to finished goods dispatch.
Carry out routine, sample, and type testing activities and ensure accurate recording of quality data.
Ensure compliance with international and national standards such as IEC, UL, VDE, BASEC, SABS, and ASNZ requirements.
Identify, segregate, and report non-conforming products and support corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
Analyze quality issues using 8D, Why-Why Analysis, Fishbone Diagram, RCA, and other quality tools.
Support customer complaint investigations and field failure analysis to ensure timely closure and customer satisfaction.
Monitor process capability and quality performance using SPC tools and KPI dashboards.
Participate in Kaizen, Quality Circle, and Continuous Improvement projects aimed at reducing rejections, rework, and scrap generation.
Maintain quality reports, test records, CAPA reports, and audit documentation.
Support implementation of corporate quality initiatives and ensure adherence to quality management systems.
Coordinate with Production, Testing Lab, Maintenance, and Quality teams to achieve quality objectives.



Preferred candidate profile
B.Tech/B.E. in Electrical Engineering from a recognized institute.
2 to 5 years of experience in Quality Assurance, PQC, OQC, or Quality Control within Cable, Wire, Electrical Equipment, Switchgear, Transformer, or Manufacturing industries.
Good understanding of LT Power Cable manufacturing processes and quality requirements.
Knowledge of international standards such as IEC, UL, VDE, BASEC, SABS, and ASNZ.
Familiarity with quality tools including SPC, CAPA, FMEA, MSA, 8D, and Root Cause Analysis (RCA).
Hands-on experience in product inspection, testing, and quality documentation.
Basic understanding of ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, and ISO 50001 systems.
Exposure to SAP and/or MES systems will be an added advantage.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and report preparation skills.
Ability to work in a fast-paced manufacturing environment and coordinate effectively with cross-functional teams.
Candidates having experience in Export Cable Manufacturing, NABL-accredited labs, or certified cable manufacturing facilities will be preferred.
AboutCompany:
Havells India Limited (Havells), one of Indias largest FMEG (Fast-Moving Electrical Goods) Company & power distribution equipment manufacturer.

Currently over 95% of the product offering is energy efficient and manufactured in-house which makes Havells a name synonymous with excellence and expertise in the electrical industry.

Job Summary
The opportunity: Project Consultant-GOV-Business Consulting PI-CNS - BC - Transformation Delivery - Jaipur
GOV :
Our Global Government & Public Sector (GPS) is a network of highly skilled professionals dedicated to serving our clients by bringing best-in-class international experience and insight combined with local knowledge to solve the most critical problems facing governments today. We actively focus on building solutions that help public sector entities face the challenges of the future and reinvent themselves.
Digital transformation is not just about new technologies; it involves an overhaul of organizational structures, governance, work processes, culture and mindset. It also means realizing a wider vision of relationships and business models that will redesign how public services function.
To achieve this vision, we help clients balance strategic choices to re-ignite performance. We have developed a suite of cross-service line strategic solutions that align with our client priorities.
We have a proud record of helping governments meet their challenges head-on, and we work closely with them to build a world that works better for all citizens.
CNS - BC - Transformation Delivery :
EY Consulting is building a better working world by transforming businesses through the power of people, technology and innovation. Our client-centric approach focuses on driving long-term value for our clients by solving their most strategic problems. EY Consulting is made up of three sub-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services.
Business Consulting works with clients to reimagine or transform their business purpose and model; create growth; manage cost and efficiency; respond to market pressures and regulation; and resolve operational challenges. The scope of this team encompasses innovation, strategy and purpose, through deep functional experience in business transformation, finance, supply chain and operations, providing support for the complex and large-scale program and portfolio management.
It has multiple fields of play such as:
Finance Consulting - helps assess and transform our clients' finance function to improve performance and effectiveness. We help organizations implement service and cost improvement initiatives, and embed a performance management process and culture that unites the business around its core objectives.
Business Transformation - a m?ultidisciplinary competency, gathering capabilities in transformation architecture, experience design, business design and transformation execution to problem-solve, design and deliver large scale, multi-year, multi-stakeholder transformation programs.
Supply Chain and Operations - we provide a unique combination of industry-specific, strategic, operational and financial insights, digital technology advances and strategic alliance partners to deliver better outcomes and also help clients effect fundamental change in their operations performance to support sales growth, become more cost competitive, minimize risk and ensure operational resilience.
Your key responsibilities Technical Excellence
Strong capability in project review, tracking, and monitoring to ensure delivery milestones and action items are consistently managed. Proficient in preparing accurate reports and maintaining detailed documentation to support consulting engagements and governance needs. Skilled in research and analytics to synthesize data, identify trends, and support evidence-based recommendations. Able to develop clear client presentations that translate findings into concise, actionable insights. Working knowledge of procurement processes, process improvement methods, and Power BI for enhanced analysis and reporting.
Experience
Project Management (6+ years)
Business Analysis (3+ years)
Technical Support (2+ years)
Technical Writing (2+ years)
Business Intelligence (3+ years)
Skills and attributes To qualify for the role you must have
Bachelor of Technology in Mechanical Engineering
Bachelor of Commerce
Master of Technology in Civil Engineering

Job Summary
The opportunity: Consultant-GOV-Business Consulting PI-CNS - BC - Transformation Delivery - Jaipur.
Our Global Government & Public Sector (GPS) is a network of highly skilled professionals dedicated to serving our clients by bringing best-in-class international experience and insight combined with local knowledge to solve the most critical problems facing governments today. We actively focus on building solutions that help public sector entities face the challenges of the future and reinvent themselves.
Digital transformation is not just about new technologies; it involves an overhaul of organizational structures, governance, work processes, culture and mindset. It also means realizing a wider vision of relationships and business models that will redesign how public services function.
To achieve this vision, we help clients balance strategic choices to re-ignite performance. We have developed a suite of cross-service line strategic solutions that align with our client priorities.
We have a proud record of helping governments meet their challenges head-on, and we work closely with them to build a world that works better for all citizens.
CNS - BC - Transformation Delivery
EY Consulting is building a better working world by transforming businesses through the power of people, technology and innovation. Our client-centric approach focuses on driving long-term value for our clients by solving their most strategic problems. EY Consulting is made up of three sub-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services.
Business Consulting works with clients to reimagine or transform their business purpose and model; create growth; manage cost and efficiency; respond to market pressures and regulation; and resolve operational challenges. The scope of this team encompasses innovation, strategy and purpose, through deep functional experience in business transformation, finance, supply chain and operations, providing support for the complex and large-scale program and portfolio management.
It has multiple fields of play such as:
Finance Consulting - helps assess and transform our clients' finance function to improve performance and effectiveness. We help organizations implement service and cost improvement initiatives, and embed a performance management process and culture that unites the business around its core objectives.
Business Transformation - a multidisciplinary competency, gathering capabilities in transformation architecture, experience design, business design and transformation execution to problem-solve, design and deliver large scale, multi-year, multi-stakeholder transformation programs.
Supply Chain and Operations - we provide a unique combination of industry-specific, strategic, operational and financial insights, digital technology advances and strategic alliance partners to deliver better outcomes and also help clients effect fundamental change in their operations performance to support sales growth, become more cost competitive, minimize risk and ensure operational resilience.
Responsibilities
Strong problem-solving capability to structure issues, analyze root causes, and develop practical transformation solutions in government consulting engagements. Proficient in stakeholder management to coordinate across internal teams, client counterparts, and public-sector stakeholders effectively. Experienced in program management to support delivery of complex transformation initiatives, timelines, dependencies, and governance. Competent in MS Office tools for preparing documents, presentations, trackers, and executive-level reports. Skilled in data management, with added exposure to data visualization and AI-enabled techniques to support analytical decision-making.
Qualifications
Master of Technology in Civil Engineering
Bachelor of Architecture
Bachelor of Business Administration
Bachelor of Commerce
Bachelor of Technology in Mechanical Engineering
Master of Commerce
Master of Business Administration
Master of Computer Applications
Experience
Business Intelligence (3+ years)
Financial Analysis (3+ years)
Content Strategy (3+ years)
Product Management (4+ years)
Business Analysis (3+ years)
Project Management (6+ years)
Data Analysis (2+ years)
What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

Role & responsibilities
This Area Manager role is responsible for commercial growth and customer engagement across Delhi & Rajasthan. The position follows a remote work style with frequent field-based customer interaction and approximately 50% travel across assigned accounts, hospitals, and healthcare institutions within the territory.

The Area Manager is responsible for driving sales performance, expanding market presence, and supporting clinical adoption of Cardiac Surgery products across the assigned territory. This role works closely with cardiac surgeons, perfusion teams, hospital stakeholders, and procurement functions to deliver product education, procedural support, and account development strategies that contribute to business growth and customer success.

Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:

Drive territory sales growth by executing account plans and identifying opportunities to expand adoption of Cardiac Surgery therapies across assigned hospitals and healthcare institutions.
Build and maintain clinical and commercial relationships with cardiac surgeons, perfusionists, operating room staff, vascular specialists, and procurement stakeholders.
Provide product education, technical support, and clinical expertise to support safe and effective use of Cardiac Surgery technologies.
Deliver procedural support during surgical cases, including troubleshooting and follow-up activities to ensure customer satisfaction and therapy adoption.
Conduct product training and in-service programmes for new and existing customers on assigned therapy portfolios.
Partner with key implant center's to develop strategies that increase product utilisation and support progression toward technical self-sufficiency.
Gather and communicate market intelligence, customer feedback, competitive activity, and product performance insights to internal stakeholders.
Maintain accurate sales forecasts, customer records, inventory-related activities, and territory data within approved business systems.



Preferred candidate profile

Required Knowledge and Experience:

High School Diploma (or equivalent) AND 8+ years experience
OR Associates Degree AND 6+ years experience
OR Bachelor’s Degree AND 4+ years experience

Preferred Qualifications
Experience in Cardiac Surgery, Cardiovascular, Structural Heart, Perfusion, Extracorporeal Life Support, or related medical device therapies.
Degree or certification in Perfusion Technology.
Master's degree in Biomedical Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, Life Sciences, or Master of Business Administration.
Experience supporting live surgical procedures and working directly with cardiac surgeons and operating room teams.
Knowledge of hospital purchasing processes, account development strategies, and healthcare market dynamics within South India.

Description:
Skill required: Procure to Pay - Invoice Processing

Designation: Procure to Pay Operations Associate

Qualifications:Any Graduation

Years of Experience:1 to 3 years

About Accenture

Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security.Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Technology and Operations services, and Accenture Song- all powered by the world's largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. Our 784,000 people deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity every day, serving clients in more than 120 countries. We embrace the power of change to create value and shared success for our clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities.Visit us at www.accenture.com

What would you do?

You will be aligned with our Intelligent Finance Operations vertically and will support Procure to Pay (P2P) operations for the client.
You will be part of the team at Accenture s Jaipur Delivery Center (JPDC3), performing P2P transactions under the guidance of your team lead.
Procure to Pay covers PO and non-PO invoice processing, vendor master data management, payment runs, T&E, vendor reconciliations, AP query, helpdesk management and period-end close activities.
You will index and process invoices, update data in client systems and respond to basic queries as per defined procedures.
You will meet daily productivity and quality targets and follow the defined controls and SOPs.

What are we looking for?
Primary skill; Procure to Pay, Accounts Payable (invoice processing)
Basic understanding of accounting concepts (debit, credit, invoices, payments)
Working knowledge of MS Excel and MS Office
Attention to detail and willingness to learn
Good written and verbal communication skills
Ability to work well in a team
Based in or willing to relocate to Jaipur and work from the JPDC3 office
Flexible working in the time zone of the supported country

Roles and Responsibilities:
In this role you are required to solve routine problems, largely through precedent and referral to general guidelines
Your expected interactions are within your own team and direct supervisor
You will be provided detailed to moderate level of instruction on daily work tasks and detailed instruction on new assignments
The decisions that you make would impact your own work
You will be an individual contributor as a part of a team, with a predetermined, focused scope of work
Please note that this role may require you to work in rotational shifts

Qualification
Any Graduation

Description:
JOB SUMMARY
Areas of responsibility include Restaurants/Bars and Room Service, if applicable. Assists in the daily supervision restaurant operations and assists with menu planning, maintains sanitation standards and assists servers and hosts on the floor during peak meal periods. Strives to continually improve guest and employee satisfaction. Determines training needed to accomplish goals, then implements plan.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area.
OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Food Service Management, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; 2 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Assisting in Management of Restaurant Team
- Handles employee questions and concerns.
- Monitors employees to ensure performance expectations are met.
- Provides feedback to employees based on observation of service behaviors.
- Assists in supervising daily shift operations.
- Supervises restaurant and all related areas in the absence of the Director of Restaurants or Restaurant Manager.
- Participates in department meetings by communicating a clear and consistent message regarding the departmental goals to produce desired results.
Conducting Day-to-Day Restaurant Operations
- Ensures all employees have proper supplies, equipment and uniforms.
- Communicates to Chef and Restaurant Manager any issues regarding food quality and service levels.
- Ensures compliance with all restaurant policies, standards and procedures.
- Monitors alcohol beverage service in compliance with local laws.
- Manages to achieve or exceed budgeted goals.
- Performs all duties of restaurant employees and related departments as necessary.
- Opens and closes restaurant shifts.
Providing Exceptional Customer Service
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
- Supervises staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and ficial objectives are met.
- Encourages employees to provide excellent customer service within guidelines.
- Handles guest problems and complaints, seeking assistance from supervisor as necessary.
- Strives to improve service performance.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Assists in the review of comment cards and guest satisfaction results with employees.
- Meets and greets guests.
Conducting Human Resource Activities
- Supervises on-going training initiatives.
- Uses all available on the job training tools for employees.
- Communicates performance expectations in accordance with job descriptions for each position.
- Coaches and counsels employees regarding performance on an on-going basis.
Additional Responsibilities
- Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Assists servers and hosts on the floor during meal periods and high demand times.
- Recognizes good quality products and presentations.
- Supervises daily shift operations in absence of Restaurant Manager.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

JOB SUMMARY
Responsible for the daily shift operations of Housekeeping, Recreation/Health Club and, if applicable, Laundry. Directs and works with employees to ensure property guestrooms, public space and employee areas are clean and well maintained. Completes inspections and holds people accountable for corrective action. Position assists in ensuring guest and employee satisfaction while maintaining the operating budget.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the housekeeping or related professional area.
OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Managing Housekeeping Operations
- Ensures guest room status is communicated to the Front Desk in a timely and efficient manner.
- Works effectively with the Engineering department on guestroom maintece needs.
- Supervises the property general cleaning schedule.
- Obtains list of rooms to be cleaned immediately and list of prospective check-outs or discharges to prepare work assignments.
- Inventories stock to ensure adequate supplies.
- Supervises daily Housekeeping shift operations and ensures compliance with all housekeeping policies, standards and procedures.
- Assists in the ordering of guestroom supplies, cleaning supplies and uniforms.
- Supports and supervises an effective inspection program for all guestrooms and public space.
- Communicates areas that need attention to staff and follows up to ensure understanding.
- Ensures all employees have proper supplies, equipment and uniforms.
Managing Departmental Costs
- Participates in the management of the department s controllable expenses to achieve or exceed budgeted goals.
- Understands the impact of department s operations on the overall property ficial goals and objectives and manages to achieve or exceed budgeted goals.
- Comprehends budgets, operating statements and payroll progress reports as needed to assist in the ficial management of department.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
- Strives to improve service performance.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
- Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.
Conducting Human Resources Activities
- Participates as needed in the investigation of employee accidents.
- Supervises staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs, and ficial objectives are met.
- Ensures employees understand expectations and parameters.
- Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently, disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and support the Peer Review Process.
- Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals.
- Uses all available on the job training tools to train new room attendants and provide follow-up training as necessary.
- Participates in the employee performance appraisal process, providing feedback as needed.
- Assists as needed in the interviewing and hiring of employee team members with the appropriate skills.
- Supports a departmental orientation program for employees to receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.
- Participates in employee progressive discipline procedures.

Job Title: Data Warehouse Testing Engineer
Experience: 8-15 Years
Location: Bangalore / Hybrid
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are looking for a skilled Data Warehouse Testing Engineer to validate and ensure the quality, accuracy, and integrity of data across Data Warehouse, ETL, and Reporting systems. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in SQL, Data Warehousing concepts, ETL testing, and source-to-target data validation.
Key Responsibilities
Analyze business requirements, data models, and source-to-target mapping documents.
Develop test strategies, test plans, test cases, and test scenarios for Data Warehouse projects.
Validate data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes.
Perform data reconciliation and source-to-target validation.
Verify data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and integrity across systems.
Execute functional, integration, regression, and system testing.
Validate reports, dashboards, and business intelligence solutions.
Perform backend testing using complex SQL queries.
Identify, document, and track defects using defect management tools.
Collaborate with Data Engineers, ETL Developers, Business Analysts, and stakeholders.
Prepare test execution reports and quality metrics.
Required Skills
Strong experience in Data Warehouse Testing and ETL Testing.
Advanced SQL skills including joins, subqueries, aggregations, and stored procedures.
Strong understanding of Data Warehousing Concepts:
Fact and Dimension Tables
Star Schema
Snowflake Schema
Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD)
OLAP Concepts
Experience with ETL tools such as Informatica, SSIS, Talend, DataStage, or Ab Initio.
Expertise in source-to-target data validation and data reconciliation.
Experience with defect tracking tools such as JIRA.
Knowledge of Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) and Agile methodologies.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Cloud Data Warehouses:
Snowflake
Amazon Redshift
Azure Synapse
Google BigQuery
Knowledge of Big Data technologies such as Hadoop, Hive, and Spark.
Experience with BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Cognos.
Basic automation knowledge using Python or SQL scripting.
Experience with Data Lake and Data Migration Testing.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
ISTQB or relevant Data Testing certifications are preferred.
Key Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent attention to detail.
Ability to understand complex data flows and business rules.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work independently and within cross-functional teams.

Must-Have Skills
Data Warehouse Testing
ETL Testing
Advanced SQL
Source-to-Target Validation
Data Reconciliation
Data Warehousing Concepts (Star/Snowflake Schema, Facts & Dimensions)
Agile & JIRA Experience

Very good PHP knowledge and understating of various frameworks

Ability to manage projects and work in strict deadlines

Description:
Role / Job Title- Manager - Oracle Fusion HCM Payroll Functional Consultant
Experience - 8 - 14 years

Key Skills -Oracle Fusion HCM Payroll, US Payroll, Payroll Configuration, Elements, Calculation Cards, Balances, Fast Formulas, Payroll Flows, Retro Processing and Costing
Location - Bangalore/Hyderabad/ Pune /Gurugram

Role & responsibilities

8 - 14 years of experience in Oracle HCM applications, with strong hands-on expertise in Oracle Fusion HCM Payroll.
Must have worked on at least two end-to-end Oracle Fusion Payroll implementations, with strong Oracle US Payroll experience; Canada Payroll experience is a plus.
In-depth hands-on configuration across Legislative Data Groups, payroll definitions and calendars, Payroll Statutory Units / Tax Reporting Units, elements, input values, element eligibility, calculation cards, balances, payment methods and payroll costing.
Strong knowledge of QuickPay, payroll flows, retroactive processing, proration, balance adjustments, costing and payment processing.
Hands-on expertise in Payroll Fast Formulas and troubleshooting complex payroll calculation and configuration issues.
Strong understanding of US payroll processing, including federal, state and local taxation, quarter-end / year-end activities and legislative updates.
Experience with HDL / payroll data conversion, payroll extracts and reporting, with the ability to collaborate with technical teams on integrations and extensions.
Ability to perform fit-gap analysis, translate business requirements into scalable configuration, and lead unit testing, UAT / regression testing, quarterly release readiness and production issue resolution.
Strong client-facing communication and delivery leadership, including risk / escalation management, team guidance and working knowledge of Core HR and related HCM touchpoints.
As a Manager, you will serve as the functional lead and client-facing subject matter expert for Oracle Fusion HCM Payroll, combining deep payroll configuration expertise with delivery leadership across implementation, enhancement and production support engagements.
Lead the Oracle HCM Payroll functional workstream across solution design, configuration, testing, cutover, hypercare and ongoing support.
Lead client requirement and design discussions, translate payroll policies into Oracle configuration, and provide clear recommendations on solution options and impacts.
Own complex payroll functional issues from analysis through resolution, driving root-cause analysis and sustainable fixes.
Review payroll configurations, functional designs and deliverables for quality, accuracy, controls and adherence to agreed standards.
Manage incidents, service requests, changes and problem records in line with SLAs / KPIs, including prioritization, risks, escalations and stakeholder communication.
Coordinate with Core HR, Benefits, Compensation, Time and Labor, Integrations, Reporting and Finance teams, and lead quarterly release impact assessment and regression testing.
Mentor functional consultants, provide configuration oversight, build team capability and drive continuous improvement while maintaining strong client relationships.
