Job Title: Oracle Cloud HCM Functional Consultant (Senior Associate)

Location: Bangalore, Hyderabad, Mumbai, Kolkata,Pune, Chennai, Gurugram (PwC Acceleration Center India)

About the Role:
We are looking for an experienced Oracle Cloud HCM Functional Consultant with strong expertise in multiple HCM modules and proven experience in end-to-end implementations. You will work closely with clients and internal teams to design, configure, and implement Oracle Cloud HCM solutions, driving HR transformation and process optimization.

Key Responsibilities:
Lead requirements gathering workshops and collaborate with stakeholders to translate business needs into Oracle Cloud HCM functional specifications
Design and configure Oracle Cloud HCM modules (Core HR, Payroll, Benefits, Absence, T&L, Compensation, Talent Management, Recruitment & Onboarding, Learning, Workforce Modelling) aligned with best practices
Manage multiple end-to-end Oracle Cloud HCM implementations ensuring quality delivery within budget and timelines
Develop and execute test scripts; lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to validate system functionality
Provide post-implementation support and training to users for smooth adoption of Oracle Cloud HCM solutions
Prepare detailed functional design documents, configuration guides, and user manuals
Integrate Oracle Fusion HCM with third-party systems using Oracle Integration Cloud, FBDI, APIs, etc.
Use Oracle HCM Cloud tools and analytics to provide insights and contribute to HR strategy and workforce planning
Manage stakeholder relations, collaborating across project managers, technical teams, and business users to ensure success

What You Must Have:

Bachelors degree any stream
Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in Oracle Cloud HCM, with at least 2 complete implementations
Expertise in 2+ Oracle Cloud HCM modules: Core HR, Payroll, Benefits, Absence, Time & Labor, Compensation, Talent Management, Recruitment & Onboarding, Learning, Workforce Modeling
Strong understanding and experience in Oracle Integration technologies (Oracle Integration Cloud, FBDI, APIs)
Excellent communication skills in English (oral and written)

Job Title: React Native Mobile Developer

Required:
4+ years of experience in mobile application development, with at least 3+ years of hands-on React Native app development.
Required Skills & Experience:
Strong expertise in React Native, including developing UI components, navigation, and using state management libraries like Redux (Redux Toolkit) or MobX.
Proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+), including core concepts such as closures, hoisting, Promises, Arrow functions, and Rest/Spread operators.
Deep understanding of TypeScript, with hands-on experience in writing scalable and maintainable applications.
Solid experience in mobile app development, particularly in integrating RESTful APIs and handling asynchronous data flows.
Familiarity with mobile development best practices, including responsive design, app performance optimization, and front-end testing tools.
Proven experience in debugging and troubleshooting mobile apps for both Android and iOS environments.
Proficiency with Git or other version control systems for code collaboration.
Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, build processes, and deployment strategies for mobile apps.
Strong understanding of mobile app security, including data encryption, secure authentication, and safe data storage.
Experience with modern development tools such as React Navigation, push notifications, and unit testing frameworks.

Key Responsibilities:
Lead the development of React Native applications, ensuring best practices and high-quality code are followed.
Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to build robust, scalable mobile solutions.
Act as a technical point of contact for the team, offering guidance on design, architecture, and implementation decisions.
Integrate APIs effectively and manage state using libraries like Redux (Redux Toolkit) or MobX.
Optimize mobile apps for performance, ensuring fast load times, responsiveness, and efficient resource usage across Android and iOS platforms.
Implement best practices in app security, including encryption, secure authentication, and safe data storage.
Actively contribute to hands-on coding, reviewing, and troubleshooting complex issues alongside the team.
Ensure continuous improvement in SDLC processes, fostering a culture of quality and efficiency within the development team.
Conduct thorough code reviews, ensuring adherence to SOLID principles, DRY principles, and design patterns to maintain a clean, maintainable codebase.
Troubleshoot and debug issues across Android and iOS environments using advanced debugging tools.
Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements, provide technical insights, and ensure timely delivery of features.

Advantage:
Experience with Salesforce Mobile SDK for iOS & Android, including Soup integration and data synchronization.
Hands-on experience with Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, or Consumer Goods Cloud.
Proficiency with Salesforce developer tools like Developer Console or Workbench.

Experience: 5-6 years
Staff Level: Senior Associate
Education: BE/BTECH or equivalent
Key responsibilities:
Define GIS performance testing strategy covering web, desktop, and servicelevel workloads (ArcGIS Server, Utility Network, Feature Services).
Identify performancecritical GIS workflows (pan/zoom, tracing, edits, large spatial queries, batch jobs).
Create realistic GIS workload models based on editor, viewer, integration, and batch processing usage patterns.
Design test scenarios for: 
Map rendering and symbology scaling
Feature service queries (attribute + spatial)
Utility Network traces and validations
Web GIS Load Test scenarios
Concurrent editing and versioned data access 
Load and Stress Simulation:Execute load, endurance, and stress tests to determine how GIS (likeArcGIS Server) perform under high user traffic, specifically testing 2D/3D map rendering and data querying.
Bottleneck Analysis: Monitor system KPIssuch as CPU utilization, memory, response times, and throughput—to identify bottlenecks related to spatial analysis or database queries.
Result Reporting: Create detailed performance analysis reports that highlight the system's performance, identifying areas for improvement or potential downtime.
Collaborate with Functional Analysts to map business flows into performance test cases.
Prior experience in GIS Testing assignments will be an advantage.
Collaboration & Optimization:Work with GIS developers and architects to suggest infrastructure changes, database tuning, or code optimizations to resolve issues.
Perform RCA on performance issues and recommend improvement opportunities.
Essential Qualifications:
Minimum of 5 years’ working experience with Esri ArcGIS Software (Enterprise, Desktop, Server, ArcGIS Pro, Online)
Understanding of ArcGIS Enterprise Architecture- ArcGIS Server, Portal, data Store etc.
Understanding of ArcGIS Pro concepts: Maps, Projects, Layout templates, Editing Templates, Tasks etc.
Understanding of Esri geoprocessing tools: model Builder
Understanding of Geodatabases: Versioning and Spatial data Types

Role- Pharma & Life Sciences (R&D Operations / Clinical Strategy / Life Sciences Consulting)
Role Overview
PwC is seeking highly motivated professionals with experience in Pharma & Life Sciences, Clinical Research, R&D Operations, Clinical Trial Strategy, or Healthcare Consulting to join our growing Sector Operations - Health team.
The selected candidate will support global consulting engagements focused on pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, and life sciences organizations. The role involves conducting strategic analyses, supporting transformation initiatives, generating data-driven insights, and enabling operational excellence across the R&D and commercial value chain.

Key Responsibilities
Conduct primary and secondary research, market assessments, and competitive benchmarking.
Analyze complex business problems and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
Support client engagements involving R&D operations, clinical trial strategy, and life sciences transformation.
Develop executive-level presentations, reports, and client deliverables.
Perform quantitative and qualitative analyses using healthcare and life sciences data.
Support portfolio management, resource planning, and business process improvement initiatives.
Collaborate with global teams and stakeholders across multiple workstreams.
Leverage emerging technologies, analytics, and GenAI solutions to improve business outcomes.
Participate in thought leadership, practice development, and knowledge management activities.

Preferred Capability Areas
R&D Operations & Strategic Planning
Understanding of pharmaceutical and life sciences R&D operations.
Knowledge of portfolio, resource, and financial management processes.
Exposure to clinical trial management systems (CTMS, EDC).
Understanding of R&D governance, reporting frameworks, and operational planning.
Familiarity with clinical data standards, system integrations, and data migration processes.

Clinical Trial Strategy
Experience supporting clinical trial design, study optimization, or clinical operations.
Knowledge of protocol development, site selection, patient recruitment, and decentralized trials.
Understanding of Good Clinical Practice (GCP) guidelines and regulatory requirements.

Location:Chennai | Bangalore | Hyderabad | Mumbai

Role Summary
Timely, reliable data pipelines are what turn a platform design into business value. The Data Engineer
builds and operates the pipelines that move data from source systems into the lakehouse and on to analytics and AI consumers. They ensure that the pipelines are automated, performant, secure and governed.
The role works alongside the data architect, data quality engineer, business analysts and AI engineers. Its
job is to deliver production-grade pipelines on Azure / Microsoft Fabric, with metadata and lineage
captured in Microsoft Purview.

Build batch, incremental, CDC and streaming ingestion pipelines from source systems into the Bronze layer, using Azure Data Factory and Fabric pipelines.
Develop Silver- and Gold-layer transformations in SQL, PySpark and Spark notebooks, including cleansing, conformance, enrichment and business-rule logic.
Implement dimensional models, SCDs, surrogate keys and data marts according to the architect's designs.
Integrate DQ checks, validation, quarantine and reconciliation into pipelines in partnership with the Senior Data Quality Engineer.
Ensure that pipelines publish metadata and lineage to Microsoft Purview.
Implement scheduling, dependency management, parameterization, error handling and alerting.
¢ Optimize pipelines, partitioning, file formats (Delta/Parquet) and compute usage for performance and cost efficiency.
¢ Apply access controls, masking, encryption and secure credential management in line with UAE PDPL, the Dubai Data Law and DESC ISR.
¢ Maintain code in source control and deploy through CI/CD pipelines, with automated tests and environment promotion.
¢ Support production operations, incident resolution and runbooks, and coach SUTHERLAND engineers so that the pipelines can be sustained after
handover.

¢ 4+ years in data engineering, preferably within UAE government or regulated-sector environments.
¢ Advanced SQL, Python and PySpark/Spark skills.
¢ Hands-on experience with Azure Data Factory, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks or Synapse.
¢ Strong understanding of Lakehouse/Medallion architecture, Delta/Parquet formats and
dimensional modelling, including SCDs and surrogate keys.
¢ Experience with CI/CD (Azure DevOps or GitHub), source control and DataOps practices.
¢ Familiarity with Microsoft Purview metadata and lineage, and with DQ tooling.
¢ Awareness of UAE data regulation, including UAE PDPL, the Dubai Data Law and DESC ISR.
¢ Excellent English communication and documentation skills; Arabic proficiency is an advantage.

Job Profile: Payer Modernization Healthcare Transformation & Analytics

Role Overview
We are looking for professionals with experience in healthcare payer operations, transformation, technology, and analytics to support payer modernization initiatives. The role will focus on improving operational effectiveness, redesigning workflows and operating models, leveraging data and analytics, and supporting technology-enabled transformation across payer functions.
Candidates may specialize in one or more of the following capability areas:
Healthcare Back Office Transformation
Healthcare Middle Office Transformation
Payer Analytics & Data Strategy

Key Responsibilities
Support strategic, operational, and technology-led transformation initiatives across healthcare payer organizations.
Assess existing processes and develop process maps, workflow assessments, operating models, and improvement recommendations.
Conduct benchmarking, workforce assessments, research, and cost-benefit analyses to identify improvement opportunities.
Support transformation across payer functions such as claims, enrollment, eligibility, billing, provider data, care management, utilization management, pharmacy/PBM, network management, payment integrity, and risk adjustment.
Analyze large and complex healthcare datasets to identify trends, operational issues, and actionable business insights.
Support technology-enabled operating model transformation, including workflow redesign, system implementation, platform optimization, and process automation.
Contribute to analytics initiatives addressing risk adjustment, quality, utilization, care management, pharmacy performance, and payment integrity.
Support data governance and effective communication of analytical insights to business and operational stakeholders.
Use GenAI to support research, insight development, and storyboarding where appropriate.
Evaluate opportunities to leverage automation, AI/ML, NLP, interoperability, and data exchange to improve payer processes.

Essential Knowledge & Experience
Understanding of healthcare payer operations and core functions.
Experience supporting operational, strategic, technology, analytics, or transformation initiatives.
Understanding of payer workflows such as claims, enrollment, eligibility, billing, provider data, benefits, care management, and utilization management.
Familiarity with process mapping, workflow assessment, operating models, project management, or benchmarking.
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
Ability to conduct independent research and translate findings into actionable insights.
Experience working with complex datasets.
Understanding of payer technology platforms and system-enabled process improvement.
Ability to communicate analytical and technical insights clearly to business stakeholders.

Preferred Knowledge & Experience
Understanding of Medicare Advantage, Medicare Part D, Medicaid, and commercial payer models.
Familiarity with risk adjustment, HCCs, Stars, HEDIS, CAHPS, and compliance-driven payer activities.
Understanding of Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM) concepts such as formulary design, utilization management, rebates, pharmacy networks, and drug-spend analytics.
Awareness of CMS oversight, payer regulatory requirements, audits, and compliance processes.
Understanding of value-based care and payment models.
Experience with payer analytics use cases involving risk adjustment, quality, care management, utilization, pharmacy, or payment integrity.
Exposure to predictive modeling, forecasting, risk scoring, or anomaly detection.
Familiarity with healthcare interoperability, data exchange, provider data platforms, and automation concepts.
Exposure to digital transformation and analytics programs.

Technical Skills
Essential
Experience analyzing large and complex datasets.
Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills.
Ability to perform benchmarking and basic cost-benefit analysis.
Basic proficiency in GenAI-enabled research and insight development.

Preferred
SQL
Python or R
Automation tools
AI/ML and NLP concepts
Predictive modeling and forecasting
Healthcare analytics and data visualization
GenAI-based research and storyboarding

Core Competencies
Strategic and structured thinking
Strong analytical mindset
Problem solving

Independent research
Business and technology alignment
Data-driven decision making
Innovation and continuous improvement
Ability to operate effectively in transformation environments

Ideal Candidate Profile
The ideal candidate combines healthcare payer domain knowledge with strong analytical and transformation capabilities. They should be comfortable understanding payer workflows, analyzing complex information and datasets, identifying improvement opportunities, and supporting technology- and data-enabled modernization initiatives.
Candidates with deeper specialization in payer operations, Medicare/Medicaid, PBM, risk adjustment, care/utilization management, healthcare analytics, data strategy, or payer technology transformation would be particularly relevant depending on the specific capability area.
What You Must Have
- Master's degree in Healthcare Administration, Public Health, Business Administration, Life Sciences, Engineering, Data Analytics, Finance, or related discipline.
- At least 2-4 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required

What Sets You Apart
- Intellectual curiosity for payer modernization and health transformation
- Supporting client projects through project delivery and team tasks
- Applying business analysis and process improvement in consulting settings
- Contributing to stakeholder engagement and customer relationship management
- Utilizing emerging technologies, AI fluency, and digital tooling
- Demonstrating change management and business transformation awareness

SAP Analytics Cloud & Datasphere Consultant
Location: Bangalore or Chennai
Duration: Contingent Worker (6 Months)
AstraZenecas Global Business Services (GBS) Process & Analytics Services capability is at the forefront of transforming our business processes through innovation in automation, analytics, and artificial intelligence. As part of the Process Insights team, we are scaling our SAP analytics expertise to deliver best-in-class solutions. We are seeking a talented SAP Analytics Cloud & Datasphere Consultant to drive analytical initiatives and empower data-driven decision-making across AstraZeneca.
Main duties and responsibilities
The role will be responsible for the following activities:
Own the end-to-end delivery lifecycle of analytics solutions, including requirements analysis, solution design, development, testing, deployment, and production support.
Design, build, and maintain scalable data models in SAP Datasphere to support reporting and analytics requirements.
Develop analytical datasets, views, and business-ready data models following governance and best practices.
Integrate and harmonize data from SAP and non-SAP sources within Datasphere.
Create and enhance SAC dashboards, stories, and KPI reports using Datasphere as the primary data source.
Partner with business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into technical designs and scalable analytics solutions.
Perform unit testing, support SIT/UAT activities, and ensure successful deployment to production.
Troubleshoot and optimize data models, queries, and SAC reports for performance, usability, and data quality.
Ensure adherence to data governance, security, and development standards.
Provide ongoing support and continuous improvement for delivered analytics products.
Prepare technical documentation and contribute to Agile delivery ceremonies.
Essential requirements
Degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics or a comparable degree.
Overall, 8-12 years of experience and at least 2-3 years experience working on SAP SAC / Datasphere solutions as a Consultant, Analyst, Developer or relevant role.
Strong hands-on experience in SAP Datasphere data modelling (Analytical Models, Views, Data Flows, Replication Flows, SQL Views).
Experience developing SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) stories, dashboards, and visualizations.
Good understanding of data warehousing, dimensional modelling, and ETL/ELT concepts.
Experience integrating data from SAP S/4HANA, BW, and non-SAP systems.
Strong SQL and analytical problem-solving skills.
Business process knowledge in Finance (P&L, Cost Centers, Budgeting, Forecasting, Procurement, Spend Analytics) and/or Operations/Supply Chain (Inventory, Logistics, Manufacturing, Order Management, Service Operations).
Ability to engage with business users and convert business requirements into technical data models and reports.
Excellent communication skills and ability to work in an Agile environment.
Energetic, organised and self-motivated.
Fluent in business English.

Client Advisor Job Description
About NoBroker
NoBroker is a technology-led real estate platform focused on simplifying the property buying, selling, and renting experience through technology. We operate in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment where ownership, customer experience, and business outcomes are highly valued.
About the Role
We are looking for Client Advisors to join our sales team. In this role, you will be responsible for driving sales, understanding customer requirements, guiding customers through NoBroker’s products and services, and converting leads into successful customers.
The role requires strong communication, relationship-building, follow-up, and negotiation skills, along with a target-oriented mindset.
Key Responsibilities
Drive sales and revenue targets within the assigned territory.
Identify and connect with potential customers to understand their property requirements.
Guide customers on NoBroker’s plans, products, and value-added services.
Build and maintain strong customer relationships throughout the sales journey.
Generate leads through calls, referrals, follow-ups, and local market opportunities.
Conduct product/service demonstrations and clearly explain pricing and benefits.
Handle customer queries, objections, and escalations effectively.
Convert leads into customers and consistently achieve individual sales targets.
Follow up with prospective customers to maximize conversions.
Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities for premium plans and additional services.
Maintain accurate customer information, follow-ups, and sales activities in the CRM.
Track daily sales performance, pipeline status, and achievement against targets.
Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth customer onboarding and service delivery.
Stay updated on local market trends, customer preferences, and competitor activities.
Prepare regular sales reports and share performance updates with the reporting manager.
Candidate Requirements
Experience: Freshers can apply.
Education: Any Graduation.
Age: Up to 30 years.
Strong verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
Good customer-handling and relationship-management abilities.
Strong persuasion, negotiation, objection-handling, and closing skills.
Comfortable working in a target-driven environment.
Self-motivated, persistent, and result-oriented.
Willingness to learn and work in a fast-paced sales environment.

Performance-driven growth opportunities.

Collaborate with Development, DevOps, Cloud, and Infrastructure teams.

Description:
SAP MDG Consultant

Location:
Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Mangalore, Chandigarh, Trivandrum, Bhubaneswar, Nagpur, Jaipur, Indore, Coimbatore, Noida, Vizag, Kolkata, Mysore, Hubli (Hybrid)

Experience:
JL4: 2-5 Years
JL5: 5-9 Years
JL6: 9-18 Years


About the Role
We are looking for an experienced SAP MDG Consultant to join our SAP practice. The candidate will be responsible for implementing, configuring, supporting, and optimizing SAP Master Data Governance (MDG) solutions across enterprise environments.
The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in SAP MDG, Data Governance, Data Quality, Replication, Validation, Data Modeling, Workflow Configuration, Business Rules, and Master Data Management. Experience in implementation, rollout, migration, and support engagements is highly preferred.

Roles & Responsibilities
Implement and support SAP MDG solutions for enterprise master data management.
Design, configure, and maintain MDG data models for Customer, Vendor, Material, Business Partner, and Financial master data.
Gather, analyze, and document business requirements related to master data governance.
Configure MDG workflows, validations, derivations, and business rules.
Establish data governance processes, standards, and approval workflows.
Configure replication frameworks and integration with SAP and non-SAP systems.
Monitor and improve master data quality across business domains.
Collaborate with business users to define governance policies and controls.
Support data migration, cleansing, enrichment, and harmonization initiatives.
Work on data replication and synchronization activities across landscapes.
Conduct SIT, UAT, regression testing, and production support activities.
Troubleshoot master data issues and perform root cause analysis.
Prepare functional specifications and support technical development teams.
Participate in implementation, rollout, upgrade, and transformation projects.
Ensure compliance with organizational data governance standards.
Provide user training, documentation, and knowledge transfer sessions.

Qualifications
B.E / B.Tech / MCA / MBA or Post Graduate qualification.
Minimum 2 years of SAP MDG experience for JL4 roles.
Minimum 5 years of SAP MDG experience for JL5 roles.
Minimum 9 years of SAP MDG experience for JL6 roles.
Strong understanding of Master Data Management and Data Governance processes.

SAP MDG

Data Quality Management

SAP BTP Exposure
Data Migration Projects
Data Warehousing Concepts
Governance Risk & Compliance (GRC)

Do not apply if:
End User Profiles
Only Training/Certification Profiles
Non-SAP MDG Profiles
Candidates without hands-on SAP MDG implementation/support experience

Description:
Job Summary
The Builder - Logistics is a high-agency, 0-to-1 role embedded within Ca's GS Retail Logistics function in the South. Based out of Bengaluru and working closely with the Regional Head - South, you will build new programs, ship new tools, and run controlled experiments across Bangalore, Hyderabad, Chennai, and Kerala. This is not a steady-state ops role - you'll spend most of your time defining problems, prototyping solutions, and turning what works into repeatable playbooks that city teams can run at scale. You'll operate at the intersection of ops, data, product, and AI.
Key Responsibilities
New Program Design - Identify gaps across pilot supply, CSP adherence, auto-allocation, and fulfilment. Design new programs from scratch, run pilots, and hand off winning plays to city teams.
Ops Diagnostics Deep Dives - Own regional data - cut it by city, cohort, and process step to surface what's broken and where the fastest wins sit. Convert findings into structured action plans.
Product Specs Tool Building - Write clear specs for internal tools and dashboards. Partner with Product and Tech to ship what the region needs; use no-code and AI where full builds are overkill.
Automation of Manual Workflows - Map the region's sheet-heavy workflows and lead their transition to automated systems. Ship quick wins with Apps Script, Zapier, or AI copilots before scoping full products.
City-Level Experimentation - Run controlled A/B tests across cities to validate whether a new process, script, or intervention actually moves the KPI. Kill what doesn't work, scale what does.
Cross-functional Execution - Work directly with city heads, Category Managers, Product, and Tech to unblock progress. Translate ground-team pain-points into shipped fixes fast.
Qualifications Experience
2-4 years in high-agency roles - startup ops, strategy consulting, category management, or founders office.
Track record of shipping something end-to-end - a program, a tool, a dashboard, a new city launch - that survived after you moved on.
Comfortable in ambiguity - can walk into a messy problem and leave with a structured plan.
Strong first-principles thinking; happy to visit yards and talk to pilots before writing a single line of a proposal.
Bengaluru-based or willing to relocate; comfortable travelling across Hyderabad, Chennai, and Kerala.
Data AI Skills
Advanced Excel / Google Sheets - pivots, lookups, and formula-based analysis at scale.
SQL fluency for querying large operational datasets; Python or R for deeper analysis is a strong plus.
Comfort building dashboards (Looker, Data Studio, Tableau) that drive city-level decisions.
Hands-on with AI copilots (ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, or similar) to accelerate analysis, drafting, and prototyping.
Familiar with no-code automation (Apps Script, Zapier, Retool) to ship quick wins without engineering support.

Familiarity with integration of BRIM SOM with CI, FI-CA, Convergent Invoicing, and downstream systems.

Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture

Do you believe technology modernization is key to unlocking growthAre you a problem solver who enjoys helping clients simplify complex technology landscapes and make the right modernization choicesDo you enjoy being part of an inclusive, diverse and collaborative culture

If yes, this is the right opportunity for you. Join Accenture Technology Strategy Transformation and work with global clients to shape enterprise-wide technology modernization strategies, target-state architecture, application modernization approaches, executable roadmaps and value cases. You will partner with C-suite stakeholders to convert modernization ambition into practical decisions, business-aligned priorities and measurable outcomes across industries.

The Practice A Brief Sketch

Technology Strategy Transformation Practice is a part of Accenture Strategy and focuses on our clientsmost strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through innovative transformation initiatives, aimed at redefining business models and delivery approaches using agile methodologies.

We provide you with a strong learning environment, deep-rooted in Technology Strategy, Enterprise Architecture and Technology consulting, where you will get an opportunity to support and work with our key global clients, defining and driving end-to-end technology modernization initiatives and strategic value, business growth and cost optimization. As part of this high-performing team, these are some of the initiatives you will support:

Modernization Strategy Value Agenda: Help clients define the strategic intent for modernization, aligning with core business objectives of growth, agility, resilience, cost and simplification to a clear modernization ambition and measurable value outcomes Technology Estate Application Portfolio Assessment: Assess complex technology landscapes across applications, platforms, integrations, data, AI, engineering and legacy applications, including non-mainframe legacy estates, to identify technical debt, business risk, modernization opportunities and portfolio-level priorities Target Architecture Modernization Pathways: Shape target-state modern architecture, reference technology stacks and modernization pathways across enterprise platforms, applications and legacy estates, helping clients make informed choices across regarding remediation Modernization Roadmap, Business Case Decision Governance: Translate modernization ambition and strategy into sequenced roadmaps, investment cases, decision frameworks and governance mechanisms that help clients prioritize initiatives, manage trade-offs and realize measurable business value

Role Overview

We are looking for a Technology Modernization Strategy Architecture leader with deep expertise in enterprise technology modernization, application modernization and modernization-led architecture strategy across all layers of IT landscape including architecture, application, data, AI, cloud, engineering and IT operations.

The role requires a senior consulting practitioner who can engage confidently with CxO and business leadership, shape the modernization value agenda, assess complex technology and application estates, drive target architecture and modernization pathway discussions, and translate business ambition into executable transformation roadmaps and value cases.

The successful candidate will be expected to evaluate complex technology estates, define modern target state, structure initiatives needed to achieve the target state, identify modernization pathways and guide clients through practical, sequenced transformation choices.

The role requires strong executive presence, structured problem solving, deep modernization expertise across IT landscape and the ability to guide senior clients through practical trade-offs across business value, technology debt, cost, risk, resilience, scalability and long-term architecture fit.

Key Responsibilities


Technology Modernization Strategy and Roadmap


Lead enterprise-wide technology modernization strategy engagements across complex technology landscapes

Define modernization ambition, strategic intent and business-aligned technology modernization priorities

Assess current-state technology estates across applications, platforms, architecture, integration, data, infrastructure and vendor ecosystems

Identify modernization opportunities, technical debt, architecture constraints, platform gaps, business risks and value pools

Shape target-state architecture and reference technology stack aligned to business priorities and enterprise architecture direction

Define modernization guiding principles, decision prioritization frameworks to support consistent technology choices

Advice on vendor, platform and ecosystem strategy, including fitment of cloud platforms, enterprise platforms, integration platforms and modernization partners

Build multi-year modernization roadmaps sequenced by business value, technical dependencies, cost, risk, complexity and readiness

Develop modernization value cases linking technology investments to measurable outcomes such as agility, resilience, scalability, cost efficiency, reduced technology debt and speed-to-market


Application Modernization Strategy, Architecture Planning


Lead application estate assessments covering business criticality, technical health, architecture fit, complexity, dependencies, cost, resilience, scalability and modernization potential

Assess aging and legacy application estates, including non-mainframe legacy applications, to identify technical debt, business risk, modernization constraints and transition priorities

Define application modernization pathways for target applications

Conduct application decomposition and domain analysis to identify modernization boundaries, dependency clusters, migration waves and sequencing options

Shape target application architecture and transition architecture across applications, platforms, integration and data dependencies

Define phased modernization approaches, coexistence models, migration plans and dependency management approaches that protect business continuity

Advice on modernization patterns such as modular architecture, API-led integration, microservices, event-driven architecture, cloud-native enablement, strangler pattern and platform-based modernization

Support data liberation and migration considerations required to reduce dependency on aging systems and enable future-ready application architecture

Develop app modernization roadmaps and value cases aligned to enterprise modernization strategy, architecture direction and business priorities


Executive advisory and Growth


Lead CxO-level conversations on technology modernization priorities, application modernization choices, architecture implications, investment trade-offs and enterprise transformation decisions

Serve as a trusted advisor to CIO, CTO, enterprise architecture and business leadership teams on modernization strategy, sequencing choices and strategic technology decisions

Translate complex modernization and architecture topics into clear executive recommendations, decision options and leadership-ready points of view

Support strategic pursuits, client account development and growth initiatives through differentiated modernization propositions and executive-ready solution narratives

Shape client opportunities by bringing together various capabilities of Accenture to provide a holistic solution to client

Develop thought leadership, market perspectives, offering assets and reusable modernization frameworks

Lead and mentor teams across discovery, modernization assessment, strategy development, roadmap creation and senior stakeholder engagement


Core Skillsets Tools

Technology Modernization Advisory


Strong understanding of how enterprise technology modernization enables business growth, agility, resilience, cost optimization, speed-to-market and technology simplification

Ability to assess complex technology estates across applications, platforms, integrations, data dependencies, AI, engineering, infrastructure touchpoints, cloud footprint, vendor ecosystem and technology debt

Strong capability in legacy application modernization, technology debt assessment, modernization prioritization and investment sequencing across large enterprise landscapes

Experience in developing modernization value cases that connect technology investments to measurable outcomes such as run-cost reduction, risk reduction, improved resilience, faster change velocity and business capability enablement

Familiarity operating model implications of modernization, including product-centric delivery, platform operating models, engineering maturity, governance and change readiness



Ability to define data, platform and architecture enablers required to scale AI responsibly across the enterprise value chain


Application Architecture, Engineering and AI


Strong understanding of application architecture, integration architecture, data AI architecture, cloud architecture and transition architecture in modernization contexts

Deep understanding of modern application architecture patterns such as domain-driven design, modular architecture, microservices, event-driven architecture, API-led integration, cloud-native application design and strangler-based modernization

Strong understanding of application modernization pathways including trade-offs across value, cost, risk, feasibility and business continuity

Experience with aging application estates, including non-mainframe legacy applications, custom applications, packaged applications, end-of-life technologies and fragmented platform landscapes

Practical understanding of modern engineering practices such as AI driven SDLC, DevSecOps, CI/CD, automated testing, observability, infrastructure-as-code, containerization, Kubernetes and platform engineering

Strong understanding of frameworks and methods such as TOGAF, COBIT, IT4IT, business capability modelling, modernization maturity assessment and technology value assessment

Good understanding of cloud, data and AI architecture concepts, including Azure/AWS/GCP, data lake, data fabric, real-time data processing, semantic models, AI/ML integration, GenAI enablement and AI-ready application architecture

Familiarity with platform ecosystems across SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, ServiceNow, hyperscalers, integration platforms, data platforms, observability tools and engineering toolchains


Consulting and Communication Skills


Strong consulting toolkit spanning structured problem solving, assessment design, facilitation, business case development and executive storytelling

Ability to engage senior stakeholders with credibility and clarity, influence client leadership and create alignment across business and technology teams

Experience in independently leading client discussions, develop thought leadership, create compelling modernization narratives and shape opportunities

Experience leading proposals, strategic pursuits and senior client relationship development


Whats in it for you


An opportunity to work on transformative projects with key G2000 clients

Potential to Co-create with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.

Ability to embed responsible business into everythingfrom how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.

Personalized training modules to develop your strategy consulting acumen to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities

Opportunity to thrive in a culture that is committed to accelerate equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.

Your experience counts!


Bachelors degree required; MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification is a plus

15+ years of experience in technology consulting, technology strategy, application modernization, architecture-led transformation, cloud modernization or large-scale technology transformation advisory

Experience working with CIO, CTO, enterprise architecture, application, platform, cloud, data and business leadership teams to shape modernization strategies and transformation priorities

Exposure to modern engineering, cloud, data and AI-enabled modernization concepts, including DevSecOps, CI/CD, platform engineering, cloud-native architecture, data modernization, GenAI enablement and AI-ready application architecture

Experience creating executive-ready deliverables such as modernization strategy documents, application portfolio heatmaps, architecture options, roadmap views, business cases, investment options and CxO-level presentations

Experience leading consulting teams, including structuring workplans, guiding analysis, reviewing deliverables, facilitating workshops and managing senior stakeholder discussions

Experience supporting proposal development, solution shaping, strategic pursuits, thought leadership or practice-building activities in technology modernization or adjacent transformation areas.

Understanding of at least one of the industries across Financial Services, Retail, Consumer Goods, Life Sciences, Telecommunications, Resources, Industrial, Automotive, Travel or similar sectors is preferred

Strong facilitation capability with experience in workshops, design thinking sessions, leadership discussions and architecture governance forums

Scripting
API Integration
Log Analysis

Job Summary
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.
Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.
Role purpose: The Workplace Change Manager will establish and lead an APAC Workplace Change Management Center of Excellence (CoE) to standardize and enhance change enablement across APAC site moves. The objective of this role is to create a consistent experience, reduce duplicated effort, and clarify change ownership across projects. This role will lead a CoE that provides structure, methodology, templates, quality control, and oversight, while project and delivery teams execute implementation. The CoE will operate through two parallel workstreams:
Build a controlled library of standardized change collateral within the first 90 days.
Deliver change support mapped to each site s location, timeline, resource requirements, and language needs.
At JLL, we are committed to helping our people achieve their ambitions by enabling them to explore new opportunities, build expertise, create long-term careers, and succeed through inclusion. We value what makes each of us unique and help our people find a place where they can belong.
The Workplace Change Manager is accountable for the CoE methodology, governance, and execution support across six change management stage gates and tier-based engagement. The role will establish the APAC change framework, including T1-T4 tiering, intake, stage gate governance, and quality control processes. It will also drive the creation and maintenance of a controlled collateral library and leadership cascade materials, while supporting project teams with scalable, high-quality change delivery across multiple locations and languages. This role requires a structured and process-minded leader who can standardize effectively without slowing delivery, and who can coach and enable local teams while maintaining strong quality oversight.
Key responsibilities
Establish the APAC change framework, including T1-T4 tiering and the six-gate methodology, with clear intake, tiering, gate approvals, and quality control.
Build and maintain the collateral library and leadership cascade pack by rebuilding existing APAC assets into a controlled library containing templates, worked examples, completion instructions, readiness checklists, and a lessons learned bank with quarterly updates.
Deliver change support aligned to the project pipeline, including engagement planning, content production, cascade and readiness activities, runbook execution, hypercare, handover, and local translation and quality assurance.
Provide daily communications enablement by standardizing event collateral, newsletter templates, workplace signage, and monthly reporting templates, while also providing oversight and quality control for employee-facing communications and campaigns.
Lead stakeholder alignment and readiness cadence with WPx, PMO, and DC to help ensure leadership alignment and employee readiness are addressed consistently.
Manage specialist or external SME engagement by exception where complexity requires additional support, such as high leadership visibility, phased moves, or compressed timelines, under central governance.
Required qualifications
Proven experience leading APAC regional change delivery and communications across workplace moves and multi-stakeholder programs.
Strong experience operating in a model where a central CoE provides structure and projects execute delivery.
Demonstrated capability in building reusable toolkits, templates, and structured approaches, and driving adoption across distributed teams.
Strong communications capability, including employee-facing messaging, campaign support, senior stakeholder engagement, approval management, and quality control.
Strong program management discipline, including intake management, tiering, gate-based governance, readiness checkpoints, and hypercare handover.
Ability to work across multiple locations, timelines, and language requirements with a high level of consistency and control.
Preferred qualifications
Experience establishing or scaling a Center of Excellence in change management, communications, or transformation delivery.
Experience supporting workplace transformation, relocation, or site move programs within a complex regional environment.
Familiarity with structured governance models and quality assurance practices in change delivery.
Ability to balance process discipline with practical execution in fast-moving environments.
Experience coaching local or delivery teams while maintaining centralized standards and oversight.
Location: Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Mumbai, Noida, Pune
Scheduled Weekly Hours: 48

Relevant years of experience in software testing with strong expertise in Web Automation Testing.

Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.

Job Purpose

The Client Manager is responsible to understand the business and most important be a bearer of relationship with Enterprise Customer, with Ownership of Entire Customer Life Cycle for the assigned Enterprise Customers. End to end operational excellence for the entire customer life cycle journey from opportunity to closure. The role of Client Manager is to focus on incremental product wise Revenue Market Share from those assigned accounts.
Key Result Areas/Accountabilities
Single & Most important bearer of Relationship with Enterprise Customer with Ownership of Entire Customer Life Cycle for all assigned Enterprise Customers.
Responsible for the incremental revenue growth on all product lines.
Farming - Protecting the Existing Revenue Stream from Competition & Downward Tariff Revision
Seeding New Products & Services - Cross Selling & Up selling - to enhance overall revenue
Business planning & Accurate Forecasting on Revenue, Order booking, Gross Addition, Gross Net, Net Addition, Churn, Billing, Collection & Bad debts.
Coordination with Cross Functional team to ensure sync in terms of tariff offering, other circle acquisitions, Order fulfilment, Issues Resolution & various other day to day activities
Monitor the service delivery and service assurance aspects are in line with agreed SLA / MSA
Facilitating Collections Team to ensure timely payments and reduction in bad debts
Manages detailed Account Dossier, Accont plans , Heat Map and update periodically.
Adhere and comply to all processes and systems of VIL & VIBS
Collaborative aproach within the team and organisation
Account Engagement and Account Mapping across multi levels /verticals
End to end operational responsibility leading to CXX
Core Competencies, Knowledge, Experience
Competencies
Experience in managing global and a track record of global accounts/ enterprise solution selling
Experience in complex change management and operating in a matrix, fast moving and technical environment.
Experience in working in multi-cultural environment ability to manage an international and distributed team.
Team player, strong influence and relationship management skills, customer centric.
Strong communication and decision making skills– ability to balance conflicting interests and ability to lead in a high-growth, high-uncertainty environments
Learning
To learn new products and services so as to be updated with the Customer needs and market trends
Apply the learning in own Customer scenario
Must have technical/ professional qualifications
Experience handling Strategic Accounts and C-level engagement
Education: MBA and Engineering background preferred
5+ years of experience
Should have preferably worked with Telecom, Technology Companies

Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture
Do you believe in creating an impact? Are you a problem solver who enjoys working on transformative strategies for global clients? Are you passionate about being part of an inclusive, diverse and collaborative culture?
Then, this is the right place for you! Welcome to a host of exciting global opportunities in Accenture Technology Strategy & Advisory.
The Practice- A Brief Sketch:
The Technology Strategy & Advisory Practice is a part of and focuses on the clients most strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through innovative R&D transformation, aimed at redefining business models using agile methodologies.
We provide you with a great learning ground, deep-rooted in , where you will get an opportunity to advice and work with our key global clients, driving end-to-end transformative strategic value and business growth. Transaction Advisory and Strategy (Tech): Lead and support M&A transactions (Carve Outs / Separation / Mergers/ Integrations) with a focus on the technology sector, including IT infrastructure, software, cybersecurity, cloud computing, SaaS, AI, and emerging tech trends. Bring your best skills forward to excel in the role:
Leverage your deep experience across technology strategy areas such as tech M&A Advisory, IT Separation / Integration Planning / Execution, Digital & Technology Strategy, Operating Model Design, Agile Operating Model Design, Workforce Transformation, Sourcing Strategy, IT Shared Services Strategy, Process Transformation, Value case/ business case formulation, Enterprise Architecture and Application Portfolio Strategy Excel as a long-term trusted advisor and partner by providing thought leadership and profound knowledge of market trends. Understand and deploy the key value drivers of a business, how they impact the scope and approach of the engagement Create expert content and use advanced presentation, public speaking, content creation and communication skills for C-Level discussions. Demonstrate strong understanding of a specific industry, client or technology and function as an expert to advise senior leadership. Manage budgeting and forecasting activities and build financial proposals

Your experience counts!
MBA from a tier 1 institute

5-8 years of M&A Advisory, Strategy Consulting or Investment banking experience

3+ years of experience in financial modeling, valuation analysis, scenario testing and writing business cases (quantitative and qualitative) to support strategic business initiatives, process improvement initiatives, or IT transformation
2+ years of experience leading or managing large teams effectively including planning/structuring analytical work, facilitating team workshops, and developing technology strategy recommendations
Good knowledge of technology and enterprise architecture concepts through practical experience and knowledge of technology trends e.g. Mobility, Cloud, Digital, Collaboration

Job Title: Risk Senior Specialist
Corporate Title: Assistant Vice President
Location: Mumbai, India
Role Description
Market and Valuation Risk Management (MVRM) provides an independent view of market risks and valuation to Deutsche Bank s senior management. Market risk team manages Deutsche Bank s Market Risk position in an independent and neutral way.
You will be a part of the Market Risk Analysis and Control (MRAC) function within MVRM and will be responsible for the provision of all official market risk metrics and core analysis in support of risk management decision making for Rates asset class. The team operates a business/asset class and risk metric aligned organizational matrix supported by central functions. The team has a global presence with staff located in London, New York, Berlin, Singapore, Mumbai and Bangalore.
You will be exposed to risk management techniques viz. analysis/computation of VaR, SVaR, IRC, Backtesting, FRTB for a diverse range of derivative products. The team is also proficient in combining this risk knowledge with best in class automation and visualization skills including python/VBA/Tableau to provide value added analytical outputs to its stakeholders
You will be expected to be proficient in automation tools (python essentially) with sufficient knowledge of risk to enhance the output of the team.
Your key responsibilities
This role is within the Rates Asset class team. The primary responsibilities are:
Risk validation and ensure appropriate controls in place
Review and understand the historical simulation VaR, FRTB and Backtesting(outlier analysis), including staying abreast of the development of this metric and related drivers
Facilitating better risk analysis and automated reporting infrastructure to stakeholders using required programming tools(python/Tableau etc.) is a critical part of profile
Perform deep dive analysis into concentrations of risk or emerging items of interest, providing high quality and accurate information at a level for senior management consumption
Perform analytical analysis of our limit to generate proposals for limit changes and for new limits
Support the analysis and communication of business portfolio level topics to senior management and their committees
Your skills and experience
Experience in working with commodities especially Energy asset class is a must.
Experience in working with python and tableau is a must.
University degree in Economics, Mathematics or other quantitative subject.
5+ years experience in Market Risk within the Financial Market / Investment Banking industry (other relevant backgrounds e.g. Trading, Product Control, IPV will also be considered)
Proficiency in Python/VBA, Tableau, MS Office tools is essential for the role
Good understanding of other Market Risk measurement techniques e.g. VaR, RNIV, Economic Capital, IRC.
Excellent communication skills; ability to articulate technical and financial topics with global stakeholders
A reliable team player with the motivation to work in a dynamic, international and diverse environment
Able to multi-task and deliver under tight deadlines
A committed and motivated individual for self-development and growth
Hands on coding skills(Python specifically) and Tableau skills will be a significant plus
Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.

Job Title: Data Analyst
Location: Bangalore / Mumbai / Pune
Department: Customer & Retail Analytics
Employment Type: Full-time
About FedEx: FedEx provides customers and businesses worldwide with a broad portfolio of transportation, e-commerce, and business services and also serves our customers through our retail presence. We foster an environment of growth and learning, where innovative ideas are encouraged, and diverse teams are valued for their contributions. As part of our commitment to excellence, were seeking a highly skilled Data Analyst to join our analytics team.
Job Summary: As a Data Analyst, you will play a key role in gathering, processing, and analyzing data to drive informed decision-making and actionable insights for FedEx. Your quantitative expertise and business acumen will help develop analytical solutions to improve operations, customer experience, and business outcomes. This role involves working closely with cross-functional teams to develop meaningful data analysis, insights summarizations/ visualizations and communicate findings that guide strategy and operational decisions.
Key Responsibilities:
Collect, analyze, and interpret complex data sets using Python and SQL to support business objectives.
Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business needs, formulate analytic solutions, and provide actionable insights.
Develop and maintain data models and reports to track key performance indicators (KPIs) and business metrics.
Create meaningful data visualizations to communicate findings, trends, and actionable insights to non-technical stakeholders.
Conduct exploratory data analysis and identify patterns, trends, and opportunities for business improvement.
Support data quality initiatives, ensuring accuracy and consistency across data sources.
Utilize statistical and quantitative techniques to support problem-solving and business optimization efforts.
Mandatory Skills:
Python: Proficiency in data manipulation, data analysis libraries (Pandas, NumPy), and data visualization libraries (Matplotlib, Seaborn).
SQL: Strong command of SQL for data extraction, transformation, and complex queries.
Business Acumen: Ability to understand business context and objectives, aligning analytics with organizational goals.
Quantitative Aptitude: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen attention to detail.
Data Visualization: Basic skills in data visualization to effectively communicate insights.
Statistical Analysis: Foundational understanding of statistical methods (e.g., regression, hypothesis testing).
Communication Skills: Ability to distill complex data insights into clear, actionable recommendations for stakeholders.
Good-to-Have Skills:
Power BI: Experience with Power BI for data visualization and report development.
Machine Learning Fundamentals: Basic knowledge of machine learning concepts for deeper pattern analysis.
Advanced Excel: Skills in advanced Excel functions, pivot tables, and data cleaning for quick analyses.
Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or a related field. Master’s degree is a plus.
3+ years of experience in data analysis, preferably within the logistics, supply chain, or transportation industry.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain complex data insights to stakeholders.
Strong organizational skills and a collaborative mindset.
Join Our Team: If you are passionate about Data analytics to drive business impact and enhance the customer experience, we invite you to join our team at FedEx. Apply now to be part of a dynamic, innovative environment where your skills and expertise will make a difference.
Application Process: To apply for this position, please submit your resume and a cover letter detailing your relevant experience and qualifications. Qualified candidates will be contacted for further evaluation.

Job Title: Senior Manager - SAP CO (Controlling) - SAP HANA
Location: [Mumbai ,pune,bangalore]
Department: IT / Finance /
Reports to: Director of ERP Solutions / Head of Finance Systems
Position Overview:
We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Senior Manager for SAP CO (Controlling) with expertise in SAP S/4 HANA. The Senior Manager will lead the design, implementation, and optimization of the SAP Controlling module within our SAP S/4 HANA environment. This role requires both technical and functional expertise in SAP CO, along with strong leadership abilities to manage a team and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders.
Key Responsibilities:
SAP CO (Controlling) Implementation & Optimization:
Lead the design, configuration, and implementation of SAP CO modules (Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Internal Orders, Product Costing, Profitability Analysis).
Drive system enhancements and process optimizations in SAP CO in the context of SAP S/4 HANA, aligning them with business requirements.
Work closely with business users and other SAP functional teams (e.g., FI, MM, SD) to ensure seamless integration and data consistency across modules.

Project Management:
Manage end-to-end SAP CO module projects including planning, requirements gathering, design, testing, and go-live support.
Oversee SAP CO HANA transformation and migration projects, ensuring they are delivered on time, within scope, and in budget.
Manage and mentor a team of functional consultants and business analysts.

Team Leadership & Collaboration:
Lead and develop a high-performing team of SAP CO professionals.
Provide guidance on troubleshooting, performance tuning, and solution optimization.
Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into system functionality.

System Maintenance & Support:
Ensure the continued smooth operation of the SAP CO module by providing technical support and troubleshooting.
Oversee regular system upgrades, patches, and performance tuning for SAP HANA.
Monitor and ensure data integrity and consistency across financial and controlling modules.

Continuous Improvement:
Identify opportunities to enhance SAP CO processes and tools for greater efficiency and accuracy.
Stay updated on the latest SAP innovations, particularly SAP S/4 HANA and best practices in CO and finance modules.

Qualifications:
Experience:
8-12 years of hands-on experience with SAP CO, with at least 3-5 years in a leadership or senior management role.
Extensive experience with SAP S/4 HANA implementation, migration, or optimization in a Controlling context.
Proven track record in managing SAP CO projects, end-to-end implementations, or system enhancements.

Skills:
Strong expertise in SAP CO configuration (Cost Center Accounting, Internal Orders, Profit Center Accounting, Product Costing, Profitability Analysis).
Experience with SAP FICO integration (FI, MM, SD, etc.).
In-depth knowledge of SAP S/4 HANA features and capabilities related to CO.
Strong project management skills with a solid understanding of Agile and Waterfall methodologies.
Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.

Education:
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Technology, or a related field. MBA or relevant certifications (e.g., SAP certifications, PMP) are a plus.

Additional Skills/Desirable:
Experience with other SAP modules (e.g., SAP MM, SD, and FI).
Knowledge of financial reporting and compliance requirements.
Ability to work effectively with business users and senior leadership.
Experience with SAP Fiori, SAP Analytics Cloud, or other reporting tools is a plus.

Location: Bangalore / Pune

The Opportunity
We are seeking an experienced Data Architect with strong expertise in data modelling and enterprise data architecture to design scalable, secure, and high-performing data solutions. The role will work closely with business, technology, data engineering, and governance teams to define data architecture and deliver strategic data initiatives.

Principal Responsibilities
Define and implement enterprise and solution-level data architecture aligned with business and technology strategy.
Develop and review conceptual, logical, and physical data models across complex business domains.
Establish data modelling standards, principles, naming conventions, and reusable patterns.
Design architectures for data warehouses, data lakes, lakehouses, and analytical platforms.
Define data integration patterns across ETL/ELT, APIs, batch, and real-time data pipelines.
Assess and recommend appropriate databases, cloud platforms, and data technologies.
Ensure solutions address data quality, governance, security, scalability, and performance.
Partner with data engineers, developers, architects, and business stakeholders to ensure effective implementation.
Review existing data landscapes and define target-state architecture and modernisation roadmaps.
Produce architecture documentation, data models, design standards, and technical recommendations.

Requirements
13+ years of experience in Data Architecture, Data Modelling, Database Architecture, or related roles.
Strong hands-on experience in conceptual, logical, and physical data modelling.
Excellent understanding of relational, dimensional, OLTP, and OLAP data models.
Experience with data warehousing, data lakes/lakehouses, and cloud data platforms.
Strong SQL and database knowledge.
Experience with ETL/ELT, data integration, data governance, metadata, and data lineage.
Exposure to AWS, Azure, or GCP data services is desirable.
Experience with modelling tools such as Erwin, ER/Studio, Sparx EA, or equivalent is advantageous.
Strong analytical, communication, stakeholder management, and documentation skills.
Experience in large and complex enterprise environments preferred.

Qualifications
Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a related field.
Certifications such as DAMA, TOGAF, AWS/Azure/GCP, or equivalent are advantageous.

Account Manager ETS Operations

Summary
We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven professional to lead our Employee Transportation Services (ETS) operations across major Indian cities. In this pivotal role, you will serve as the primary liaison for key corporate clients, ensuring the delivery of exceptional transportation solutions. The ideal candidate will blend strategic account management with hands-on operational expertise to drive client satisfaction, foster long-term partnerships, and optimize service efficiency. This position offers a unique opportunity to shape the future of employee mobility for leading organizations while managing a diverse portfolio of accounts.

Responsibilities
Cultivate and maintain comprehensive relationships with corporate clients, serving as their dedicated point of contact for all matters.
Address daily operational requests, manage service escalations, and resolve account-specific inquiries promptly and effectively.
Develop robust client partnerships to maximize satisfaction rates and ensure high levels of account retention.
Collaborate closely with internal operations teams to guarantee seamless service execution and strict adherence to agreed-upon Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
Supervise end-to-end transportation logistics, including route optimization, staff rostering, vehicle allocation, and trip coordination.
Oversee the performance of fleet vendors, transport partners, and on-ground teams to uphold rigorous service quality standards.
Continuously monitor operational metrics to identify performance gaps and execute timely corrective measures.
Manage client performance reviews, generate detailed MIS reports, coordinate billing processes, and maintain accurate account documentation.
Proactively identify avenues for business expansion, account growth, and the enhancement of service delivery models.


Requirements
Possess a minimum of three years of relevant experience in Account Management, Client Relationship Management, Fleet Operations, or Transportation Services.
Demonstrate a proven track record of managing corporate clients and successfully handling high-value accounts.
Exhibit superior communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management abilities.
Show versatility in balancing client-facing duties with the practical execution of operational tasks.
Display strong analytical skills for problem-solving and effective management of complex escalations.
Maintain a solid understanding of fleet management principles, transportation logistics, and service delivery frameworks.
Be proficient in using MS Excel, creating MIS reports, and interpreting operational dashboards.
Possess excellent verbal and written communication capabilities.
Preferred Industry Background
Candidates with prior experience in the following sectors are highly encouraged to apply:
Food Delivery and Restaurant Account Management
Quick Commerce and E-commerce Key Account Management
IoT Solutions, including GPS Tracking and Dashcam Sales
Automobile Sales and Account Management
Real Estate Sales and Client Relationship Management
Fleet Management and Transportation Services

About the role:

team as a Territory Sales Manager. In this role, you will be responsible for acquiring leads and generating revenue

person and explaining the product.

Minimum 1-5 years of proven sales track record and ability to meet targets.
Lead generation through prospecting referral and web researches
Should have an interest in Business Development (B2C/ B2B) for Software Application Products
/solutions.

benefits with a focus on the value of the solution.


Capabilities of selling Hardware IOT devices

understand the scope of business and their expectations.




Prospect, educate, qualify, and generate interest for Sales Opportunities and lead conversions.
Ability to do product demonstrations to higher level authorities

Researching potential leads from the open market, web searches, or digital resources.

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Should be proficient in English and Regional language (knowing the regional language of the job location
will be a plus).






Should be comfortable working on weekends(Sat & Sun compulsory working), with a week off on Monday.
Effective presentation and negotiation skills.
Hands-on MS Office Excel, Word & PPT, etc.
Ability to handle CRM softwares
A valid drivers license(DL) with a two-wheeler/four-wheeler as this role requires you to be on the field.

What we have to offer!

Working directly with the leadership team; having a high level of work independence, autonomy, and
empowerment to lead company-wide changes


Flexible working hours
Being part of a start-up from an early stage, lead your area of expertise and be a part of this exciting growth
journey of changing the real estate world


Excellent platform for learning how to build teams, achieve goals and handle high-growth situations. Ideal
for people with entrepreneurial ambitions.
Uncapped variables based on performance

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Tribeca is the largest branded luxury developer in India! Established in 2012, we have grown to become the largest developer of Trump-branded properties in the world (after the Trump Organization). Our current employee strength comprises more than 250+ associates across Mumbai, Pune, Delhi-NCR, Kolkata, and Bangalore, and we have a team of incredibly talented, hungry, bright, and passionate folks, including IIT, IIM, Wharton, and SPA toppers and industry stalwarts.

At Tribeca, we are focused on creating world-class products and customer experiences. We are also proud to be developing the world's largest rooftop terrace.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Tribeca is seeking a Manager, Interior Design to lead interior design for luxury high-rise residential projects in Lower Parel, Mumbai. You will oversee design development, approvals, and delivery across sales galleries, show homes, common areas, and residential units, while driving material selection, vendor relationships, and procurement in line with the brands luxury positioning.

LOCATION: Lower Parel, Mumbai
EXPERIENCE: 10+ Years
REPORTING TO: Head Design - West

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

Oversee and manage design development, approvals, and delivery across sales galleries, show homes, common areas, and residential units.
Ensure alignment with the brands luxury ethos and global design sensibilities.
Collaborate closely with internal teams (Project, Sales, Procurement) and external partners (consultants, architects, designers) to ensure smooth coordination and delivery.
Maintain strict adherence to timelines, quality standards, and budget expectations.
Conduct regular site visits to monitor design execution and resolve on-ground challenges.
Drive material selection, specifications, and sourcing decisions in line with the luxury positioning.
Provide creative input while ensuring feasibility, functionality, and execution efficiency.
Support sales teams with design narratives and customer walkthroughs.
Build and manage vendor relationships, including vendor empanelment, evaluation, and development, to maintain a reliable network of high-quality partners.
Source and specify luxury materials and products, including marble, fabrics, chandeliers, chairs, curtains, blinds, fittings, appliances, and wood polishing finishes, drawing on international designs and brands.
Apply a thorough understanding of layouts, materials, and detailing, from overall spatial planning to smaller finishing details.
Manage procurement and coordinate with distributors to ensure timely availability of approved materials and products.
Apply a functional working knowledge of AutoCAD to review and validate design drawings.
Stay well versed in emerging interior design trends, and translate them into project concepts, using platforms such as Pinterest for mood boards and inspiration.

QUALIFICATION & EXPERIENCE

B.Arch (Bachelor of Architecture) is mandatory.
10+ years of relevant experience in interior design, including experience leading or managing design teams.
Developer-side experience is a must.
Luxury residential high-rise project experience is essential.

KEY SKILLS & ATTRIBUTES

Blend of creative vision and technical proficiency
Strong communication and interpersonal skills
Keen eye for detail and aesthetics
Awareness of current design trends and styles
Effective problem-solving abilities
Proficiency in budgeting and cost estimation
Strong project management skills
Understanding of building codes and compliance requirements

Job description: SAP BW4/HANA L3 Support and Enhancement.
A BW/4HANA L3 Support Engineer requires advanced technical support for SAP BW/4HANA systems, resolving complex issues escalated from lower support levels. This role requires deep knowledge of SAP BW/4HANA architecture, data modelling and troubleshooting techniques. Key responsibilities include analysing and resolving critical incidents, performing root cause analysis, and collaborating with development teams for long-term solutions.
Key Responsibilities:
Troubleshooting and Resolution: Investigate and resolve complex technical issues related to SAP BW/4HANA, often involving performance bottlenecks, data inconsistencies, or system errors.
Root Cause Analysis: Conduct thorough root cause analysis to identify the underlying causes of issues and implement preventative measures.
Collaboration: Work closely with L1 and L2 support teams, development teams, and other IT teams to resolve issues and improve system stability.
System Monitoring: Monitor the health and performance of SAP BW/4HANA systems, proactively identifying and addressing potential problems.
Knowledge Management: Document solutions, troubleshooting procedures, and best practices to build a knowledge base for future reference.
Mentorship: Provide guidance and mentorship to junior support engineers.
Incident Management: Manage critical incidents (P1 and P2 tickets) and ensure timely resolution.
System Enhancement: Contribute to the development and implementation of solutions to improve system performance and stability.
Required Skills & Experience:
Deep knowledge of SAP BW/4HANA: Including data modelling, data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes.
Advanced troubleshooting skills: Ability to analyse complex issues, identify root causes, and implement effective solutions.
Strong communication and collaboration skills: Ability to effectively communicate with various stakeholders, including business users and technical teams.
Experience with SAP BW/4HANA administration: Including system configuration, performance tuning, and security.
Experience with ABAP development: For data extraction and transformation.
Knowledge of HANA platforms: (e.g., Native HANA modelling, AMDP) is often preferred.
Experience with incident management and ticketing systems: 3-5 years of experience is required.

Job Description

We are seeking a highly skilled and passionate SAP ABAP Workflow Consultant to join our growing SAP practice. Work with functional consultants and stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical workflow solutions.
Ensure adherence to SAP development standards, best practices, and quality processes throughout the project lifecycle.

Required Skills

Strong hands-on experience in SAP ABAP Workflow Development.
Expertise in SAP Business Workflow configuration and development.
Experience with BOR (Business Object Repository) and ABAP OO Workflow.
Good knowledge of Workflow Administration, Event Management, Agent Determination, and Rule Resolution.
Strong ABAP development skills including Reports, Enhancements, BAdIs, User Exits, Function Modules, and Object-Oriented ABAP.
Experience in workflow debugging, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
Knowledge of SAP S/4HANA workflow framework will be an added advantage.
