Job Description (JD) – SAP BRIM SOM Consultant
Position: SAP BRIM SOM Consultant
Experience: 6–12 Years
Location: PAN India / Hybrid
Employment Type: Full-Time


Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced SAP BRIM SOM (Subscription Order Management) Consultant with 6–12 years of SAP experience and hands-on expertise in SAP BRIM solutions. The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of subscription lifecycle management, order orchestration, billing integration, and end-to-end BRIM processes.
Key Responsibilities
Design, configure, and support SAP BRIM SOM solutions for subscription-based business models.
Work closely with business stakeholders to gather and analyze requirements.
Configure and customize SAP SOM processes including:
Subscription Order Capture
Order Fulfillment and Orchestration
Product Modeling
Contract Management
Change Processes (Upgrade, Downgrade, Renewals, Cancellations)
Integrate SOM with:
SAP Convergent Charging (CC)
SAP Convergent Invoicing (CI)
SAP Billing and Revenue Innovation Management (BRIM)
SAP CRM/S4HANA
Develop functional specifications and support technical development teams.
Perform system testing, SIT, UAT, and production deployment activities.
Troubleshoot and resolve issues across BRIM modules.
Participate in solution design workshops and provide best practice recommendations.
Prepare project documentation and knowledge transfer materials.
Required Skills
6–12 years of SAP experience with 3+ years in SAP BRIM SOM.
Strong experience in:
SAP Subscription Order Management (SOM)
SAP BRIM Solution Architecture
Product Catalog & Product Modeling
Subscription Lifecycle Management
Order Distribution & Fulfillment
Master Data Management
Good understanding of:
SAP Convergent Charging (CC)
SAP Convergent Invoicing (CI)
FI-CA
SAP S/4HANA integration
Experience in integration technologies:
SOAP/REST APIs
Web Services
SAP CPI/PI/PO
Strong debugging and issue resolution skills.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in Telecom, Media, Utilities, or Subscription-based industries.
Exposure to SAP BRIM implementation or transformation projects.
SAP BRIM/SOM certification preferred.
Experience in Agile delivery methodologies.
Educational Qualification
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related discipline.

Thanks & Regards,
Gayatri Gupta

Job Description
Job Title: Product Lifecycle Risk Manager, AVP
Location: Mumbai, India
Alternative Locations: Pune, India / Bangalore, India


Role Description:
Today, markets face a whole new set of pressures but also a whole lot of opportunity too. Opportunity to innovate differently. Opportunity to invest responsibly. And opportunity to make change.
Join us at DWS, and you can be part of an industry-leading firm with a global presence. You can lead ambitious opportunities and shape the future of investing. You can support our clients, local communities, and the environment.
We’re looking for creative thinkers and innovators to join us as the world continues to transform. As whole markets change, one thing remains clear; our people always work together to capture the opportunities of tomorrow. That’s why we are ‘Investors for a new now’.
As investors on behalf of our clients, it is our role to find investment solutions. Ensuring the best possible foundation for our clients’ financial future. And in return, we’ll give you the support and platform to develop new skills, make an impact and work alongside some of the industry’s greatest thought leaders. This is your chance to achieve your goals and lead an extraordinary career.

About DWS Investment Risk:
The Chief Risk Office within DWS is an independent function responsible for protecting the business as well as being a trusted adviser and partner for supporting sustainable business growth.
As part of the Chief Risk Office, Investment Risk provides independent oversight and challenge of risks arising from DWS fiduciary activities, including the governance of investment products throughout their lifecycle.
The Product Life Cycle Risk Team is responsible for the New Product Approval framework, related policies, procedures, controls and governance tooling. The team works closely with Business, Investment, Product Management and control functions to support robust, transparent and regulatory-compliant product decisions.

What we’ll offer you
As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy
Best in class leave policy
Gender neutral parental leaves
100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
Accident and Term life Insurance
Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above

Your key responsibilities
Manage and further develop Product Risk processes, policies, controls and governance frameworks across the product lifecycle, ensuring consistent, scalable and effective standards.
Manage and continuously enhance the New Product Approval (NPA) framework, including transparent prioritization of initiatives and effective management of dependencies across the product pipeline.
Perform independent 2LoD reviews of NPA submissions and support the relevant Risk Type Heads in assessing and signing off product initiatives, including the identification, challenge and escalation of material risks and control gaps.
Own and further develop the NPA platform and related governance tooling, driving system enhancements, process automation and scalable workflow solutions.
Coordinate Product Governance activities across Business, Investment, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Operations and other control functions to ensure initiatives are complete, decision-ready and progressed effectively through the governance process.
Support governance committees and contribute to global Product Lifecycle initiatives through management information, decision materials, governance records, regulatory implementation and process transformation.

Your skills and experience
University degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience, with at least five years of relevant experience in Asset Management, Product Governance, Product Management, Risk Management, Compliance, Operations, Regulatory Change or a related governance or control function.
Strong understanding of investment products, asset management operating models, product lifecycle management and Product Governance frameworks within a regulated financial services environment.
Knowledge of relevant regulatory requirements, with the ability to assess regulatory developments and translate their impact into appropriate governance processes, policies and controls.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with proven ability to independently review and challenge complex product initiatives, identify material risks and control gaps, and formulate clear, practical recommendations.
Experience managing or enhancing governance processes, workflows and control frameworks, including translating governance requirements into system enhancements and supporting tool implementation, testing, migration or automation initiatives.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management and organizational skills, with the ability to prepare concise materials for senior stakeholders and committees, constructively influence cross-functional teams and deliver high-quality outcomes across competing priorities.
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and Word; experience with data analytics, reporting tools or process automation solutions is advantageous.

How we’ll support you
Training and development to help you excel in your career
Coaching and support from experts in your team
A culture of continuous learning to aid progression
A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs

Role & responsibilities
The Sales Executive shall be responsible for promoting and selling solar power solutions offered by Gibbon Infrastructures Pvt. Ltd., with a primary focus on residential rooftop solar installations under the PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana, along with commercial and industrial solar projects.
The employee shall be responsible for lead generation, customer acquisition, site visit coordination, documentation, sales conversion, order booking, payment follow-up, and coordination with the installation and technical teams to ensure smooth execution of solar projects.

Preferred candidate profile
A minimum Class X pass candidate with good communication skills, a positive attitude, and the ability to generate leads and develop customer relationships in the solar power sector.

Perks and benefits
Annual Bonus: Annual bonus as per company policy and applicable eligibility criteria.
Travel Allowance (TA): Travel expenses for authorised official visits and sales activities, as per company policy.
Daily Allowance (DA): Daily allowance for eligible official travel and field assignments, subject to applicable company rules.

AboutCompany:
GIBBON INFRASTRUCTURES PVT. LTD.
Company Profile
Renewable Energy | Solar Power Solutions | Civil Construction & Infrastructure Development
1. About the Company
Gibbon Infrastructures Pvt. Ltd. is an infrastructure and renewable energy company engaged in the solar power industry since 2021, alongside civil construction and infrastructure development activities. The company is committed to delivering reliable, technically sound, and cost-effective solutions that address the growing demand for sustainable energy and quality infrastructure.
With a focus on professional project execution, customer satisfaction, and responsible business practices, the company undertakes solar power installations and civil construction works for residential, commercial, institutional, and other project requirements.
Through its presence in the renewable energy sector and its involvement in construction activities, Gibbon Infrastructures Pvt. Ltd. aims to contribute to India's clean energy transition and infrastructure development.
2. Solar Power & Renewable Energy Division
Since 2021, the company has been engaged in solar power solutions, supporting the adoption of renewable energy through rooftop solar installations and commercial solar projects. Its activities include project planning, system supply, installation, testing, commissioning, and associated technical services.
The company undertakes solar projects across a range of capacities, from 3 kW residential rooftop systems to large-scale projects of up to 100 MW, subject to project scope and technical requirements.
Key Areas of Expertise
Residential rooftop solar power systems.
Solar installations under the PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana.
Commercial and industrial solar power projects.
On-grid, hybrid, and off-grid solar solutions.
Solar photovoltaic (PV) system design and installation.
Supply, installation, testing, and commissioning of solar systems.
Solar project coordination and technical support.
Assistance with project documentation and relevant utility coordination.
The company works with solar equipment brands including Premier, Pahal, Adani, Vikram Solar, INA, Microtek, and Citizen, subject to project specifications and availability.
3. Civil Construction & Infrastructure Division
In addition to renewable energy, Gibbon Infrastructures Pvt. Ltd. undertakes civil construction and infrastructure-related works. The company recognises the importance of sound engineering practices, proper planning, quality materials, and efficient execution in delivering durable and dependable infrastructure.
Scope of Activities
Civil construction and building works.
Plain Cement Concrete (PCC) and Reinforced Cement Concrete (RCC) works.
Structural and allied construction activities.
Site preparation and development.
Foundation and related civil works.
Construction support for solar power installations.
Other civil and infrastructure works as per project specifications.
The company seeks to execute projects in accordance with applicable technical requirements, contractual obligations, safety practices, and agreed project schedules.
4. Our Vision
To establish Gibbon Infrastructures Pvt. Ltd. as a trusted organisation in renewable energy and infrastructure development by delivering sustainable solutions, maintaining professional standards, and creating long-term value for clients and stakeholders.
5. Our Mission
To promote the adoption of clean and renewable energy.
To deliver reliable and efficient solar power solutions.
To undertake civil construction works with a focus on quality and durability.
To maintain transparency, accountability, and professionalism in business operations.
To develop long-term relationships through customer satisfaction and dependable project delivery.
To contribute to sustainable development through responsible construction and energy solutions.
6. Our Core Values
Quality: Maintaining appropriate standards in materials, workmanship, and project execution.
Integrity: Conducting business with transparency, accountability, and ethical practices.
Reliability: Focusing on dependable solutions and professional service delivery.
Safety: Promoting safe working practices across project sites and operations.
Sustainability: Supporting renewable energy adoption and environmentally responsible development.
Customer Focus: Understanding client requirements and providing solutions aligned with project objectives.
7. Our Approach to Project Execution
Gibbon Infrastructures Pvt. Ltd. follows a project-oriented approach based on understanding client requirements, planning resources, coordinating technical activities, and executing works in accordance with agreed specifications.
For solar projects, the approach may cover site assessment, system design, equipment selection, installation, testing, commissioning, and associated documentation. For civil construction projects, the approach focuses on work planning, material and resource coordination, construction quality, site safety, and timely completion.
8. Commitment to Sustainable Development
The company recognises the growing role of renewable energy and dependable infrastructure in economic and social development. By operating across solar power and civil construction, Gibbon Infrastructures Pvt. Ltd. seeks to support energy efficiency, infrastructure improvement, and sustainable growth.
The company remains committed to strengthening its capabilities, developing professional partnerships, and delivering value-driven solutions for its clients.
9. Conclusion
Gibbon Infrastructures Pvt. Ltd. combines its experience in the solar power industry since 2021 with its involvement in civil construction and infrastructure works. Through a commitment to quality, technical competence, responsible execution, and customer satisfaction, the company aims to build lasting relationships and contribute meaningfully to India's renewable energy and infrastructure sectors.
GIBBON INFRASTRUCTURES PVT. LTD.
Powering a Sustainable Future. Building Infrastructure for Tomorrow.

COMPUTER TEACHER JOB DESCRIPTION
Position

Computer Teacher
Responsibilities
Provide quality computer training to students in the assigned school and conduct classes
online when required.
Plan and deliver engaging, age-appropriate computer lessons using clear explanations,
demonstrations, activities, and practical sessions.
Conduct regular computer laboratory/practice sessions and guide students through
hands-on exercises.
Prepare lesson plans, teaching materials, presentations, worksheets, assignments, and
practice exercises.
Conduct students assessments in a timely manner, including class tests, practical
assessments, assignments, and project work.
Evaluate student performance, provide constructive feedback, and support students who
require additional guidance.
Maintain student assessment data, attendance, records, and documentation of the
programs work in the school.
Use student-centered teaching methods and encourage participation, questioning,
problem-solving, creativity, and practical learning.
Maintain classroom discipline and ensure responsible use of computers, internet
resources, and laboratory equipment.
Conduct classes as per applicable government guidelines and the school’s academic
requirements.
The instructor has to conduct classes at ZPHS.
Support school-level administration of the project and complete project-related work
assigned by the reporting officer.
Coordinate with school staff and the reporting officer regarding schedules, student
progress, assessments, and program activities.
Deliver sessions in English and the official language of the state, as required.
Technical Skills
Strong knowledge of computer fundamentals, operating systems, file management, and
basic troubleshooting.
Proficiency in MS Office applications such as Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

Knowledge of internet usage, email, online safety, digital citizenship, and basic cyber-
safety practices.

Knowledge of coding/programming concepts and ability to teach age-appropriate coding
through languages or platforms such as HTML, CSS, Python, Scratch, or similar tools.
Ability to conduct practical computer laboratory sessions and guide students through
coding and application-based exercises.

Ability to use digital teaching tools, online classrooms, presentations, multimedia
resources, and educational software.
Basic understanding of computer hardware, peripherals, networking concepts, and
common software installation/troubleshooting.
Ability to prepare digital learning materials, assessments, and student-performance data.
Teaching & Classroom Skills
Create structured lesson plans aligned with the prescribed curriculum and
government/school guidelines.
Explain technical concepts in simple, student-friendly language and adapt teaching to
different learning levels.

Use demonstrations, practical exercises, group activities, projects, quizzes, and real-
world examples to make lessons interactive.

Monitor student understanding during lessons and provide timely remedial support.
Manage classroom and computer-lab behavior while promoting a safe, respectful, and
inclusive learning environment.
Track learning outcomes and use assessment results to improve teaching and student
support.
Encourage students to develop logical thinking, problem-solving, creativity, digital
confidence, and responsible technology use.
Qualifications
B. Tech (any branch), MCA, or M.Sc. (Computer Science).
Any graduation with coding training certification.
Candidates with M. Tech / B. Ed. are given preference.
Experience
1+ years of experience in IT training, with familiarity in assessments, evaluation, and
practice sessions.

Location

Nagaland (Wokha)

Description:
Trainee, Program Implementation
Location: Nagaland, Haryana
About Program Operations and Logistics Sub-vertical
Antarang Foundation runs 2 programs: 1) Career Aware with students of municipal schools and low-income private schools studying in 9th and 10th standard across Mumbai, Pune, Udaipur and Goa. 2) Career Ready with students of low-income private junior colleges studying in 11th and 12th standard across our five geographies. The role of Program Operations and Logistics Sub-vertical is to provide end to end support to the facilitators and partner schools/colleges to be able to deliver the program with the required quality. From orienting the schools/colleges at the start of the year, distributing the books/materials to them, allocation of facilitators, to ensure data comes back on a timely basis and gets scanned and uploaded on to our systems, we do it all.
Position Overview
If you have a knack for management, multi-tasking, problem solving coupled with the traits like consistency, spontaneity and dependability, this is the place you may want to be in.
This position is an opportunity for you to impact the career journeys of more than 60,000 young adults and you will need to do everything to make their experience with us, a smooth and memorable one. You will specifically have a very important role in working with our High-tech OMR scanner to ensure student information gets uploaded on our systems timely and accurately. This is a Full-time position and requires an dependable and committed candidate who has an eye for detail.
Responsibilities
Data Management and Upload (PRIMARY): Ensuring filled OMR sheets come back on a timely basis from facilitators
Checking if the sheets are filled as expected, else getting it rectified with facilitators
Scanning approx 2000 sheets per hour on our high tech scanner and and doing minor troubleshooting if required
Operations and Administration: Sorting and Packaging of student books and getting it couriered to schools
Operations and Administration: Managing the storage of books and scanned OMRs and optimum utilization of office space.
Operations and Administration: Packaging of gifts/momentos if required and couriering it to all the Headmasters
Operations and Administration: Maintaining the inventory of medium wise books and other program Related materials
Vendor Management: Coordinating with the vendors (Courier, Books printing and Scanner) to get the tasks done
Vendor Management: Maintaining the bills/invoices and submitting it to the Finance department
Communication: Coordinating with Headmasters to share the progress and solve for the issues Escalate it on a timely basis to ensure speedy resolution of the same
Communication: Keeping the internal teams looped in to seek their support and inputs
Communication: Writing emails to the stakeholders in reference to the task in hand
Student Support and Tracking: Making student support calls to collect information and tracking their journeys post of our programs
Student Support and Tracking: Maintaining, updating the database with the same and preparing reports
Student Support and Tracking: Interpreting data from dashboards and reporting trends to the team.
Profile Requisites
Minimum 1-year commitment required with 8.5 hrs per day
Ability to multitask and prioritize tasks
Clear verbal and written communication, knowledge of local language
Tech Savvy (comfortable using Microsoft Office; confident of learning to operate scanners, dashboards)
Ability to do a certain task multiple times with focus without getting bored
Readiness to give hand and feet support even at odd hours (if and when required).

Description:
Position: Regional Head Northeast: Manipur, Nagaland and Assam (Programmes, Partnerships & Business)

About Dharmalife
Dharmalife (www.dharmalife.in) is a social impact organization advancing inclusive progress across India through two core pillars — People and Planet. Working in over 40,000 villages across 15 states, it has built a rural network of 20,000+ women entrepreneurs, known as Dharmalife Entrepreneurs (DLEs), who drive sustainable community development.

The organization works alongside women by enhancing their economic power, agency, and leadership, while addressing key social and environmental challenges. Through this network of DLEs, Dharmalife promotes sustainable livelihoods, behaviour change, and solutions across key domains — Health, Well-being, Livelihood, Education, Care, Clean Energy, Sustainability, and Circular Economy.

By 2030, Dharmalife aims to advance 1 million rural women through sustainable livelihoods and care support. Its group entities — Dharmalife Foundation, Gajam India Pvt. Ltd., Dharmalife Labs, and Dharmalife Society — work together to create lasting systemic change at scale.

Position Summary
The Regional Head – Northeast-Manipur, Nagaland and Assam is the senior leadership position in the region responsible for driving Dharmalife’s growth, programme delivery, partnerships, and operational excellence across the region.

The role combines four critical dimensions:
Business and Sales Growth through the Dharmalife Entrepreneur (DLE) network
DLE Group Development and Entrepreneur Ecosystem Strengthening
High-Quality Execution of Donor and CSR-Funded Programmes
Strategic Government and Institutional Partnership Development

The Regional Head serves as the primary representative of Dharmalife within the Northeast region, along with central office functions, and is responsible for achieving commercial, social impact, operational, and stakeholder engagement objectives across all assigned districts

Key Responsibilities

1. Business Growth & Revenue Generation
Drive state-level sales and revenue targets across region, across Dharmalife products, services, and programme-linked business opportunities.
Strengthen entrepreneur productivity, customer outreach, and market penetration.
Develop district-wise growth plans and sales strategies.
Monitor sales conversion, order fulfilment, collections, inventory movement, and business performance.
Identify new business opportunities and market expansion areas.
Improve DLE earnings and income-generating opportunities.
Drive sustainable business growth through community-based distribution models.

2. DLE (Dharmalife Entrepreneur) Network Development & Community Engagement
Lead recruitment, onboarding, activation, and retention of DLEs and DLTs.
Build and strengthen village-level DLE groups and entrepreneur collectives.
Increase active participation and engagement of women entrepreneurs.
Develop leadership capabilities among high-potential DLEs.
Ensure regular field engagement, group meetings, and entrepreneur support.
Improve entrepreneur retention and productivity.

3. Programme & Project Execution
Lead implementation of donor-funded and CSR-supported programmes across the Northeast.
Ensure achievement of programme deliverables, timelines, budgets, and impact indicators.
Monitor beneficiary outreach, training completion, adoption metrics, and community engagement.
Ensure high-quality implementation across Health, Livelihood, Education, Care, Clean Energy, Sustainability, Circular Economy, and future programmes.
Maintain programme documentation, field evidence, case studies, and reporting standards.
Support surveys, assessments, research activities, audits, and donor visits.
Ensure safeguarding, compliance, and quality standards are maintained.

4. Government & Strategic Partnerships
Develop strategic relationships with: State Rural Livelihood Missions (SRLMs); Women & Child Development Department; Labour Department; Education Department; Tribal Development Department; Skill Development Missions; Renewable Energy Agencies; District Administration; and Panchayati Raj Institutions
Build partnerships with CSR foundations, corporate partners, financial institutions, NGOs, development organizations, Academic and research institutions
Identify opportunities for programme convergence, co-funding, and scale-up.
Represent Dharmalife at state-level/ region level forums, consultations, and stakeholder meetings.
Facilitate approvals, coordination, and institutional support for programme implementation.

5. Team Leadership, Governance & Operations
Lead and mentor Territory Channel Managers, Cluster Heads, Enterprise Leaders, and other teams.
Drive performance management, coaching, and capability development.
Conduct regular reviews and field visits.
Ensure compliance with organizational policies and operating procedures.
Monitor budgets, resource utilization, and operational efficiency.
Ensure data quality, reporting discipline, and governance standards.

Candidate Profile

Education
Graduate or Postgraduate in: Rural Management; Business Administration; Social Work; Development Studies and Related disciplines

Experience Required
8–12 years of relevant experience.
Experience in rural markets, social enterprises, development sector, livelihood promotion, microfinance, channel management, CSR, or large-scale field operations.
Proven experience managing multi-district or state-level teams across the region.
Demonstrated success in both programme delivery and business development.
Experience working with government stakeholders and donor-funded programmes will be preferred.

Competencies Required

Leadership Competencies: Strategic Thinking; Execution Excellence; Team Leadership; Ownership & Accountability

Functional Competencies: Rural Market Development; Programme Management; Sales & Business Development; Stakeholder Engagement; Partnership Development; Community Mobilisation; Data-Driven Decision Making;

Behavioural Competencies: Integrity; Collaboration; Resilience; Learning Agility; Entrepreneurial Mindset; Relationship Building

Travel Requirement
This position requires extensive travel across the Northeast, including regular visits to the Head office (Delhi), villages, DLE groups, programme sites, government offices, partner organizations, and district headquarters. Field immersion and direct stakeholder engagement are critical success factors for this role.

Why Join Dharmalife
This role is a chance to lead one of India's largest women-led rural entrepreneurship and impact ecosystems and to directly contribute to livelihoods, sustainability, community development, and social transformation at scale.
AboutCompany: Dharmalife is a grassroot level social impact organization committed to fostering inclusive progress for both people and the planet. Its initiatives are driven by women change agents, known as Dharmalife Entrepreneurs (DLEs), and are supported by data-driven insights, innovative approaches, and technology. Operating through a network of over 20,000 rural women entrepreneurs across 40,000 villages in 15 states, Dharmalife has positively impacted more than 17.5 million individuals, including 500,000 children. We aim to enhance womens economic autonomy and leadership while promoting sustainable practices, thereby contributing to the creation of resilient communities. By 2030, Dharmalife aims to empower 1 million rural women through sustainable employment, livelihood growth, and care support.

A field service engineer's responsibilities usually focus on the the interaction of multiple technical systems and components and software. They are often seen performing direct maintenance or repairs on complex technology systems. Field service engineers' responsibilities may include, for example: Troubleshooting problems.
Job role
1.On-Site Maintenance and Repairs: Conduct regular inspections, maintenance, and repairs on a wide range of oil and gas equipment, including fuel dispensers and other types of equipment at retail outstations like Petrol pumps, to ensure their optimal performance and minimize downtime.
2.Troubleshooting: Diagnosing and troubleshooting complex technical issues that may arise during the operation of equipment, utilizing a deep understanding of the specific systems and processes involved in our industry.
3. Installation and Commissioning: Assisting with the installation, configuration, and commissioning of new equipment (fuel dispensers and other types of equipment at retail outstations like Petrol pumps), ensuring that it operates according to specified guidelines and safety standards.

6.Documentation and Reporting: Maintaining detailed records of service activities, including maintenance schedules, repairs performed, and any modifications made, and providing comprehensive reports to supervisors or management as required.
7.Training and Knowledge Sharing: Attending training sessions or workshops to enhance the understanding of equipment operations, maintenance procedures, and safety protocols.
8.Field Operations Coordination: Collaborating with other team members, including engineers, technicians, and project managers, to coordinate field operations, prioritize tasks, and ensure timely and effective resolution of technical issues.

Description:
Field Enumerators (15 Posts): Position Summary:
We are seeking dedicated and enthusiastic Field Enumerators to conduct baseline assessments for students in primary schools. The successful candidates will visit schools, interact with children to make them feel comfortable, ask assessment questions, and accurately record their responses using a provided tool. This role requires excellent communication skills, proficiency in English, and the ability to use technology effectively. Prior experience working with primary-grade children is highly desirable.
Key Responsibilities:
Visit assigned schools to conduct baseline assessments with students.
Create a welcoming and comfortable environment for children to ensure accurate and honest responses.
Ask assessment questions as per the guidelines and record responses using the designated tool.
Ensure accuracy and completeness of recorded data.
Report any issues or inconsistencies encountered during the assessments to the project supervisor.
Maintain the confidentiality and integrity of the data collected.
Adhere to the schedule and complete the assessments within the stipulated timeframe.
Utilize technology tools efficiently to record and manage data.
Communicate effectively with school staff and maintain a professional demeanor at all times.
Qualifications/Requirements:
Must have a two-wheeler to travel to conduct the assessments
Proficiency in English (both written and spoken) is a mandatory requirement.
Proficiency in the local language is required.
Basic knowledge and experience in using tech tools and software.
Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to make children feel at
ease.
Attention to detail and accuracy in data recording.
Ability to work independently and manage time effectively.
Flexibility to travel to various school locations as required.
High school diploma or equivalent; higher education in education, psychology, or a
related field is a plus point.
Functional area:
Chozuba Block, Dist. Phek
Employment type:
Temporary/Contract
Salary:
450 INR per day + 250 INR Travel allowance

Description:
Job Summary
The Employment Livelihood Supervisor will be responsible for supporting the implementation, supervision, and monitoring of employment, livelihood, skilling, entrepreneurship, and value-chain development initiatives across Nagaland.
The role will work closely with youth, entrepreneurs, producers, community groups, artisans, trainees, government departments, financial institutions, corporates, development partners, and other stakeholders to ensure effective implementation of programmes and achievement of project outcomes.
Responsibilities
Employment Livelihood Programme Implementation: Support the planning and implementation of Employment Livelihood programmes and projects.
Coordinate day-to-day field activities and ensure timely achievement of programme targets.
Supervise programme activities across assigned locations and ensure compliance with project plans and guidelines.
Identify implementation challenges and coordinate with the concerned team for timely resolution.
Livelihood Value-Chain Development: Support the implementation and strengthening of various livelihood value chains promotion.
Work with producers, entrepreneurs, community groups, and other stakeholders across different stages of the value chain, including production, processing, value addition, packaging, marketing, and market linkage.
Support initiatives related to Banana Fibre, Pineapple Fibre, and other livelihood enterprises.
Assist in identifying opportunities for improving productivity, product development, market access, and income generation.
Document challenges, learnings, innovations, and success stories from livelihood interventions.
Financial Institution-Supported Initiatives: Support the implementation and field-level coordination of programmes undertaken in collaboration with development and financial institutions.
Coordinate with beneficiaries, entrepreneurs, producer groups, community institutions, and project stakeholders.
Ensure that project activities and deliverables are implemented in accordance with approved plans and timelines.
Support beneficiary identification, mobilisation, training, enterprise development, monitoring, and reporting.
Maintain accurate project records and supporting documentation as required by partners and funding agencies.
Youth Mobilisation Employment Support: Mobilise youth for employment, skill development, entrepreneurship, and livelihood opportunities.
Conduct outreach activities in communities, educational institutions, training centres, and other relevant locations.
Support career guidance, job-readiness, and employment-related activities.
Facilitate linkages between youth and relevant employers, training institutions, and livelihood opportunities.
Track employment and livelihood outcomes of programme participants.
Enterprise Entrepreneur Support: Provide field-level support to aspiring and existing entrepreneurs.
Assist entrepreneurs in identifying opportunities, challenges, and potential market linkages.
Support enterprise development activities, including business planning, capacity building, product development, and market access.
Coordinate with relevant technical experts, financial institutions, and market partners where required.
Field Supervision Stakeholder Coordination: Conduct regular field visits to monitor programme activities and beneficiary progress.
Supervise field staff, mobilisers, trainers, and other project personnel, as assigned.
Build and maintain relationships with government departments, financial institutions, employers, educational institutions, community organisations, producer groups, and other stakeholders.
Represent in field-level meetings, workshops, consultations, exhibitions, and other programme events.
Monitoring, Documentation Reporting: Maintain accurate records of beneficiaries, enterprises, training activities, production, employment, placements, and livelihood outcomes.
Collect, verify, and maintain programme data and supporting documentation.
Prepare regular field visit reports, progress reports, case studies, success stories, and other project documentation.
Track project indicators, milestones, outputs, and outcomes against approved targets.
Support the preparation of reports and updates required by YouthNet s partners and funding agencies.
Market Linkages Promotion: Support market linkage initiatives for products developed through livelihood value chains.
Assist in identifying potential buyers, institutional markets, retailers, distributors, and other market opportunities.
Support exhibitions, fairs, product showcases, buyer-seller meets, and promotional activities.
Coordinate with relevant teams on branding, packaging, marketing, and product promotion.
Key Deliverables
Timely and effective implementation of assigned Employment Livelihood projects.
Achievement of beneficiary, training, employment, enterprise, and livelihood targets.
Effective field-level implementation of financial institution-supported initiatives.
Strengthened livelihood value chains.
Increased participation of youth and communities in sustainable livelihood and employment opportunities.
Improved market and institutional linkages for livelihood enterprises.
Accurate and timely programme data, documentation, and reporting.
Regular field monitoring and follow-up with beneficiaries and stakeholders.
Documentation of programme outcomes, success stories, and lessons learned.
Qualifications Requirements
Bachelor s degree in Development Studies, Social Work, Rural Development, Management, Economics, Sociology, Agriculture, Entrepreneurship, or a related field.
2-4 years of relevant experience in livelihood development, employment, entrepreneurship, skill development, value-chain development, community development, or programme implementation.
Experience working with development organisations, government programmes, financial institutions, NGOs, CSR programmes, or donor-funded projects will be an advantage.
Experience in livelihood value chains, enterprise development, market linkages, or community-based programmes will be preferred.
Familiarity with the socio-economic and livelihood context of Nagaland will be an advantage.
Key Skills Competencies
Employment and livelihood programme implementation
Value-chain and enterprise development
Field supervision and community mobilisation
Youth engagement and employment facilitation
Stakeholder and partner coordination
Market linkage and business development
Monitoring, data collection, and reporting
Team coordination and problem-solving
Strong written and verbal communication
MS Office/Google Workspace proficiency
Willingness to undertake frequent field travel across Nagaland
Personal Attributes
Strong ownership and accountability
Proactive and solution-oriented approach
Good interpersonal and community engagement skills
Ability to work with diverse stakeholders
Strong organisational and coordination skills
Adaptability to field-based working environments
Commitment to youth development, employment generation, and sustainable livelihoods
Employment type
Full Time
Notes
For Queries - Working Hours: Monday to Friday (10:00 am to 4:30 pm)
Or you can upload your resume via WhatsApp and one of our YouthNet Job Centre Representatives will call you back

Job Summary
NagaEd is seeking a Program Manager to lead the implementation, monitoring evaluation (ME), and stakeholder engagement for a portfolio of school education programs in rural areas. Based in Nagaland, this role is crucial in ensuring that these programs are delivered effectively, aligned with community needs, and contribute to improving teaching quality and school outcomes. The role will involve managing junior team members, contributing to program design, and ensuring that stakeholder voices are integrated into program implementation and improvements.
Organisational Unit Function
1. Program Implementation
Oversee and coordinate the implementation of a portfolio of education programs and school improvement initiatives in rural schools across the assigned districts.
Ensure all program interventions align with state and national education policies (e.g., NEP 2020).
Support teacher training sessions and ensure schools adopt best practices across programs.

The Senior People Officer is the experienced HR generalist within NagaEd, responsible for managing the applicant tracking system (ATS) pipeline, maintaining HR documentation and policies, administering compliance filings, and supporting the full employee lifecycle with growing independence. This role bridges the gap between administrative HR execution and strategic people operations handling complex HR processes that require judgement, accuracy, and a working knowledge of Indian employment practice. Reporting to the Operations Manager, the Senior People Officer takes ownership of HR processes rather than simply executing them. Where the People Officer handles coordination and data entry, this role manages the ATS pipeline end-to-end, drafts and maintains HR policy documents, prepares compliance filings, conducts initial screening of candidates, supports performance review administration, and serves as a knowledgeable resource on HR processes for the wider team. The Senior People Officer also provides task-level guidance to the People Officer and People Associate on shared workflows. Success in this role is measured by the quality and currency of HR documentation, the integrity of recruitment and employee data, the timeliness of compliance filings, and the ability to manage HR processes independently while knowing when to escalate.


Job Details
Department: Operations
Direct Reports: None (provides task-level guidance to People Officer / People Associate)
Manager: Operations Manager
Mentor/support: Operations Manager
Location: Kohima


Organisational Unit Function
ATS Pipeline Recruitment Management: Manage the applicant tracking system maintaining pipeline stages, updating candidate statuses, and ensuring data integrity throughout the recruitment cycle. Conduct initial CV screening and shortlisting against position description criteria, preparing shortlist recommendations for the hiring manager and Operations Manager. Coordinate and support interview processes scheduling panels, preparing assessment materials, collecting interviewer scorecards, and compiling evaluation summaries. Draft offer letters, employment contracts, and pre-employment correspondence for the Operations Manager s review and approval. Maintain recruitment analytics time-to-fill, pipeline conversion rates, and source effectiveness and surface insights to the Operations Manager. Ensure a professional, timely, and consistent candidate experience across all touchpoints.
HR Documentation Policy Administration: Maintain, update, and version-control NagaEd s HR policy documents, SOPs, the Employee Handbook, and associated templates. Draft new HR policies and SOP updates as directed by the Operations Manager researching best practice and ensuring alignment with Indian employment law requirements. Ensure all employees have signed and acknowledged current versions of key HR documents employment contracts, NDAs, handbook acknowledgements, and code-of-conduct agreements. Manage the HR documentation lifecycle drafting, review routing, approval tracking, distribution, and archiving maintaining a clear audit trail. Prepare HR correspondence confirmation letters, role change notifications, warning letters, and other employee communications for the Operations Manager s review.
Compliance Filing Statutory Administration: Prepare and coordinate statutory compliance filings POSH annual returns, Shops and Establishments Act returns, Professional Tax, and other applicable filings in coordination with the Operations Manager and external advisors. Maintain compliance calendars and trackers, ensuring all filing deadlines are surfaced to the Operations Manager at least two weeks in advance. Support POSH compliance administration maintaining the Internal Complaints Committee (ICC) register, scheduling mandatory awareness training, and tracking completion. Coordinate with the Senior Finance Officer on employee-related statutory matters EPF, ESIC, and TDS records ensuring consistency between HR and finance records. Prepare documentation for labour inspections, audits, and regulatory queries as required.
Employee Lifecycle Records Management: Manage the HRIS (Zoho People or equivalent) employee master data, employment history, contract records, probation dates, and lifecycle milestones. Administer the probation review cycle tracking probation end dates, sending reminders to reviewing managers, compiling review documentation, and preparing confirmation or extension letters. Process employee changes promotions, transfers, reporting line updates, and salary revisions ensuring all changes are documented, filed, and reflected in HR systems. Maintain accurate and complete personnel files for all employees, ensuring audit readiness at all times. Administer the offboarding process exit checklists, knowledge transfer coordination, access revocation, final settlement documentation, and exit interview scheduling.
Performance Management Engagement Support: Support performance review cycles distributing review templates, tracking submission deadlines, compiling completed reviews, and maintaining performance records. Administer the goal-setting and OKR/KPI tracking process, ensuring all employees have current documented goals and that review cadences are maintained. Support the Operations Manager in running engagement initiatives pulse surveys, recognition programmes, team events, and feedback mechanisms. Compile and analyse HR data for engagement reporting participation rates, survey results, and trend tracking presenting summaries to the Operations Manager.
Leave, Attendance Payroll Coordination: Oversee leave and attendance management reviewing leave records for accuracy, resolving discrepancies, and maintaining up-to-date leave balances. Prepare monthly payroll inputs attendance summaries, leave adjustments, new joiner and leaver details, and variable components for handoff to the finance function. Respond to employee queries on leave policy, entitlements, and attendance with accuracy and in a timely manner.
Team Coordination Task Guidance: Provide day-to-day task-level guidance and quality checks to the People Officer and People Associate on recruitment coordination, data entry, filing, and onboarding logistics. Serve as the first escalation point for HR process queries from NagaEd staff before matters reach the Operations Manager. Ensure continuity of people operations during the Operations Manager s absence by maintaining standing HR processes and escalation protocols.


Reporting Relationships
This role reports directly to the Operations Manager. The Senior People Officer works with all NagaEd staff and managers on HR processes, coordinates with external advisors on compliance matters, and collaborates with the finance function on payroll and statutory employee contributions. The role does not hold formal line-management authority but provides task-level guidance to the People Officer and People Associate.


Selection Criteria
This role requires an experienced HR generalist who can manage multiple HR processes with accuracy and growing independence. The Senior People Officer must have a working knowledge of Indian employment practice, be comfortable drafting HR documents, and be able to exercise judgement on routine HR matters while knowing when to escalate.


Essential
Minimum 2 3 years of experience in HR generalist, HR administration, or people operations roles.
Working knowledge of Indian employment law fundamentals leave entitlements, POSH obligations, statutory filings, employment contract requirements.
Experience managing an ATS or structured recruitment pipeline.
Strong documentation and writing skills able to draft policies, SOPs, employment letters.

Network Engineer (1Post): Qualifications:
Bachelor s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Network Engineering, Electronics & Telecommunications, BCA, or a related field.

Knowledge of network security, firewalls, access control management.
Ability to troubleshoot and resolve network, connectivity, and hardware-related issues.
Experience in network design, implementation, optimization, capacity planning, and performance tuning.

Description:
Bada Business Pvt Ltd is looking for Business Counselors to join our dynamic team and embark on a rewarding career journey
Must have good listening skills and be passionate about sales, with a keen interest in understanding and addressing client needs.

Collaborate with the sales team to develop effective strategies for acquiring new clients and retaining existing ones.

Meet or exceed sales targets while maintaining high levels of customer satisfaction.
Conduct follow-up calls and meetings to ensure customer satisfaction and identify opportunities for upselling or cross-selling.
Continuously seek feedback from clients to improve service delivery and enhance the overall customer experience.
Demonstrate empathy and understanding in addressing client concerns and objections.
Stay updated on product knowledge and sales techniques to enhance performance and productivity.

Description:
The Educator, Art Labs will lead and facilitate impactful, art-based learning sessions in classrooms, promoting creative expression and social-emotional development among children. This role will involve regular observation and documentation of classroom dynamics and student engagement. This role will shape the holistic growth of the children by driving a community-building movement in our model school, thereby creating strong evidence on art and SEL in classrooms.


Roles and Responsibilities

1. School Scouting and Art Lab Development
Identify and visit potential schools where Art Labs can be set up.
Assess schools based on available space, infrastructure, student strength, school leadership, and readiness to support an Art Lab.
Meet principals and teachers to understand the schools needs and assess the feasibility of setting up and sustaining an Art Lab.
Document school visits and share findings to support school selection and planning for Art Lab setup.
Coordinate with selected schools to support the setup of Art Labs and their integration into regular school activities.


2. Government Engagement and Stakeholder Relationships
Build and maintain relationships with relevant state and district government officials, including the Education Department, SCERT, DIET, and other relevant institutions.
Share SArCs approach and work with government stakeholders and explore opportunities to establish and strengthen Art Labs in schools.
Coordinate with government officials, funders, and school leadership to facilitate school visits, address implementation needs, and support program delivery.
Work with artists, volunteers, and creative professionals to bring additional art experiences to children.


3. Art Facilitation and Classroom Engagement
Facilitate joyful and inclusive art sessions for children from Grades 1 to 8 throughout the academic year.
Adapt existing art lesson plans to suit childrens needs, interests, and classroom contexts while keeping the intended learning outcomes in mind.
Create a classroom environment where children feel comfortable expressing themselves, sharing ideas and exploring their creativity.
Guide children through reflection and discussion to help them express their thoughts, listen to others, and develop self-awareness.
Design visual teaching aids and lead school-wide art projects, exhibitions and installations that give children opportunities to explore relevant social and community themes through art.


4. Field Observations and Research
Conduct school visits and structured classroom observations to understand how art education is practised, and the challenges schools and teachers face.
Collect information through classroom observations, interviews with teachers and school leaders, and other research tools as required.
Support research studies on art education, teaching practices, student engagement and the implementation of Art Labs.
Prepare field visit reports, case studies and summaries of findings, highlighting challenges, patterns and practices that can inform program decisions.
Work with the Research and Impact team to plan school visits, collect data and maintain accurate records.


5. Curriculum and Monitoring and Evaluation (ME)
Work closely with the Curriculum and ME teams to share feedback from classrooms and schools on the relevance, suitability, and implementation of art activities.
Identify gaps in lesson plans, teaching resources and facilitation approaches based on classroom experiences, teacher feedback and student participation.
Share specific recommendations on what needs to change in the curriculum, activities or teaching resources to meet childrens needs better and address classroom realities.
Support the Curriculum team in reviewing and testing revised activities and resources, and share feedback on their effectiveness.
Work with the ME team to document classroom observations, track student progress, and assess whether sessions are meeting their intended outcomes.
Maintain relevant program records, including classroom dashboards, field notes, and documentation of childrens work, to support program review and improvement.


Qualifications and Experience
A graduate degree in Education, Arts, Child Development, or a related field is required. A postgraduate degree is an added advantage.
3-4 years of experience in teaching and classroom facilitation, preferably in creative learning or arts-integrated settings.
Experience working with low-income or underserved school communities will be an advantage.
Strong understanding of child-centred pedagogy, experiential learning and childrens social-emotional development.
Experience in classroom observation, documentation and using feedback or data to improve teaching and learning.
Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work with children, teachers, school leaders, government stakeholders and internal teams.
Alignment with Saturday Art Classs vision of making arts education an integral part of public school education.
Skills and Mindset
Facilitation and empathy: Creates inclusive spaces where children feel safe to express themselves and explore their creativity.
Curriculum adaptation: Can work with art-based curricula and adapt activities and lesson plans to suit childrens needs, abilities and classroom contexts while keeping learning objectives in mind.
Ownership and organisation: Takes responsibility for tasks and outcomes, manages multiple priorities and meets deadlines with minimal supervision.

Summary
The Area Sales Manager is a key strategic leader within the solar energy industry, responsible for driving revenue growth and expanding market presence across a defined geographic region. This role focuses on building and managing a high-performing B2B sales team, cultivating relationships with commercial and industrial clients, and executing targeted sales strategies to achieve aggressive quarterly and annual targets. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in B2B sales within the renewable energy sector, with a proven ability to navigate complex procurement processes, negotiate long-term contracts, and deliver scalable solar solutions. As a critical link between the organization and its enterprise clients, the Area Sales Manager plays a pivotal role in advancing sustainable energy adoption, contributing to corporate sustainability goals, and strengthening the companys position as a leader in the solar industry.

Responsibilities
Develop and execute regional sales strategies aligned with company growth objectives and market opportunities in the solar energy sector.
Lead, mentor, and manage a team of B2B sales representatives, ensuring performance excellence through coaching, goal setting, and regular feedback.
Identify, qualify, and pursue new commercial and industrial B2B prospects, focusing on solar PV system installations for businesses, manufacturing facilities, and institutional clients.
Build and maintain strategic relationships with key decision-makers at enterprise accounts, including facility managers, sustainability officers, and procurement teams.
Collaborate with technical and project development teams to deliver customized solar solutions that meet client energy needs and financial objectives.
Analyze market trends, competitor activity, and customer behavior to refine sales approaches and improve win rates.
Prepare and present detailed proposals, financial models, and ROI analyses to support client decision-making.
Track and report on sales pipeline, forecast accuracy, and KPIs using CRM platforms to ensure transparency and data-driven planning.
Ensure compliance with industry regulations, safety standards, and company policies throughout the sales and project handoff process.

Requirements
Requirements:
Bachelors degree in Business, Engineering, Renewable Energy, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
Proven experience (5+ years) in B2B sales, with a strong track record of exceeding sales targets in the renewable energy, clean tech, or construction industry.
In-depth knowledge of solar energy systems, including photovoltaic (PV) technology, financing models (PPA, lease, cash purchase), and incentive programs (e.g., ITC, state rebates).
Demonstrated ability to manage complex sales cycles involving multi-stakeholder decision-making and long-term contracts.
Proficiency in CRM software (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and Microsoft Office Suite for reporting, forecasting, and client presentations.
Strong negotiation, presentation, and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence at the executive level.
Valid drivers license and willingness to travel extensively within the assigned region.
Experience in team leadership and performance management, including hiring, training, and performance evaluation.
Familiarity with sustainability metrics and ESG reporting is a plus.

Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
401(k) plan with company match
Paid time off, holidays, and professional development opportunities
Company-sponsored training in solar technology and sales strategy

- Ability to work with sales targets and manage multiple leads.
- Basic knowledge of MS Excel, CRM tools, and dialer operations.
- A customer-focused attitude with a passion for education and career counselling.

Salary & Benefits
- Salary as per experience, skills, and company norms.
- Attractive performance-based incentives.
- Opportunity to work in the growing EdTech and online education sector.

Description:
Lead - Business Development
About the Role:
The role will spearhead strategic revenue growth by driving enterprise customer acquisition and expansion across key verticals and geographies. The role demands deep industry insight, strong solutioning capability, and the ability to build executive relationships within large organizations. As a senior leader, you will own the go-to-market strategy, shape high-value logistics solutions for clients, and build a scalable and high-performing BD team.
Key Responsibilities:
Drive Revenue Growth: Lead and deliver aggressive revenue targets on a monthly and quarterly basis through new customer acquisition and strategic account expansion in the logistics and supply chain domain.
Enterprise Sales Ownership: Identify, engage, and convert large B2B clients particularly those with complex freight, warehousing, and distribution needs across industries such as retail, FMCG, manufacturing, and e-commerce.
Market Development: Launch and scale presence in new geographies; perform competitive intelligence, demand mapping, and localization of offerings to suit regional market dynamics.
Team Leadership: Build, mentor, and lead a high-impact BD team; establish scalable processes for lead generation, funnel management, and account growth.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Operations, Product, Pricing, and Finance to develop compelling proposals, pilot programs, and commercial models.
Performance Tracking: Own pipeline forecasting, sales performance metrics, and revenue attribution; regularly report to executive leadership on growth performance and strategic initiatives.
Client Success & Retention: Ensure seamless client onboarding, continuous engagement, and upselling of adjacent logistics services such as reverse logistics, express delivery, or value-added services.
Preferred Background & Skills:
5+ years of experience in B2B sales or business development, with a strong focus on logistics, LTL/PTL, FTL, freight forwarding, 3PL/4PL, or supply chain tech platforms.
Strong track record of closing complex enterprise deals, especially in contract logistics, transportation management, and integrated logistics solutions.
Deep understanding of supply chain processes including LTL, FTL, warehousing, distribution networks, and logistics tech platforms.
Data-driven, solution-oriented mindset with strong commercial acumen.
Ability to work in a high-growth, agile environment with rapidly evolving priorities.
Local market knowledge or regional exposure is a strong advantage.
AboutCompany:
Delhivery is India's leading supply chain services company.
The company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, LTL and FTL freight, reverse logistics, cross-border, B2B & B2C warehousing and technology services.
Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, logistics operations of the highest quality and cutting-edge engineering and technology capabilities

Description:
About the Role
We are looking for a sharp, energetic, and customer-focused Associate Inside Sales to join our Intracity Logistics business. The role will involve managing customer relationships, driving retention and growth, and identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling through effective inside sales.
The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, a sales mindset, and the ability to build meaningful customer relationships while working in a fast-paced environment.
What You’ll Do
Manage a portfolio of customers and build strong, long-term relationships.
Drive customer retention and engagement through regular follow-ups and proactive account management.
Handle inbound and outbound sales calls to generate business opportunities.
Identify customer needs and recommend relevant Delhivery solutions.
Drive upselling and cross-selling opportunities within existing accounts.
Work closely with customers to understand their requirements and ensure a positive customer experience.
Support customer success by resolving queries and coordinating with internal teams for timely closure.
Maintain accurate customer and sales information and track opportunities through the sales funnel.
Meet defined sales, retention, revenue, and customer engagement targets.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve customer experience and business growth.
What We’re Looking For
0–3 years of experience in inside sales, account management, customer success, relationship management, telesales, or a similar customer-facing role.
Freshers with excellent communication skills and a strong interest in sales may also be considered.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Confident in handling inbound and outbound calls and engaging with customers.
Strong relationship-building and customer-handling skills.
Good sales orientation with the ability to upsell and cross-sell.
Sharp, proactive, and target-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Basic proficiency in MS Office/Google Workspace and CRM tools
Prior experience in logistics, e-commerce, D2C, or B2B sales will be an added advantage.

Job Summary

Proficiency in SQL and database concepts.
Experience with relational databases such as Oracle, SQL Server, DB2, PostgreSQL, or MySQL.
Knowledge of DataStage components including:
Designer
Director
Administrator
Manager
Parallel Jobs
Sequence Jobs
Understanding of data warehousing concepts and dimensional modeling.
Experience in Unix/Linux commands and shell scripting.
Knowledge of source code management tools such as Git.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.

RELATIONSHIP MANAGER

OYO is a global platform that aims to empower entrepreneurs and small businesses with hotels and homes
by providing full-stack technology products and services that aims to increase revenue and ease

world. OYO offers 40+ integrated products and solutions to patrons who operate over 157K hotel and

Location

Multiple

•
•

proactively

booking conversions
Ensure cluster performance of customer & guest experience metrics, especially focusing on
bottom properties in the cluster
•
•
•
Ensure collection of accounts receivable/outstanding amount from portfolio clients
Resolve issues arising between property owners, customers & internal stakeholders
Share regular feedback on market conditions, trends, competition, pricing and other factors
influencing on ground business

Indicators

•
•
•
Ensuring occupancy (URNs) month on month
Pay at Hotel (PAH) realization
Ensuring daily availability of Sellable rooms (DSRN)
Cx / Gx metrics

Networking ability 
Soft Skills (ERP/APP usage, Excel, Email writing)  
Good negotiation skills 
Analytical ability

Description:
Department: HCD (Projects & Services Division)

Tasks :
1.Facility Development & Project Execution: Review designs, specifications, BOQs and P&IDs; supervise mechanical installation, testing and commissioning; coordinate with EPC contractors, consultants and vendors; monitor progress, quality, cost and timelines.

2.HVAC & Cleanroom Engineering: Review and execute HVAC for classified areas, covering HEPA filtration, air changes, pressure cascades and environmental control; coordinate testing, commissioning and qualification.

3.Process Utilities: Supervise installation, commissioning and maintenance of chillers, cooling towers, AHUs, steam and pure steam, WFI, purified water, compressed air and gases, boilers, ETP, exhaust systems and cold storage.

4.Equipment Integration: Coordinate mechanical and utility requirements for bioreactors, fermenters, purification systems and filling lines; ensure hygienic design and maintainability; support qualification documentation.

5.Maintenance & Facility Operations: Develop preventive, predictive and corrective maintenance programmes; ensure utility availability; maintain equipment records and asset plans; implement AMC/CAMC; coordinate calibration and statutory compliance; support deviations, change control and CAPA.

6.GMP, Qualification & Compliance: Ensure compliance with WHO-GMP, Schedule M, biosafety and contamination control; support DQ, IQ, OQ and PQ; coordinate with QA, QC, Validation and Production; support inspections and audits.

7.Tendering & Contract Management: Prepare specifications, BOQs, DPRs, estimates and tender documents; evaluate bids and vendors; monitor contractor performance and handover of completed facilities.

Requirements
Maximum Age: 40 years as on 01.11.2026 for BE / B.Tech holders;
45 years as on 01.11.2026 for Diploma holders

Basic pay range: Rs. 30,000 - 50,000 per month
Gross Salary: Rs. 61,830.00 (Non-Metro) (approx.) at the minimum of the scale.
Annual CTC: 8.82 Lakhs (Non-Metro) (approx.) at the minimum of the scale.

Qualification:
Essential: BE / B.Tech in Mechanical.
OR
Diploma in Engineering (Mechanical).

Post Qualification Experience:
For Degree holders, minimum 3 years of post-qualification experience in mechanical engineering for the planning, design, development, execution, installation, commissioning, qualification and maintenance of vaccine and biologicals manufacturing facilities, pharmaceutical or biotechnology facilities, similar institutes. Experience in cleanroom HVAC, GMP-compliant utilities and industrial process systems, and in project execution, installation, commissioning and facility maintenance. Knowledge of WHO-GMP, Schedule M, biosafety and contamination control requirements.

For Diploma holders, minimum 10 years of post-qualification experience in mechanical engineering for the planning, design, development, execution, installation, commissioning, qualification and maintenance of vaccine and biologicals manufacturing facilities, pharmaceutical or biotechnology facilities, similar institutes. Experience in cleanroom HVAC, GMP-compliant utilities and industrial process systems, and in project execution, installation, commissioning and facility maintenance. Knowledge of WHO-GMP, Schedule M, biosafety and contamination control requirements.

Essential Technical Competencies
Cleanroom HVAC and controlled environmental systems.
GMP-compliant process utilities.
WFI and Purified Water Systems.
Steam, Pure Steam and Compressed Air Systems.
Chillers, Boilers and Industrial Utility Systems.
Biological manufacturing equipment integration.
Equipment qualification and commissioning.
Preventive and predictive maintenance.
Technical tendering, procurement and project management.
AutoCAD, P&ID and engineering drawing interpretation.

Job Description:
To develop and expand the business in Industrial & building segments in assigned/ territory.
Responsible to deliver targets on sales volume, price and grow the business significantly & consistently
Responsible for market intelligence, generating project leads & proactively pursuing them to a logical conclusion.
Generate inquiry data bank & track the progress on regular basis and seek support wherever required.
Drive brand / product differentiation in the market by Thermal / Acoustic Performance of Stonewool and Glasswool products.
To work with sales team, System-providers like drywall companies, roofing, civil, insulation contractors and HVAC contractors, to develop techno-commercially viable and value-added insulation solution for this sector.
Closely co-ordinate with all supporting functions to deliver upon the agreed business strategy.
Create Brand / Product awareness based on applications / performance among the specification community/ OEMs & look for opportunities for converting other types of insulation to Stonewool and Glasswool in Industrial & building segments.
Implement all key initiatives to achieve the strategy & growth.
Develop & maintain effective networking with Architects and Consultants within the Industrial & building segments through specifications.
Promote System Selling for dry wall partitions, sandwich panel applications etc.
Thorough knowledge about Thermal calculations & energy savings and solution based technical bidding.
Track the Stonewool and Glasswool specified projects & ensure their conversion by closely working with sales team in the region.
Independently submit and clear technical bids and work with sales team to clear techno commercial bids.

Requirements:

5+ years of experience in sales, client relationship management, and front office operations.
Proven track record in achieving sales targets, managing large accounts, and leading sales teams.
Experience in cold-calling, prospecting, and relationship development for sales opportunities.
Strong understanding of inside sales processes and ability to prepare sales reports and forecasts regularly.
Excellent communication skills and proficiency in CRM tools such as Apollo.io, HubSpot, and ZoomInfo.
Prior experience in managing retail sales forces, implementing marketing activities, and supervising sales promotions.
Knowledge of sales tools and strategies to capture key demographics, drive sales growth, and meet business goals effectively.

Fosroc is a leading global manufacturer of construction chemicals and performance solutions for the construction industry. Established in 1934 in the UK, the company has built a strong international presence across India, the Middle East, Asia-Pacific, and Africa.

Brushbond (Waterproofing)
Renderoc (Repair mortars)
Nitoseal (Sealants)
Global Presence
Operations in around 20+ manufacturing facilities globally
Presence in 70+ countries
Strong market leadership in India and the Middle East
Approximately 3,000 employees worldwide

Description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
The Position
Role Overview
The Squad Lead sets and delivers the Outcome-Based Plan for the assigned cluster. End-to-end accountable for regional portfolio ambitions and patient outcomes, the role operates across the Visionary, Architect, Catalyst, and Coach (VACC) leadership model.
Key Responsibilities
Strategy & Vision: Define and execute the cluster s strategic ambition in alignment with affiliate priorities and North Star goals.
Ecosystem Shaping: Co-create partnerships with key regional and corporate accounts to accelerate access to Roche innovations.
Agile Execution: Define and oversee high-impact work packages, resource allocation, and operating models in collaboration with Disease Area Squads and Key Account Managers.
People & Network Leadership: Coach Patient Journey Partners (PJPs) and cross-functional network teams; break down internal silos to drive collective execution.
Compliance: Ensure uncompromising adherence to safety, industry codes, and Roche compliance standards, keeping patients at the center.
Qualifications
Strong track record of leadership in Roche-relevant therapy areas(esp. Hemat-Oncology).
Proven experience in strategic account management, system shaping, and multi-stakeholder partnerships.
Demonstrated ability to lead and coach cross-functional or agile network teams.
Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100 000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let s build a healthier future, together.

About the Role
We are looking for a sharp, energetic, and customer-focused Associate Inside Sales to join our Intracity Logistics business. The role will involve managing customer relationships, driving retention and growth, and identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling through effective inside sales.
The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, a sales mindset, and the ability to build meaningful customer relationships while working in a fast-paced environment.
What You’ll Do
Manage a portfolio of customers and build strong, long-term relationships.
Drive customer retention and engagement through regular follow-ups and proactive account management.
Handle inbound and outbound sales calls to generate business opportunities.
Identify customer needs and recommend relevant Delhivery solutions.
Drive upselling and cross-selling opportunities within existing accounts.
Work closely with customers to understand their requirements and ensure a positive customer experience.
Support customer success by resolving queries and coordinating with internal teams for timely closure.

Confident in handling inbound and outbound calls and engaging with customers.
Strong relationship-building and customer-handling skills.

Sharp, proactive, and target-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Basic proficiency in MS Office/Google Workspace and CRM tools
Prior experience in logistics, e-commerce, D2C, or B2B sales will be an added advantage.

Someone who is sharp, articulate, proactive, and comfortable speaking to customers every day—someone who enjoys sales and account management, takes ownership, learns quickly, and can turn customer conversations into meaningful business opportunities.
