Role Overview:
The Assignment Manager will be responsible for the end-to-end management of physical security operations across high-profile client sites in the South Zone of India. This includes ensuring effective deployment of personnel, compliance with client protocols, documentation accuracy, stakeholder engagement, crisis readiness, and operational audits. The Assignment Manager is expected to maintain high discipline standards, handle large-scale operations seamlessly, and serve as the bridge between the client, site security teams, and the G4S backend.
This role demands strong leadership, a proactive mindset, technical know-how, and non-negotiable communication excellence. Impeccable fluency in spoken English with the right accent, grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation is strictly mandatory.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Site Operations Oversight:
Plan and deploy daily security personnel as per shift schedules and site-specific SOPs.
Conduct briefing sessions across all shifts and ensure grooming, discipline, and attendance compliance.
Prepare and manage MDR, shift schedules, and site logs.
Carry out efficient patrolling of internal and perimeter areas.
Observe and respond to suspicious man/material movements.
Ensure access control compliance and critical access management (labs, restricted zones).
Maintain visitor/vendor records, key logs, badges, and lost & found registers.
Conduct weekly security training and refresher briefings.
Perform surprise night inspections to assess readiness of night staff.
2. Technical Systems & Documentation:
Ensure the uptime and functionality of CCTV, access control systems, and FAPA equipment.
Maintain workstations audit, badge audits, and access key audits.
Coordinate with facility teams for system rectification and AMC partner activities.
Take access approvals via eApproval portals.
3. Reporting & MIS:
Share daily, weekly, and monthly operations reports with G4S and designated site managers.
Maintain event trackers, alarms reports, RPM data, incident logs, and vendor performance records.
Support site managers in Hyderabad, Mumbai, Delhi, and Gurugram for consolidated reporting.
4. Emergency & Incident Management:
Act as the first escalation point for medical emergencies, duress alerts, or system-triggered alarms.
Liaise with EMEIA SOC for remote access control and video retrieval.
Prepare incident reports, investigate breaches, and implement CAPAs.
Conduct mock drills, shutdown protocols, and risk preparedness activities.
5. Client & Stakeholder Coordination:
Respond to client queries and share required reports (daily/weekly/monthly) within agreed SLAs.
Attend virtual coordination meetings with client-side managers to sync activities Pan India.
Coordinate closely with facilities and places teams for smooth operations, approvals, and events.
Handle onboarding/offboarding of employees with badge issuance and access revocation.
6. G4S Internal Coordination:
Share weekly duty rosters, attendance, and nominal rolls with G4S backend.
Coordinate on salary concerns, health insurance issues, and uniform issuance.
Maintain leave records and escalate absenteeism trends.
Work with Key Account Managers to resolve operations-related escalations.

Minimum Requirements:
Graduate in any discipline (mandatory)
Minimum 5-10 years of experience in security operations management
Experience handling multi-location operations preferred
Prior exposure to multinational corporate environments in IT sector shall be very advantageous for the candidate.
Essential Competencies:
Communication: Fluent spoken and written English (mandatory); clarity, grammar, and pronunciation will be tested.
Operational Skills: Security deployment, documentation, SOPs, reporting tools.
Technical Proficiency: Familiar with access control, surveillance systems, e-portals, and Microsoft Office.
Leadership & Ethics: High integrity, team management skills, crisis-handling experience.
Behavioral Traits: Attention to detail, time-sensitive decision-making, calm under pressure.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
100% compliance in daily deployment & reporting
95% uptime for security equipment and systems
2 critical incidents per year (with timely CAPA)
SLA adherence for report submissions and audits
Staff discipline, grooming, and performance audit scores 90%

About Us:
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytms mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.

About the team:
Oil & Gas. This team is directly responsible for growth of Oil and Gas offline transactions & users at Paytm.

About the role:
Team Lead KAM - To work with the business to understand and manage Programs being run for the Clients/Brands. And for accelerating the core growth metrics focusing on sales & distribution. Provides guidance and instruction to a working group about a project or portfolio of projects. These leads are responsible for monitoring the efforts of the team members and getting the work done effectively and efficiently with the proper utilization of resources.

Skills that will help you succeed in this role:

2+ yrs. of experience in Distribution sales in fintech, Banking/ Sales, EDC Sales.
Develop plans and strategies for developing business and achieving the company's sales goals.
Create a culture of success and ongoing business and goal achievement.
Hire and build a new team to support our growing needs and future projects.
Define optimal sales force structure.
Define and coordinate sales training programs that enable staff to achieve their potential and support company sales objectives.
Manage customer expectations and contribute to a high level of customer satisfaction.
Define sales processes that drive desired sales outcomes and identify improvements.
Going to the Merchant and educating him/her about the benefits of the Swipe machine (EDC) converting them and managing their accounts.
Exceptional communication, presentation skills and relationship building skills.
Ability to aggressively manage the successful execution of a sales strategy.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.

Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, or a related field (MBA preferred).
Should have a strong understanding of the local language.
Self-motivated and goal-oriented, with a demonstrated ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Willingness to travel as needed to meet with clients and attend industry events.

Education: Applicants must possess bachelor’s degree or above

Why join us: We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Our success is rooted in our people’s collective energy and unwavering focus on the customers, and that is how it will always be. We are the largest merchant acquirer in India

Job Summary
The Territory Manager is responsible for driving sales growth, market development, and customer engagement across the assigned territory. The role partners closely with healthcare professionals, distributors, and key stakeholders to expand product adoption, support clinical utilization, and deliver territory-specific growth strategies across the Trauma and CSOT portfolios.

Achieve or exceed sales targets across the assigned Trauma and CSOT product portfolios.

Identify new business opportunities and convert prospective accounts into active customers.
Provide product support and clinical assistance during procedures, including operation theater engagements when required.
Conduct product education programs and training sessions for healthcare professionals and distributor teams.
Analyze market trends, customer needs, and competitor activities to develop territory growth plans.
Execute territory-specific sales strategies and business development initiatives to increase market penetration.
Communicate customer feedback, market insights, and product improvement opportunities to internal stakeholders.
Qualifications
High School Diploma (or equivalent) and 6+ years experience
Associate's Degree and 4+ years experience
Bachelor's Degree and 2+ years experience

On-the-Job Training: Take part in training sessions to improve your skills and grow within the role.

Passion for exploring and discovering Chandigarh s FB, lifestyle, cultural, and entertainment experiences. Proficiency in content management and social media platforms.
Familiarity with SEO principles and keyword research tools.

About the Role
We are looking for an experienced and target-driven Assistant Manager – Key Accounts (Inside Sales) to lead a high-performing team of 15-20 associates and drive revenue growth, customer retention, and own end-to-end account management
The ideal candidate will have strong experience in Inside Sales, Key Account Management, Customer Retention, and Account Management, with a proven track record of achieving challenging business and growth targets. You should have a strong understanding of the sales funnel and complete sales lifecycle, along with the ability to coach and develop large sales teams that become trusted advisors for our client partners.
Key Responsibilities
Lead, manage, and motivate a team of 15-20 Inside Sales/Key Account associates.
Own and deliver revenue, sales, growth, retention, and productivity targets for the team.
Develop and execute strategies to drive account growth, upselling, cross-selling, and customer retention - own the sales retention funnel to drive SoW gain and increase order frequency 
Drive performance across the entire sales lifecycle and identify opportunities to improve conversion at each stage.
Analyze sales metrics, team productivity, revenue performance, conversion ratios, retention, and other key KPIs. Identify performance gaps and implement structured sales training, coaching, and improvement plans.
Conduct regular performance reviews, coaching sessions, and team huddles to improve individual and team performance.
Work closely with cross-functional teams such as Operations, Customer Success, Marketing, and Product to improve customer experience and business outcomes.
Build forecasting mechanisms and ensure accurate tracking of pipeline, revenue, and growth targets.
Establish a strong performance-oriented culture focused on customer retention, revenue growth, productivity, and conversion.
Have a pulse on the voice of the customer that could help build critical product/experience improvements to build client stickiness on the platform 
What We’re Looking For
3+ years of overall experience, with significant experience in Inside Sales / Account Management / Key Account Management / Customer Retention.
Prior experience managing a large sales team of 30+ members is highly preferred.
Proven experience of managing and delivering revenue and growth targets.
Strong understanding of the inside sales process, sales funnel, and end-to-end sales lifecycle.
Demonstrated experience in customer retention, account growth, upselling, and cross-selling.
Strong analytical and data-driven approach to sales and team management.
Excellent people-management, coaching, and communication skills.
Ability to work in a high-pressure, target-driven environment.
Strong understanding of sales metrics such as conversion rate, revenue per associate, productivity, pipeline, retention, churn, and achievement against target.
Strong stakeholder management and problem-solving abilities.

Position Title: Area HR Partner- Upper North (Third Party Contractual)

Reports to: Lead HR Retail (North and East)

Note: This role is on one year contract. Based on performance we can convert this role on-rolls, but if not then after one year the contract will terminate after one year

Location: Chandigarh (First two months in Gurgaon office)

Position Summary:
The Retail HR role partners closely with retail operations to support people-related initiatives across stores. The role focuses on driving hiring, employee engagement, capability development, and compliance while building a strong connect with store teams and supporting the overall employee experience in the region

Key Objectives:
Manage the end-to-end employee lifecycle for retail employees including recruitment, onboarding, engagement initiatives, training and development, and exit interviews.
Drive hiring across retail stores by identifying and leveraging both internal and external recruitment sources to ensure timely closure of open positions.
Partner with retail operations stakeholders and store managers to understand manpower requirements and support people-related decisions across stores.
Assess behavioral and capability development needs of store employees and coordinate relevant training programs with internal or external trainers.
Plan and manage the monthly employee engagement calendar across stores to strengthen employee connect and morale.
Coordinate and ensure timely and accurate submission of payroll inputs for retail employees.
Conduct regular store visits to interact with employees, gather feedback, understand on-ground challenges, and support resolution of employee concerns.
Track attrition trends and employee feedback across stores and work with business leaders to drive retention and employee experience initiatives.
Ensure effective implementation of company policies across stores and monitor compliance with statutory requirements, including maintenance of statutory registers and documentation.
Actively participate in various company forums and people initiatives within the organization.

Eligibility Criteria and Functional Competencies Required:
MBA / PGDM students specializing in HR or related fields.
2-4 years of HR experience, preferably in retail, hospitality, or other customer-facing industries.
Prior experience in managing store hiring, employee engagement, and HR operations will be an advantage.
Good communication and coordination skills.
Working knowledge of MS Excel and PowerPoint.
Ability to manage multiple tasks and work with multiple stakeholders.

Founded in 1948, PUMA designs and sells footwear, apparel, and accessories for sports and everyday fashion. The brand operates across categories such as running, football, training, basketball, and motorsport, and is known for combining performance, innovation, and street style.

Drive customer retention and engagement through regular follow-ups and proactive account management.

Identify customer needs and recommend relevant Delhivery solutions.
Drive upselling and cross-selling opportunities within existing accounts.
Work closely with customers to understand their requirements and ensure a positive customer experience.
Support customer success by resolving queries and coordinating with internal teams for timely closure.
Maintain accurate customer and sales information and track opportunities through the sales funnel.
Meet defined sales, retention, revenue, and customer engagement targets.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve customer experience and business growth.
What We’re Looking For
1–5 years of experience in inside sales, account management, customer success, relationship management, telesales, or a similar customer-facing role. Freshers with excellent communication skills and a strong interest in sales may also be considered.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Confident in handling inbound and outbound calls and engaging with customers.
Strong relationship-building and customer-handling skills.
Good sales orientation with the ability to upsell and cross-sell.
Sharp, proactive, and target-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Basic proficiency in MS Office/Google Workspace and CRM tools

The role requires strong operational leadership, commercial acumen, and the ability to drive service excellence while maintaining profitability and operational efficiency.

Role & responsibilities

Ensure consistent achievement of all customer and operational SLAs.
Lead end-to-end fulfillment center operations, including inbound, inventory management, order fulfillment, dispatch, returns, and quality control.
Own and manage the fulfillment center P&L, driving cost optimization and productivity improvements.
Develop and execute strategies to improve operational efficiency, customer experience, and business performance.
Drive workforce planning, capacity management, and resource utilization.
Monitor operational KPIs and implement corrective actions to address performance gaps.
Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, vendors, and internal stakeholders.
Lead continuous improvement initiatives through process optimization, automation, and best practices.
Ensure compliance with safety, quality, and operational standards.
Mentor and develop teams while fostering a culture of accountability, ownership, and high performance.

Preferred candidate profile

Strong expertise in fulfillment center, warehousing, supply chain, and logistics operations.
Proven ability to consistently deliver operational and customer SLAs.
Strong P&L management and business acumen.
Excellent interpersonal, stakeholder management, influencing, and persuasion skills.
Strong leadership capabilities with experience managing large teams.
Self-driven, proactive, and highly accountable with an ownership mindset.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, and data analysis/reporting tools.
Ability to leverage AI tools and technologies to improve productivity, reporting, decision-making, process automation, and operational efficiency.
Strong communication and presentation skills.

Job Description
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

About Us:
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytm mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.

About the role:
To sell products or services for a company and represent their brand. Also, to manage relationships with customers, serving as the key point of contact, from initial lead outreach to when a purchase is ultimately made.
Expectations/ Requirements:
1. Grow Distribution and Market share in the assigned area (Rural) of operations.
2. Visibility and Accountability through sale of the financial products.
3. Identify and recruit the sales team (FSE) to align and drive business in the market.
4. Skilled in coaching and mentoring, a quick learner who grasps and puts into application new learned ideas and concepts.
5. Plan the market size, span and geographies for FSE.
6. Should be able to devise the best methods for communication of plans/targets to the team so as to minimize the expectations vs delivery gap.
7. Monitor the Quality parameters as suggested by the management.
8. Validate and conduct the audits on the acquisitions and sales done by the team.
9. Ensure the team members are in the market where sales & usage are done regularly
10. Should have good networking capabilities and be willing to travel extensively throughout their specified area.
11. Sale of cross sales product to existing and new merchants like Merchant Loan, Personal Loan, GOLD SIP etc along with Upgrades for the merchant
12. Good understanding of lending products
13. Able to train and groom the manpower allocated to him
Education :
Graduate or above / Post Graduation preferred.

Why join us:
1. A collaborative output driven program that brings cohesiveness across businesses through technology
2. Improve the average revenue per use by increasing the cross-sell opportunities
3. A solid 360-degree feedback from your peer teams on your support of their goals
4. Respect, that is earned, not demanded from your peers and manager

Compensation:
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you. With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story.

As a professionally trained Lady Security Guard for G4S, you could be a member of the security team responsible for securing premises, such as building sites, courts, shops, warehouses, banks and factories. 12. Handle patient grievances politely and escalate them to the hospital management or the State Health Agency (SHA), Bihar helpline when needed.

About the Role:

ORCHIDS The International School is looking for a highly motivated, target-oriented, and parent-focused Parent Relationship Manager Inside Sales to drive admissions and build strong relationships with prospective and existing parents.
The role will be responsible for managing admission enquiries, counselling prospective parents, conducting systematic follow-ups, converting qualified leads into admissions, and ensuring a smooth parent journey from the initial enquiry through enrolment.
The ideal candidate should have excellent communication and convincing skills, a strong customer-service mindset, and the ability to understand parent requirements and recommend the school's offerings appropriately.
Key Responsibilities
Lead Management & Inside Sales
Handle inbound and outbound calls with prospective parents regarding school admissions.
Respond promptly to leads generated through calls, website enquiries, digital campaigns, walk-ins, referrals, and other channels.
Understand the family's requirements, child's age/grade, preferred curriculum, location, and other admission-related needs.
Explain the school's curriculum, academic approach, facilities, co-curricular activities, fee structure, admission process, and key differentiators accurately.
Qualify leads based on defined admission criteria and maintain systematic follow-up.
Convert prospective parent enquiries into school visits, counselling sessions, applications, and confirmed admissions.
Follow up with prospective parents through calls, WhatsApp, email, and other approved communication channels.
Maintain consistent engagement with leads throughout the admission funnel.
Handle objections related to fees, curriculum, location, transport, academics, facilities, and competition in a professional and solution-oriented manner.
Achieve defined monthly and annual admission and conversion targets.
Parent Counselling & Relationship Management
Build trust and establish strong relationships with prospective parents.
Understand parent expectations and provide personalized counselling based on their child's needs.
Address parent questions and concerns professionally and provide accurate information.
Guide parents through the complete admission journey, from enquiry to registration and documentation.
Maintain regular communication with high-potential and pending leads.
Follow up with parents after school visits and counselling sessions to understand their decision-making stage.
Ensure a positive and professional parent experience throughout the admissions process.
School Visits & Admissions Conversion
Coordinate and schedule school visits/campus tours for prospective parents.
Work closely with the front office, academic coordinators, and school leadership to ensure a smooth campus-visit experience.
Follow up with parents after visits and identify opportunities for conversion.
Assist parents with application forms, required documentation, assessments, and other admission formalities.
Track each lead from initial enquiry through final enrolment.
Identify potential drop-offs in the admission funnel and proactively reconnect with parents.
CRM & Data Management
Maintain accurate and up-to-date lead information in the CRM/admission management system.
Record all calls, interactions, follow-ups, parent requirements, visit details, and lead status.
Ensure timely follow-up on all open and pending leads.
Maintain accurate sales funnel and pipeline data.
Prepare daily/weekly/monthly reports on:
New enquiries
Qualified leads
Calls and follow-ups
School visits
Applications
Conversions
Admissions
Lost/deferred leads
Conversion ratios
Analyse lead data to identify opportunities for improving conversion rates.
Sales & Target Achievement
Meet or exceed assigned lead conversion, admission, revenue, and follow-up targets.
Maintain a healthy admissions pipeline and prioritize high-intent leads.
Develop effective follow-up strategies for undecided and deferred parents.
Re-engage old, inactive, and lost leads where appropriate.
Track competitors and understand parent preferences and market trends in the local area.
Share market feedback and parent insights with the Admissions and School Leadership teams.
Contribute ideas for improving the admissions funnel and parent conversion journey.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
The role is mainly in the field: visiting our corporate and government tie-up clients, keeping their beneficiaries informed, and resolving issues at the hospital end throughout all the Districts of Bihar.
Corporate and government client relations
Make regular, scheduled field visits to tie-up clients across Bihar, including CGHS, ECHS, FCI, SSB, CAPF, PSUs, banks, insurers/TPAs and other empanelled organizations.
Act as the single point of contact between these organizations and the hospital for beneficiary queries, referrals and feedback.
Hold awareness sessions and camps for employees, ex-servicemen and their dependents on the hospital's services, empanelment benefits and cashless procedures.
Maintain good working relations with the officers who handle medical claims and referrals (welfare officers, medical officers, HR and admin heads).
Empanelment and compliance
Coordinate empanelment, renewal and rate-list updates with CGHS, ECHS, PMJAY and other schemes, and keep the hospital's documents current.
Follow up on pending bills, claim queries and payment delays with the client and the hospital's billing and TPA desk.
Make sure scheme rules, package rates and referral requirements are followed at the time of admission.
Business development and marketing
Find and pursue new corporate tie-ups, MoUs and health-check-up contracts across Bihar.
Plan and run health camps, CMEs, community outreach and corporate wellness programmes.
Manage the hospital's brand, print and digital material, local media relations, and social media in coordination with the management.
Build referral relationships with doctors, clinics and nursing homes in the districts.
Public relations and patient experience
Represent the hospital at official meetings, events, and press interactions.
Handle complaints and escalations from tie-up clients and patients quickly and courteously.
Collect patient and client feedback, and report service gaps to management

Preferred candidate profile
Skills
Strong communication in Hindi and English; working knowledge of local dialects such as Hindi is useful.
Professional, confident and presentable with senior government and corporate officers.
Good negotiation, follow-up and problem-solving skills.
Working knowledge of MS Office, email and WhatsApp for reporting; basic social media skills.

Perks and benefits
Salary: as per experience and hospital norms, plus travel allowance and incentives linked to performance.

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a smooth check-in and check-out.
Instead, we want to build and experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Guest Experience Experts take the initiative to deliver a wide range of services that guide guests through their entire stay.
They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done.
Whether processing operational needs, addressing guest requests, completing reports, or sharing the highlights of the local area, the Guest Experience Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, protecting company assets, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Experience Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Experience Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: No related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
To provide high-quality psychological assessment, short-term counselling, and evidence-based therapeutic interventions to outpatients and inpatients. The role acts as a bridge between mental and physical healthcare, working within a multidisciplinary medical team to improve patient outcomes while rigorously adhering to NABH Standards regarding patient care, rights, informed consent, and clinical documentation.

Key Responsibilities1. Core Psychological & Therapeutic Duties
Assessments: Conduct systematic psychological, emotional, and behavioral evaluations to identify patient distress patterns related to chronic illnesses, lifestyle diseases, surgeries, trauma, or psychiatric conditions.
Therapy Delivery: Provide evidence-based individual, group, or family counselling to address anxiety, clinical depression, stress, grief, and treatment adherence issues.
Crisis Intervention: Deliver emergency psychological first aid for patients experiencing acute trauma, severe diagnoses, or self-harm ideation within the hospital.
Specialized Care Support: Collaborate with departments like Oncology, Cardiology, Diabetology, Palliative Care, and Bariatrics to help patients cope with chronic medical conditions.
2. NABH Standard Compliance & Quality Control
Standardized Documentation (COP - Care of Patients): Maintain flawless, highly precise electronic and manual case files. Document all psychological evaluations, customized care plans, progress tracking, and discharge notes according to standard templates approved by the hospital's quality desk.
Patient Rights & Education (PRE): Ensure the absolute protection of patient data and medical confidentiality. Formally educate the patient and their family members regarding treatment plans, therapeutic expectations, and available support systems.
Informed Consent: Strictly obtain and document informed consent before executing specialized psychotherapeutic strategies or assessments.
Incidents & Medication Safety: Report any adverse behavioral events or psychological crises immediately via the hospital's standardized incident reporting system. Ensure clear separation between psychological therapies and psychotropic prescription tracking.
Audits & KPIs: Participate in routine internal clinical audits and track psychology department Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to ensure the department remains fully prepared for NABH surveillance audits.
3. Interdisciplinary Collaboration
Participate actively in multidisciplinary case conferences alongside psychiatrists, neurologists, physicians, and medical social workers to enable holistic recovery paths.
Provide consultation, basic counselling skills training, and burnout management workshops for the hospital's nursing and allied health staff.

Qualifications and Skills
Education:
Masters Degree (M.A./M.Sc.) in Counselling Psychology or Clinical Psychology from a UGC-recognized university.
Preferred: M.Phil in Clinical/Counselling Psychology or a relevant doctoral degree (Ph.D./Psy.D.).
Note: Registration with the National Commission for Allied and Healthcare Professions (NCAHP) or Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI) is highly valued depending on specific clinical assessment duties.
Experience: Minimum 2–5 years of practice in a multi-specialty or psychiatric hospital setting (prior exposure to NABH or JCI accredited workflows is a significant advantage).
Core Competencies: Active listening, high emotional intelligence, crisis de-escalation, and proficiency in clinical information systems (HIS/EMR tools)

Job Title: Team Leader - HNI Dealing - Branch Broking

Company Name: Bajaj Broking

Job Description
As a Team Leader - Branch Broking, you will be responsible for driving individual business performance as well as leading the branch dealing team to achieve overall business objectives. The role involves managing your own HNI client portfolio, generating revenue through client acquisition and trading activities, and simultaneously guiding the team to achieve their respective targets.

You will be accountable for individual revenue generation, team productivity, client acquisition, retention, and overall business growth while ensuring superior client servicing, operational efficiency, and regulatory compliance.

Key Responsibilities
Lead, motivate, and manage the team to achieve overall business and revenue targets.
Drive team-level revenue generation, client acquisition, activation, and retention.
Monitor individual team members' performance and ensure achievement of assigned targets.
Support team members in acquiring new clients, increasing client engagement, and improving revenue productivity.
Oversee trading activities across equity, derivatives, Nifty, and stock options.
Ensure timely sharing of stock, sector, and market updates with clients.
Handle key HNI relationships and resolve escalated client queries.
Conduct regular performance reviews, provide coaching, and develop team capabilities.
Coordinate with research and internal teams to provide relevant investment insights and strategies.
Ensure accurate trade execution, documentation, and adherence to regulatory and internal compliance requirements.
Track individual and team performance through regular business reviews and reporting.
Identify opportunities to improve revenue, operational efficiency, and overall client experience.
Coordinate with Branch and Regional leadership to achieve business objectives.
Achieve assigned individual revenue targets through HNI client acquisition, relationship management, and trading activities.

Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration, or a related field; an MBA will be an added advantage.
Minimum of 5-7 years of experience in dealing, sales, or business development within the financial services industry, preferably with exposure to HNI clients.
Prior experience in team handling or a supervisory role will be preferred.
Strong knowledge of financial markets, equity, derivatives, and investment products.
Strong leadership, communication, relationship management, and people-management skills.
NISM Series VIII Certification is mandatory.

Key Responsibilities:
Design, build, and maintain Alteryx workflows for data preparation, transformation, and integration.
Develop and support ETL/data workflows to ingest, cleanse, validate, and enrich data from multiple sources.
Translate business requirements into technical workflow designs and reusable components/macros.
Implement data quality checks, reconciliation logic, and exception handling to ensure accuracy and completeness.
Optimize workflow performance by improving logic, reducing run time, and managing resource usage effectively.
Document workflow logic, data mappings, and operational steps to support maintainability and handovers.
Collaborate with analysts, data engineers, and stakeholders to troubleshoot issues and deliver enhancements.
Support production runs, monitor scheduled workflows, and resolve failures within defined timelines.

Minimum Qualifications:
Bachelors degree (or equivalent) in Engineering/Technology/Computer Applications/Science (e.g., BTech, BE, BSc, MCA, MTech, MSc).
2-5years of experience working with Alteryx to build and maintain data preparation or automation workflows.
Strong hands-on experience in ETL and data workflow development, including transformation and validation steps.
Solid understanding of data concepts such as joins, aggregations, filtering, data types, and schema handling.
Ability to analyze requirements, debug workflow issues, and deliver reliable outputs with attention to detail.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience integrating Alteryx workflows with databases and file-based sources, including efficient input/output patterns.
Familiarity with SQL for data validation, reconciliation, and performance-aware querying alongside Alteryx pipelines.
Exposure to workflow scheduling/automation and operational support for recurring data processes.
Understanding of analytics lifecycle practices such as versioning, documentation standards, and reusable workflow design.
Ability to communicate clearly with stakeholders, present findings, and recommend improvements to data processes.
Good to have skills:
SQL, Data Warehousing, Data Quality Frameworks, Power BI, Python

Description:
Job Summary
As a Consultant you will help the team deliver and contribute to the profitable growth by ensuring client engagements are executed in an efficient manner.
Responsibilities
Your client responsibilities: Conduct the engagement in a professional manner and in accordance with client expectations and as defined by the terms and conditions of the contract.
Preparation and filing of individual tax return, e-TDS return, drafting of submissions before tax authorities, representation before the tax authorities.
Advising on outbound/inbound structuring in connection with movement of employees, working knowledge of immigration and provident fund in connection with expatriates, etc.
Your people responsibilities: Exhibit positive attitude and demonstrate willingness to learn.
Work constructively with team to evaluate and improve personal and team performance.
Contribute and leverage knowledge from individuals, databases and other sources.
Provide timely and high-quality services and work products that exceed client expectations.
Operational Excellence / Day to day responsibilities: Participate in executing work within a group by assisting by delivering work effectively, and teaming with tax professionals to provide comprehensive tax solutions.
Ensure that the areas of work assigned are executed in accordance with the work programme and the firms methodologies and guidance, and professional standards.
Use electronic working papers, efficiently including various software applications and sources of knowledge in an appropriate manner to conduct research.
Acquire and demonstrate competence in technical knowledge, and compliance process by keeping up to date on trends, developments and technical authorities and apply them to moderately complex situations.
Analyze and convert data into a tax product (advisory/compliance) and ensure accuracy and timeliness of the product.
Where applicable thoroughly check documents and make available for tax inspections in an appropriate manner.
Demonstrate professionalism through a positive and cooperative attitude and by maintaining the confidential and proprietary nature of client relationships and related work products.
Contribute to the overall success of the team by developing a thorough understanding of our methodologies and tools to enhance service delivery; keeping team members informed of work status; actively seeking assignments when unassigned; proactively seeking opportunities to provide tax services; challenging traditional procedures used in the past; and attempting to find new approach.
Skills and attributes for success
Good Communication skills (Written & Oral)
Proficient in MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint
Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines
Strong Analytical/Numerical ability
Enthusiastic and Self Starter
Team Player
Ability to grasp details
Good time management skills
Good interpersonal skills
To qualify for the role you must have
A certified CA
0-1 year of relevant experience
Ideally you'll also have
Be highly flexible, adaptable, and creative
Comfortable interacting with senior executives (within the firm and at the client)
What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative way to provide services across multiple client departments while adhering to commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions.

Description:
Key Responsibilities
1. Quality Strategy & Leadership
Develop and implement manufacturing quality assurance strategies and improvement plans.
Establish manufacturing process quality standards, specifications, and controls.
Utilize data-driven decision-making to enhance quality performance.
Provide quality performance reporting to management and stakeholders.
Mentor and support quality professionals where applicable.
Deliver quality awareness training and coaching to manufacturing personnel.
2. Customer Quality Focus
Support fulfillment of customer-specific quality requirements.
Analyze customer complaints, feedback, and quality concerns.
Participate in cross-functional initiatives aimed at improving customer satisfaction.
Translate customer expectations into manufacturing process improvements.
3. Quality Management System (QMS)
Develop and maintain SOPs, work instructions, and process controls.
Conduct process audits and compliance assessments.
Ensure adherence to quality standards, procedures, and regulatory requirements.
Train manufacturing teams on quality management practices and risk mitigation methods.
4. Manufacturing Quality Assurance
Conduct Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA).
Identify manufacturing and assembly process risks.
Develop and implement risk mitigation plans.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to eliminate potential quality failures.
Monitor effectiveness of risk controls and preventive actions.
Maintain and update risk assessments throughout the product lifecycle.
Manage change control activities related to:
Product features
Manufacturing processes
Materials
Suppliers
Design modifications
5. Quality Control
Implement quality control plans and inspection requirements.
Conduct process audits, inspections, and verification activities.
Analyze test results, measurements, and statistical quality data.
Identify trends and improvement opportunities through data analysis.
Recommend and implement corrective actions to improve quality performance.
6. Process Performance Management
Monitor key process performance indicators.
Analyze manufacturing performance data and trends.
Support implementation of Statistical Process Control (SPC) techniques.
Maintain process performance documentation.
Drive corrective and preventive actions to improve process capability and efficiency.
Train operators and manufacturing teams on performance monitoring methods.
7. Non-Conformance Management
Investigate process and product non-conformities.
Lead root cause analyses using structured problem-solving methodologies such as:
8D
5 Why Analysis
Fishbone Diagram
Statistical Analysis Tools
Implement and verify effectiveness of corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
8. Continuous Improvement
Lead and support continuous improvement initiatives across manufacturing operations.
Identify opportunities to improve:
Process capability
Product quality
Productivity
Cost efficiency
Operational performance
Participate in Lean and Six Sigma projects.
Facilitate waste reduction and process optimization activities.
Prioritize and execute improvement projects based on business impact.
Authority & Accountability
The position is accountable for:
Quality risk identification and mitigation.
PFMEA development and maintenance.
Manufacturing quality assurance activities.
Process audit execution.
Quality performance monitoring.
Continuous improvement project execution.
Supporting customer quality requirements and compliance.

Strategic Buyer - Global Technology (Indirect) Global Procurement
Solutions (GPS) | Buying Desk - Global Technology Category Location Band Role Type Shift Kraft Heinz India GCC - Ahmedabad or Bangalore B13 Individual Contributor North America-aligned / night shift support required CRITICAL EXPERIENCE 10+ years in procurement, including 5-7 years specifically in IT Procurement Role Summary The Strategic Buyer - Global Technology (Indirect) leads complex, end-to-end strategic sourcing initiatives of up to USD 15 million across global technology categories within the Global Procurement Solutions organization. The role requires strong commercial acumen, deep expertise in technology sourcing, and the ability to structure and negotiate complex, multi-year agreements that deliver measurable business value. Operating as a senior individual contributor, this role partners with Director and VP-level stakeholders across North America, Europe, and APAC to shape demand, influence sourcing strategies, and drive optimal commercial outcomes. The role is accountable for sourcing excellence, procurement governance, contract compliance, and continuous improvement across the source-to-pay lifecycle. The successful candidate must bring hands-on expertise in SaaS agreements, supplier redlines, and complex IT services negotiations, working closely with Legal and cross-functional stakeholders to achieve successful contracting outcomes. Page 1 Kraft Heinz India GCC | Global Procurement Solutions Key Responsibilities 1. Strategic Sourcing & Project Delivery Lead end-to-end sourcing projects of up to USD 15 million across SaaS, enterprise software, cloud, telecom, managed services, and IT services. Develop sourcing strategies covering supplier segmentation, RFx design, commercial structures, TCO and cost models, negotiation plans, communications, and award recommendations. Conduct market analysis, benchmarking, and cost modelling to identify value levers, savings, and cost-avoidance opportunities. Own complex sourcing initiatives aligned with business priorities, procurement KPIs, and committed outcomes. 2. Contract Negotiation & Commercial Management Lead complex negotiations for SaaS subscriptions, software licensing, cloud services, managed services, telecom, and IT professional services. Review supplier contractual redlines and collaborate with Legal, Information Security, Finance, IT, and business stakeholders to resolve issues and drive agreements to closure. Structure agreements to optimize pricing, service levels, contractual protections, risk allocation, and long-term value. Manage contract lifecycle activities including drafting, negotiation, validation, execution, renewals, amendments, Statements of Work, and Change Requests. Clearly articulate negotiation strategy, tactics deployed, stakeholder alignment, and measurable commercial outcomes. 3. Role & responsibilities

To ensure that all loose grocery staples (rice, wheat, pulses, spices, sugar, flour, etc.) are
processed and packed in the factory to meet FSSAI and regulatory standards and company

• Monitor packing lines to ensure correct weight, sealing, labelling, batch coding, and

• Ensure the factory follows FSSAI, HACCP, GMP, and hygiene norms.
• Monitor pest control, sanitation, and staff hygiene.
• Support internal/external quality audits.
5. Documentation & Reporting
• Maintain inspection logs, QC reports, and non-conformance records.
• Raise corrective/preventive actions (CAPA) with production & purchase teams.

Job Description & Candidate Preparation Guide
Career Development Ocer (CDO)
1. About Jaro Education
Jaro Education is India's most trusted online higher education company and a pioneer in the executive
and online education industry. Founded in 2009 by Dr. Sanjay Salunkhe, the company has been self-
funded and protable since inception. Jaro Education has been honored with the EdTech Leadership
Award and recognized as a National Best Employer by the World HRD Congress.
Jaro Education bridges the gap between top-tier global academic institutions and ambitious
professionals. The organization nurtures entrepreneurs and working executives across entry-level to C-
Suite roles through strategic aliations with globally renowned universities and business schools,
including:
IIMs: IIM Ahmedabad, IIM Indore, IIM Kozhikode, IIM Mumbai, IIM Nagpur, IIM Tiruchirappalli,
IIM Visakhapatnam
IITs and IIT-linked institutions: IIT Bombay, IIT Delhi, IIT Jammu, IIT Palakkad, IIT Roorkee,
E&ICT Academy IIT Kanpur, E&ICT Academy IIT Guwahati, IITM Pravartak IIT Madras
Technology Innovation Hub
Other premier Indian institutions: IISc, XLRI, IMT Ghaziabad, Loyola Institute of Business
Administration (LIBA), IFEEL Institute for Future Education, Entrepreneurship and Leadership,
MIT Institute of Design / MIT IDSS, Niranjan Hiranandani School of Real Estate & HSNC University
Indian Universities and Higher Education Partners: Adani Institute of Digital Technology
Management, Amity University, Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham, Bharati Vidyapeeth / BVDU,
Chandigarh University, Dayananda Sagar University (Bengaluru), Dr. D. Y. Patil Vidyapeeth
Centre for Online Learning (DPU-COL, Pune), Dr. M.G.R. Educational and Research Institute, JAIN
Online, MAHE Manipal Academy of Higher Education, Manipal University, Manipal University
Jaipur, Parul University, Sikkim Manipal University, Symbiosis International (Deemed University) /
SSODL
Global Academic and Executive Education Partners: Deakin University (Australia) & KPMG
in India, Harvard Business Impact, Imperial College Business School Executive Education, Rotman
School of Management (University of Toronto) & IITM Pravartak, Wharton Interactive
Company Vision: To be globally recognized for providing a seamless learning platform for professionals
around the world.
Page 1 of 5



Jaro Education | CDO Role Guide
Company Mission: To make high-quality, outcome-oriented executive education accessible to every
student and professional at all stages of their career.
2. Role Overview & Snapshot
The Career Development Ocer (CDO) / Inside Sales Specialist plays a critical role in driving
business growth by engaging with working executives, assessing their career goals, and counseling them
on higher education options. This is an end-to-end sales and counseling role that combines lead
generation, relationship building, and consultative program matching.
Designation
Career Development Ocer (CDO) / Inside Sales Specialist
Admissions & Executive Education Sales
Department
Target Audience
Working Days
Working Professionals, Corporate Executives & Freshers
Monday to Saturday (Sunday Weekly-O)
10:00 AM to 7:00 PM (Note: Shift may stretch basis business
requirements)
Working Hours
Dress Code
Mon Fri: Business Formals | Saturday: Smart Casuals
Primary CRM Tool
LeadSquared
3. Key Responsibilities & Performance Expectations
High-Volume Lead Outreach & Prospecting
¢ Connect daily with a minimum of 80 working professionals sourced from the LeadSquared CRM
database to build a healthy sales pipeline.
¢ Initiate conversations using cold-calling and warm lead nurture strategies, establishing rapid rapport
with high-potential prospects.
Consultative Counseling & Needs Analysis
¢ Analyze candidate professional backgrounds, current skills, domain expertise, and future career
aspirations.
¢ Identify skill gaps and recommend optimal executive programs, degree courses, diplomas, or
certications from Jaros university partners.
¢ Conduct structured telephonic, virtual, or in-person counseling sessions detailing curriculum
highlights, faculty credentials, learning methodologies, and career outcomes.
Page 2 of 5



Jaro Education | CDO Role Guide
End-to-End Sales Execution & Enrolment
¢ Guide prospects through the complete sales funnelfrom cold calling to lead nurturing, objection
handling, fee negotiation, and nal enrolment closures.
¢ Maintain consistent, personalized follow-up schedules with high-intent leads to maximize conversion
rates.
¢ Meet or exceed assigned daily activity deliverables, weekly conversion targets, and monthly revenue
metrics.
Operations & Data Management
¢ Maintain accurate, real-time records of lead statuses, meeting notes, follow-up dates, and payment
stages in LeadSquared.
¢ Coordinate closely with internal Admissions, Student Support, and Operations teams to ensure a
seamless onboarding experience for enrolled learners.
¢ Stay up-to-date with evolving EdTech trends, institutional accreditation updates, and competitor
oerings.
4. Candidate Prole & Prerequisites
¢ Education & Experience: Bachelors degree in any discipline. Freshers with exceptional
communication skills or candidates with prior sales/EdTech outreach experience are preferred.
¢ Communication Skills: Fluency in English with strong verbal, written, and persuasive articulation
capabilities.
¢ Sales Mindset: High competitive drive, negotiation skills, objection-handling capability, and comfort
working in target-driven environments.
¢ Interpersonal Skills: Empathy, active listening, and the ability to build immediate rapport with mid-to-
senior working professionals.
¢ Technical Savvy: Basic familiarity with Microsoft Oce (Excel, Word) and CRM applications like
LeadSquared.
5. Career Growth Pathway
¢ Structured Career Path: Opportunities to transition from CDO to Senior CDO, Team Leader,
Assistant Manager, and Business Manager based on performance and target achievements.
Page 3 of 5



Jaro Education | CDO Role Guide
Interview Preparation Kit
Please review the following instructions and preparation guidelines before attending your interview with
Jaro Education.
A. General Interview Hygiene & Rules
1. Professional Appearance: Dress in business formals (MonFri style) to demonstrate
professionalism.
2. Technical Setup: Ensure a stable high-speed internet connection, functional camera/microphone,
and a silent, distraction-free environment for virtual meetings.
3. Communication Delivery: Keep answers crisp, structured, and focused. Avoid lengthy anecdotes
or o-topic details.
4. Energy & Condence: Demonstrate high energy, enthusiasm, and articulate speech throughout
the conversation.
5. Past Employer Etiquette: Maintain a strictly positive, objective, and factual approach when
discussing previous employers. Do not speak negatively about former companies or colleagues.
B. Fundamental Concepts to Master
1. What is EdTech?
Denition: EdTech (Educational Technology) refers to the integration of technology, software, and
hardware tools into educational processes to enhance learning accessibility, engagement, and
eectiveness.
Industry Context: Explain why online higher executive education is essential todayallowing
working professionals to upskill without pausing their full-time careers.
2. What is Consultative Selling?
Denition: A sales approach focused on prioritizing the buyer's needs, challenges, and goals rather
than aggressively pushing a product.
Application at Jaro Education: As a CDO, you do not simply "sell a course." You rst identify a
professionals career bottlenecks, understand their skill gaps, and then recommend the specic
executive program that aligns with their career growth.
Page 4 of 5



Jaro Education | CDO Role Guide
C. Sample Interview Questions & Preparation Strategies
Important Note: Interview questions may change from person to person depending on individual
candidate proles and interviewer evaluation. The questions below are representative FAQ example
types to aid your preparation.
¢ "Walk me through your resume and key achievements."
Tip: Focus on your outreach metrics, target achievements, past sales/counseling experience, and
everyday responsibilities.
¢ "Why do you want to build a career in the EdTech industry?"
Tip: Highlight the rapid growth of the online education sector, your passion for career counseling, and
the impact of upskilling working professionals.
¢ "How do you handle a candidate who says the program fee is too high?"
Tip: Demonstrate consultative sellingreframe the fee as a long-term career investment, highlight the
prestige of partner institutes (e.g., IIMs, IITs, Wharton Interactive, Harvard Business Impact), and
discuss nancial exibility (EMIs, loan support).
¢ "What is your reason for leaving your current/previous role?"
Tip: Provide an honest, professional, and growth-oriented answer (e.g., seeking better exposure,
career progression, or entry into the EdTech industry).
¢ "How do you explain gaps in your career (if applicable)?"
Tip: Be transparent, condent, and concise. Explain how you utilized the gap period productively
(certications, skill-building, personal responsibilities).
D. Quick Checklist Before Joining the Interview
Researched Jaro Educations company background, leadership (Dr. Sanjay Salunkhe), vision, and
mission.

Memorized key partner institutions across categories (e.g., IIMs, IITs, IISc, XLRI, Wharton Interactive,
Harvard Business Impact).

Prepared to explain past key performance indicators (KPIs), call targets, and sales achievements.

Reviewed the core denition of Consultative Selling and EdTech.

Dressed in crisp business formal attire.

All the best for your interview!

Job Description Factory / Plant Manager:
Job Overview
We are looking for an experienced Factory / Plant Manager to lead the overall operations of our manufacturing plant. The role will be responsible for ensuring efficient production, quality, safety, regulatory compliance, cost control, and effective people management.
The incumbent will work closely with Production, Quality, Maintenance, Stores, Supply Chain, HR and other functions to ensure smooth and efficient plant operations while maintaining statutory and company standards.

Key Roles & Responsibilities
1. Plant & Production Management
Lead end-to-end plant operations and ensure achievement of production targets.
Plan and monitor production schedules, capacity utilization and operational efficiency.
Ensure optimum utilization of manpower, machinery, materials and other resources.
Monitor production losses, downtime, wastage and overall plant productivity.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives to improve efficiency and reduce operational costs.
2. Quality, Food Safety & Compliance
Ensure adherence to applicable quality, food safety, statutory and regulatory requirements.
Ensure compliance with company SOPs, quality systems, safety standards and audit requirements.
Coordinate with Quality teams to maintain product quality and hygiene standards.
Ensure timely closure of observations arising from internal, external and regulatory audits.
Maintain necessary plant documentation, records and compliance requirements.
3. Maintenance & Engineering Coordination
Coordinate with Engineering/Maintenance teams to ensure maximum machine availability.
Monitor preventive and breakdown maintenance activities.
Identify recurring equipment issues and drive corrective and preventive actions.
Ensure proper planning of maintenance activities without impacting production.
4. People Management
Lead, develop and manage plant employees across functions and shifts.
Ensure adequate manpower availability and effective manpower deployment.
Set clear performance expectations and monitor team performance.
Develop a culture of discipline, accountability, safety and continuous improvement.
Identify training and capability-building requirements for plant employees.
Handle employee-related operational issues in coordination with HR.
5. Stakeholder Management
Act as the key point of coordination between the plant and corporate functions.
Work closely with Quality, HR, Procurement, Supply Chain, Sales and other stakeholders.
Coordinate with external agencies, vendors, contractors and relevant authorities as required.
Ensure effective communication and timely resolution of operational issues.
6. Safety & Hygiene
Ensure strict adherence to plant safety, hygiene and housekeeping standards.
Drive awareness and compliance with safety procedures across the plant.
Identify potential safety risks and ensure appropriate corrective actions.
Promote a strong safety culture among employees and contractors.
7. Cost & Resource Management
Monitor plant operating costs and identify opportunities for cost optimization.
Ensure efficient utilization of raw materials, packaging materials, utilities and manpower.
Monitor wastage, energy consumption and other key operating expenses.
Support budgeting and operational planning for the plant.

Description:
CCTV Operator - Bangalore
Educational qualification: Intermediate / Graduation
Professional Experience: Minimum 2 to 3 years experience as a CCTV Operator.
Skills required:
Attention to Detail: must be able to identify small, seemingly insignificant details that most people would overlook. This ability allows them to keep the area as safe as possible.
Ability to Multitask: on receiving phone call or has to speak to a colleague, they must always be keeping an eye on the monitors.
Ability to Work Independently: For the most part, CCTV Operator will not be required to interact with very many people. Because of this, it is important that they re able to work and stay alert without constant supervision.
Communication Skills: Since CCTV Operators will occasionally have to give statements to police officers, communicate with emergency services or even appear in court, they need to have strong written and verbal communication skills.
Duties and Responsibilities: In the interest of protecting students, Teaching, Non-Teaching and other staff members of the institute, information and property, CCTV Operators perform a variety of tasks.
Operate CCTV infrastructure: Must have a thorough understanding of the equipment they re working with. Viewing and monitoring all cameras throughout the working hours, ensuring all cameras are in working condition and recorded to NVR, deleting or archiving old footage as needed, organizing old footage in an orderly fashion, and switching out compact discs, memory cards, hard drives or servers.
Maintain Equipment: Other than to operate video surveillance equipment additionally, CCTV Operator must also be able to maintain and repair that same equipment reporting and coordinating with vendor/partner if camera or NVR has issues and get it rectified, whether it s analog or digital.
Store Footage: Since any amount of footage from any given day could be required at any given time, properly storing footage is most important. CCTV Operators will need to correctly catalog all footage so that it can be easily recalled at a later time.
Watch Surveillance: Must watch the video surveillance footage and ensure it s being recorded.
Make Observations: Must be unwaveringly focused and observant so that whenever witness something unusual, suspicious or questionable then able to make a detailed note of it.
Report Incidents: If a CCTV Operator sees something illegal on one of their monitors, it is up to them to contact the appropriate authorities at the appropriate time. In serious situations, CCTV Operators can also save the police vital time by immediately reporting a criminal s license plate number, clothing, tattoos or other identifying features.

Description:
Job Summary
Hitachi Energy is seeking a Global Technical Instructional Designer to support our 12,000+ global employees in the High Voltage Business Unit.
In alignment with Hitachi Energy High Voltage's learning vision and growth strategy, this role will help architect our inaugural training center of expertise and knowledge community. This will include creating engaging technical content and courses, utilizing micro-, people-centric, role- skill- and level-based learning methodologies.
If you're ready to transform our onboarding and learning journey, then we want to hear from you.
Responsibilities
Working closely with the Global Learning Manager, you will collaborate with cross-cultural and functional leaders, technical subject matter experts, knowledge owners, and learning experts to determine and create content to fulfill critical knowledge needs. This role will help architect our inaugural Global HV Learning Center of Expertise.
You will create skill- and role-based learning objectives, assessments, certifications, stories, scenarios, knowledge checks, case studies, interactive activities, scripts, content, and videos adhering to all branded standards, processes, and style-guides.
You will interpret skill matrixes to determine critical knowledge gaps and develop training content. You will create step-by-step guides, best practice and troubleshooting documents, infographics, animations, videos, interactive elements, learning activities, assessments, gamification, and courses while maintaining the highest standards of safety, quality, compliance, and operational excellence.
Interpret content analytics for success and continuous improvement by implementing a plan of improvement to address poor review comments, low ratings and completions.
Support the acceleration of our employees' learning by creating content that onboards, assesses, and advances skill acquisition and proficiency.
Lead and track projects that align with goals to ensure on-time and quality completion.
Develop, edit, and maintain content and other documentation that enhance the effectiveness of on-the-job training and inquiry-based (hands on) learning.
A bachelor's degree is required, with a master's degree preferred in Technology, Science, Technical Writing, or Instructional Design.


Your Background
Advanced knowledge and in-depth experience in adult micro-learning, skill- and role-based training design, skill mapping, learning levels and learning paths, people-centric, scenario-based, and adaptive learning methodologies.
Experience in development and maintenance of high-stakes internal examinations.
Advanced experience using: Camtasia, Articulate 360 (Storyline, Review, and Rise), Screen Capture, Vyond, Synthesia, Adobe Creative Suite, and a Learning Management System.
A minimum of 10 years of experience in andragogy learning, training, and/or knowledge content management in manufacturing, engineering, higher education, and/or technology industries is required.
Highly organized and detail-oriented, capable of managing multiple projects simultaneously.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, comfortable working with employees across the organization.
Demonstrated flexibility to adjust training approaches to meet evolving employee needs.

Job Title: Intern
Department: Operations
About Business line/Function: The Operations team includes different business units such as Securities Services, Wealth Management, Global Banking Operations, Markets Operations (back office & middle office) and Client engagement & Financial Securities.
These business units provides services to global clients across Asia, Europe & US region offering a wide range of services, which include custody operations, fund accounting, middle-office operations, static data management, trade clearing and settlement operations, securities lending, corporate action, Tax Operations, AML / KYC and other transversal services.
Position Purpose: The purpose of the roles is to provide service to Clients and their Portfolios related activities pertaining to different markets across the globe. 
The incumbent will be managing the daily operations/workflow within the business group and helps the Leads in achieving the process deliverables. 
Responsibilities
Processing of transactions within the agreed timelines
Ensure all the transactions are completed and approved in the system within the TAT /SLA
Ensure all the transactions are processed with at most care without errors/mistakes.
Prioritize the work and conduct investigation with due diligence on all the discrepancies.
Taking corrective measures/action in consultation with the Leads
Escalate unresolved open items to the Leads
Maintain Communication Channels with internal peer groups.
Participate in Cross Training and ensure the Knowledge transfer between the team and processes is happening on periodic basis.
Participate in Brainstorming Sessions and share the best practices and ideas with the peer groups and team members.
Consistently evaluate and update documented procedures to ensure they are complete, accurate and current
The position interfaces with other Process Associates, Mid Office Staff, Relationship Managers and Clients
The position interfaces with International Team Members of BNP Group and its Clients or Vendors or Sub-Custodians
Compliance and Risk Management: Ensure adherence to compliance and risk management policies and procedures. Identify and report any potential risks or compliance issues.
Quality Assurance: Conduct regular self-checks to ensure that all processes and transactions meet the required standards and guidelines.
Technical & Behavioral Competencies
The candidate should be able to read, write and speak in French language
Strong analytical skills, detail orientation, service commitment, solid organizational and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work in shifts as required.
Specific Qualifications:
Graduation in any discipline
DELF B1 and above certification in French language
Location: Mumbai/ Chennai/ Bangalore
About BNP Paribas Group:
BNP Paribas is the European Unions leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Groups commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial & personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability.
About BNP Paribas India Solutions:
Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best-in-class solutions.

Hunger and passion for learning new skills

This is with reference for AWS Data Engineer Professionals

PFB the Job Description

Key responsibilities
Inventory and baseline current Lambda functions, Dagster pipelines, dbt models, MySQL ODS flows and Kafka feeds, document lineage, schedules, SLAs and failure paths.
Design and build Gluebased ingestion, transformation, and cataloguing patterns (Glue jobs, Glue Catalog, Crawlers) with Lambda/Step Functions/Event Bridge orchestration.
Implement S3 Bronze landing with lifecycle/archive policies, Redshift Silver conformance and Gold canonical data products (Customer, Loan, Collections, Risk).
Build automated dataquality gates, reconciliation checks, and sourcetoreport lineage; support the enterprise data dictionary and certification of businesscritical reports
Implement IAM, AWSnative encryption, Secrets Manager and Goldlayer RBAC/leastprivilege access.
Establish Dev/Test environments, Gitbased CI/CD, schema version control (Liquibase) and controlled release promotion; monitoring and recovery via CloudWatch.
Migrate and reconcile workloads wave by wave against baselines; decommission ODS dependencies and replace reverse flows with governed interfaces.
Optimise Redshift performance and cost (WLM, sort/Dist keys, materialised views).
Mentor engineers, own technical quality assurance of deliverables, and work with Data Owners/Champions and Atos architects in an Agile setup.

Mandatory skills
10+ years in data engineering with 5+ Experience in AWS data platforms.
Amazon Redshift (deep): data modelling, performance tuning, WLM, RBAC, external schemas/Spectrum.
AWS Glue (jobs, Glue Catalog, Crawlers) and handson medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) implementation on S3 + Redshift.
AWS Lambda, Step Functions, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, Secrets Manager.
Advanced SQL, dimensional/canonical data modelling, ETL/ELT frameworks.
Python (primary) PySpark for Glue jobs.
MySQL (operational data store) and CDC/batch extraction patterns.
dbt must be able to read, reverseengineer, and migrate existing dbt models.
Dataquality frameworks, reconciliation, and lineage/metadata practices.
Git,CI/CD pipelines, database schema version control (Liquibase or equivalent), Dev/Test/Prod promotion.
Leadership, mentoring, stakeholder management; ability to work independently in Agile.

Nice to have
Dagster orchestration for ASIS discovery and migration.
Kafka / eventdriven streaming ingestion.
Apache Iceberg on S3, Apache Spark/EMR
Tableau, Metabase servinglayer knowledge.
Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/CloudFormation).
Datagovernance tooling (Glue Data Quality, Data Zone, Lake Formation).

AboutCompany:
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Servicessolving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As an AES Salesforce Developer – Senior Associate- Operate, you will focus on connecting Salesforce with other systems, applications, or databases to enable seamless data flow and process automation. Within our Commercial & Service Excellence practice, you will design, develop, and implement integration solutions using various technologies and tools, such as Salesforce APIs, middleware platforms, and web services. This role involves analyzing client needs, implementing software solutions, and providing training and support to help clients optimize operational efficiency and achieve their strategic objectives.
As a Senior Associate, you will build meaningful client connections and learn how to manage and inspire others. You will navigate increasingly complex situations, growing your personal brand and deepening your technical skills. You are expected to anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, delivering quality solutions even when the path forward is unclear. In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will leverage your skills to respond effectively to diverse perspectives and use a broad range of tools and methodologies to generate new ideas and solve problems. This position offers an opportunity to develop a deeper understanding of the business context and how it is evolving.
