Description:
Who We Are

Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the worlds technology.

What We Offer

Location:
Bangalore,IND, Chennai,IND
At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. Were committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.
As a Software Engineer at Applied Materials, youll dive deep into ground-breaking technologieslike machine learning and AIto craft novel software solutions that solve our customers high-value problems. Our Software Engineers are responsible for designing, prototyping, developing, and debugging software solutions for semiconductor equipment components and devices to ensure quality and functionality. You'll develop software documentation and test procedures, troubleshoot software problems, and communicate with internal customers to understand project requirements. As part of our team, you'll contribute your expertise in intricate systems, deciphering code, and anticipating software behaviors to ensure Applied remains the leader in the semiconductor and display sectors.
About Applied
Applied Materials is the leader in materials engineering solutions used to produce virtually every new chip and advanced display in the world. Our expertise in modifying materials at atomic levels and on an industrial scale enables customers to transform possibilities into reality. At Applied Materials, our innovations make possible the technology shaping the future.
Responsibilities:

As a seasoned Software Architect, you will be responsible for designing and implementing scalable, reliable and maintainable software solutions for our organization.

You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including software engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders, to understand requirements and translate them into architectural/software designs that meet business needs.
You will be coding and developing quick prototypes to establish your design with real code and data.
You will be a subject Matter expert to unblock software engineers.
Conduct technical reviews and provide guidance to software engineers during the development process.
Identify and mitigate technical risks and issues throughout the software development lifecycle.
Evaluate and recommend appropriate technologies and frameworks to meet project requirements.
Lead the design and implementation of complex software components and systems.
Mentor and coach Tech Leads & s/w engineers.

Qualifications & Requirements:

12-18 yrs of experience with BTech / MTech in Computer Science.
Proven experience as a Software Architect or similar role with experience of 10+ yrs in product development.
Minimum experience of 10+ years in core Java & advanced features. E.g., streams, functional programming, virtual threads.
Minimum experience of 5+ years in Spring Boot & associated Spring features.
Minimum experience of 4+ years of driving/contributing towards HLD & LLD, contribution towards code reviews & coding practices (like clean code & SOLID principles)
Minimum experience of 4+ years in building and driving microservices based architecture or large-scale systems.
Strong algorithms & data-structures.
Experience in workflow frameworks. Examples - Temporal, Apache Airflow etc.
Experience in reactive programming.

Good to have:

Good knowledge of Semiconductor domain.
Design, prototype, implement and test software and computer vision machine learning algorithms in Python.
Experience with scikit-image, Tensor Flow, PyTorch.

Applied Materials is committed to diversity in its workforce including Equal Employment Opportunity for Minorities, Females, Protected Veterans and Individuals with Disabilities.

SUMMARY
Account Manager ETS Operations

Summary
We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven professional to lead our Employee Transportation Services (ETS) operations across major Indian cities. In this pivotal role, you will serve as the primary liaison for key corporate clients, ensuring the delivery of exceptional transportation solutions. The ideal candidate will blend strategic account management with hands-on operational expertise to drive client satisfaction, foster long-term partnerships, and optimize service efficiency. This position offers a unique opportunity to shape the future of employee mobility for leading organizations while managing a diverse portfolio of accounts.

Responsibilities
Cultivate and maintain comprehensive relationships with corporate clients, serving as their dedicated point of contact for all matters.
Address daily operational requests, manage service escalations, and resolve account-specific inquiries promptly and effectively.
Develop robust client partnerships to maximize satisfaction rates and ensure high levels of account retention.
Collaborate closely with internal operations teams to guarantee seamless service execution and strict adherence to agreed-upon Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
Supervise end-to-end transportation logistics, including route optimization, staff rostering, vehicle allocation, and trip coordination.
Oversee the performance of fleet vendors, transport partners, and on-ground teams to uphold rigorous service quality standards.
Continuously monitor operational metrics to identify performance gaps and execute timely corrective measures.
Manage client performance reviews, generate detailed MIS reports, coordinate billing processes, and maintain accurate account documentation.
Proactively identify avenues for business expansion, account growth, and the enhancement of service delivery models.


Requirements
Possess a minimum of three years of relevant experience in Account Management, Client Relationship Management, Fleet Operations, or Transportation Services.
Demonstrate a proven track record of managing corporate clients and successfully handling high-value accounts.
Exhibit superior communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management abilities.
Show versatility in balancing client-facing duties with the practical execution of operational tasks.
Display strong analytical skills for problem-solving and effective management of complex escalations.
Maintain a solid understanding of fleet management principles, transportation logistics, and service delivery frameworks.
Be proficient in using MS Excel, creating MIS reports, and interpreting operational dashboards.
Possess excellent verbal and written communication capabilities.
Preferred Industry Background
Candidates with prior experience in the following sectors are highly encouraged to apply:
Food Delivery and Restaurant Account Management
Quick Commerce and E-commerce Key Account Management
IoT Solutions, including GPS Tracking and Dashcam Sales
Automobile Sales and Account Management
Real Estate Sales and Client Relationship Management
Fleet Management and Transportation Services

Job Description

MES Developer
Location: Pune, Bangalore
Experience: 2-6 Years
Join us to build and support next-generation Manufacturing Execution System (MES) solutions that drive operational excellence across automotive and discrete manufacturing environments.
Role Overview
We are looking for an experienced MES Developer with 2+ years of hands-on experience in Manufacturing Execution Systems. The ideal candidate should possess strong technical expertise in MES development, customization, and support, along with experience in automotive or discrete manufacturing industries. The role also requires exposure to AMS support, SLA management, and production support activities.
Key Responsibilities
Develop, customize, and configure MES solutions based on business requirements.
Provide functional and technical support for MES applications.
Troubleshoot and resolve complex MES issues to minimize production downtime.
Develop and maintain web-based reports and dashboards.
Ideal Candidate Profile
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
2+ years of experience in MES development and support.
Hands-on experience working in automotive or discrete manufacturing environments.
Strong technical skills in:
.NET, SQL,PL/SQL,MES
Experience with MES customization, configuration, and web reporting.
Exposure to AMS support models and SLA-driven environments.
Preferred Skills
Experience working under AMS contracts and support engagements.
Understanding of manufacturing operations and industry best practices.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Strong customer-focused mindset with proven service delivery experience.
What You'll Gain
Opportunity to work on enterprise MES implementations and support projects.
Exposure to leading automotive and discrete manufacturing clients.
Collaborative work environment with opportunities for continuous learning and growth.
Participation in digital manufacturing transformation initiatives.

Description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you'd like, where you'll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you'll be able to reimagine what's possible. Join us and help the worlds leading organizations


Your Role

We are looking for experienced Guidewire professionals with strong hands-on expertise across Policy Center and Guidewire Integrations to design, configure, customize, and support scalable solutions for Property Casualty insurance clients. The role involves working across the Guidewire Insurance Suite ecosystem to enable seamless policy administration, claims management, billing operations, and system integrations.
Design, develop, configure, and maintain Guidewire applications across Policy Center.
Customize Guidewire components using Gosu, Java, Guidewire Studio, and configuration tools.
Work on Guidewire Policy Center capabilities including policy administration, product configuration, underwriting rules, rating, pricing, renewals, endorsements, cancellations, and reinstatements.
Design and build integrations using the Guidewire Integration Framework, including plugins, messaging, web services, batch processes, event triggers, and data exchange pipelines.
Develop and maintain SOAP/REST APIs, XML/XSD-based data exchanges, JSON structures, messaging components, and integration interfaces.
Collaborate with business analysts, architects, QA teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.




Your Profile

6+ years of experience in software development, with strong hands-on exposure to Guidewire Policy Center applications.
Strong experience in one or more Guidewire modules: PolicyCenter
Proficiency in Gosu, Java, XML, JSON, XSD, SQL, SOAP/REST Web Services, and Guidewire configuration tools.
Good understanding of Property Casualty insurance domain processes across policy and policy integration landscapes.
Hands-on experience with Guidewire data models, workflows, rules engine, plugins, messaging, batch processes, and web services.
Experience integrating Guidewire applications with PolicyCenter, comp raters, payment gateways, document systems, accounting platforms, customer portals, and other external systems.
Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and tools such as JIRA and Confluence.
Exposure to CI/CD pipelines, DevOps tools, Git, Jenkins, Maven, and cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Guidewire Cloud is preferred.
Strong problem-solving, analytical, communication, and documentation skills.
Guidewire certification in PolicyCenter is preferred.




What you will love about working here

Opportunity to work on large-scale Guidewire Insurance Suite transformation programs for global PC insurance clients.
Exposure to end-to-end insurance technology delivery across policy, claims, billing, and integration platforms.
Hands-on experience with modern engineering practices including Agile delivery, CI/CD, DevOps, cloud, and integration-led architecture.
Structured learning, certifications, and continuous upskilling opportunities in insurance platforms and emerging technologies.
A collaborative and inclusive culture focused on innovation, delivery excellence, and client value.

Mission Statement:
Understand and apply project documentation and execution practices in accordance with internal project control standard procedures/instructions in system.

Ensure adherence to quality standards, create reports, and provide analysis using project document trackers.
Should have experience in reading customer contracts and understand the project documentation requirements. Working knowledge with EMDS.
Analyze & upload Engineering and Supplier documents (new and revised) for Tender / Project into the DMS or common drive.
Create and control Document Registers and analyze & upload Engineering and Supplier documents (new and revised) for Tender / Project into the DMS or common drive.
Communicate with Project Manager and Departments for Clarifications and Suggestions
Handling Customer commented/approved documents in DMS and informing Project team.
Adding the documents into web-based database, for easy access for the members in different locations
Prepare the publishing documents packages for printing (hard copies), if needed.
After Customer Approval of project's final documents, hand over the Project to After Sales Department.
Living Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.
Your background:
Non-Engineering - A diploma or bachelor's/master's degree.
5 to 8 years of experience as a document controller.
Proficiency in MS-Office Applications (Word, PPT and Excel).
Strong communication skills in written and verbal (English).
Capability to work with multi-cultural and multilingual users.
Quick learner, Proactive, Self-Motivated, and Flexible.

Description:
Business Information:
The Hitachi Energy Indian Operations Center (INOPC) is a competence center with around 3600+ skilled engineers who focus on tendering, engineering, planning, procurement, project Management, functional system testing, installation supervision, documentation and commissioning. However, over the last decade, it has evolved to become the largest Operations hub. The India Operations Centre team at Chennai, Bangalore and Gurugram supports Hitachi Energys units in more than 40 countries across a wide portfolio of all the four business units in Hitachi Energy To date, the team has executed engineering and commissioning for projects in more than 80 countries.
Mission Statement:
Service Sales & Tendering Team Manager is responsible for leading the Service Sales and Tendering team to deliver high-quality, timely and competitive offers for service business opportunities. The role includes managing team operations, resource allocation, competence development, stakeholder collaboration and people development. This position drives standardization, best-practice sharing, continuous improvement and team capability development while supporting business growth, customer satisfaction and operational excellence across global and local service sales requirements.
Your Responsibilities:
Team Leadership and People Development
Lead, coach and mentor the Service Sales and Tendering team, fostering accountability, collaboration, innovation and continuous improvement.
Conduct regular performance and development discussions, define individual goals, identify competency gaps and support career growth.
Build team capability through structured onboarding, training, knowledge sharing and development of behavioral and functional competencies.
Drive recruitment, onboarding and resource readiness to support business expansion and future scope growth.
Promote diversity, inclusion, positive team dynamics and a healthy work environment.
Service Sales and Tendering Operations
Manage end-to-end service sales and tendering activities, ensuring alignment with customer requirements, timelines, quality standards and business expectations.
Oversee RFQ review, scope clarification, technical-commercial alignment, offer preparation, risk assessment, bid submission and post-offer support.
Provide guidance on tendering process flow, commercial governance, risk identification and quality of offer submissions.
Support scope addition, team scaling and long-term capability building to match evolving business needs.
Stakeholder and Business Collaboration
Collaborate with global stakeholders, sales units, factories, HUBs, customers and cross-functional teams to understand requirements, provide updates and ensure customer satisfaction.
Maintain regular engagement with business counterparts to align priorities, review performance and address operational challenges.
Performance Management and Operational Excellence
Drive and monitor key performance indicators such as On-Time Delivery, Hit rate, efficiency, utilization, NPS/customer satisfaction and quality of deliverables.
Ensure effective workload planning, prioritization of critical cases and visibility of long-pending offers or execution gaps.
Lead continuous improvement initiatives, process standardization, best-practice deployment and quality management system adherence.
Develop and maintain a roadmap for team growth, productivity improvement, competency development and future technology/tool adoption.
Administrative and Financial Responsibilities
Manage team administration, including resource planning, leave planning, onboarding support, infrastructure coordination and HR-related operational support.
Support business-related financial coordination such as offer submission tracking, purchase order follow-up, invoicing coordination and payment collection follow-up where applicable.
Ensure accurate reporting, timely updates and effective governance of team deliverables and business support activities.
Knowledge, Skills and Experience:
Education
Bachelors or masters degree in Engineering, Business or a related discipline.
Electrical Engineering or power/energy sector background will be an added advantage.
Experience
10+ years of experience in Sales, Tendering, Front-End Sales, EPC or related functions.
Prior experience in managing teams, working with global stakeholders and supporting multi-location or global business environments will be preferred.
Experience in HV switchgear, Transformer, substations or service business.
Functional Skills
Strong knowledge of service sales, tendering process flow, commercial review, risk assessment and offer management.
Ability to manage sales processes, stakeholder requirements, timelines, quality standards and business priorities.
Working knowledge of CRM/Salesforce and Power BI will be an added advantage.
Strong analytical, organizational and risk management skills.
Leadership and Behavioral Skills
Strong leadership, communication, stakeholder management and team-building abilities.
Strong interpersonal skills to manage team dynamics, resolve conflicts and maintain a positive work environment.
Strategic thinking with a proactive approach to business growth, scalability and capability development.

Job Summary
We are seeking a highly motivated AI/ML Engineer to design, develop, and deploy machine learning models and AI-powered solutions. The ideal candidate will work closely with data scientists, software engineers, and business stakeholders to build scalable AI systems that drive business value.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, train, and optimize machine learning and deep learning models.
Build and maintain end-to-end ML pipelines for data ingestion, model training, validation, and deployment.

Deploy AI/ML models into production using cloud platforms and ML Ops practices.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into AI solutions.

Experience with cloud platforms like Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
Strong understanding of SQL, data modeling, and data engineering concepts.
Familiarity with REST APIs and software development best practices.
Qualifications
Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field.
2+ years of experience in Machine Learning/AI development (adjust as needed).
Experience delivering AI/ML solutions in production environments.
Preferred Skills

Knowledge of NLP, Computer Vision, Recommendation Systems, or Agentic AI.

Description:
Key Responsibilities
Act as the primary bilingual liaison between Japanese client stakeholders (HQ and regional teams) and the Oracle Cloud delivery team across requirement workshops, CRP/UAT cycles, and steering committee updates.
Support supply chain process workstreams planning, order management, procurement, inventory, and manufacturing — and, where relevant experience exists, contribute to configuration, testing, and rollout activities on the Oracle Cloud platform.
Translate and localise functional specifications, process flows, test scripts, and training materials between Japanese and English, ensuring technical accuracy is preserved.
Facilitate real-time interpretation during design workshops, CRP demonstrations, and issue-resolution calls with Japanese business and IT stakeholders.
Support fit-gap analysis and solution design for Japan-specific statutory, tax, and reporting requirements within Oracle Cloud (e.g. consumption tax, Japan GAAP nuances, e-invoicing).
Coordinate with onshore Japan-based teams and offshore delivery teams to manage cultural and time-zone alignment, escalations, and status reporting.
Contribute to test scenario validation, data migration reviews, and cutover planning for multi-country, multi-plant Oracle Cloud implementations in the automotive sector.
Support change management and end-user training delivery for Japanese-speaking plant and business teams.

Required Qualifications
Japanese Language Proficiency (Primary requirement): JLPT N3 minimum; N2 or above strongly preferred. Demonstrated experience using Japanese in a professional/business context (client calls, documentation, workshops).
Industry Background (Primary requirement): Prior experience on automotive OEM or Tier-1/Tier-2 supplier programmes — familiarity with JIT/JIS manufacturing, multi-plant/multi-country rollouts, and automotive-specific supply chain processes.
Oracle Cloud Knowledge (Good to have, not mandatory): Exposure to Oracle Cloud Supply Chain modules — Supply Planning, Order Management, Procurement, Inventory Management, Manufacturing, Product Hub/PLM — will be viewed favourably but is not a prerequisite.
Consulting Experience: Prior experience with a Big 4, global systems integrator, or automotive-industry consulting/coordination role; comfortable working in client-facing delivery roles.
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Commerce, or a related field; any ERP or Oracle Cloud certification is a bonus, not expected.
Willingness to travel to client sites (India and potentially Japan) as required by programme milestones.

Preferred / Good to Have
Prior experience specifically supporting Japanese automotive clients (e.g. DENSO, Toyota Group, Honda, Nissan, Suzuki, or their Tier-1 supplier ecosystem).
Hands-on knowledge of Oracle Cloud Supply Chain modules from prior implementation, support, or super-user experience.
JETRO or other formal bilingual business-communication certification.
Prior experience as a bridge engineer, IT coordinator, or business analyst in a Japanese-client environment — candidates strong on language and automotive-industry fit will be considered even without direct Oracle exposure, with structured platform training provided on the job.

Job Title: Compliance Review Controller (Associate)
Department: India Compliance COE
About Business line/Function: CIB
India COE Compliance Hub: The India CoE Compliance Hub serves as a strategic global partner to Compliance functions, helping safeguard the Groups reputation and manage risk across all business lines. Organized around specialized service domains, the Hub provides expertise in Financial Security (KYC, Sanctions, and Quality Assurance), Operational Risk & Controls, Conduct, Data Governance, Market Integrity, Operational Efficiency and AI Enablement, and other transversal Compliance activities.
Working in close partnership with stakeholders across geographies and business lines, the Hub drives operational excellence, enhances risk management capabilities, fosters innovation, and supports the execution of the Groups global Compliance strategy.
Responsibilities
Direct Responsibilities
The person will be a part of the Transversal Risk Management (TRM) team reporting to Team Lead, Non-FS Controls.
Perform testing and controls as defined by testing and control procedures under the supervision of TRM Managers or their delegates in order to assess and review compliance with legal, regulatory and firm’s policy and procedure requirements
Maintain an audit trail for all work carried out during the control testing, reporting and action plan stages
Escalate weaknesses identified to TRM Managers for discussion and further investigation if deemed necessary.
Draft and validate issues and recommendations addressing the root cause of the issues with stakeholders.
Ensure that all findings and recommendations are entered into the appropriate tool for tracking purposes, perform periodic follow-up with stakeholders of open issues and review / validate submitted closure evidence to ensure proper resolution.
Report results in Digitized Control Sheets, SharePoint Workflow, CIB/TRM SharePoint Reporting tool & PowerBI dashboards. Ensure to use various tools as rolled out by CIB / TRM-E team from time to time
Enhance, deliver, and support the annual TRM Plan, ensuring coverage for existing Firm standards, new regulations, changes to existing regulations, and any audit or exam findings.
Achieve objectives within strict time constraints.
Contributing Responsibilities
In the spirit of continuous improvement, assist with the identification of potential enhancements to the TRM process, tools, reporting and analytics and provide suggestions on how to improve, add to, or streamline current practices in the firm.
Assist the team manager with tasks which may include assisting in testing reviews, preparing materials, organizing meetings, and taking minutes.
Respond timely to internal or external requests for information and analysis.
Assist in responding to regulatory and internal audit queries.
Assist with related Compliance monitoring activities as needed.
Promote a compliance culture within the firm which supposes also to update knowledge on a regular basis.
Technical & Behavioral Competencies
Excellent IT and excel skills
Excellent communication and project management skills
A good understanding of Financial Markets (participants, basic products and activities) and related Compliance topics including AML, Sanctions, KYC, KYI, KYS, KYX, Market Integrity, Market Abuse Surveillance, Swap Dealer, Banking Structural Reforms, Client interest Protection, Client Fiscal Regulations, Professional Ethics topics
Team player with interpersonal and teamwork skills
Self-confidence, ability to stand their ground when required
Flexibility and adaptability to work on different topics
Specific Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree or higher from an accredited institution
Compliance, Audit, Risk Management qualifications.
Skills Referential (Required knowledge, skills and abilities)
Minimum 5 years’ experience working for a financial services firm and/or self-regulatory organization in a Compliance Monitoring/Testing, Internal Audit or regulatory related position.
Working knowledge of capital markets and investment banking activities and regulatory requirements governing those activities.
Strong analytical, organizational abilities, project management skills and attention to detail.
Problem solving, critical thinking, investigative and root cause identification skills.
Advanced computer skills including MS Excel (including macros), Word, and PowerPoint; Power BI is a plus.
Excellent execution skills with the ability to work successfully under demanding deadlines.
Team player with ability to work collaboratively across Compliance.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to interact effectively with front and back-office staff and senior management
High ethical standards.
Flexibility to adapt to a new and changing environment.
Technical Skills:
Basic knowledge on AI and python preferred
Behavioral Skills:
Ability to collaborate / Teamwork
Attention to detail / rigor
Decision Making
Communication skills - oral & written
Education Level: Bachelor Degree or equivalent
Location: Mumbai

Description:
Job Description
Overview
A Growth Associate owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative & On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience & Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

POSITION SUMMARY
Promote awareness of brand image internally and externally. Use sales techniques that maximize revenue while maintaining existing guest loyalty to Marriott. Communicate with potential owners via telephone to set up preview package sales/tours. Encourage guests or callers to purchase or schedule preview package sales/tours. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards.

Description:
Dear Candidate,

Looking to build something meaningful for Indias MSMEs? Join Tata nexarc, a digital-first B2B platform from the house of Tata, as our Sr. Associate Operations.

About the role:
Own the end-to-end order journey for steel and bitumen raw material orders, from order verification to delivery and proof of delivery. You will be the face of Tata nexarc Operations for customers.

Key Responsibilities:
Manage the full supply chain lifecycle of assigned orders: order verification, documentation checks and seller dispatch coordination.
Monitor deliveries, collect Proof of Delivery (POD), and ensure quality and compliance requirements are met.
Track payments and customer credit limits as per SOPs and payment terms.
Maintain OTIF (On-Time In-Full) delivery performance of 85% or higher, and escalate exceptions early.
Validate documents: customer and seller POs, proforma and tax invoices, e-way bills, Mill Test Certificates (MTC) and delivery proofs.
Coordinate with transporters, fleet owners and drivers, and visit seller locations and transporter hubs when needed.

Desired Candidate Profile:
Graduate or postgraduate in Supply Chain, Operations, Logistics or Engineering.
2–6 years in operations, supply chain, logistics or customer operations; steel experience preferred, bitumen or commodity exposure a plus.
Working knowledge of ERP, CRM and AI-enabled productivity tools.
Strong English and Hindi communication, stakeholder management, attention to detail and a bias for action.

Why Join Us:
Join a start-up from the house of Tata. Build the India Stack with a nation-first vision of uplifting SMEs, in a fast-paced culture built on Integrity, Pioneering, Unity, Responsibility and Excellence. You get high autonomy through agile cross-functional teams, and you will work on SME-focused products. Benefits include a hybrid work model, need-based health, wellness and childcare leaves, Tata group employee benefits, and medical, term life and personal accident insurance.


Skills: Order Management, Supply Chain, Logistics, OTIF, E-way Bill, MTC, Steel, Bitumen, ERP, Stakeholder Management .

If this sounds like you, apply now and be part of the Tata nexarc journey.

Purpose of the role

The face of the D2C platform in the physical market. Visit mechanics, roadside garages, small workshops, and truck operators in an assigned territory. Demonstrate the platform, register new buyers, facilitate the first purchase, and ensure the buyer can use the app independently. This role converts an unorganized market buyer into a digital platform user.

Cover assigned pin codes daily visit mechanics, garages, and small fleet operators to introduce the D2C platform
Register new buyers on the platform (app install + profile creation) target 15+ new registrations per day

Maintain a daily activity log: shops visited, registrations done, first purchases facilitated
Attend weekly territory review with Category Manager / Lead BD

13 years in field sales, FMCG distribution, insurance agency, or fintech outreach roles
Knowledge of commercial vehicles or spare parts market strongly preferred
Smartphone proficiency; able to demonstrate app fluently in local language
High energy and comfort with ground-level market work workshops, roadside interactions
Local language fluency essential; Hindi and regional language preferred
Diploma Holder from Mechanical Background

Purpose of the Role
The position will be responsible for driving retail sales of Passenger Electric Vehicles to personal customers in assigned regions to achieve business objectives in terms of volumes, market share and customer experience; the incumbent is to provide focus to EV retail efforts, including market activation, tie-ups, customer & pipeline management
Lack of focus for EV retail in a primarily ICE focused dealership structure; limited EV ecosystem development and activation for personal segment EV buyers
Job Responsibility
1. Driving EV Retail Sales volumes & Market Share:
Deliver Retail targets for the city/region through dealership as well as alternate channel sales teams
Direct responsibility of managing sales in Store-in-Store/Experience Centres
Micro-market activation: Identify, optimize and conduct micro market activations within the region to optimize lead generation and conversion
Interface with dealerships through PV TSMs to seek dealer support & ensure dealer focus to achieve retail targets
Optimize test drives and conversion through special initiatives executed through dealers and alternate channels
Develop market intelligence on customer preferences, competitor offerings, key opportunities, etc. and share with Head – EV Retail Sales
Develop and manage region specific tie-ups to increase value proposition of EVs
2. Manage Customer Relationships:
Engage frequently with EV customers & serve as first point of escalation for customers (adhering to SLAs)
Share feedback with Charging Solutions & Customer Experience teams
3. Team Management:
Monitor Sales funnel and direct Product Specialists to Manage pool of TML Sales executives deployed in alternate sales channels to take appropriate follow-up actions to ensure retail customer satisfaction.
Onboard and manage product specialists across relevant sales channels
Stakeholder Profiles & Nature of Interactions
Internal:
Regional Customer Care Manager
Specific service campaigns/ communicate service-related issues being faced by retail customers in the region
Sales Planning
Providing inputs on the sales forecast and tracking delivery
Zonal Retail Marketing
Align on EV specific offers
Charging Solutions/
Customer Experience
Communicating product/service feedback received on-ground to charging/customer experience team
PVBU TSM
Interface with TSMs to seek dealer support and ensure dealer focus to achieve retail targets

External:
Channel Partners
Direct Feedback/ daily assistance to them to sort issues.
Financial Institutions
For financial offerings as required by retail customers (along with RCFI, at times directly)
Desired Candidate Profile
Education: B.E/ B. Tech & MBA - Sales & Marketing
Relevant Experience: 5-6 years of Sales & Marketing experience with a focus in EV/PV sales.
Understanding of Competition Product Portfolio and own competitive advantage.
Ability to communicate with learned and environmentally conscious set of Customers.
Experience in Value Selling concept of Sales.
Ability to lead and manage teams and achieve targets; drive product specialists and dealerships to achieve retail targets
Strong Oral & written communication with good fluency in English language and local language of relevant city/region
Ability to guide teams in prioritizing and managing customer pipeline without losing sales
Strong planning & problem solving skills to create city specific market activation plans, tie-ups and customer schemes
Knowledge of EV/PV sales process and sales resource allocation
Ability to influence colleagues/ other BU manpower without direct reporting relationship
Strong sales team leadership experience/ skills, evidenced through track record or references
Strong experience in Retail customer management, handling escalations and working with multiple internal stakeholders etc.
Knowledge of EV/PV sales process and sales resource allocation
Good technical knowledge of EV/PV products along with product features
Skills & Competencies
Effective Communication and Influencing Skills
Ability to drive teams to meet targets
Result Oriented approach
Accountability & Ownership
Ability to change user behaviour
Data Driven

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a smooth check-in and check-out.
Instead, we want to build and experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Guest Experience Experts take the initiative to deliver a wide range of services that guide guests through their entire stay.
They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done.
Whether processing operational needs, addressing guest requests, completing reports, or sharing the highlights of the local area, the Guest Experience Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, protecting company assets, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Experience Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Experience Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: No related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

We are Hiring for Store Manager (for HealthKart Retail Store)

Designation- Store Manager

Location- Bhilai

Job Specification:-

Energetic and ready to take challenges.
Demonstrable leadership abilities
Age between 18 - 35
Exp - 2 to 6 years
Industry: Health Supplement & sports nutrition preferable, Retail Store
Having sound knowledge of Nutrition and supplements, retail sales
Should have good communication skills
Marketing activities need to be done (LMS)
Gym visits to increase the sale of store and awareness
Excellent Selling Skills

Job Description:-

Overall operational responsibility of HealthKart store.
Taking care of customer service
Creating new customer database to increase the sale and share daily customer
footfall report to your reporting manager.
Stock/Inventory management - inward & outward
Participate and conduct BTL & Local Store Marking activities to increase Sales of
the Store i.e. Gym visit, product sampling in the different kinds of events.
Handling store - Opening & closing of the store
Cash management and daily banking with banking partner without any error.
Raising customers Invoice
Following store aesthetics
Strong in operations & eye for detail.
Strong in maintaining KPIs of the store.
Promoting of products and services of the organization.
Prepare and share Daily Sales MIS of the store.

Interested candidate can share resume at akshat.chauhan@brightlifecare.com or Call/WhatsApp- 9650023605

Description:
About the Role : Dainik Bhaskar is looking for a highly driven sales professional to lead and grow advertisement revenue across key business categories. The role requires a blend of sales leadership, client relationship management, category understanding, and revenue generation capabilities. The incumbent will be responsible for managing a sales team, acquiring new advertisers, retaining existing clients, and achieving assigned revenue targets.


Key Responsibilities:
1.Sales Leadership & Team Management
Lead and manage a team of Field Sales Executives (FSEs) and sales professionals.
Set monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue targets for the team. Conduct regular performance reviews, pipeline reviews, and coaching sessions.
Drive accountability through daily activity tracking and sales monitoring. Develop team capabilities through mentoring and field accompaniment.

2.Revenue Generation & Business Development
Achieve and exceed assigned revenue targets.
Build and manage a robust 90-day sales pipeline.
Identify and acquire new advertisers across categories.
Drive client retention, renewal, upselling, and cross-selling opportunities.
Ensure strong conversion rates from prospecting to closure.


3. Client Relationship Management
Build strong relationships with business owners, CXOs, marketing heads, and decision-makers.
Understand client business objectives and recommend suitable advertising solutions.
Conduct effective sales presentations and proposal discussions. Handle negotiations, pricing discussions, and contract closures professionally.
Maintain long-term advertiser relationships and enhance client satisfaction.


4. Category Development & Market Intelligence
Develop strong understanding of key categories such as: Education / Real Estate / Automobile / Retail / FMCG / BFSI
Track market trends, competitor activities, launches, and promotional opportunities.
Identify category-wise revenue opportunities and develop growth strategies, Prepare category acquisition and retention plans.

5. Media Sales & Advertising Solutions
Promote print advertising solutions and integrated media offerings. Understand ad inventory, pricing structures, packages, and campaign planning.
Guide clients on campaign execution, visibility, reach, and impact. Coordinate with internal stakeholders for seamless campaign delivery.

6. Communication & Presentation
Prepare client-specific proposals and sales presentations.
Conduct effective client meetings, pitches, and business reviews. Communicate professionally in Hindi and English, both written and verbal.
Deliver regular sales updates and business reports.

7. Planning & Business Analytics
Track sales performance using Excel, CRM, and reporting tools.
Analyse category trends, revenue performance, client retention, and market opportunities.
Prepare monthly and quarterly business plans. Develop action plans to improve productivity and revenue realization.

8. Educational Qualification: Graduate in any discipline / MBA in Marketing / Sales / Business Development preferred.

9. Preferred Additional Skills:Exposure to print advertisement sales, Experience handling multiple categories or markets, understanding of digital advertising platforms, Ability to design integrated advertising solutions combining print and digital media.

• Retail Store Staff / Store Associates

• Weekly off and other benefits as per company policy.

Description:
SUMMARY
Summary
We are currently seeking dedicated and detail-oriented individuals to serve as Off-Role Quality & Process Control Representatives (OPC) for a leading paints manufacturing firm across various locations throughout India. This role offers an excellent opportunity for professionals with a background in quality control, production, or manufacturing operations to contribute to maintaining high standards within a respected industry name. The position is pivotal in ensuring product integrity and operational compliance from raw material sourcing through to final dispatch.

Responsibilities
Oversee the quality of raw and packaging materials at vendor sites to ensure they meet established standards.
Execute quality inspections, sampling procedures, and testing protocols in strict accordance with approved specifications.
Supervise production workflows to guarantee adherence to approved formulations and recipes.
Validate batch charging procedures, premix measurements, and the accuracy of production records.
Manage token systems effectively and reconcile them against finished goods shipments.
Perform final quality assessments on completed goods and maintain comprehensive batch-specific documentation.
Track filling weights, verify laboratory equipment calibration, and monitor critical quality parameters.
Generate and submit daily activity reports via a mobile application equipped with geo-tagging capabilities.
Detect any deviations in quality standards and promptly escalate significant findings to management.
Assist in scheduled quality audits and ensure ongoing compliance with regulatory and internal activities.



Requirements
Possess a Graduate degree or Diploma in Science, Chemistry, or a closely related field.
Have between 0.6 to 3 years of professional experience in quality control, production, manufacturing, or conducting plant and vendor audits.
Demonstrate practical knowledge of quality testing methods, sampling techniques, and documentation processes.
Exhibit strong observational, reporting, and analytical capabilities.
Be willing and able to work at external vendor or plant locations and utilize mobile applications for reporting tasks.

Location: Raipur

* Eligibility Criteria:
Graduate/Diploma in Science, Chemistry or a related discipline.
0.6 3 years of experience in Quality Control, Production, Manufacturing or Plant/Vendor Audits.
Knowledge of quality testing, sampling and documentation
Good observation, reporting and analytical skills.
Comfortable working at vendor/plant locations and using mobile applications.

Job Summary
The Deputy Relationship Manager for Fast Track Loan within the South Business department at Ujjivan Small Finance Bank plays a pivotal role in driving the growth and management of the bank's fast track loan portfolio. This position requires a strategic and customer-centric professional who can effectively manage client relationships, assess creditworthiness, and ensure timely disbursal of loans while adhering to regulatory and internal compliance standards. The role demands collaboration with cross-functional teams to optimize loan processing, mitigate risks, and enhance customer satisfaction in a competitive banking environment focused on financial inclusion and rapid service delivery.
Job Type: Full-time


Key Duties and Responsibilities
Manage and nurture relationships with existing and prospective clients to promote fast track loan products tailored to their financial needs.
Conduct thorough credit appraisals and risk assessments to ensure the quality and profitability of the loan portfolio.
Coordinate with credit, legal, and compliance teams to ensure all loan disbursals meet regulatory guidelines and internal policies.
Drive the end-to-end loan processing cycle, ensuring timely documentation, verification, and disbursal to meet customer expectations.
Identify opportunities for cross-selling and upselling additional banking products to enhance customer value and bank revenue.
Monitor loan repayments and proactively manage delinquency by engaging with customers to resolve issues and minimize non-performing assets.
Prepare detailed reports on loan portfolio performance, market trends, and customer feedback for senior management review.
Collaborate with marketing and product teams to develop and implement strategies that increase loan penetration in the South Business region.
Train and mentor junior relationship managers and field staff to improve team effectiveness and customer engagement.
Stay updated with industry developments, regulatory changes, and competitive landscape to adapt strategies accordingly.


Minimum Requirements of Knowledge and Skills

Educational Qualifications
Bachelors degree in Finance, Business Administration, or a related field; MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification preferred.
Minimum of 4-6 years of experience in retail banking or microfinance, with a focus on loan portfolio management and customer relationship management.

Credit Risk Assessment
Loan Portfolio Management
Customer Relationship Management (CRM)
Regulatory Compliance in Banking
Financial Analysis and Reporting
Cross-selling and Upselling Techniques
Negotiation and Conflict Resolution
Team Leadership and Mentoring
Documentation and Loan Processing


Behavioural Skills
Market Research and Competitive Analysis

Description:
About the company
Treebo Hospitality Ventures is Indias most loved brand and one of the largest chains in the budget segment of hospitality. With a network of 850+ hotels across 120+ cities, Treebo offers travellers the unprecedented value proposition of high-quality stays at affordable prices wherever they go. We are proud of putting dignity back into budget travel where earlier the traveller was forced to contend with poor quality and hygiene. Treebo Hospitality Ventures masterfully combines engineering prowess with deep hospitality expertise. Our operational ethos is clear and focused from Treebo Club, an innovative distribution platform and extremely rewarding loyalty programme to Hotel Superhero, a cutting-edge SaaS solution and a comprehensive hotel management software. With a strong technological foundation and a passion for hospitality, THV aims to deliver exceptional experiences across our diverse portfolio. Our range of brandsItsy Hotels, Treebo,
Treebo Premium and Medalioprovides a symphony of choices that blend quality, comfort and affordability. Treebo is a Great Places to Work certified organisation. We take immense pride in our culture which is built on a strong foundation of 7 values. Some of these values include - Exhibit Owner Mindset and Have the humility and hunger to learn and help learn, amongst others. We strongly believe in offering our people - “Treebs”, as they are called - unmatched opportunities to learn and grow. If you’re looking to work at a place that is built on strong fundamentals of
business and professional conduct, Treebo is the place for you.
About the Role
As an Area General Manager, you will be responsible for executing the company’s strategic vision of democratizing the joy of travel. You will be responsible for a given area and the portfolio there in to ensure highest levels of guest experience, product quality and business & profitability of the assets. While managing the operations and enabling
sales for your portfolio, you will also drive the expansion of our hotel portfolio across your area and beyond through your network. This is a mission critical role that requires a perfect balance of delivering operational excellence, relationship management, and a
business development mindset.
Key Responsibilities -
1) Operational Excellence
Oversee day-to-day operations across multiple hotel properties in your area, ensuring adherence to brand standards and service benchmarks
Drive compliance with Treebo's brand standards and SOPs, health and safety guidelines, and service quality norms
Conduct audits, quality assurance checks, and drive corrective/preventive actions through hotel partners to maintain Treebo standards
Act as the key liaison between the company and hotel partners, ensuring seamless coordination and timely issue resolution
Monitor and enhance overall guest satisfaction by ensuring prompt and effective service recovery mechanisms
2) Business Development & Growth
Identify, evaluate, and onboard new hotel properties to expand the company’s portfolio within the assigned area
Negotiate terms of the agreement and ensure complete alignment with Treebo's operating procedures before onboarding any hotel
Collaborate with the central business development team to oversee launch process of the signed properties
3) Sales & MICE
Drive regional sales performance by collaborating with internal sales teams and property owners to achieve revenue targets for your portfolio
Identify and push sales POCs to close MICE deals for your portfolio properties
Support pricing, promotions, and campaigns to drive business at the property level
Engage with local corporate clients, event organizers, and travel planners to push business to your portfolio if needed
4) Team & Partner Management
Lead, mentor, and develop on-ground portfolio hotel teams to deliver exceptional guest experience in the segment
Train hotel staff in brand values, SOPs, and customer service skills to ensure consistency
Build strong relationships with hotel owners and partners to foster collaboration and long-term association

- Conducts site inspections.

About the Role
We are looking for an experienced SAP MDG Consultant to join our SAP practice. The candidate will be responsible for implementing, configuring, supporting, and optimizing SAP Master Data Governance (MDG) solutions across enterprise environments.

Implement and support SAP MDG solutions for enterprise master data management.
Design, configure, and maintain MDG data models for Customer, Vendor, Material, Business Partner, and Financial master data.

Monitor and improve master data quality across business domains.
Collaborate with business users to define governance policies and controls.
Support data migration, cleansing, enrichment, and harmonization initiatives.
Work on data replication and synchronization activities across landscapes.
Conduct SIT, UAT, regression testing, and production support activities.
Troubleshoot master data issues and perform root cause analysis.
Prepare functional specifications and support technical development teams.
Participate in implementation, rollout, upgrade, and transformation projects.
Ensure compliance with organizational data governance standards.
Provide user training, documentation, and knowledge transfer sessions.

Ability to accept and implement feedback effectively.
Excellent time management and multitasking skills.
Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
Strong work ethic and commitment to delivering results.

Job Summary
As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom. At EY, we don't just focus on who you are now, but who you can become. We believe that its your career and Its yours to build which means potential here is limitless and we'll provide you with motivating and fulfilling experiences throughout your career to help you on the path to becoming your best professional self.
The opportunity: Consultant-National-TAX-TAX - ITTS - Advisory - Bangalore
National comprises of sector agnostic teams working across industries for a well rounded experience.
TAX - ITTS - Advisory :
Our globally coordinated tax professionals offer connected services across all tax disciplines to help the clients thrive in an era of rapid change. We combine our exceptional knowledge and experience with the people and technology platforms to equip clients in making better business decisions by bringing insights to the forefront. We help companies understand the tax policies and tax laws of governments around the world to plan and comply accordingly. Our teams leverage transformative technologies to deliver strategy and execution, from tax and regulatory obligations to operations and workforce management, to reduce risk and drive sustainable value.
We have competencies in Business Tax Services, Global Compliance and Reporting, Global Law, Indirect Tax, International Tax and Transaction Services.
Responsibilities
Technical Excellence
Your main objective is to help the Transaction tax team deliver quality deliverables using tax knowledge gained from training and assistance from more experienced tax professionals.
Contribute to the profitable growth by ensuring client engagements are executed in an efficient manner.
Conduct the engagement in a professional manner and in accordance with client expectations and as defined by the terms and conditions of the contract.
To the extent you have client contact, build productive working relationships with your clients.
Exhibit positive attitude and demonstrate willingness to learn.
Contribute and leverage knowledge from individuals, databases and other sources.
Provide timely and high quality services and work products.
Mentoring and coaching interns and consultants.
Research and analysis of transaction tax related laws on inbound and outbound deals, corporate reorganizations, securities market aspects, etc.
Research on tax theory and positions, and apply them to specific client needs.
Prepare deliverables capturing implications arrived on the basis of above research, in word, PowerPoint, excel or email form as required.
Perform direct tax diligence and capture the facts and analysis in a diligence report.
Skills and attributes for success
Ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously & attention to detail.
Positive attitude and responsible and ability to handle pressure.
Willingness to travel locally and outside city for work.
To qualify for the role you must have
A qualified Charted Accountant with 0-2 years of relevant experience
Preferred Tax experience either during internship or post qualification
Use and apply the right tax practice processes and tools to be as efficient as possible in your work
What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.
What we offer
Fuelled by the brilliance of our people, EY has emerged as the strongest brand and the most attractive employer in our field, with market-leading growth over competitors. Our people work side-by-side with market-leading entrepreneurs, game-changers, disruptors, and visionaries. As an organization, we are investing more time, technology, and money than ever before in skills and learning for our people. At EY, you will have a personalized Career Journey and also the chance to tap into the resources of our career frameworks to better know about your roles, skills, and opportunities. EY is equally committed to being an inclusive employer, and we strive to achieve the right balance for our people enabling us to deliver excellent client service while allowing our people to build their careers as well as focus on their wellbeing.

Job Summary
The opportunity: Consultant-TMT-Business Consulting Risk-CNS - RISK - DIGITAL RISK - Bangalore.
TMT :
Industry convergence offers TMT (Technology, Media & Entertainment, and Telecommunications) organizations the chance to evolve and transform, but it also presents challenges around competitiveness and delivering agile corporate strategies for growth. Content distributors are transforming into content producers, service providers are becoming tech companies, technology companies are the catalyst for dramatic change in every sector, and customers want the latest innovations now.
We help TMT companies create compelling employee and customer experiences, retaining skills and talent while achieving enterprise-wide operational excellence. We help them protect their data, brand and reputation. We also enable the pursuit of M&A strategies that systematically create value, reduce risk and transform TMT companies into powerhouses that will lead the technology revolution of the future building a better working world for all.
CNS - RISK - digital RISK :
EY Consulting is building a better working world by transforming businesses through the power of people, technology and innovation. Our client-centric approach focuses on driving long-term value for our clients by solving their most strategic problems. EY Consulting is made up of three sub-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services.
We help our clients in identifying and managing the interplay between upside and downside risk in order to make the long-term decisions to prevent risk and impact on their organization's ability to meet its future business strategy and objectives. The 3 key fields of play are :
Enterprise Risk - helps clients identify and address key risk areas, while building the agility to respond quickly. The areas of focus include Enterprise risk and resilience, Internal audit, Compliance and Internal controls
Technology Risk - helps clients to achieve sustainable growth by supporting their efforts to protect their business performance and by providing trusted communications on internal control and regulatory compliance to investors, management, regulators, customers and other stakeholders. EY teams accomplish this by assessing the technology risks that are introduced to businesses.
Financial Services Risk - helps clients in the financial sector to identify, manage and monitor the risks in their business. It is done through a transformative and agile approach including process and procedures, risk, data modeling and analytics, reporting to stakeholders and third parties, business requirements (for software selection and IT implementation), analysis of assets and liabilities, and capital and liquidity management.
Your key responsibilities Technical Excellence
Strong capability in managing end-to-en
Perform assessments of computer systems and processes for Life Sciences clients (compliance with internal procedures, leading practices, and regulatory requirements)
Create/ reviewCSV deliverables like user requirements, system specifications, Validation Plan, Qualification Plans, SOPs, IQ/OQ/PQ, Traceability matrix, Design Specs, and validation summary reports
Provide guidance and oversight of validation activities for projects involving GxP relevant computer systems
Work closely with project team members to incorporate appropriate elements of quality and compliance into the system lifecycle
Review and approve computer system validation work products, assuring thoroughness of validation planning and making appropriate progress towards timely completion of validation deliverables
Skills and attributes To qualify for the role you must have
Experience in Quality and Compliance withhands-on computer system validation experience on Enterprise Applications (SAP ECC/HANA, LIMS, QMS, ELN, DMS, PLM, CRM, CTMS, RPA etc.)
Experience in FDA regulated environment with good understanding of cGxP (cGMP, cGDP, cGAMP, cGLP) standards and Risk based validation.
Experience with validation/ testing tools like HPALM, Azure DevOps (ADO) etc. will be an added advantage
Experience in training validation resources will be an added advantage
What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

Description:
Job Summary
We are looking for a highly experienced Staff Engineer with deep expertise in Windows internals, Active Directory internals, and AD security. This is a single, combined role: you will build the Windows agent, model Active Directory at the protocol and database level, and reason about how attackers compromise a directory and how a defender recovers from it. The work spans granular change tracking, object recovery, forest-level backup, identity threat detection, and full forest recovery onto clean operating systems.
Responsibilities
Design and deliver AD protection features: granular change tracking, object- and attribute-level recovery, forest-aware backup, and full forest recovery.
Build and own the Windows agenta signed, serviceable, silently upgradeable component running on domain controllers.
Design identity threat detection: change-delta engines, rules for privileged-object and ACL abuse, and the findings pipeline into audit log and SIEM.
Own the safety of write and restore paths - idempotent steps, USN-rollback safety, pre-flight validation before any destructive action.
Engage across the security lifecycle: threat modeling, architecture review, attack-surface reduction, vulnerability remediation.
Work hands-on in code and test automation, including automated recovery drills and fidelity validation.
Lead projects, mentor engineers, and build Windows and AD depth across the team.
Education
B.S./M.S./Ph.D. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
Experience
10+ years in software design and development, with significant time on Windows-platform software.
5+ years with Active Directory internals - building software that reads, writes, replicates, backs up, or recovers directory data, not only administering it.
3+ years security-focused: identity security, detection engineering, security architecture, or product security.
Shipping agent or systems software onto customer-managed production infrastructure.
Windows Platform Agent Engineering
Windows internals: registry and hive structure, the SYSTEM hive and BootKey material, WMI, services, RPC.
Agent development in C++, C#, or Go; VSS writers and shadow copy APIs - writer sets, freeze/thaw, DiskShadow, orphaned shadows.
Windows security model: SIDs, tokens, privileges, ACLs and SDDL, impersonation, service accounts.
Serviceability and transport: code signing, MSI packaging, silent upgrade, mTLS and certificate handling, gRPC agent-to-cluster channels with resumable operations.
Debugging: WinDbg, ETW, performance counters, dump analysis; PowerShell modules, remoting, and hosting PowerShell from native code.
Active Directory Internals
Schema, object classes, naming contexts, linked-value replication; safe writes - modify, ModifyDN, object create.
LDAP at depth: filters, server controls, paged and persistent search, change notification; DirSync and USN cookies for incremental capture.
Tombstones, deleted-object lifetime, Recycle Bin; SID, SID history and GUID continuity semantics.
Group Policy internals (GPC/GPT, SYSVOL, DFSR/FRS, authoritative restore); AD-integrated DNS zones, forwarders, delegation.
Database and topology mechanics: ESE/JET, ntds.dit and logs, esentutl, FSMO, trusts, repadmin/dcdiag, USN rollback, DC promotion, IFM, DSRM, RODC.
Active Directory Security ITDR
Kerberos and NTLM internals: ticket flow, delegation, krbtgt and its role in forest compromise and recovery.
AD attack techniques and their detectable artifacts - DCSync, DCShadow, AdminSDHolder tampering, ACL abuse, privileged group manipulation, ticket forgery.
Detection engineering: deterministic rules with low false-positive rates, baseline-diff and attack-path reasoning; AD auditing and change attribution.
Cyber recovery of identity: clean-source and clean-OS principles, malware re-introduction risk in image-based restore, isolation during recovery.
SIEM integration (syslog, CEF, webhooks); threat modeling a component that runs privileged on a domain controller.
General
Distributed systems: durable state machines, idempotency, crash recovery and resume, long-running orchestration. Protocols: LDAP, Kerberos, DNS, SMB, TLS, gRPC, REST.
Test automation for infrastructure software: multi-domain forest labs, destructive recovery drills, upgrade and interop matrices.
Soft Skills
Excellent analytical skills under incomplete information - customer forests are never the lab forest.
Ability to lead initiatives, mentor, and explain directory-level failure modes to non-specialist audiences.
Sound judgement about risk. Recovery software gets one chance to be right, and knowing when not to proceed matters as much as knowing how.
Nice to Have
A commercial AD backup, recovery, or ITDR product, or having executed a real forest recovery.
AD tooling - DSInternals, BloodHound, PingCastle; hybrid identity with Entra ID and Entra Connect.
Windows kernel or filter driver work; EDR allowlisting; air-gapped or regulated environments.
Published security work, CVE credits, Red/Blue Team experience; OSCP, GCFA, or equivalent.
Location
This position is located in our office in Bangalore or Pune, India.

Description:
About us:
Paytm is Indias leading digital payments and financial services company, which is focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform by offering them a variety of payment use cases. Paytm provides consumers with services like utility payments and money transfers, while empowering them to pay via Paytm Payment Instruments (PPI) like Paytm Wallet, Paytm UPI, Paytm Payments Bank Netbanking, Paytm FASTag and Paytm Postpaid - Buy Now, Pay Later. To merchants, Paytm offers acquiring devices like Soundbox, EDC, QR and Payment Gateway where payment aggregation is done through PPI and also other banks financial instruments. To further enhance merchants business, Paytm offers merchants commerce services through advertising and Paytm Mini app store. Operating on this platform leverage, the company then offers credit services such as merchant loans, personal loans and BNPL, sourced by its financial partners.

About the team: EDC Retail – EDC is one of Paytm‘s business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.

About the role:
The person should be capable of increasing the sale of EDC machines through proper channels to the merchants across multiple locations.
Expectations/ Requirements :
1. Create an inspiring team environment with an open communication culture
2. Need to drive swiping device sales in the assigned area.
3. Resolving merchant queries 
4. Drive overall engage merchant base 
5. Capable of hiring and building team
6. Set clear team goals
7. Delegate tasks and set deadlines
8. Oversee day-to-day operation
9. Monitor team performance and report on metrics
10 .Motivate team members
11. Discover training needs and provide coaching
12 .Listen to team members feedback and resolve any issues or conflicts
13. Recognize high performance and reward accomplishments
14. Encourage creativity and risk-taking
15. Suggest and organize team building activities

Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role  
1. High level of drive, initiative and self-motivation
2. Must Have Experience in Leading Team
3. Must Be a Graduate
4. Growth Mindset

Why join us :
We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Our success is rooted in our people’s collective energy and unwavering focus on the customers, and that’s how it will always be. We are the largest merchant acquirer in India.

Qualification:- Graduate/Post Graduate

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES AND ACCOUNTABILITIES
Vendor Management & Expediting
Drive proactive vendor engagement with a go-getter attitude to ensure timely deliveries.
Prepare and monitor scheduling lines post-PO release; align supplier schedules with plant requirements.
Track delivery performance, escalate critical delays, and ensure adherence to monthly supply plans.
Utilize Vendor Portal for streamlined communication and grievance resolution.
Collaborate with planning and plant teams to maintain safety stock and optimize storage utilization.
Develop and maintain procurement dashboards for performance tracking and reporting.

Operational Procurement & P2P Cycle
Own the end-to-end Procure-to-Pay (P2P process, ensuring compliance and efficiency.
Process orders via SAP MM; manage both domestic and import purchases using various Incoterms.
Implement engineering change notifications (ECR/ECN) and manage rejection material disposal within defined timelines.
Understand and apply payment terms such as LC/BG in procurement transactions.
Ensure the Long Lead Time parts are well planned based on Season requirement
Supplier RM wise (ABS) monitoring and ensure uninterpreted supplies.

Inventory & Material Management
Manage raw material inventory and refine lead times based on plant requirements.
Measure and report RM/component availability against production plans.
FSN Analysis & Aging Inventory Analysis
Indirect Purchase (Opex/Capex) Experience.

Governance & Compliance
Ensure adherence to government norms related to taxation, safety, and environmental regulations.
Apply 5S, QC tools, and process control charts to enhance procurement operations.
Support corporate SCM initiatives across logistics, planning, strategic sourcing, and supplier development.

Strong analytical and communication skills.
Exposure to vendor negotiations, import/export regulations, and compliance frameworks.
SAP End user skill level important

Indirect purchase experience
