Description:
Sikkim Skill University is looking for Estate Manager to join our dynamic team and embark on a rewarding career journey.

An Estate Manager, also known as a Property Manager or Estate Supervisor, is responsible for overseeing and managing various aspects of a property or estate, ensuring its efficient operation and maintenance. Estate Managers can work in residential, commercial, or institutional settings, and their duties may vary based on the size and nature of the estate they are managing. Key Responsibilities : Property Maintenance : Supervise and coordinate maintenance and repair tasks. Ensure the property is clean, well - maintained, and aesthetically pleasing. Manage landscaping, gardening, and outdoor maintenance activities. Regularly inspect the property to identify maintenance needs and address them promptly. Financial Management : Prepare and manage budgets for property operations and maintenance. Monitor expenses, approve invoices, and reconcile financial records. Negotiate contracts with vendors and service providers to ensure cost - effective services. Security and Safety : Implement and oversee security measures to safeguard the property and its occupants. Coordinate with security personnel and install security systems as necessary. Develop and enforce safety protocols and emergency procedures. Tenant and Guest Relations : Interact with tenants, guests, and residents in a professional and courteous manner. Address tenant concerns, complaints, and requests promptly and effectively. Conduct regular tenant meetings and ensure a high level of tenant satisfaction. Staff Management : Recruit, train, and supervise estate staff, such as maintenance workers, security personnel, and housekeeping staff. Delegate tasks and responsibilities to staff members. Conduct performance evaluations and provide feedback to employees. Administrative Tasks : Maintain accurate records of property - related activities, contracts, and expenses. Prepare regular reports for property owners or management. Handle administrative tasks such as scheduling, correspondence, and document management. Compliance and Regulations : Ensure the property complies with local, state, and federal regulations and codes. Stay updated on relevant laws and regulations affecting property management. Obtain necessary licenses and permits for the property's operation. Project Management : Oversee renovation, remodeling, and construction projects on the property. Coordinate with contractors, architects, and designers to ensure projects are completed on time and within budget. Qualifications : Bachelor's degree in Business, Property Management, Hospitality, or a related field (or equivalent experience). Previous experience in property management, estate management, or a related field is highly desirable. Strong organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills. Knowledge of property management software and basic financial principles. Ability to multitask, prioritize tasks, and work efficiently in a fast - paced environment. Leadership skills and the ability to motivate and manage a team effectively.

Description:
Job Summary
Lead - Policy
ATREE is seeking an experienced professional to lead reviews, analyses, studies, consultations, and recommendations on mountain-specific policies related to biodiversity conservation, landscape restoration, and bio-resource use in the project landscapes and States. The policy vision will be guided by global, regional, national, and state mountain policies from IHR.
You will be a key member of a versatile team led by the Director - The Himalaya Initiative. You will represent ATREE with external stakeholders, including government departments in the project states, IHR states, and at the national level, and will collaborate closely with regional teams in the IHR and at ATREE headquarters in Bengaluru.
In the Himalaya, ATREE s strategy is to work towards a future where resilient mountain and downstream societies sustainably enjoy the natural endowment of the Indian Himalayan Region (IHR) while protecting and preserving its rich biodiversity. ATREE has developed a 10-year strategy called The Himalaya Initiative (THI), focused on the IHR amid increasing biodiversity loss, environmental degradation, and climate change.
Project AMP-Himalaya is funded by the Rural India Supporting Trust (RIST), co-financed by Conservation International and Global Conservation, within the THI strategy, for a 5-year project period. The project aims to conserve biodiversity, restore landscapes, and foster human well-being in the Indian Himalayan Region. Three key areas prioritized to achieve the goal in the IHR are: 1) Assessment, Monitoring, and Conservation of Biodiversity; 2) Restoration of Multi-functional Landscapes; and 3) Nature-based Rural Livelihoods and Climate Change Resilience. Integral to these priorities are: creating digital knowledge commons to accelerate participatory management and local stewardship; strengthening human resources through training programs for local youth leaders and expanded environmental education opportunities; and creating conditions to develop and implement multi-level, mountain-specific policies that prioritize biodiversity conservation and natural resource management at scale.
The project is being implemented in 3 distinct landscapes located in 3 states and 1 union territory of IHR, namely: the Khangchendzonga Landscape covering the Darjeeling hills of North Bengal and Sikkim state; the Trans-Himalayan Landscape representing a high dependence on rangelands with agro-pastoral and pastoral systems in Ladakh; and Arunachal Pradesh with the largest, greenest, ethnically diverse and most biodiversity-rich landscapes.
Responsibilities
Develop and lead the roadmap and strategy, in collaboration with the THI Director, for the policy component of the AMP-Himalaya project, including annual workplans, timely donor and project reporting, and tracking policy outcomes and success indicators.
Lead and drive the process of reviewing existing policies related to biodiversity, forests, rangelands, agroforestry, restoration, bioresource use, nature-based livelihoods, and climate resilience, including stakeholder mapping to identify gaps, overlaps, and mountain-specific policy approaches across the three project landscapes.
Develop and advocate state-level policy action plans across all three landscapes, restoration and agro-ecology (Sikkim), OECM and CCA (Arunachal Pradesh), and rangeland and pastoral governance (Trans-Himalaya, Ladakh), ensuring balanced policy engagement across landscapes.
Lead in conducting FGDs, expert interviews, and multi-stakeholder workshops, following FPIC and inclusive community-engagement protocols and ensuring equitable participation of women and marginalized groups; use findings to flag policies/practices harmful to climate and ecosystem resilience and document successful mountain-specific case studies.
Develop and lead a roadmap for presentation of policy recommendations and briefing papers for key stakeholders for validation, and compile a comprehensive IHR policy report and toolkit for dissemination to stakeholders.
Create and lead the development of Legal-Institutional Framework and Modules for OECM/CCA in Arunachal Pradesh, partnering with external legal counsel engaged by ATREE for specialized legal drafting where required.
Develop and lead policy engagement and advocacy campaigns to raise awareness and strengthen capacity, including training government officials, policymakers, community leaders, and other relevant stakeholders.
Collaborate with ATREE s Academy for Conservation Science and Sustainability Studies and the project s digital knowledge commons to align policy work with ongoing research, fellowships and knowledge generation.
Contribute to the learning and reporting plan; provide technical guidance to Policy Analysts and Consultants; coordinate with landscape, thematic, research, MEL and communications teams.
Represent ATREE in national and international forums and apply a proactive, strategic approach within and outside ATREE to deliver measurable policy impact.
Qualifications
PhD in a related field, i.e., social sciences, environmental/natural sciences/natural resources management, public policy, law, economics, or a related interdisciplinary field.
A background in law, public policy, or economics is preferred in addition to the environmental/natural sciences; where specialized legal drafting is required (e.g., the Legal-Institutional Framework for OECMs/CCA), this will be carried out in partnership with external legal counsel engaged by ATREE.
Experience Required
5-6 years of professional experience in policy development and analysis, with substantial experience in mountain policy frameworks and a strong focus on the Himalaya.
Strong networking skills and demonstrated ability to build and maintain relationships with stakeholders.
Strong understanding of policy processes in government systems.
Demonstrated understanding of, and commitment to, Free, Prior and Informed Consent (FPIC) and ethical community engagement protocols when working with indigenous and local communities in the IHR.
Sensitivity to gender and social inclusion considerations, with the ability to help ensure equitable participation of women and marginalized groups in FGDs, consultations and workshops.
Excellent written and verbal English skills; knowledge of Hindi and/or a Himalayan regional language is an advantage; where not proficient, willingness to work through local translators/facilitators is required.
Excellent communication skills, with demonstrated ability to coordinate teams, motivate colleagues and engage effectively with diverse stakeholders.
Proficient in analytical skills, report writing, and documentation.
Willingness to travel extensively across project locations in the Himalaya.
Experience working with nonprofits in the Conservation / Environment / Sustainability / Biodiversity space highly desirable.
Self-motivated and able to work independently while collaborating across teams and geographies to deliver on a set of goals.
Strong organizational, interpersonal and leadership skills with the ability to motivate and lead small teams.
Desirable Skills
Working knowledge of international and regional mountain and biodiversity frameworks, including the CBD Global Biodiversity Framework, ICIMOD/Hindu Kush Himalaya frameworks, and UNFCCC/NDC processes.
Experience in grant management, resource mobilization, proposal writing, and donor engagement.
Experience using digital knowledge and communication tools, including data visualization and dashboards, to translate technical findings into accessible briefs and toolkits.

Description:
Role Overview:
Medhavi Skills University is seeking a dynamic Senior Manager Placements to lead the university s corporate engagement and student placement strategy at the Sikkim campus. This leadership role will be responsible for building strong industry partnerships, managing the placement team, and ensuring high-quality placement opportunities for students through strategic recruiter engagement. He will be responsible for getting all eligible
students placed.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Leadership & Team Management
Lead and manage the Campus Placement & Corporate Relations team to achieve placement goals.
Define KPIs, performance targets and accountability structures for the placement team.
Monitor team performance through regular reviews and ensure timely achievement of placement milestones.
Mentor team members and strengthen internal systems for effective placement management.
2. Industry Partnerships & Corporate Outreach for Placements
Develop and expand long-term partnerships with corporates, recruiters and industry bodies across sectors.
Identify and establish new recruitment partnerships for internships and final placements by frequent visits to Companies, Organizations PAN India.
Actively engage with industry leaders to position the university as a preferred talent sourcing partner.
Maintain strong relationships with existing recruiters to ensure recurring hiring engagements.
3. Placement Strategy & Performance Monitoring
Develop and implement the annual placement strategy for the campus.
Monitor placement progress across programs and ensure achievement of placement targets and quality benchmarks.
Establish systems for data-driven monitoring of placement performance, including placement dashboards and reports.
Provide periodic insights and updates to university leadership on placement outcomes.
4. Stakeholder Management
Work closely with academic leadership and faculty to align student skills with industry requirements.
Coordinate with internal teams to strengthen student employability and career readiness initiatives.
Ensure effective communication between students, recruiters, faculty, and the placement team.
5. Employer Branding & Institutional Representation
Represent the university in corporate meetings, industry forums, and networking platforms.
Promote the university s talent pool to attract high-quality recruiters and hiring partners.
Strengthen the university s reputation as an industry-aligned institution with strong placement outcomes.
Qualifications & Skills Required:
Master s degree in Management, HR or related field.
8-12 years of experience in placements, corporate relations or industry partnerships.
Mandatory: Prior experience managing placements in universities or higher education institutions at least 3-5 years.
Proven experience in building corporate partnerships and managing recruitment engagements.
Candidates should be proficient in: Corporate relationship management
Team leadership and performance monitoring
Strategic planning and execution
Stakeholder management
Strong networking and negotiation skills
Data-driven monitoring and reporting

What We Offer
Opportunity to architect and scale a future-focused, industry-integrated higher education ecosystem.
Competitive compensation with performance-linked incentives.
Leadership role in a rapidly growing national skills and university platform.
A collaborative, mission-driven environment.
The opportunity to create a measurable impact on employability and workforce transformation at scale.
AboutCompany:
Medhavi Skills University (Sikkim) operates in the education and skill development sector, focusing on industry-aligned higher education and vocational training. The university integrates academic learning with practical skill-building to prepare students for employability across diverse sectors. With a mission to bridge the gap between education and workforce needs, Medhavi Skills University emphasizes experiential learning, innovation, and partnerships with industry to deliver future-ready talent.

Description:
Job Summary
A technical procurement specialist supports various business lines to identify, shortlist, select, and acquire suitable goods or services or works from a third-party vendor through a direct purchase while ensuring timely delivery of the right quality and quantity. This role is also expected to maintain and build relationships with the existing suppliers and strategically diversify NOV s supplier base through market research. Having technical aptitude, the technical procurement specialists ensure the conformance of goods and services with engineering specifications during the entire procurement process.
Primary Responsibilities
Work closely with the operations teams to understand procurement requirements details and request vendor quotes.
Participate in the new vendor approval process.
Capture technical and commercial information and order goods in correct quantities to maintain the supply and demand balance.
Coordinate with planning teams to gather service PO workscope, generate service POs and communicate information related to the scope and delivery terms with vendors.
Follow up with vendors and suppliers regarding goods and service procurement and update production teams about delivery date changes when vendor PO due dates are rescheduled
Identify and resolve issues with vendors arising throughout the procurement process.
Identify ongoing procurement process improvement opportunities, review with management and implement as directed.
Liaise with the account payable department.
Comply with local regulations, API and ISO standard requirements.
Participate in API and ISO audits and represent the NOV purchasing department.
Perform other work-related tasks as assigned.
Comply with all NOV Company and HSE procedures and policies.
Analyze technical and commercial information from SMEs required to create vendor service POs.
Coordinate with the quality control department and independent verification authorities to manage inspection and witness activities at the vendor s site.
Determine the timing of placing orders for goods based on required dates and lead times.
Develop strong relationships with key suppliers and measure suppliers performance based on cost, quality, delivery, and service level.
Analyze the market to identify opportunities to expand the vendor base.
Determine vendors based on established criteria, negotiate the organization s purchasing agreements/contracts, and ensure their materials and products meet the company s specifications.
Identify sources based on internal global inventory analysis.
Coordinate with global NOV locations to fulfill unmet goods demand.
Identify potential bottlenecks and implement procurement strategies that support the company goals and long-term outsourcing objectives.
Routinely study vendor capabilities and new vendor establishments locally and regionally
Visit vendor locations to evaluate opportunities to diversify the regional vendor base.
Identify cost reduction opportunities by comparing multiple sources based on time-studies.
Coordinate with all shop departments to maintain knowledge of plant operations and equipment design in order to plan effectively.
Periodically review non-conformances and engineering changes to ensure suppliers are following correct revisions.
Research and obtain technical guidance from engineering and manufacturing experts to resolve technical questions during procurement.
Education & Experience Qualifications
A bachelor s degree/Diploma in Mechanical Engineering required.
Minimum of 04 years of experience with a working knowledge of procurement methods and procedures and processes.
CIPS Qualifications (Desirable)
Experience with ERP system required.
Knowledge of ISO, API, ASTM Material Standards required.
Knowledge of Casting, Forging, Heat Treatment process and raw material procurement required.
Knowledge of machining, Special coating & other manufacturing processes
Knowledge of Inventory Management
Proficient in use of Microsoft Office suite of products.
Strong communication in English (Both Verbal and Written)
Strong time management and analytical skills

Job Description
Overview
The project management opportunities we have are varied in size and responsibility levels, from delivering our consultancy services, to working for the client organisation delivering their projects and programmes.
You'll have exceptional stakeholder communication and people management skills and thrive on working within a dynamic and diverse project delivery environment.
Your Role
Working within our Nuclear business sector in our Bangalore or Gurgaon office, you will lead the delivery of AtkinsRealis technical design and engineering projects or work directly for our key clients.
You must be able to appreciate complex practical, technical, and commercial issues and to work constructively with a broad range of stakeholders; leading project teams that are either local to you or distributed across multiple sites.
The opportunities we have are varied in size and nature, and particularly suit an agile project management style, where the work is particularly discovery in nature. To help us grow the future of our business we are particularly keen to speak to individuals who are building a career as a professional project manager, who are delivery focused, and enjoy being customer focused.
Other aspects of the role will include supporting the growth of our capabilities through building a reputation for excellence, mentoring others, supporting business development and bidding activities.
About You
You'll have excellent communication, listening, stakeholder management and influencing skills. You'll be able to manage client relationships, engage constructively with multiple stakeholders and lead delivery teams. Through your work you will also help support and shape the development of future business.
You'll enjoy turning your hand to new challenges and will be keen to learn, whilst also wanting to support others within our diverse multi-disciplinary teams. You must also be able to successfully manage the commercial and quality performance of projects and proactively deploy a range of techniques to control delivery, cost, manage risk and change.
Your experience in working collaboratively with teams spread across multiple geographical locations.
Engineering professional with 20 or more years of experience
Direct and demonstrable experience of successfully managing one or more of the following types of projects to agreed time, cost and quality requirements:
Consultancy services supplying engineering advice, or
Engineering design
Must be an Engineering Professional
Experience of leading and directing teams and resources. Able to motivate self and teams, deal with conflict and create a collaborative team culture to meet client requirements
A strong element of client relationship management and people leadership. Excellent communication skills.
Willingness to travel as necessary.
Willing to work flexibly with occasional out of hours work to accommodate project and client requirements.
Nuclear industry experience. Applications from candidates from other high hazard, or highly regulated industries such as process, Oil and Gas, Defense, and Aerospace would be welcomed.
Rewards Benefits
Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive - at every stage of your life and your career.
This includes:
Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
Generous annual leave balance.
Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
Remote work opportunities outside of country.
Company gratuity scheme.
Discretionary bonus program.
Relocation assistance.
Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.
Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

Overview
Our Transmission Distribution (TD) business delivers end-to-end engineering solutions for power networks, including substations, transmission lines, and grid modernization. The BIM team drives digital transformation by creating accurate 3D models, enabling clash detection, and supporting Scan-to-BIM workflows. Opportunities include advanced modelling, project coordination, automation using tools like Dynamo, and collaboration on global projects-ideal for candidates passionate about innovation and multidisciplinary design.
AtkinsRalis Global Technology Centre (GTC) is seeking an experienced Electrical BIM Designer with 8 to 15 years of Substation experience with Revit to join our Bangalore office. This role involves working on single and multi-disciplinary Substation projects (Green field and Brown field), focusing on delivering high-quality BIM and CAD outputs that meet international standards. The role spans Power Generation, Transmission Distribution (TD), Renewables, Infrastructure, and Nuclear domains.


Your role
Key Responsibilities
Lead drawing and modelling production as a BIM coordinator for Electrical/Civil systems.
Prepare SLDs, control schemes, layouts, 3D models, and hazardous area classifications.

Coordinate with internal teams and external stakeholders.
Ensure quality assurance and compliance with CAD/BIM standards.
Mentor junior staff and contribute to team motivation.
Engage in BIM and Scan-to-BIM workflows.
Support project setup, customization, and delivery tracking.
Ideal Candidate Profile
We are seeking a highly experienced CAD/BIM professional with:
Multidisciplinary exposure across Electrical, Civil, Structural, and Mechanical domains.
Proven leadership skills and the ability to mentor junior staff and manage teams effectively.
A strong grasp of drawing standards, CAD/BIM protocols, and project workflows.
Hands-on experience in Substation projects (Green field and Brown field), including project setup in Revit, layout preparation, support structure modelling, concrete structures reinforcement detailing, power, earthing, lighting, and protection systems.
Familiarity with National Grid standards is a significant advantage.
Proficiency in Revit, AutoCAD, Microstation, Dynamo, and other BIM-related tools.
Exposure to international standards (UK, India, Middle East, APAC) and experience with Scan-to-BIM workflows.
Ability to prepare and check complex drawings, ensuring quality and compliance with CAD/BIM standards.

Essential
Proficiency in Revit, AutoCAD, Microstation, Dynamo.

Ability to prepare and check complex drawings.
Familiarity with Electrical/Structural/Mechanical design basics.
Experience with EDMS and drawing control protocols.
Capable of implementing GDC BMS QSE procedures.
Knowledge of project programming and resource utilization.
Desirable
Exposure to international standards (UK, India, Middle East, APAC).
Experience with 3D modelling and BIM standards.
Familiarity with BEP and Xrefs.

Strong communication and report-writing skills.
Team-oriented with leadership potential.
Detail-oriented and quality-focused.
Capable of giving and receiving clear instructions.
Proactive in career development and team contribution.
Assertive and responsive to client requirements.

#ACN Song GN Reinvention Services Customer Service Retail Service Reinvention Manager
Job Title Retail Service Reinvention Manager
Management Level: L07 Manager
Location: Bangalore, Gurgaon, Mumbai (India; global remit)
Experience: 10+ Years (L07)
Must have skills: Retail Service Reinvention / Customer Service Strategy Transformation; a blend of industry and consulting experience with deep understanding of the end-to-end retail value chain and how it drives service demand, volume and exceptions; experience shaping AI-native / agentic service operating models.
The Practice A Brief Sketch
The practice works with clients across their marketing, commerce, sales and service functions to reinvent how they engage customers. As part of the Reinvention Services Customer Service team, you will help the worlds leading retailers transform service from a reactive, cost-driven function into an intelligence-led, AI-native capability that senses signals in real time, resolves issues before they escalate, and continuously improves from every interaction across the shopper, store, supplier and fulfilment ecosystem driving customer value, growth, margin, operational efficiency and enterprise resilience.
Job summary
As a Retail Service Reinvention Senior Manager / Associate Director, you will advise C-suite executives, shape AI-native service operating models, and lead end-to-end transformation for the worlds leading retailers. Reporting to the Customer Service Managing Director, you will build and lead a team of Managers, Consultants and Analysts and carry accountability for generating business development opportunities upwards of USD 4M. The role requires a strong blend of retail domain expertise, consulting leadership, end-to-end value chain understanding, executive stakeholder management, and business development capability to shape and deliver scalable, future-ready retail service solutions.
Roles and responsibilities
Service Strategy Advisory
Define enterprise and omnichannel service strategy across the shopper, store, supplier and fulfilment ecosystems.
Shape AI-native service vision, target operating models and multi-year transformation roadmaps.
Develop business cases, prioritize investment and establish value-realization frameworks.
Advise boards and C-suite on where to sequence quick wins against enterprise-scale change.
Experience Design
Map end-to-end journeys for shoppers (order, delivery, returns, loyalty, complaints), associates (store, picker, contact centre) and suppliers (onboarding, purchase orders, invoicing, disputes).
Blueprint services across people, process, data and technology layers.
Identify moments of truth and design service recovery for stock-outs, failed deliveries, substitutions and disputed refunds.
Define channel strategy spanning mobile app, web, WhatsApp, voice, social, store desk and associate/picker devices.
Operating Model Process Transformation
Design target operating models spanning shopper services, supplier services, store workforce services, and fulfilment/ecosystem services.
Design the workforce across shoppers, store associates, pickers and inventory teams, contact-centre specialists and leads, supplier account teams, and delivery partners/dispatchers.
Establish governance frameworks policy and business rules, approval/escalation thresholds, SLAs and entitlements, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints.
Build KPI and performance frameworks tied to customer value, growth, margin, operational efficiency and enterprise resilience outcomes.
Technology AI Transformation
Set CRM and CCaaS platform strategy (Genesys, NICE, Salesforce Service Cloud, Five9, Amazon Connect).
Shape knowledge and case management (ServiceNow, Zendesk).
Design conversational and agentic AI (Kore.ai, Dialogflow) intent detection, content enrichment, knowledge graphs and decisioning/policy engines.
Integrate across order, store and supply-chain systems of record (OMS, POS, WMS, TMS, ERP, supplier/EDI portals) and IoT/GPS-enabled field and delivery tracking.
Build service analytics, predictive/prescriptive models and root-cause analysis capability.
Human + Agentic Operations
Design hybrid workforce models blending advisors, associates, AI copilots and autonomous agents across the shopper, supplier, store and fulfilment domains.
Design agents for high-volume service capabilities order status, substitutions, returns, refunds, delivery orchestration, supplier collaboration and dispute resolution.
Lead change management, upskilling and adoption programmes for frontline and support teams.
Establish AI governance, ethics and bias controls, and ongoing model/agent performance oversight.
Enterprise Transformation Delivery
Lead end-to-end programmes from strategy through implementation, adoption and value realisation.
Orchestrate multi-workstream delivery across business, experience, operations, technology and data/AI teams.
Manage executive steering committees and track value against committed business cases.
Practice Building
Develop market-leading thought leadership and intellectual property.
Build reusable methods, accelerators, assets and AI workflows for retail reinvention services.
Coach and mentor consulting teams.
Support business development and strategic pursuits collaborating with Song leadership to identify new opportunities and with Songs Consulting, Technology and Data AI teams for delivery.
Professional Technical Skills
Deep expertise in grocery, apparel or large omnichannel retail, with working knowledge of the end-to-end value chain merchandising and assortment planning, inventory and price management, promotions execution, digital commerce, in-store operations, supplier and partner operations, and last-mile fulfilment and how each stage drives customer demand, service volume and service exceptions.
First-hand practitioner experience inside leading grocery, apparel or omnichannel retailers (not advisory-only) having lived these operations, partnered with frontline teams, and redesigned them at enterprise scale.
Proven track record across service strategy advisory, experience design, operating model transformation, technology AI transformation, and enterprise delivery; consulting background is valuable but strong industry leadership experience counts equally.
Hands-on shopper/customer service experience across the lifecycle: order status and delivery-exception handling; substitutions, out-of-stock and refund/credit resolution; returns and reverse-logistics servicing; loyalty, rewards and membership servicing; complaint, feedback and social/review response; and multi-channel delivery (mobile app, web, WhatsApp, voice, social) with consistent resolution regardless of entry channel.
Supplier and partner service experience: onboarding, compliance and account management; forecast, purchase-order and inventory collaboration; quality issues, disputes and score-carding; invoice, payment and reconciliation servicing; and supplier/partner portals, EDI exchanges and account-management workflows.
Store and workforce service experience: inventory accuracy, price integrity and promotion execution at store level; pick, pack and in-store fulfilment; store-to-contact-centre escalation and case hand-off; associate empowerment tools (store apps, picker/associate devices, knowledge assistants); and workforce scheduling, service standards and frontline performance management.
Fulfilment and ecosystem service experience: delivery orchestration, routing and ETA/live tracking; failed-delivery, missed-slot and delivery-recovery workflows; reverse logistics and returns-to-warehouse operations; driver, dispatcher and 3PL partner management; and last-mile SLAs, on-time performance and partner score-carding.
Working knowledge of core retail service processes order-to-delivery, returns refunds, complaint case management, store-to-contact-centre escalation, substitution/refund workflows and supplier dispute resolution with the SLAs and benchmarks that define operational excellence, and fluency in how cases move end-to-end (detect, triage/categorise, route/assign, investigate/enrich, decide/approve, orchestrate, execute/communicate, confirm/close).
Exposure to the retail service technology and AI stack: CRM CCaaS (Genesys, NICE, Salesforce Service Cloud, Five9, Amazon Connect); knowledge case management (ServiceNow, Zendesk); conversational and agentic AI (Kore.ai, Dialogflow); systems of record (OMS, POS, WMS, TMS, ERP, PIM/MDM, pricing and promotions engines); supplier/EDI portals and IoT/GPS-enabled tracking; and the underlying AI/ML stack (intent detection, content enrichment, knowledge graphs, policy/rules engines, predictive/prescriptive models, decisioning/optimisation and root-cause analytics).
Experience designing target operating models that combine human and AI/agentic capacity reusable service capability design, hybrid workforce design, and governance/guardrail frameworks (policy business rules, approvals escalation, human-in-the-loop controls, SLAs entitlements, privacy consent, security access, compliance audit, model/agent performance governance, ethics bias controls, and data quality traceability).
Demonstrated track record of driving measurable outcomes customer value (NPS/CSAT, trust, advocacy); growth (repeat purchase rate, average order value, attach rate, customer lifetime value); service quality productivity (first-contact and overall resolution, reduced cost-to-serve and contact volume, higher associate productivity); and availability resilience (in-stock rate, on-time delivery/payment, margin protection, and supply/compliance resilience).
Executive stakeholder management, communication and storytelling; ability to build and defend a business case at board level; fluency across business, experience, operations, technology and AI/data teams; and comfort translating complex operating models into a clear enterprise narrative.
Additional information
Experience in retail, customer service or enterprise service transformation, including large-scale programmes delivered end-to-end from strategy through implementation; the ideal candidate blends industry and consulting experience.
Reports to the Customer Service Managing Director; builds and leads a team of Managers, Consultants and Analysts, with accountability for generating business development opportunities upwards of USD 4M.
Employment type: Permanent. Work arrangement: remote / hybrid / onsite, flexed to client and project needs; travel expectation varies by client engagement.
MBA or postgraduate qualification in retail preferred. Relevant certifications a plus CCXP, Six Sigma/Lean, ITIL, PMP, CSCP/APICS, Agile or Design Thinking, or platform certifications (Genesys, NICE, Salesforce).



Qualification
Experience in Retail industry (physical + digital) - Grocery, Apparel or large omnichannel retail sector experience
Good to have skills: relevant certifications (CCXP, Six Sigma/Lean, ITIL, PMP, CSCP/APICS, Agile or Design Thinking) and platform certifications (Genesys, NICE, Salesforce).
Educational Qualification: MBA or postgraduate qualification in retail preferred; MBA or equivalent degree in Business, Strategy, Sales Marketing.

Basic Qualification:
- Proficiency in process modelling tools and software such as Visio, ARIS, or Signavio.
- Experience with process mining and data analytics tools such as Celonis or Power Automate.
- Working knowledge of how AI and automation integrate into business-process and customer-service design.
- Exposure to customer service or contact centre operations, including familiarity with core service metrics.
- Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and project-management skills.
- Ability to analyze data and translate findings into structured recommendations for senior review.

- Experience in a management consulting firm.
- Exposure to CRM or contact centre platforms such as Salesforce, Genesys, or Amazon Connect.
- Strong analytical skills and the ability to communicate complex findings in clear business terms.
- Experience working on proposals and contributing to business-development activities.

Additional Information:
- The ideal candidate combines process-analysis capability, customer-centric service design, AI-enabled transformation, and the ability to develop structured recommendations.
- The role requires growing fluency in process disciplines and the ability to design interactions among people, AI agents, and processes across the service journey.

The role will spearhead strategic revenue growth by driving enterprise customer acquisition and expansion across key verticals and geographies. Enterprise Sales Ownership: Identify, engage, and convert large B2B clients particularly those with complex freight, warehousing, and distribution needs across industries such as retail, FMCG, manufacturing, and e-commerce.

Deep understanding of supply chain processes including LTL, FTL, warehousing, distribution networks, and logistics tech platforms.
Data-driven, solution-oriented mindset with strong commercial acumen.

EnKash is a full stack payments company offering a unified platform for payables, receivables, corporate cards, and expense management. Backed by key RBI licenses including PA-O & PA-P and PPI, EnKash enables merchants to automate financial operations with compliance and control.

About the Role
We are looking for a seasoned Risk & Compliance professional with strong expertise in payments for managing our PA & PPI license This role will play a critical part in strengthening risk governance, ensuring regulatory compliance, and managing fraud across payment flows, card systems, and merchant transactions. You will work at the intersection of risk, compliance, and operations, driving robust controls across both issuance and acquiring environments in a highly regulated fintech landscape. The person is expected to coordinate internally & externally with banks, regulators, FIUs, LEAs etc and help manage risk in the ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities
Fraud Risk Management & Monitoring: Design and implement end-to-end fraud prevention and detection strategies across payment gateway/acquiring flows/ issuing flows, including real-time monitoring and risk mitigation.
Fraud Investigations & Incident Response: Lead investigations, manage chargebacks/disputes, and handle fraud incidents across card transactions, merchant payments, and gateway flows, ensuring timely resolution and escalation.
Regulatory Compliance & Reporting: Ensure adherence to RBI guidelines across PAPG, PPI, including KYC/KYB, AML transaction monitoring, FIU-IND STR reporting, and regulatory submissions.
Risk Assessment & Control Framework: Conduct comprehensive risk assessments across acquiring ecosystems, identifying vulnerabilities in transaction flows, integrations, settlements, and merchant onboarding. Audit & Governance: Drive internal and external audits, strengthen governance frameworks, and ensure robust internal controls, documentation, and audit readiness.
Policy Development & Process Excellence: Develop and enhance risk, compliance, and fraud management policies/SOPs aligned with regulatory requirements and industry best practices across both ecosystems.
Stakeholder Management & Training: Collaborate with product, tech, business, and compliance teams; present risk insights and drive organization-wide awareness on fraud prevention and regulatory compliance.

What Were Looking For
8-12 years of experience in Audit, Risk, Fraud, or Compliance roles within fintech
Strong exposure to PAPG (Payment Aggregator/Payment Gateway) ecosystems and/or Prepaid Payment Instruments ecosystems.
Solid understanding of RBI regulations, including KYC/KYB, AML transaction monitoring, fraud management, and digital payments compliance
Hands-on experience in fraud risk management, transaction monitoring, and chargeback handling across cards and/or payment gateway environments
Proven experience managing internal/external audits and regulatory interactions
Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills
Managing and closing LEA/FIU queries.

Why Join EnKash?
Opportunity to work across both acquiring (PAPG) and issuance (PPI) ecosystems
Exposure to complex, high-scale payment and regulatory frameworks
High ownership role with direct impact on risk strategy and governance

Key Responsibilities
1. Databricks Enterprise Strategy
Define and own the enterprise-wide Databricks platform strategy, roadmap, and adoption model in line with business goals.
Set up a Databricks Center of Excellence (CoE), including best practices, reusable frameworks, and engineering standards.
Assess new Databricks capabilities (Unity Catalog, Delta Live Tables, Serverless, Photon, Mosaic AI, Databricks SQL) and lead their adoption.
Drive platform cost optimization (FinOps), workspace strategy, and capacity planning.
Act as the primary technical liaison with Databricks and cloud vendor partners.
2. Advanced DABs (Databricks Asset Bundles) Framework
Design and implement an enterprise-grade CI/CD framework using Databricks Asset Bundles for consistent, repeatable deployments.
Standardize Infrastructure-as-Code and Configuration-as-Code practices across environments (Dev, QA, UAT, Prod).
Integrate DABs with DevOps tools such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, and Terraform.
Build reusable bundle templates, deployment patterns, and automated testing and validation pipelines.
Ensure version control, environment promotion, and release governance across all Databricks workloads.
3. Governance Implementation
Lead the design and rollout of data governance using Unity Catalog, covering access controls, data lineage, auditing, and data discovery.
Implement data security, privacy, and compliance controls (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, SOC 2, CCPA, as applicable).
Define data quality frameworks, metadata management standards, and data ownership and stewardship models.
Work with InfoSec, Risk, and Compliance teams to enforce policies such as row/column-level security, data masking, and fine-grained permissions.
Set up monitoring, observability, and audit mechanisms across the data platform.
4. Data Lakehouse Architecture
Architect and evolve the enterprise Data Lakehouse using Delta Lake and the Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold).
Design scalable data models that support analytics, BI, ML/AI, and real-time use cases.
Lead migrations from legacy data warehouses, Hadoop, and on-prem platforms to the Databricks Lakehouse.
Ensure performance tuning, storage optimization (Z-Ordering, Liquid Clustering, partitioning), and high availability.
Enable data sharing through Delta Sharing and support data mesh and data product approaches where relevant.
5. Cloud Architecture (AWS / Azure)
Design secure, scalable, and resilient cloud-native data architectures on AWS and/or Azure.
Oversee the integration of Databricks with cloud services, such as:
Azure: ADLS Gen2, Azure Data Factory, Event Hubs, Key Vault, Synapse, Entra ID, Purview
AWS: S3, Glue, Kinesis, Lambda, IAM, Redshift, Lake Formation
Define networking, identity, and security architecture, including VNet/VPC injection, Private Link, and SSO/SCIM.
Drive disaster recovery, business continuity, and multi-region strategies.
6. Enterprise Data Pipeline Design
Lead the design and delivery of robust batch and streaming pipelines using PySpark, Spark SQL, Structured Streaming, Delta Live Tables, and Auto Loader.
Establish reusable ingestion, transformation, and orchestration frameworks (Databricks Workflows, Airflow, ADF).
Ensure pipelines meet SLAs, scalability, reliability, and data quality requirements.
Promote engineering excellence through code reviews, testing standards, modular design, and documentation.
Enable real-time and near-real-time data processing for critical business use cases.
7. Portfolio Management
Manage a portfolio of data engineering programs and projects, ensuring delivery on scope, schedule, budget, and quality.
Prioritize initiatives based on business value, ROI, and strategic alignment.
Own resource planning, budgeting, vendor management, and risk mitigation across the portfolio.
Report progress, KPIs, and outcomes to senior leadership and executive stakeholders.
Run delivery governance using Agile, SAFe, or hybrid methodologies.
People Leadership
Lead, mentor, and grow a team of data engineers, architects, and tech leads, including onshore and offshore teams.
Build a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous learning.
Drive hiring, performance management, and career development for the team.

Role Overview
We are looking for an experienced Backend Engineer to design, develop and maintain scalable backend services and enterprise integrations. The candidate will be responsible for building robust APIs, integrating business applications such as Salesforce and Microsoft 365, and developing secure, event-driven backend workflows using Python and Azure services.
The role requires strong backend engineering fundamentals, experience with cloud-based application development, API integrations, authentication mechanisms and distributed systems.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop and maintain scalable backend services using Python and FastAPI.
Build and manage REST APIs for integrating enterprise applications and business systems.
Develop integrations with Salesforce, SharePoint, Outlook and Microsoft Teams using REST APIs and Microsoft Graph API.
Implement asynchronous processing, background jobs and event-driven workflows.
Work with Azure services including Cosmos DB, Azure Functions, App Service, API Management and Service Bus/Event Grid.
Implement secure authentication and authorization using Microsoft Entra ID, OAuth 2.0 and managed identities.
Design and manage application state, data persistence and long-running workflows using Cosmos DB.
Implement error handling, retries, idempotency, timeouts and fault-tolerant mechanisms.
Monitor application performance, troubleshoot production issues and maintain structured logging and audit trails.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver reliable and scalable backend solutions.

Role Overview
The Assistant Cluster Lead will support the Cluster Lead in managing operations across multiple residential & comemrcial communities. The incumbent will be responsible for driving operational excellence, team effectiveness, vendor performance, customer satisfaction, governance compliance, and financial discipline across assigned sites while ensuring adherence to organizational standards and service commitments.

Key Responsibilities
Operational Management
Support the Cluster Lead in overseeing daily facility management operations across assigned communities.
Ensure implementation and adherence to FM guidelines, SOPs, statutory requirements, and work instructions.
Conduct regular site visits and operational audits to ensure service quality and compliance.
Monitor preventive and corrective maintenance activities across sites.

Team Management
Guide, mentor, and supervise Site Managers, Community Executives, and operational teams.
Ensure manpower deployment, attendance management, roster adherence, and workforce productivity.
Support hiring, onboarding, training, and performance management of site teams.
Drive a culture of accountability, customer-centricity, and continuous improvement.

Financial Management
Review operational expenses and support budget control across assigned sites.
Monitor monthly budgets and identify opportunities for cost optimization.
Coordinate with Finance for billing, collections, vendor payments, and financial reconciliations.
Assist in achieving revenue and profitability targets for assigned communities.

Stakeholder Management
Build strong relationships with Resident Welfare Associations (RWAs), Management Committees, and Developer Representatives.
Support governance meetings and ensure closure of action items.
Act as a key escalation point for operational and service-related issues.

Customer Experience
Drive resident satisfaction by ensuring timely resolution of complaints and service requests.
Monitor customer feedback and implement improvement initiatives.
Support resident engagement activities and community-building programs.
Minimize escalations through proactive issue identification and resolution.

Vendor Management
Monitor vendor performance against defined SLAs, KPIs, and contractual commitments.
Conduct periodic vendor reviews and service quality audits.
Ensure compliance with safety, statutory, and operational standards.
Support onboarding and governance of service partners.

Compliance & Governance
Ensure adherence to EHS guidelines, statutory compliances, and internal audit requirements.
Monitor documentation, licenses, certifications, and compliance trackers.
Support implementation of risk mitigation and corrective action plans.

Description:
Job Summary
The Builder - Logistics is a high-agency, 0-to-1 role embedded within Ca's GS Retail Logistics function in the South. Based out of Bengaluru and working closely with the Regional Head - South, you will build new programs, ship new tools, and run controlled experiments across Bangalore, Hyderabad, Chennai, and Kerala. This is not a steady-state ops role - you'll spend most of your time defining problems, prototyping solutions, and turning what works into repeatable playbooks that city teams can run at scale. You'll operate at the intersection of ops, data, product, and AI.
Key Responsibilities
New Program Design - Identify gaps across pilot supply, CSP adherence, auto-allocation, and fulfilment. Design new programs from scratch, run pilots, and hand off winning plays to city teams.
Ops Diagnostics Deep Dives - Own regional data - cut it by city, cohort, and process step to surface what's broken and where the fastest wins sit. Convert findings into structured action plans.
Product Specs Tool Building - Write clear specs for internal tools and dashboards. Partner with Product and Tech to ship what the region needs; use no-code and AI where full builds are overkill.
Automation of Manual Workflows - Map the region's sheet-heavy workflows and lead their transition to automated systems. Ship quick wins with Apps Script, Zapier, or AI copilots before scoping full products.
City-Level Experimentation - Run controlled A/B tests across cities to validate whether a new process, script, or intervention actually moves the KPI. Kill what doesn't work, scale what does.
Cross-functional Execution - Work directly with city heads, Category Managers, Product, and Tech to unblock progress. Translate ground-team pain-points into shipped fixes fast.
Qualifications Experience
2-4 years in high-agency roles - startup ops, strategy consulting, category management, or founders office.
Track record of shipping something end-to-end - a program, a tool, a dashboard, a new city launch - that survived after you moved on.
Comfortable in ambiguity - can walk into a messy problem and leave with a structured plan.
Strong first-principles thinking; happy to visit yards and talk to pilots before writing a single line of a proposal.
Bengaluru-based or willing to relocate; comfortable travelling across Hyderabad, Chennai, and Kerala.
Data AI Skills
Advanced Excel / Google Sheets - pivots, lookups, and formula-based analysis at scale.
SQL fluency for querying large operational datasets; Python or R for deeper analysis is a strong plus.
Comfort building dashboards (Looker, Data Studio, Tableau) that drive city-level decisions.
Hands-on with AI copilots (ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, or similar) to accelerate analysis, drafting, and prototyping.
Familiar with no-code automation (Apps Script, Zapier, Retool) to ship quick wins without engineering support.

Role & responsibilities
Mandatory Skills
1. Advanced Prompt Engineering.
Experience with structured outputs (JSON mode, function/tool calling) and system prompt design.
Ability to systematically test, version, and optimize prompts for quality and token efficiency.
Knowledge of prompt injection risks and mitigation techniques.
2. LLM Architecture Design
Strong understanding of transformer architecture, attention mechanisms, tokenization, and context windows.
Ability to design scalable LLM system architectures, including agents, memory, tool use, and orchestration layers.
Experience making trade-off decisions on model selection, latency, cost, and accuracy.
3. RAG System Implementation
Hands-on experience building production RAG systems end-to-end.
Proficiency with vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS, Chroma, Milvus, Qdrant, or pgvector.
Knowledge of embedding models, chunking strategies, hybrid search (semantic + keyword), re-ranking, and query transformation.
Experience evaluating RAG pipelines using tools like RAGAS, TruLens, or custom metrics.
4. Fine-tuning Strategy
Ability to determine when fine-tuning is the right approach compared with prompting or RAG.
Hands-on experience with PEFT techniques (LoRA, QLoRA), instruction tuning, and alignment methods (RLHF, DPO).
Experience with dataset curation, cleaning, and preparation for fine-tuning.
Familiarity with Hugging Face Transformers, PEFT, TRL, Axolotl, or Unsloth.
5. LangChain / LlamaIndex (Advanced)
Deep, hands-on experience building complex chains, agents, and multi-step workflows.
Proficiency with LangGraph, LCEL, custom tools, retrievers, memory modules, and callbacks.
Experience with LlamaIndex indexing strategies, query engines, and data connectors.
Ability to extend frameworks with custom components when needed.
6. Multi-model Integration
Experience integrating and orchestrating multiple LLM providers and open-source models.
Ability to implement model routing, fallback mechanisms, load balancing, and cost optimization.
Exposure to multimodal models (text, image, audio, vision-language).
Familiarity with gateways and abstraction tools such as LiteLLM, OpenRouter, or similar.
7. Production Deployment
Proven experience deploying LLM applications to production at scale.
Proficiency with model serving frameworks such as vLLM, TGI, Ollama, Triton, or TensorRT-LLM.
Strong knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including services like Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, or Vertex AI.
Experience with LLMOps and observability tools such as LangSmith, MLflow, Weights & Biases, Langfuse, or Arize.
Understanding of caching, batching, quantization, rate limiting, and latency optimization.

Commercial Strategy and Value & Payer Evidence

Experienced working in sizable/multi-disciplined teams and leading employees within the management consulting environment

A good communicator with excellent interpersonal and team-working skills and strong written, numerical, and problem-solving skills

Description:
Role Purpose
The Software Procurement intern is responsible for overseeing the end-to-end lifecycle of global software assets, software procurement processes, and supplier contracts at Thoughtworks. This role ensures cost efficiency, streamlined workflows, timely supplier payments, regulatory compliance, and seamless cross-functional collaboration across GITS, InfoSec, Finance, Accounts Payable, and Legal departments.
Key Responsibilities
Learn and work closely with Software Procurement Lead on below mention responsibilities:
1. Procurement Operations & Purchase Management
End-to-End Workflow Optimisation: Direct and analyse the efficiency of software procurement processes, from request ingestion to inventory updating
Coupa Platform Management: Initiate supplier onboarding forms, monitor supplier statuses until active, and create/publish Purchase Orders (POs) and Virtual Contracts in Coupa
Requisition Approvals: Act as the designated Global Procurement Approver and authorise high-value requisitions (e.g., JetBrains, LinkedIn Sales Navigator) on behalf of the Global Software Lead.
Manage Credit Card Spend: Manage monthly or annual subscriptions that are on credit card and submit weekly expense reports in Expensify; allocating cost accurately.Manage multiple domain registrars: Register and renew domains, working closely with LegalAWS account provisioning: Work closely with CloudOps team on provisioning / deprovisioning AWS accounts including management of login credentials
2. Vendor Relationship & Renewal Management
Vendor Coordination: Manage direct communication with major global SaaS vendors (e.g., JetBrains, LinkedIn, Snowflake, Sisense, Pearson VUE) regarding quotes, order forms, and payment terms.
Renewal Pipeline Tracking: Partner with external procurement platforms to monitor renewal deadlines, evaluate license needs, coordinate stakeholder feedback, and schedule retirements of legacy software.
3. Financial & Budget Governance
Invoice & Payment Resolution: Partner closely with Accounts Payable (AP) to verify receipts, resolve billing discrepancies, split invoices manually, and escalate critical past-due accounts.
Budgeting & Cost Allocation: Monitor license allocations and manage pay-as-you-go or credit-based models to optimize spend and ensure unused credits do not expire.
Cost Distribution Mapping: Distribute software costs accurately among business units, regions (DEC/POH), and specific accounts or departments by aligning data from Jigsaw and other tools.
4. Software Entitlement & Compliance Management
Software Asset Management (SAM): Track active software assets and license assignments via ServiceNow (SNOW). Requires close coordination with multiple teams.
Risk & Regulatory Compliance: Collaborate with GITS, InfoSec, and regional legal leads to verify software compliance, evaluate export regulations (such as the Remote Access Security Act), and implement geographic usage restrictions.
Required Skills & Qualifications
Learn and build following skills (tools/applications and Soft skills:
Procurement Platforms: High proficiency in Coupa Software, ServiceNow, Expensify and Zendesk.
Negotiation & Financial Acumen: Strong capability in analyzing pricing models (pay-as-you-go, subscription, credit-based, or enterprise commitments) and driving cost splits across departments.
Collaboration & Stakeholder Alignment: Exceptional cross-functional relationship-building skills, specifically with Finance, AP, Legal (contracts/compliance), GITS, and InfoSec.
Compliance Mindset: Understanding of IT software security guidelines, software usage terms, and regional compliance standards.
Must-have criteria
Education: MBA / PGDM graduate, 2026 pass-out
Specialization: Procurement, Supply Chain Management, Operations, Strategic Sourcing, or a closely related specialization
Location: Gurgaon, Bangalore, Pune
Experience: Freshers and candidates with relevant internship/project experience can be considered
Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills
Stakeholder management: Comfortable interacting with internal stakeholders and external vendors
Commercial mindset: Interest in negotiation, pricing, cost optimisation and vendor management
Analytical skills: Comfortable working with data, comparing options and drawing insights
Technology interest: Willingness to learn about software, SaaS products and technology procurement

Description:
Senior Associate Workforce Solutions (Dayforce)
Job description
is responsible for independently managing assigned workstreams and supporting end-to-end Dayforce HCM implementation projects across functional areas, including Core HR, Time & Attendance, Payroll, Benefits, and Talent Management, as well as technical areas such as Data Conversion, Integrations, and Reporting. The role requires strong expertise in one or more Dayforce modules, with a working understanding of related modules and cross-functional dependencies. Key responsibilities include requirements gathering, business process design, solution design, system configuration, data migration and validation, integrations, reporting, testing, cutover, and post-go-live activities. The position involves collaborating closely with clients, project managers, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into effective HCM solutions, resolve implementation challenges, and ensure timely, high-quality project delivery. Additionally, the role supports regulatory compliance, process optimization, and transition to managed services while ensuring solution quality and alignment with client business objectives.
Essential Responsibilities
Support the end-to-end implementation and transformation of Dayforce HCM solutions for external clients, covering discovery, design, configuration, testing, deployment, and post-go-live support, within your primary module and in coordination with other module workstreams.
Own assigned Dayforce functional workstreams, ensuring timely and accurate delivery of project milestones, deliverables, and client requirements.
Facilitate client discovery workshops and working sessions to gather requirements, document current-state HR and payroll processes, business rules, organizational structures, and data flows, validate design decisions, resolve open items, and align client needs with Dayforce capabilities.
Translate business and functional requirements into Dayforce configurations, solution design documents, configuration workbooks, and test scenarios.
Support data migration activities, including coordination of legacy data extraction, data mapping, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and issue resolution to ensure accurate conversion into Dayforce.
Collaborate with technical and integration teams on inbound and outbound integrations between Dayforce and third-party systems, including data mapping, integration testing, error resolution, and data flow validation.
Plan and execute testing activities, including functional, system integration (SIT), user acceptance (UAT), regression, and end-to-end business process testing; support payroll parallel testing where applicable by validating calculations, analyzing variances, and reconciling results; and manage defects through resolution.
Advise clients on Dayforce capabilities, HCM business processes, regulatory compliance considerations, and leading practices, and identify opportunities for standardization, automation, and optimization by assessing manual workarounds, control gaps, and system capabilities.


Requirements
48 years of relevant experience in HCM implementation, HR technology consulting, HR transformation, or enterprise HRIS projects, including hands-on Dayforce HCM implementation experience.
Hands-on experience configuring Dayforce in at least one primary module (Core HR, Time & Attendance, Payroll, Benefits, or Talent Management), with working knowledge of cross-module dependencies.
Experience across the end-to-end Dayforce implementation lifecycle, including discovery, requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, data migration, integration testing, user acceptance testing, cutover, go-live, and post-production support.
Experience independently managing a functional workstream, facilitating client workshops, translating business requirements into system solutions, troubleshooting configuration issues, and delivering documentation and project milestones.
Solid knowledge of HCM data migration, mapping, validation, reconciliation, integration testing, and defect management.

Education and Experience

Leading Pastry Culinary Team

Job description
Key Responsibilities:
As a Learning Design & Development practitioner, you will play a key role in helping clients navigate their transformation challenges by designing and building the learning solutions that carry those transformations, owning the work from curriculum architecture through to release-ready assets. You will provide tailored learning solutions to enhance workforce capabilities, optimize HR functions, and support long-term organizational success. By offering insights into company culture and designing impactful learning programs, you will help clients build a skilled, adaptable workforce that drives performance and growth
As such, the key responsibilities for this position include (but are not limited to):
Engagement Delivery
Delivering learning solutions for technology driven or culture-based client transformation journey, by including (but not limiting to) the below skill sets:
Learning Strategies:
Instructional Design (ID) or Learning Experience Design (LXD) with a strong command of adult learning principles and instructional strategies, and working fluency in recognized frameworks - ADDIE and/or SAM, Blooms taxonomy for objective setting, and Kirkpatrick for evaluation.
Demonstrate a deep understanding of business operations and ERP and HCM solutions like Workday, Oracle, SAP, etc.
Learning Activities:
Collaborate with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to deliver Training Needs Analysis, Curriculum design, role-based learning plans and blended training solutions.
Ability to use a variety of collaboration tools available to the client to run workshops and presentations.
Ability to develop engaging scenarios, activities, and assessments for blended learning solutions.
Hands-on proficiency with industry-standard authoring and multimedia tools - Articulate Storyline and Rise 360, Adobe Captivate, Camtasia, Vyond, or equivalent - to build visually engaging learning assets.
Publish and troubleshoot content on an LMS or LXP, including SCORM/xAPI packaging and versioning, and build to accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 / Section 508).
Work directly with clients to support engagement delivery spanning across phases of analysis, design, development, and implementation of training.
Learning Effectiveness:
Evaluate the effectiveness of learning programs against Kirkpatrick Levels 13 using a range of methods - reaction surveys, knowledge checks, and on-the-job performance measures.
Continuously improve learning programs based on feedback, industry best practices, and emerging trends.
General Requirements:
Excellent storyboarding skills, and able to produce release-ready facilitator guides, participant materials and ILT/vILT decks to a publishable standard.
Communicate complex information effectively through engaging written and verbal formats tailored to the client's needs and audiences.
Ensure regular communication and alignment on project updates with the engagement team
Ability to work through ambiguity, flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and business needs.
Ability to work flexibly across time zones as per project requirements, ensuring seamless coordination and efficient project execution.
Stay up to date with the latest trends and advancements in learning and development.
Contribute learning scope, effort estimates and instructional methodology input to pursuits and proposals as a subject-matter expert.
Provide guidance and support to team members to reinforce learning from engagements.
Believe in the value created by diverse teams and adapt to different working styles.
Continue to develop internal relationships and your PwC brand.

Strong SQL and PL/SQL skills
Experience with HCM Extracts

Good communication and documentation skills
Good to have
Knowledge of Fusion Data Intelligence (FDI) or Oracle Analytics

Exposure to multiple end-to-end Fusion HCM implementations
Oracle HCM Cloud certification
Consulting Requirements
5-8 years of relevant consulting, industry or technology experience
Proven knowledge of Oracle Cloud platform and tools
Excellent team player
Strong problem solving and troubleshooting skills
Strong communicator
Willingness to travel up in case of project requirement
Strong knowledge of software implementation best practices
Ability to adapt quickly to an existing, complex environment and learn new concepts and software
Self-motivated, independent, detail oriented, responsible team player and exhibit exceptional relationship management skills
Passionate about building high-quality systems with software implementation
Professionalism and integrity
Strong interpersonal and written communication skills
Ability to work in fast paced environment

Risk & Regulatory-Enterprise Technology Solutions -SAP provides a broad range of assess and recommend services specific to the SAP related to controls around the financial reporting process, including business process and IT management controls.
The team provides multiple services related to security and controls assessment.
The role would primarily be focused on working on Business Process controls for RTR/OTC/PTP/PTM etc. for SAP-ERP and IT Risk and Controls assessments/audit.
Working as a senior associate, expected to work in a team of 2-5 people for multiple projects in the area of Control Integration (CI)/ Process Controls (PC) for SAP ERP.
In the space of CI (Control Integration), the various tasks includes
CTS (Control test scripts) preparation, documenting the CAN (Control Activity Narrative)/MCP (Manual Control Procedure)
Execution of CTS
Documenting the results and highlighting the exceptions noted in various control related configurations within SAP

Reviewing the RCM/RACI matrix along with the Control Owners documentation for specific control and documenting test scripts, execution of key reports (custom/standard) within SAP.
Reviewing the RICEFW documents and noting down the exceptions.

Develop integrations between BMC Helix and enterprise systems using REST APIs, web services, and integration frameworks.

Work closely with functional teams, architects, infrastructure teams, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable technical solutions.
Identify opportunities for automation and AI-led service management improvements.

Strong hands-on experience in BMC Remedy AR System / BMC Helix ITSM development.
Strong knowledge of Remedy workflow customization and automation.
Experience with Forms, Active Links, Filters, Escalations, Menus, Guides, and workflow objects.
Experience with BMC Helix migration / Remedy-to-Helix transformation.
Hands-on experience with BMC Digital Workplace and DWP Catalog.
Experience developing applications/workflows using BMC Helix Innovation Studio.
Knowledge of REST API / Web Services-based integrations.
Good understanding of ITSM processes such as Incident, Problem, Change, Request, and Asset Management.
Strong troubleshooting, debugging, and analytical skills.

Good to Have:
Exposure to HelixGPT and Generative AI capabilities within BMC Helix.
Experience with BMC Helix Dashboards, Business Workflows, and automation capabilities.
Experience with integrations involving tools such as ServiceNow, monitoring platforms, identity-management solutions, or enterprise applications.
Understanding of ITIL processes and best practices.
Scripting/automation knowledge and experience working in Agile delivery environments.

Overview
The BIM Designer/Lead Designer role at AtkinsRalis GDC Transportation focuses on delivering advanced BIM and CAD designs for major global rail and bridge infrastructure projects. Based in Bangalore or Gurgaon, the position involves creating and managing 3D models, producing detailed 2D drawings, coordinating multidisciplinary BIM workflows, and ensuring compliance with AtkinsRalis standards and international BIM practices. The role requires strong modelling expertise, understanding of BIM standards, experience with tools like MicroStation, OpenBuildings, ProjectWise/ACC, and the ability to collaborate within large engineering teams. It offers excellent growth opportunities within a world-leading infrastructure consultancy.


Your role
Should be able to develop CAD/BIM 3D Models / 2D Drawings to the standards codes
Should be able to produce medium to complex 3D modelling for bridges Rail structures
Competent in producing GA and RC detailing drawings for bridges and Rail structures.
Work with the Information Manager and project teams to assist in the development and implementation of BIM strategies, BIM Execution Plans, workflows and processes on projects in accordance with AtkinsRalis Corporate Standards, Client requirements and industry best practice.
Should be able to produce 3D models and extract information directly from models to create 2D drawings, schedules, setting out, quantities and other deliverables.
Should be able to develop models and technical content including clash detection and compliance with BEP.
Should be able to follow OCRA process in EDMS workflow
Should have strong written verbal communication in English
Experience of working in Common Data Environment (CDE) like ProjectWise / ACC
Apply AtkinsRalis Quality, Safety Environmental (QSE) standards and Business Management System (BMS).


About You
Requirements
Must have Civil Engineering background with preferable Rail domain experience.
Experience of Bridge Detailing, reinforcement detailing, structural steel detailing and schedules.
Hands-on experience of industry standard Rail BIM Platforms such as OpenBuildings Designer, MicroStation Connect (3D).
Proven experience of a range of CAD and BIM industry standards including an understanding of UK BIM Level 2 requirements. Understanding of BIM Standards such as BS1192 and PAS1192 Part 2 is also desirable.
I-Twin or Bentley Cloud Services with capabilities to federate individual discipline BIM Models. Setup, maintain and run clash rules and clash tests across federated BIM Models
Working experience in Revit Structures including 3D RC detailing would be an added advantage
Qualifications and attributes
Excellent time management skills.
3 to 5 years of relevant experience
Experience of using written and spoken English within a business environment.
A Diploma/Degree holder in Civil Engineering with sufficient and relevant experience.
Flexible and engaging with resilience, drive and self-motivation
Ability to collaborate successfully within a project and team environment but also to work independently and in a client environment
Constantly striving towards continuous improvement and innovation.
Ability to exercise initiative and take ownership of project issues
Ability to adapt to different cultures and working environments to build rapport with customers
Highly IT literate, excellent command of standard office software, knowledge of IT infrastructure and hardware.
Working knowledge of British / American Standards

have a great opportunity in our Bangalore office for an ambitious Principal Geotechnical Engineer to join our experienced and dynamic team to help deliver a range of projects primarily in the infrastructure sector (roads, rail, water and commercial / industrial development)

have a great opportunity in our Bangalore office for an ambitious Principal Geotechnical Engineer to join our experienced and dynamic team to help deliver a range of projects primarily in the infrastructure sector (roads, rail, water and commercial / industrial development).
