Role & responsibilities :
OCM Lead Consultant
Location: EMEA / USA / India
Job Summary
The OCM (Organizational Change Management) Lead Consultant is responsible for leading change management, training, and communication activities associated with enterprise-wide transformation programs, including ERP/HRIS implementations and organizational transitions.
This role focuses on the people side of change, helping organizations successfully adopt new processes, technologies, job roles, and organizational structures. The objective is to minimize resistance, maximize engagement, and drive successful adoption of transformational initiatives.
Key Responsibilities
Change Management & Stakeholder Engagement
Develop and execute structured change management strategies, communication plans, and training programs to support organizational transformation.
Conduct change impact assessments and identify stakeholder groups affected by change.
Develop stakeholder maps and engagement plans to effectively manage client audiences.
Identify potential sources of resistance and implement mitigation strategies to encourage positive acceptance of change.
Build, mobilize, and manage change champion/change agent networks to accelerate adoption.
Training & Adoption
Design and implement role-based training strategies and learning programs.
Create employee orientation and onboarding plans related to new business processes and technologies.
Collaborate with client teams and Learning & Development stakeholders to create detailed training schedules and participant plans.
Work closely with Training/Learning Leads to ensure successful training delivery and adoption.
Program Execution & Leadership
Monitor change management and training activities and provide regular status updates.
Adapt change strategies as organizational needs evolve.
Lead and manage large-scale OCM teams consisting of junior, mid-level, and senior consultants.
Ensure alignment of change, communication, and training activities for a seamless end-user experience.
Best Practices & Methodology
Apply industry-leading change management methodologies and frameworks.
Integrate communication, training, and change interventions into a unified adoption strategy.
Recommend and implement best practices to improve transformation outcomes.
Required Skills & Qualifications
Experience
5-10 years of experience in Organizational Change Management (OCM).
Experience supporting large-scale organizational transformation programs.
Digital Transformation implementation experience is highly desirable.
Experience working with global teams, offshore (India) teams, and international client stakeholders.
Change Management Expertise
Strong understanding of organizational change principles and change adoption processes.
Experience with ADKAR methodology.
PROSCI Certification preferred.
CCMP (Certified Change Management Professional) certification is a plus.
Project & Delivery Knowledge
Understanding of software implementation lifecycles and project management methodologies, including:
SDLC
Waterfall
Agile
Core Competencies
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.
Analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.
Strong decision-making skills.
Ability to work effectively with employees and leaders at all organizational levels.
Ability to drive alignment toward a common vision and business goal.
Preferred Candidate Profile
OCM Lead / Change Management Consultant with experience in ERP, HRIS, or Digital Transformation programs.
Experience leading large change initiatives in global organizations.
Skilled in stakeholder engagement, change impact assessments, communications, training strategy, and adoption management.
Comfortable managing geographically distributed teams and client-facing engagements.

Description:
Hello,
Hope you are doing well!

We are having multiple openings for the role of Payroll Associate (Spanish Speaking along with any Global Payroll or any HCM experience) at the Noida (Sector 62) & Pune (Kalyani Nagar).

Role Overview
The Payroll Specialist supports end-to-end payroll operations for assigned LATAM countries from a global delivery environment, ensuring accurate, compliant, and timely payroll execution. The role partners with In-Country Partners (ICPs), clients, and internal stakeholders to deliver high-quality payroll services and resolve complex issues in a multi-country environment.
Key Responsibilities
• Execute end-to-end payroll processing for assigned LATAM countries (e.g.: Mexico, Colombia, Brazil, Argentina, etc)
• Review payroll inputs, outputs, reconciliations, and variance reports
• Partner with ICPs to ensure accurate and timely payroll delivery
• Investigate and resolve payroll discrepancies and client/employee queries within SLAs
• Support GTN balancing, statutory reporting, and compliance activities.
• Manage client interactions and handle escalations with appropriate ownership
• Support integrations (employee data, time files) and drive root cause resolution
• Maintain strong stakeholder relationships across clients, ICPs, and internal teams
• Contribute to process improvements, documentation, and knowledge sharing
• Ensure adherence to internal controls, SOC requirements, and year-end activities
Required Qualifications
• 3 to 8 years of payroll experience with strong exposure to LATAM payroll
• Experience supporting payroll via ICP (In-Country Partner) model
• Advanced Spanish proficiency (B2+) with ability to manage business communication
• Experience supporting one or more LATAM countries (multi-country preferred)
• Experience in handling client escalations and complex payroll issues.
• Strong understanding of payroll compliance, reconciliations, and controls
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
• Advanced Excel skills (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUPs, formulas) for payroll analysis
• Ability to work in LATAM-aligned shifts (evening/night IST as required)
Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with UKG Pro or other global payroll platforms
• Experience in shared services/global delivery model
• Exposure to payroll implementations or transitions
• Relevant Payroll certification (CPP or FPC equivalent)
Why UKG:
At UKG, the work you do matters. The code you ship, the decisions you make, and the care you show a customer all add up to real impact. Today, tens of millions of workers start and end their days with our workforce operating platform. Helping people get paid, grow in their careers, and shape the future of their industries. Thats what we do.
We never stop learning. We never stop challenging the norm. We push for better, and we celebrate the wins along the way. Here, youll get flexibility thats real, benefits you can count on, and a team that succeeds together. Because at UKG, your work mattersand so do you.

Company Overview:
UKG is the Workforce Operating Platform that puts workforce understanding to work. With the world's largest collection of workforce insights, and people-first AI, our ability to reveal unseen ways to build trust, amplify productivity, and empower talent, is unmatched. It's this expertise that equips our customers with the intelligence to solve any challenge in any industry because great organizations know their workforce is their competitive edge. Description:
Business Intelligence (BI) Programmer Analyst
The Business Intelligence (BI) Programmer Analyst provides day-to-day support of the production, QA, test, and development using Microsoft Business Intelligence tools. Is responsible for the administration of the MSBI Infrastructure and provides 24x7 availability of the Enterprise Business Intelligence. Also performs software upgrades, performance monitoring, system tuning, upgrades and infrastructure management.
Responsibilities
Responsible for the administration of the MSBI Infrastructure and provides 24x7 availability of the Enterprise Business Intelligence.
Perform software upgrades, performance monitoring, system tuning, upgrades and infrastructure management.
Actively provide BI solutions, developing project plans, monitoring progress, and resolving issues.
Provided consultation and knowledge transfer to peers and internal contacts as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in the administration and new development using MSBI.
Provides technical expertise to design business solutions using acquired knowledge and experience related to MSBI.
Provide MSBI administration including install, configure, control failover and load balancing across multiple servers and maintain security.
Plan/drive Business Intelligence project deliverables for the entire organization using MSBI as a BI tool.
Performs application code migrations.
Trouble-shoots hardware and software problems as they apply to design, implementation, or installation activities.
Schedule and coordinate infrastructure maintenance activities including such items as hardware and software upgrades and maintenance.
Consult with business community to gather requirements for specific BI scorecard, dashboard and reporting needs; write detailed specifications to be used in developing reports and processes.
Design and develop scorecards, dashboards and multi-dimension data cubes using MSBI.
Consult with end users to refine/enhance existing BI applications.
Participate in the design and development of enterprise wide data repositories; make recommendations to improve the efficiency and functionality of the database, MSBI environment and associated processes.
Develop and deliver reports on an ad-hoc basis using MSBI; develop and execute a verification and security strategy to ensure the accuracy of the data distributed in the reports.
Function as the enterprise MSBI administrator ensuring performance and security is compliant.
Assist management in attaining problem resolutions, working with multiple BI partner groups and multiple levels of staff and management.
Adhere to ethical standards and comply with the laws and regulations applicable to your job function.
Develops and documents BI coding and naming standards, templates and metadata.
Ensures BI environment is optimized to address business requirements by designing and creating tables, diagnosing and repairing user and performance issues, and testing, monitoring and tuning software.
Bachelors degree, or an equivalent combination of education and experience from which comparable knowledge and abilities can be acquired is necessary.

Description:
Role Summary

The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow thebusiness and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value
(GMV) per month.
The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and specific geographies assigned

Responsibilities

Account & Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions for month-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.

Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:
Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.

Interaction with Stakeholders:
Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team ( reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).
Functional Competencies
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition


Desired Skills

Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working
knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude & Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative & Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.
Creativity & Initiative: Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

Description:
Job Description (JD)
Consultant / Assistant Manager Internal Audit
Location: Mumbai, Kolkata, Hyderabad, Chennai & Bangalore
Function: Governance, Risk and Compliance Services (GRCS) Department: Risk Consulting
Role Overview
Consultant / Assistant Manager Internal Audit will be responsible for managing and executing internal audit, risk consulting and process improvement engagements across multiple industries. The role involves leading project teams, managing client relationships, ensuring quality deliverables, supporting business development activities and contributing to the growth of the GRCS practice
Key Responsibilities
A. Internal Audit & Risk Advisory
Lead risk-based internal audits, process audits and risk consulting engagements.
Conduct Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) and risk assessments.
Evaluate business processes, identify operational risks and assess internal controls.
Perform SOX 404, Internal Financial Controls (IFC) and regulatory compliance reviews.
Identify control gaps and recommend process improvements and risk mitigation measures.
Execute control self-assessments, revenue assurance and continuous monitoring activities.
B. Project Management & Execution
Manage multiple internal audit and risk consulting projects simultaneously.
Lead project teams and oversee project planning, execution and delivery.
Ensure project quality, profitability and adherence to timelines and budgets.
Report project progress and key risks to the Director / Partner.
Act as the primary client contact throughout project execution.
C. Client & Stakeholder Management
Manage client relationships and understand business requirements.
Conduct stakeholder discussions and management presentations.
Communicate audit findings, control gaps and recommendations.
Support clients in implementing corrective actions and process improvements.
D. Team Management & Leadership
Supervise, coach and mentor junior team members.
Review team deliverables and ensure quality standards.
Conduct training and support team capability development.
Manage team performance and promote effective collaboration.
E. Business Development & Practice Growth
Identify business opportunities and contribute to lead generation and deal closure.
Support proposals, pre-sales activities and RFP responses.
Identify cross-selling opportunities across KPMG service lines.
Contribute to revenue growth and client relationship development.
F. Thought Leadership
Contribute to developing new solutions and service offerings.
Participate in knowledge management and practice development initiatives.
Stay updated on industry trends, regulatory developments and emerging risks.
3. Key Service Offerings
Risk-Based Internal Audit
Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) and Risk Assessment
Business Process Consulting
SOX 404 and Internal Financial Controls (IFC)
Regulatory and Contractual Compliance
Corporate Governance Advisory
Revenue Assurance and Control Self-Assessment
Continuous Auditing / Monitoring
Accounting Manuals Development
Capital Projects Audits
Project-Focused Control Assessment
Setting Up Internal Audit Functions
4. Educational Qualifications
- MBA / Chartered Accountant (CA)
Preferred Certifications:
CIA Certified Internal Auditor
CISA Certified Information Systems Auditor
CPA Certified Public Accountant
CMA Certified Management Accountant
ACCA Association of Chartered Certified Accountants

Ensure accurate tracking, reconciliation, and security of all cash deposit and electronic payments received during regular operation in hospital

Establish team as well as individual goals and deliver against the same as per defined service delivery framework and quality processes
Ensuring Regular Governance in place (Internal & External Governance Meeting with teams and Business)
Need to have functional proficiency and specialized knowledge for own areas of responsibility, fair understanding of end-to-end process and IT systems supporting the same

Functional Knowledge of Skills (Must Have)
Proficiency in data management and treasury operation, Good interpersonal skills, Flexible with Job duties, Cash/Collection management and resolve settlement issue

Risk Taking, Accountability, Collaboration

Description:
Role Summary

The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value
(GMV) per month.
The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and
specific geographies assigned

Responsibilities
Account & Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions formonth-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.

Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:
Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.

Interaction with Stakeholders:
Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (
reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).

Functional Competencies
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition

Desired Skills
Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working
knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude & Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative & Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.
Creativity & Initiative: Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

Founded in 2014, Swiggy is headquartered in Bangalore and operates in more than 580 Indian cities, as of July 2023.[4] Besides food delivery, the platform also provides quick commerce services under the name Swiggy Instamart, and same-day package deliveries with Swiggy Genie.

Description:
We work in collaboration with State Education Departments to bring reform by implementing large-scale system-led projects, with the goal of improving foundational learning (FLN) outcomes in students. Our team supports the State in designing and implementing an integrated program that encompasses multiple aspects of a reform process - ranging from designing effective classroom pedagogy to building salience and state capacity to deliver FLN at scale, while also strengthening governance and other critical enablers. Room to Read has partnered with the Education Department of Jharkhand on a long-term engagement for system reform and a demonstration program in selected districts.


Responsibilities

Program Understanding
Develop a thorough understanding of Room to Read s Literacy program design and Project Deliverables
S/he has good awareness of Foundational Literacy and Numeracy programs, their design and strategies operating in project region.
Develop a strong understanding of Govt s education policies NEP 2020, NCF, FLN, SIQE, Mission Ankur etc.
On-ground Implementation and Monitoring
Support the quality implementation of the project in the district and blocks, ensuring timely, efficient, and well-coordinated implementation, adhering to the program and budget guidelines.
Complete higher frequency of regular visits to program schools, observe classroom transactions, speak to teachers and head masters and make suggestions for improving quality and utilization of these materials.
Support District Lead collating collated from the field to further communicate the same to SO and CO for necessary changes in the pedagogy and material.
Support in analyzing various data and information emanating from the field, develop programmatic co- relations and flag off issues for a larger discussion.
Participate in any other activities which may be required to be undertaken to fulfil the objectives of the organization.
Support effective utilization of program budget through proper planning and tracking of planned activities. Ensure that financial and procurement norms are adhered to, and efforts are made to reduce cost to the extent possible, without compromising on the quality.
Track program progress on key indicators according to the ME framework during monthly meetings and throughout the project timeline.
Participate actively on social media in all Room to Read (RtR) campaigns.
Stay updated and share this knowledge with the District Lead regarding new programs/interventions of the like-minded organizations in district.
Identify operational bottlenecks and weaknesses, wherever applicable and come up with solutions for the same in consultation with District Lead.
Support the District Lead in the execution of the Project by leading all technical tasks in the district focused on capacity building of stakeholders across all levels (District, Block, Cluster and Schools), support uptake of materials, and establish coordination with various stakeholders at the district level to sustain the impact and interventions from the program.


Government Liaison and Technical Support
Support District Lead in participation of technical assistance discussions at the district level.
Attend government meetings, discussions and committees on foundational literacy as well as Numeracy and use those forums to advocate for enabling policies and government orders in support of RtR literacy program.
Interact with key stakeholders (government departments and officials such as CDEO/ADPC/DEEO/RPs/DIET etc.) as recommended by the District Lead to ensure delivery of program objectives and explore opportunities for systemic integration.
Conduct discussions with stakeholders at multiple levels across the districts reflecting on the insights collated via field visits, monitoring data and interactions to formulate the way forward for the month.


Participate in Meeting/Workshops at State and INCO Level
Participate in IDTS workshops on material development, training module development and training of trainers.
Attend review meetings at the state/national level and provide reflective feedback on program implementation and design issues. At the same time acts as the conduit for transferring innovative ideas and practices from the national level (or from other states) on to the field.


Planning, Reporting and Documentation
Support District Lead for preparing regular (monthly, quarterly, and yearly basis, including program data) qualitative reports and documenting event reports, case studies and best practices.
Support and ensure all data entry and compilation on monthly, quarterly and yearly basis, including GSD, Dashboard data, maintaining high levels of data quality.
Develop actionable insights through analyses of data collected via monitoring visits to further inform the project implementation.
Assist for preparing Implementation calendar, cash forecast, PRs budget outlook, APB and regular tracking of budget management.


Qualifications

Required
Master s degree in education / social sciences or equivalent preferred.
Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in the education sector.
In-depth knowledge on foundational literacy, language and reading practices and approaches.
Strong written and oral communication skills.
Critical thinking and analytical skills.
Proven track record of achieving results.
Proven ability to work effectively with schools and communities.
Ability to travel regularly to project sites in remote locations.


Preferred
Able to design google forms, sheets, sites, dashboard etc.
Data analysis through advance excel, SPSS etc.
Development of short videos
Able to design workshops session plan.
Able to lead facilitation in workshop for internal team, teachers and officers etc.
Able to design modules, feedback forms, questionnaire, etc.
Child Protection Principles
Room to Read is committed to the education and welfare of children and protecting them from abuse and exploitation
Room to Read has zero tolerance for child abuse and exploitation.
All children have the right to be free from abuse and exploitation, including neglect, maltreatment, and physical, mental or sexual violence, injury or abuse.
All children should be treated with respect and dignity.
The well-being of the child is Room to Read s first priority when dealing with all identified or suspected cases of child abuse.
Room to Read shall integrate child protection into all its organizational strategies, structures and work practices.

Job Summary
Important: All applicants must be legally eligible to work in the country where the position is located. Room to Read is not able to provide sponsorship.
Position Overview: The Associate will support technology adoption, EdTech pilots, and on-ground program delivery for the Prevail Fund Jharkhand Foundational Literacy Program (SFLP) in Jharkhand. The role also feeds into the wider Jharkhand State Project Management Unit (SPMU) technology agenda. The role sits close to field cadres and program teams. It will be a cross functional role involving you moving between a training hall, a school, and a spreadsheet in the same week. This role turns technology into action on the ground: configuring the LMS, running pilots, listening to users, and closing the gap between what a tool promises and what a CRP or teacher actually experiences in the field. This position requires frequent travel and will report to District Lead.
About the Edtech Function in Prevail-Jharkhand: Room to Read uses a blended training framework (Online + Offline) to train and certify field cadres (Program Field Coordinator, Program Associate, Program Officer, District Lead) across multiple districts. The program also testing new EdTech and AI tools to support teacher training, coaching, and classroom practice.


Responsibilities
LMS Management: Manage day-to-day use of the Jharkhand LMS instance for field cadre training and certification.
Set up courses, quiz banks, and completion tracking for each training module.
Coordinate with the Room to Read India LMS administrator for platform changes and upgrades.
Troubleshoot access and login issues for learners and facilitators.
EdTech Pilots and AI App Testing: Coordinate the testing of AI applications and EdTech tools proposed for the Jharkhand program.
Plan and run field pilots from setup through review: install the tool, train the users, observe use, and record results.
Flag technical issues and usability problems to the EdTech Lead and the tool developer.
User Research and Feedback: Plan and conduct user interviews with teachers, CRPs, Master Trainers, and other field cadres.
Collect feedback on the Moodle platform, training content, and EdTech pilots.
Turn raw feedback into clear, short insights the Edtech team can act on.
Use Case Landscaping: Map where technology is already used, and where it could help, across the Prevail Jharkhand project: training, coaching, monitoring, and libraries.
Keep a shared, up-to-date use-case map for the project team.
Flag priority use cases for the EdTech Lead to take forward.
Creation of mockups and prototypes using AI and other design tools.
Field and Program Support: Give on-ground support to program staff and government cadres in multiple districts.
Join field visits with the District Lead, CRPs, and Master Trainers as needed.
Support the rollout of training sessions, TLM (Teaching and Learning Material) distribution, and monitoring tools at the school and cluster level.
Technology Facilitation: Act as the first point of contact for field staff questions about LMS, apps, and other digital tools.
Run short orientation sessions on new tools for field cadres.
Write simple, step-by-step guides for tools and workflows.
Reporting and Documentation: Keep clear records of pilot activities, interview notes, and platform issues.
Contribute EdTech updates to monthly and quarterly program reports.
Keep the project's knowledge base current on EdTech status and open issues.


Qualifications
Graduate degree in education, social sciences, computer applications, or a related field.
2-4 years of relevant experience in EdTech, LMS administration, or field program support.
Comfort with frequent field travel as needed across multiple districts.
Basic troubleshooting skills with mobile apps and digital tools.
Experience with qualitative research methods, such as user interviews and feedback collection.
Strong oral and written communication skills in English and Hindi.


Preferred Qualifications
Working knowledge of Moodle or another LMS platform.
Prior experience in the education or development sector.
Exposure to AI tools used in education or training delivery.
Experience working with government education cadres (CRPs, BRPs, Master Trainers) or community-level stakeholders.

Job Summary
Position Overview: The Associate will supports technology adoption, EdTech pilots, and on-ground program delivery for the Prevail Fund Jharkhand Foundational Literacy Program (SFLP) in Jharkhand. The role also feeds into the wider Jharkhand State Project Management Unit (SPMU) technology agenda. The role sits close to field cadres and program teams. It will be a cross functional role involving you moving between a training hall, a school, and a spreadsheet in the same week. This role turns technology into action on the ground: configuring the LMS, running pilots, listening to users, and closing the gap between what a tool promises and what a CRP or teacher actually experiences in the field. This position requires frequent travel and will report to District Lead.
About the Edtech Function in Prevail-Jharkhand: Room to Read uses a blended training framework (Online + Offline) to train and certify field cadres (Program Field Coordinator, Program Associate, Program Officer, District Lead) across multiple districts. The program also testing new EdTech and AI tools to support teacher training, coaching, and classroom practice.


Responsibilities
LMS Management: Manage day-to-day use of the Jharkhand LMS instance for field cadre training and certification.
Set up courses, quiz banks, and completion tracking for each training module.
Coordinate with the Room to Read India LMS administrator for platform changes and upgrades.
Troubleshoot access and login issues for learners and facilitators.
EdTech Pilots and AI App Testing: Coordinate the testing of AI applications and EdTech tools proposed for the Jharkhand program.
Plan and run field pilots from setup through review: install the tool, train the users, observe use, and record results.
Flag technical issues and usability problems to the EdTech Lead and the tool developer.
User Research and Feedback: Plan and conduct user interviews with teachers, CRPs, Master Trainers, and other field cadres.
Collect feedback on the Moodle platform, training content, and EdTech pilots.
Turn raw feedback into clear, short insights the Edtech team can act on.
Use Case Landscaping: Map where technology is already used, and where it could help, across the Prevail Jharkhand project: training, coaching, monitoring, and libraries.
Keep a shared, up-to-date use-case map for the project team.
Flag priority use cases for the EdTech Lead to take forward.
Creation of mockups and prototypes using AI and other design tools
Field and Program Support: Give on-ground support to program staff and government cadres in multiple districts.
Join field visits with the District Lead, CRPs, and Master Trainers as needed.
Support the rollout of training sessions, TLM (Teaching and Learning Material) distribution, and monitoring tools at the school and cluster level.
Technology Facilitation: Act as the first point of contact for field staff questions about LMS, apps, and other digital tools.
Run short orientation sessions on new tools for field cadres.
Write simple, step-by-step guides for tools and workflows.
Reporting and Documentation: Keep clear records of pilot activities, interview notes, and platform issues.
Contribute EdTech updates to monthly and quarterly program reports.
Keep the projects knowledge base current on EdTech status and open issues.


Qualifications
Graduate degree in education, social sciences, computer applications, or a related field.
2-4 years of relevant experience in EdTech, LMS administration, or field program support.
Comfort with frequent field travel as needed across multiple districts.
Basic troubleshooting skills with mobile apps and digital tools.
Experience with qualitative research methods, such as user interviews and feedback collection.
Strong oral and written communication skills in English and Hindi.


Preferred
Working knowledge of Moodle or another LMS platform.
Prior experience in the education or development sector.
Exposure to AI tools used in education or training delivery.
Experience working with government education cadres (CRPs, BRPs, Master Trainers) or community-level stakeholders.

Description:
JOB SUMMARY
Areas of responsibility include Restaurants/Bars and Room Service, if applicable. Supervises daily restaurant operations and assists with menu planning, maintains sanitation standards and assists servers and hosts on the floor during peak meal periods. Strives to continually improve guest and employee satisfaction and maximize the financial performance in areas of responsibility. Determines training needed to accomplish goals, then implements plan.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area.
OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Food Service Management, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; 2 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Managing Day-to-Day Operations
- Supervises and manages employees. Manages all day-to-day operations. Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
- Maintains service and sanitation standards in restaurant, bar/lounge and room service areas.
- Reviews staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and financial objectives are met.
Leading Food and Beverage Team
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound financial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
- Serves as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
- Identifies the developmental needs of others and coaches, mentors, or otherwise helps others to improve their knowledge or skills.
- Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.
- Ensures and maintains the productivity level of employees.
- Provides the leadership, vision and direction to bring together and prioritize the departmental goals in a way that will be efficient and effective.
- Ensures compliance with all food & beverage policies, standards and procedures by training, supervising, follow-up and hands on management.
- Ensures compliance with all applicable laws and regulations.
- Ensures compliance with food handling and sanitation standards.
- Ensures staff understands local, state and Federal liquor laws.
- Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.
- Establishes guidelines so employees understand expectations and parameters.
- Monitors alcohol beverage service in compliance with local laws.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Manages day-to-day operations, ensures the quality, standards and meets the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
- Displays leadership in guest hospitality, exemplifies excellent customer service and creates a positive atmosphere for guest relations.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
- Acts as the guest service role model for the restaurants, sets a good example of excellent customer service and creates a positive atmosphere for guest relations.
- Handles guest problems and complaints.
- Meets with guests on an informal basis during meals or upon departure to obtain feedback on quality of food and beverage, service levels and overall satisfaction.
- Ensures corrective action is taken to continuously improve service results.
- Incorporates guest satisfaction as a component of departmental meetings with a focus on continuous improvement.

Job Description
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners

Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help

CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Human Resources, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; 1 year experience in the human resources or related professional area; certified trainer. OR

- Meets regularly with participants to assess progress and address concerns.
- Partners with operational leaders to assess if employees demonstrate effective technical and leadership skills.

- Assists with making any necessary adjustments to training methodology and/or re-trains as appropriate.
- Aligns current training and development programs to effectively impact key business indicators.
- Assists with establishing guidelines so employees understand expectations and parameters.
- Develops specific training to improve service performance.
- Drives brand values and philosophy in all training and development activities.
- Incorporates guest satisfaction as a component of departmental meetings with a focus on continuous improvement.
Assisting with Managing Training Budgets
- Assists with the development of the Training budget as required.
- Assists with managing budget in alignment with Human Resources and property ficial goals.
- Assists with managing department controllable expenses to achieve or exceed budgeted goals.
- Utilizes P-card if appropriate to control and monitor departmental expenditures.

Title: Business Development Executive \ Field sales apprentice role
Location: Ranchi (Retail Store Based)
Job Type: Full\-Time apprentice role for 12 months
Industry: Beauty & Cosmetics \/ Retail \/ FMCG

Summary:
We are seeking a motivated Business Development Executive to drive growth for a leading online cosmetic and beauty products retailer across Uttar Pradesh. This role is centred on expanding our retail footprint by building strong relationships with distributors, retailers, and vendors within the assigned territory. The ideal candidate will be proactive in lead generation, product promotion, and sales execution, ensuring consistent visibility and performance of our offerings in key retail locations. The position is retail store\-based with regular field visits, offering a dynamic opportunity to contribute directly to business expansion in a fast\-paced FMCG environment.

Responsibilities:
\- Identify and develop new leads through systematic market visits, provided data, and personal referrals
\- Engage with distributors, retailers, and vendors to present product portfolios and drive sales
\- Conduct in\-store product sampling and promotional activities to enhance customer engagement
\- Execute targeted product launch initiatives and ensure timely deal closures
\- Support retail partners with business development strategies and on\-ground execution
\- Monitor, analyse, and report monthly sales performance, campaign outcomes, and key market insights

Requirements
\- Graduate in any discipline (from 2021 to 2025 pass\-out)
\- Freshers are encouraged to apply
\- Up to 11 months of sales or field experience is acceptable
\- Must be a local resident of the assigned location (within 10 km of the retail store)
\- Personal two\-wheeler (bike preferred) is mandatory with valid driving license
\- Prior knowledge or experience in the beauty\/cosmetics or FMCG sector is preferred
\- Male candidates are preferred for this role

Work Details:
\- Work Schedule: 6 days a week
\- Weekly Off: Sunday
\- Work Type: Retail store\-based with regular local market visits

Benefits
\- Fixed salary: \\u20b911,500 from Nykaa + 4500 from Govt (16000 in hand)
\- Daily TA\/DA: \\u20b9200
\- Attractive performance\-based incentives

Description:
Job Responsibility

1. Grievance handling for all bargainable employees:
Interact with employees to identify and effectively resolve all issues
Effective predicting of issues that pose a threat to smooth functioning of organization & prioritize accordingly
Prevent employee grievances from turning into bigger IR issues that can hamper production
Conduct regular meetings like IRC (Industrial Relations Committee) to capture all employee grievances.
2. Ensure maintenance of Internal Discipline:
Ensure that there is good understanding & acceptance for all rules and regulations mandated by the Management.
Take necessary preventive actions and measures of counselling wherever necessary
Take necessary disciplinary actions wherever required to ensure harmonious and productive environment on the shop floor.
Lead Quality Circle, SDT, improvement projects.
Ensure Statutory Compliance of the factory he/she is responsible for : Monitoring Statutory compliances such as ESI,PF, Minimum wages, maternity benefit, Bonus Act & Submission of returns
3. Liaise with employees, Union Leaders, line managers, divisional heads & factory heads:
Work closely with line managers for improvement in production, interacts with shop supervisors, managers, function heads.
Implement long term settlements, wage negotiations clauses, Bonus settlements, union elections and other critical items as and when they are due & manage industrial relations.
Provide inputs to the ER head for preparing management demands.
Provide cross-functional support to administration, communication and productivity services, safety team.
Resolve ER issues at the plant level striving for no/minimum loss to business/ corporate image.
Maintain cordial relations with all stake holders in order to ensure smooth functioning on the shop floor.
Implement location level ER priorities in consultation with Factory Head, Shop heads & ER Head.
Identify risks and opportunities in the respective factory location and put in place plans to mitigate the same.
4. Drive initiatives to motivate bargainable employees:
Identify and implement welfare activities including sports for blue collar workers in line with organizational guidelines
Organize regular Reward & Recognition functions like the long service awards
Plan and organize various family events or departmental picnics.
Be responsible for a set of employees in shop/area for engagement, growth, recognition,
Self –Directed teams , SQDCME (Safety / Quality/ Delivery/ Cost/ Morale and Environment)
Stakeholder Profiles & Nature of Interactions
Internal
Employees: Regular Liaising & proactive IR
Block Union Representatives / Line Managers/Divisional Heads/Factory Heads : Regular Interaction and communication for smooth functioning.
Shared services, Construction, Safety, Administration, Medical: To assist workmen in resolving their grievances
ER Team: Regular Interaction between factories for good flow of management ideas.
External
Labour Department & Government Agencies: For Statutory Requirements
Industry Associations: Participation in industry associations and forums related to Industrial Relations to stay informed about trends, regulations, and emerging practices.
Desired Candidate Profile
Education : Post Graduate in Human Resources.
Relevant Experience : 5+ years of experience in HR / ER with exposure to handling blue collared workers extensively.
Skills & Competencies
Business Acumen
Change Management
Conflict Management
Influencing Skills
Labour Relations
Strategy & Risk Management
Stakeholder Management

Job Introduction:
Admin Support
Position Title: Admin Support
Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent
Minimum Qualification: Graduate (mandatory)
Role Overview:
The Assignment Manager will be responsible for the end-to-end management of physical security operations across high-profile client sites in the South Zone of India. This includes ensuring effective deployment of personnel, compliance with client protocols, documentation accuracy, stakeholder engagement, crisis readiness, and operational audits. The Assignment Manager is expected to maintain high discipline standards, handle large-scale operations seamlessly, and serve as the bridge between the client, site security teams, and the G4S backend.
This role demands strong leadership, a proactive mindset, technical know-how, and non-negotiable communication excellence. Impeccable fluency in spoken English with the right accent, grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation is strictly mandatory.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Site Operations Oversight:
Plan and deploy daily security personnel as per shift schedules and site-specific SOPs.
Conduct briefing sessions across all shifts and ensure grooming, discipline, and attendance compliance.
Prepare and manage MDR, shift schedules, and site logs.
Carry out efficient patrolling of internal and perimeter areas.
Observe and respond to suspicious man/material movements.
Ensure access control compliance and critical access management (labs, restricted zones).
Maintain visitor/vendor records, key logs, badges, and lost & found registers.
Conduct weekly security training and refresher briefings.
Perform surprise night inspections to assess readiness of night staff.
2. Technical Systems & Documentation:
Ensure the uptime and functionality of CCTV, access control systems, and FAPA equipment.
Maintain workstations audit, badge audits, and access key audits.
Coordinate with facility teams for system rectification and AMC partner activities.
Take access approvals via eApproval portals.
3. Reporting & MIS:
Share daily, weekly, and monthly operations reports with G4S and designated site managers.
Maintain event trackers, alarms reports, RPM data, incident logs, and vendor performance records.
Support site managers in Hyderabad, Mumbai, Delhi, and Gurugram for consolidated reporting.
4. Emergency & Incident Management:
Act as the first escalation point for medical emergencies, duress alerts, or system-triggered alarms.
Liaise with EMEIA SOC for remote access control and video retrieval.
Prepare incident reports, investigate breaches, and implement CAPAs.
Conduct mock drills, shutdown protocols, and risk preparedness activities.
5. Client & Stakeholder Coordination:
Respond to client queries and share required reports (daily/weekly/monthly) within agreed SLAs.
Attend virtual coordination meetings with client-side managers to sync activities Pan India.
Coordinate closely with facilities and places teams for smooth operations, approvals, and events.
Handle onboarding/offboarding of employees with badge issuance and access revocation.
6. G4S Internal Coordination:
Share weekly duty rosters, attendance, and nominal rolls with G4S backend.
Coordinate on salary concerns, health insurance issues, and uniform issuance.
Maintain leave records and escalate absenteeism trends.
Work with Key Account Managers to resolve operations-related escalations.
Candidate Profile:
Minimum Requirements:
Graduate in any discipline (mandatory)
Minimum 5-10 years of experience in security operations management
Experience handling multi-location operations preferred
Prior exposure to multinational corporate environments in IT sector shall be very advantageous for the candidate.
Essential Competencies:
Communication: Fluent spoken and written English (mandatory); clarity, grammar, and pronunciation will be tested.
Operational Skills: Security deployment, documentation, SOPs, reporting tools.
Technical Proficiency: Familiar with access control, surveillance systems, e-portals, and Microsoft Office.
Leadership & Ethics: High integrity, team management skills, crisis-handling experience.
Behavioral Traits: Attention to detail, time-sensitive decision-making, calm under pressure.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
100% compliance in daily deployment & reporting
95% uptime for security equipment and systems
2 critical incidents per year (with timely CAPA)
SLA adherence for report submissions and audits
Staff discipline, grooming, and performance audit scores 90%

Description:
Purpose of the Role
The role is responsible for driving sales of vehicles through sales volumes and market share and ensuring enhancing customer engagement in the assigned territory. It involves actively managing dealer relationships & driving demand, developing new business and achieving the territory sales targets.

Job Responsibility
1. Sales Planning:
Drives sales in the specified territory for a particular product line ensuring volume sales, market share growth and enhanced customer engagement in assigned territory
Plan and conduct monthly target setting including marketing activations at the dealerships in line with forecast/ estimated TIV and sales volume for the assigned territory
Coordinate with various partners and internal teams to drive customer engagement & sales. Plan and execute monthly activations and provide the necessary support to drive effectiveness while measuring outcomes of activities conducted
Ensure monthly and annual targets to be achieved in terms of retail sales and customer satisfaction levels as per Sales & Marketing plan.
Support state product manager in the conversion of mid-to-big sized deals when needed
Drive the conversion of C4T customers with assigned dealership into Tata Motors fold
Drive sales and share of business with key accounts customers
Drive value added sales in the assigned territory and seek support from sales teams on need basis
2. Review and Execution:
Conduct sales execution meeting on a monthly basis with dealers sales representatives and sales team to monitor performance and to set future action plan
Execute dealer wise and outlet wise performance to monitor sales pipeline and deploy action plan to different territories based on performance and potential
Review and monitor MIS of the following: Volume, Market Share, Activity Report, Retail tracker, C4T list and pipeline DSE
Ensure the execute of distribution of dealership target DSE wise and Micro Market wise
Provide product wise indent to RSMs as per the agreed schedule
Capture and review market intelligence through multiple sources, including voice of customer on product/services and regulatory requirements. Explore potential white spaces due to emerging customer expectations
Review and monitor dealers inventory and ensure that it stays at optimum level through proper forecasting
Provide inputs on existing product improvements/ development of new products and variants to create differentiation in the market
Work closely with state product managers to share market intelligence about the product on regular basis
3. Financial Management:
Monitor liquidation of stock at assigned dealerships to ensure timely payment by financiers and channelling of funds back into the system
4. People Management:
Drive manpower, infrastructure and processes at dealerships as per TML norms
Execute trainings for dealer sales team on pre-sales & sales processes, new product features / modifications etc.
Stakeholder Profiles & Nature of Interactions
Internal:
State Product Manager (Product Line), State Head
Update and seek support on sales and market share growth
Provide support, if and when necessary, in conversion of mid-to-big sized deals
Regional Sales Managers
Product, targeting setting for self and dealership, ATL activities
Regional Head SNM/ SNM Manager
Drive Manpower, infrastructure and processes at dealerships
Regional Head RCFI/ RCFI Manager
Ensure finance availability to dealers and customers

Desired Candidate Profile
Education : B.E/ B.Tech with relevant experience/ MBA in Sales & Marketing preferred.
Relevant Experience : 4 - 7 years.
Experience in Automobile Industry.
Experience in Sales & Marketing.

Skills & Competencies
Product Knowledge
Analytical Skills
Interpersonal Skills
Communication Skills

Description:
Dear Candidate,

We are looking for a dedicated and experienced Site Engineer to manage waterproofing, retrofit, repairs application projects across. The candidate will be responsible for site execution, billing, coordination with applicator manpower, and client interaction to ensure timely and quality project completion.

Please go through the Job Profile. Interested candidate are required to share their profile at shraddha.bhosle@jsw.in

Key Responsibilities:
1. Site Execution & Supervision
Supervise waterproofing application works at site.
Ensure work is executed as per technical specifications and quality standards.
Conduct site inspections and resolve technical issues.
Maintain daily progress reports.
2. Billing & Documentation
Prepare client RA bills and subcontractor/applicator bills.
Measure work quantities and maintain proper billing records.
Coordinate with accounts for timely submission and approvals.
Maintain material reconciliation statements.
3. Manpower Coordination
Coordinate with applicator teams and subcontractors.
Ensure availability of required manpower and materials.
Monitor productivity and discipline at site.
Provide technical guidance to applicators.
4. Client Coordination
Act as the primary point of contact at site.
Attend client meetings and provide project updates.
Handle site-related queries and ensure client satisfaction.
Coordinate for approvals, inspections, and certifications.
5. Planning & Material Management
Plan daily and weekly work schedules.
Ensure proper storage and usage of waterproofing materials.
Monitor material consumption and reduce wastage.
Preferred Candidate Profile:
Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Civil Engineering.
25 years of experience in waterproofing or construction site execution.
Good knowledge of waterproofing systems (PU coating, APP membrane, injection grouting, etc.).
Strong billing and measurement skills.
Basic knowledge of MS Excel and billing software.

Role: Area Sales Manager
Location: Zonal office- Bhubaneswar
Reporting to: Regional Sales Manager
Team name: Sales team
About the Team and the Role:
The Sales team at Ather is responsible for building a network and establishing the blueprint for selling Electric Vehicles in India, driving a historic transformation of the two-wheeler commute through a breakthrough product and an engaged community.
This role is for an Area Sales Manager who will play a key role in the growth story, owning the business in their region and ensuring growth in sales while maintaining high levels of customer experience and operational profits.
Responsibilities:
Drive sales through assigned Channel Partners
Build teams and systems that ensure sustainable sales growth while maintaining exceptionally high customer experience standards.
Foster and manage strong relationships with retail partners to ensure business thriving and alignment with brand vision.
Execute operational excellence at Channel Partners covering local demand generation and sales driving activities.
Analyze the sales funnel to identify problem statements, develop solutions, and motivate teams for implementation.
Deliver against steep ramp-up plans with a focus on scaling the regional business effectively.
Manage multi-stakeholder inputs from internal teams and external partners to maintain design and operational integrity.
Conduct regular performance reviews and site assessments to ensure business health and consistency across locations.
Strategise and strive to improve Ather market share in the assigned territory
Required qualifications
Postgraduate or graduate degree in Business or Engineering from a Tier I/Tier II institute.
4 to 10 years of experience in B2C/Channel sales.
Must Have Competencies
Data-driven analysis of sales funnels to identify bottlenecks and implement strategic solutions for revenue growth.
Strategic channel management to align retail partners with corporate goals while ensuring partner profitability.
Operational excellence in retail management, specifically driving local demand generation and customer experience standards.
Expertise in B2C sales strategies and the ability to execute aggressive market ramp-up plans in competitive environments.
Good to Have Competencies
Deep understanding of technology or automobile retail landscapes and evolving mobility trends in the Indian market.
Advanced negotiation and persuasive communication skills for navigating complex stakeholder relationships and retail partnerships.
Proficiency in organizational planning and resource prioritization to manage multi-location business operations.
Ability to build and empower high-performing teams through structured mentorship and performance management systems.
Want to know more?
At Ather, weve built India’s first intelligent scooter, from scratch. Based on the philosophy of clean design and smart technology, we are transforming the urban commute experience. We are expanding in India, and in the coming years, we look forward to scaling up and launching more products globally. Today, our product offerings include the Ather 450X, 450S, 450 Apex, and Rizta. Beyond the product, we are also setting up an extensive charging network and re-imagining end-to-end ownership experience. To know more, check out our Careers site and our Substack.
Be You, With Us
The Ather story doesn't write itself - our people do. We believe everyone is equal, but not the same. Diversity is our strength, and building an inclusive and equitable workplace begins with acknowledging and embracing our differences. We are an equal opportunity employer, and our team reflects a wide range of identities, experiences, and perspectives - all united by a shared passion to shape the Ather journey.

We built Indias first smart and connected electric scooters, the Ather 450 product line because we believe that's where the future of personal mobility is headed.
Ather is one of the few start-ups in India, specifically within the automotive industry, to have products & services that are an amalgamation of clean design & engineering - Hardware & Software.

Job Summary
The opportunity: Senior Project Consultant-GOV-SaT-SaT - TCF - Infrastructure Advisory - Bhubaneshwar
Our Global Government & Public Sector (GPS) is a network of highly skilled professionals dedicated to serving our clients by bringing best-in-class international experience and insight combined with local knowledge to solve the most critical problems facing governments today. We actively focus on building solutions that help public sector entities face the challenges of the future and reinvent themselves.
Digital transformation is not just about new technologies; it involves an overhaul of organizational structures, governance, work processes, culture and mindset. It also means realizing a wider vision of relationships and business models that will redesign how public services function.
To achieve this vision, we help clients balance strategic choices to re-ignite performance. We have developed a suite of cross-service line strategic solutions that align with our client priorities.
We have a proud record of helping governments meet their challenges head-on, and we work closely with them to build a world that works better for all citizens.
SaT
The Government and public sector transactions services is part of EY's Government & Public Sector (GPS) Services which is a network of highly skilled professionals from assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, devoted to serving the government and public sector organizations and institutions.
The practice combines private sector leading practice with an understanding of the public sectors diverse needs, focused on delivering improved public services. Government and public sector transactions services, sits under EYs Transaction Advisory Services practice, a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team, working with leading businesses across a range of industries. This practice is in a unique position to deliver implementable strategies given the firms sector depth, transaction perspectives, and operational insights.
The practice provides experience working with various sectors such as, Transport, Social & Health care, Education, Urban & Infrastructure, Economic Development Advisory , Water waste & Sanitation, Power & Utilities and Public Finance & Management.
SaT - TCF - Infrastructure Advisory
Strategy and Transactions enables clients to reimagine ecosystems, reshape portfolios and reinvent for a better future. Using our Capital Agenda framework, we work with clients to find answers to todays toughest strategic, financial, operational and commercial questions. We help corporates, private equity, governments, sovereign wealth funds, private and family businesses, and educational institutions with their key financial issues. From portfolio review and capital allocation processes to financial planning analytics and decision support, we have the people, analytics and tools to better allocate capital. Our team helps clients manage their risk/return trade-offs to support them with better decision-making around financing and capital efficiency.
Whether clients are preserving, optimizing, raising or investing, our Connected Capital Solutions (CCS) are our five go-to-market offerings that help drive competitive advantage and increased returns through improved decision-making. The CCS include Strategy, Corporate Finance, Buy and Integrate, Sell and Separate and Reshaping Results, and are underpinned by our Connected Capital Technologies.
Our key focus areas are - Investment Banking Advisory, Valuations, Modeling and Economics, Transaction Diligence, Restructuring and Turnaround Services, Project Finance and infrastructure, EY Parthenon - Strategy and EY Parthenon - Execution.
Your key responsibilities
Agr business development
Qualifications and experience Qualification
Master of Business Administration
Experience
Business Analysis (3+ years)
What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

Job Description
Candidates should have 8-15 years of experience in water or waste water treatment projects, with at least 3-5 years in a Testing and Commissioning role. Strong knowledge of treatment processes, equipment, and PLC/SCADA systems is essential, along with good leadership, problem-solving, and communication skills. The role is primarily site-based and may require extended working hours during commissioning phases.
Responsibilities
Develop detailed commissioning plans, procedures, and schedules, and coordinate with engineering, construction, and client teams. Review design drawings, P&IDs, and technical specifications, and identify system boundaries and commissioning priorities.
Ensure completion of mechanical, electrical, and instrumentation installations prior to commissioning. Verify equipment alignment, calibration, and integrity. Supervise flushing, cleaning, hydro-testing, and loop checking activities, and prepare necessary checklists and inspection reports.
Lead dry and wet commissioning of treatment systems and oversee start-up activities of pumps, blowers, motors, clarifiers, filters, aeration systems, chemical dosing systems, and PLC/SCADA control systems. Monitor system performance and troubleshoot operational issues.
Conduct trial runs and performance guarantee tests, ensuring treated water meets required regulatory standards. Optimize process parameters such as flow, pH, dissolved oxygen, and sludge handling, and document all test results and compliance reports.
Prepare and submit commissioning reports, test certificates, and as-built documentation. Support client training, assist in final handover, and ensure all punch points are completed prior to project closure.
Ensure strict adherence to health, safety, and environmental standards, and comply with all applicable environmental regulations, pollution control norms, and project quality requirements.


Requirements
Candidates should have 8-15 years of experience in water or wastewater treatment projects, with at least 3-5 years in a Testing and Commissioning role.
Strong knowledge of treatment processes, equipment, and PLC/SCADA systems is essential.
Good leadership, problem-solving, and communication skills.
The role is primarily site-based and may require extended working hours during commissioning phases.

CNS - BC - Transformation Delivery :
EY Consulting is building a better working world by transforming businesses through the power of people, technology and innovation. Our client-centric approach focuses on driving long-term value for our clients by solving their most strategic problems. EY Consulting is made up of three sub-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services.
Business Consulting works with clients to reimagine or transform their business purpose and model; create growth; manage cost and efficiency; respond to market pressures and regulation; and resolve operational challenges. The scope of this team encompasses innovation, strategy and purpose, through deep functional experience in business transformation, finance, supply chain and operations, providing support for the complex and large-scale program and portfolio management.
It has multiple fields of play such as:
Finance Consulting - helps assess and transform our clients' finance function to improve performance and effectiveness. We help organizations implement service and cost improvement initiatives, and embed a performance management process and culture that unites the business around its core objectives.
Business Transformation - a multidisciplinary competency, gathering capabilities in transformation architecture, experience design, business design and transformation execution to problem-solve, design and deliver large scale, multi-year, multi-stakeholder transformation programs.
Supply Chain and Operations - we provide a unique combination of industry-specific, strategic, operational and financial insights, digital technology advances and strategic alliance partners to deliver better outcomes and also help clients effect fundamental change in their operations performance to support sales growth, become more cost competitive, minimize risk and ensure operational resilience.
Your key responsibilities
Strong consulting expertise with hands-on experience in government engagements and sector-level transformation delivery. Demonstrated field experience supporting district-level program implementation and monitoring, with exposure to DMF-related work. Ability to manage sectors under PMKKKY and track progress across DMF districts with accuracy and consistency. Skilled in preparing structured concept notes and supporting procurement-related documentation and processes. Proficient in coordinating reporting inputs for team leads and maintaining clear progress visibility across multiple stakeholders.

To qualify for the role you must have
Qualification
Masters in Social Work or Development
Experience
5 years of experience in social sector
What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

- Graduation / Post graduation
- Strong analytical skills to drive channel performance and drive profitability

- Excellent Communication and Negotiation Skill
b) Work Experience:

- Cross sell targets 650 IPC to be maintained

Partner with the best
Baker Hughes stands as a leading global energy technology company, delivering innovative solutions that make energy safer, cleaner, and more efficient across the entire value chain. Operating in more than 120 countries, the company blends deep industrial expertise with advanced engineering and digital technologies to support energy production, transformation, and decarbonization. With over a century of heritage, Baker Hughes partners with customers in oil and gas, industrial sectors, and emerging energy markets to accelerate progress toward a more sustainable energy future.

Fuel your passion
The Tender Manager - Wireline Services leads and coordinates tendering activities across the Asia Pacific region and Middle East (MEAP), driving proposal excellence, commercial governance, tender strategy, and bid execution to support profitable growth across multiple Baker Hughes Product Companies and business segments. The role partners closely with Sales, Commercial Operations, Product Lines, Pricing, Commercial Risk, Finance, and Regional Leadership to deliver competitive, compliant, and high-quality tenders that maximize win rates, improve commercial outcomes, and strengthen customer value propositions.

As a Tender Manager - Wireline Services, you will be responsible for
Lead wireline tender execution across multiple functions including Product Companies and business lines within the MEAP region.
Drive tender strategy and bid execution for complex, strategic, and high-value opportunities involving multiple products, technologies, and service offerings. Ensure development of winning bid strategies through close partnership with Sales, Product Lines, Commercial Hubs, Pricing, and Commercial Risk teams. Own tender governance, quality, compliance, and adherence to commercial approval processes and risk management requirements.
Establish tender management best practices, standardization, and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance bid quality, efficiency, and response times.
Coordinate cross-functional and cross-segment resources to ensure timely development of integrated customer proposals.
Provide support during customer negotiations and deal shaping, executive bid approval processes, and lead commercial reviews.
Drive visibility to regional opportunity pipelines, tender performance metrics, win rates, and proposal effectiveness.
Champion commercial excellence and promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, customer focus, and profitable growth.

To Be Successful in This Role You Will:
Bachelor s degree in engineering, Business, Finance, or a related discipline.
Minimum 6 to 8 years of experience within the OFSE sectors. Strong experience in tendering, proposal management, sales, commercial operations, or commercial leadership roles.
Have 6 to 8 years of experience in Wireline Product Line.
Strong knowledge of commercial strategy, tender governance, pricing methodologies, contract structures, and risk management.
Demonstrate leadership, stakeholder management, and executive communication skills.
Ability to influence senior leaders and drive alignment across Sales, Product Lines, Commercial Teams, and Functional organizations.
Experience operating across diverse international markets, particularly within the Middle East and Asia Pacific regions is preferred.

Work in a way that works for you

We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns:
Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.

Working with us
Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.

Working for you
Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we must push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:

Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities
Comprehensive private medical care options
Safety net of life insurance and disability programs
Tailored financial programs
Additional elected or voluntary benefits
