SAP CPI Consultant JD
About the Role
We are looking for experienced SAP CPI Consultants to join our SAP practice. The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, implementing, and supporting integration solutions using SAP Cloud Platform Integration (CPI) and SAP Integration Suite.The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in SAP CPI, SAP Integration Suite, iFlows, Groovy Scripting, OData Services, API integrations, and cloud-based integration scenarios. Experience in implementation, migration, enhancement, and support projects is highly preferred.
Location: Bangalore,Chennai,Mysuru,Noida,Nagpur,Mumbai,Hyderabad,Kolkata,
Coimbatore,Thiruvanandhapuram,Mangaluru,etc
Experience: JL4: 2-5 Years | JL5: 5-9 Years
Roles & Responsibilities
Design, develop, and support integration solutions using SAP CPI and SAP Integration Suite.
Develop and maintain iFlows for cloud-to-cloud and cloud-to-on-premise integrations.
Create and enhance integration scenarios using SOAP, REST, IDoc, RFC, and OData services.
Develop custom integration logic using Groovy Scripts.
Configure adapters, mappings, content modifiers, routers, and exception handling mechanisms.
Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize integration interfaces.
Collaborate with functional and technical teams to understand business requirements and integration needs.
Perform unit testing, SIT, UAT support, defect resolution, and production support activities.
Prepare technical specifications and integration documentation.
Participate in implementation, rollout, migration, upgrade, and support projects.
Support SAP S/4HANA integration initiatives.
Ensure adherence to integration best practices, security standards, and governance processes.
Qualifications
Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience in SAP CPI/Integration Suite.
B.E./B.Tech/MCA/M.Sc/MBA or any Postgraduate degree.
Mandatory Skills
SAP CPI,CLOUD PLATFORM,INTEGRATION SUITE,IFLOWS,GROOVY SCRIPT,ODATA,ODATA

Position Name-Senior Manager
Position Details
As part of our EY-Assurance Team, the Digital Senior Manager will be responsible for working closely and leading teams with associates, seniors, team leaders, assistant managers, and handling service delivery for an Area/Region/Solution/Sector. The principal objectives will be to ensure that consistent and high-quality service is provided by the team by taking end-to-end project ownership and accomplishing the define goals. The Innovation Manager is responsible for the overall success of implantation of solutions/ideas that can bring more business or can bring efficiencies by digitalize the manual work.
Requirements (including experience, skills and additional qualifications)
Requirement & Qualification
A Bachelors/ Master s degree (BE/BTech/MCA/MTech & MBA) in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems Management, Accounting, Finance or a related field with adequate industry experience.
15-20 years experience (demonstrated competence, depth, and breadth) of operational and project/Program management experience
Strategize and outline goals and objectives of the program
Monitor multiple projects through the entire program cycle, Manage the daytoday detailed aspects of multiple projects, Coordinate and utilize resources for multiple projects in the program
Communicate program objectives, goals, and progress to program directors, executives, upper management, and stakeholders
Experience in independently leading the organization wide Tech Initiatives along with managing the delivery of those initiatives spanning across
Automation - Robotics Process Automation, SharePoint/ React, .NET, Web Portal development, Cloud etc.
Transformation - Business Process Reengineering, Business Process
Optimization
Data Visualization - PowerBI, Spotfire etc.
Knowledge & ability to manage Financial Accounting engagements across domains
Ability to manage tight deadlines and multiple strategic initiatives simultaneously.
Prior experience with agile methodologies and practices
Awareness on cloud technologies is required
The individual will assist the management team in developing and coaching team members as well as ensuring that resources are deployed in the most effective manner
While the individual will be based at our Bangalore office, the role requires the person to travel to other countries on a short or long-term basis for client engagements.
Good to have
PMP Certifications or equivalent certification
Scrum Product Owner or Scrum Master Certifications
Key Responsibilities :
Develop strong relationship with onshore stakeholders (Area s leadership and champion network) and manage their expectations on service delivery
Building Centralized Data storage system
Building Data Strategies for the team
Built good understanding of Sources and Target sources by understanding the GDS Assurance Business.
Responsible for identifying and creating new service offerings/Solutions
Responsible for ensuring high quality consistent and efficient service is provided by the team to the Project teams of different areas/regions
Responsible for managing the operational aspects of Project management such as, resource management, Metrics & Reporting, performance management and elements of risk management
In addition, the Manager will be responsible to build strong relationships with local teams and clients, identifying areas where GDS can improve quality of, and increase the scope of work
Experience in coordinating projects and interdependencies between various projects within the program
Additional skills requirements :
Excellent written, oral, presentation and facilitation skills
Ability to coordinate multiple projects and initiatives simultaneously through effective prioritization, organization, flexibility and self-discipline.
Must have demonstrated project management experience.
Knowledge of firm s reporting tools and processes.
Proactive, organized and self-sufficient with ability to priorities and multitask.
Analyses complex or unusual problems and is able to deliver insightful and pragmatic solutions.
Ability to quickly and easily create/ gather/ analyze data from a variety of sources.
A robust and resilient disposition able to encourage discipline in team behaviors
What we look for
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 7200 + professionals, in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
Opportunities to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries
At EY, we re dedicated to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies - and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to :
Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that s right for you
EY | Building a better working world

Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. As an IFS Cloud EAM - Senior Associate, you will engage with clients to deliver tailored solutions within our Business Application Consulting practice. You will focus on Maximo Consulting, leveraging your skills to address complex business challenges and optimize operations. As a Senior Associate, you will build meaningful client connections, anticipate needs, and navigate ambiguity to deliver quality work. You will guide and mentor others, using your skills to analyze complex concepts and develop a deeper understanding of the business context.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will be part of the Business & Supply Chain Operations network, contributing to Field Service & Operations Modernisation initiatives. You will utilize a broad range of tools and methodologies to generate new ideas and solve problems, enhancing your personal brand and technical skills. This position offers the opportunity to grow professionally while working in a dynamic environment that values relationship building and personal growth.
Responsibilities
Design, develop, and implement custom solutions in IFS Cloud EAM/ERP. Customize IFS modules to meet specific business needs by writing and modifying PL/SQL code, utilizing APIs, and creating custom fields, menus, and reports.
Develop and implement integration solutions using IFS Connect/REST (OData/Projections) and coordinate cutover to Ensure seamless data flow and integrity across the organization.
Own data migration using templates, cleansing rules, validation, migration jobs and coordinate cutover. 
Configure IFS Cloud Aurana (Lobbies, Workflows, pages, custom fields/actions, projections), permissions/security, and application parameters.
Develop reports/analytics using Quick Reports/SQL, IFS Report Designer, IFS Report Studio.
Collaborate with functional teams, business analysts, and project managers to gather requirements and create technical specifications. Document technical changes, configurations, and custom code to ensure knowledge transfer and system maintainability.
Provide technical support to resolve complex issues within the IFS system, identifying root causes and implementing timely fixes. Troubleshoot performance issues and recommend optimization techniques to enhance system efficiency.
Support the upgrade process for IFS Cloud, including testing, data migration, and user acceptance testing. Work closely with the IFS support team and internal IT to manage patches, upgrades, and enhancements.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a focus on root-cause analysis and solution-based development.
Effective communication skills to convey technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Ability to manage development tasks within project timelines and adapt to changing priorities.
High level of accuracy and focus on quality in development work and documentation.
What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 5+ years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
Minimum 5+ years of experience working with IFS Cloud and 2+ years of experience in Integration Experience.
5+ years of experience as a technical developer in IFS Cloud EAM/ERP environments.
Experience in at least 2 end to end implementation of any IFS Cloud Projects
Implementation and configuration knowledge across IFS Cloud ERP, EAM,
Demonstrated configuration expertise in core EAM processes (PM programs, work orders, resources, failure codes, materials).
Working knowledge of Projections/REST APIs, IFS Connect, security/permission sets, and data migration tools.
Strong PLSQL (Oracle) for troubleshooting and Reports.
Understanding of discrete and/or process workflows and how they integrate with IFS Cloud module.
Exposure to integration between IFS Cloud and other systems.

IFS Certified Practitioner Technical Consultant ( Required )

Description:
Extensive SAP S/4HANA Finance expert with solution design experience across the full FI stack, preferably with an accounts and finance background.
Lead a team of Finance specialists; facilitate and guide the implementation and support teams.
Ability to lead and facilitate design workshops, assessments, and planning sessions, demonstrating leadership experience in project management.
Lead dynamic, interactive requirements-gathering sessions with stakeholders throughout the enterprise.
Strong, hands-on expertise across core SAP FI modules:
FI-GL (General Ledger) New GL, document splitting, parallel ledgers/accounting principles, chart of accounts design, financial statement versions, and period-end closing activities.
FI-AR (Accounts Receivable) — customer master data, credit management, dunning, incoming payments, down payments, and customer-side intercompany processes.
FI-AP (Accounts Payable) — vendor master data, payment runs, payment terms, down payments, automatic/electronic payments, and vendor reconciliation.
Asset Accounting (FI-AA) — asset classes, depreciation areas, parallel valuation, asset acquisitions/retirements/transfers, and integration with GL and CO, including regulated utility plant and FERC asset classification where applicable.
Bank Accounting / Treasury integration — bank master data, electronic bank statement processing, cash management, and bank reconciliation.
Taxation — tax procedures, tax codes, withholding tax, and statutory/compliance reporting requirements.
Basic, working knowledge of Controlling — Cost Center Accounting (CO-CCA), Profit Center Accounting (CO-PCA), and Internal Orders — sufficient to support FI-CO integration points and cross-module postings; deep Product Costing or Material Ledger specialization is not required for this role.
Strong knowledge of FERC (Federal Energy Regulatory Commission) regulatory reporting for the utilities/energy industry, including FERC Form 1/2/6 preparation, regulatory chart of accounts mapping, and FERC account classification within SAP.
Hands-on experience configuring FERC-compliant Asset Accounting structures — Continuing Property Records (CPR), Allowance for Funds Used During Construction (AFUDC, both debt and equity components), Construction Work in Progress (CWIP) capitalization, retirement units, and regulatory versus book depreciation.
Understanding of the regulatory ledger/parallel ledger approach (New GL document splitting, or FI-SL) to maintain FERC regulatory books alongside US GAAP/IFRS books, including regulatory asset/liability (ASC 980) accounting.
Exposure to Public Utility industry-specific functionality, Work Order management integration (PM/PS) for capital project accounting, and minor/major retirement processing relevant to utility plant.
Experience supporting FERC audits and regulatory filings, including variance analysis between book and regulatory basis of accounting.
Mentor, coach and manage multiple teams and projects.
Proven experience in configuring, testing and supporting SAP Finance solutions across GL, AR, AP, Asset Accounting, Bank Accounting and Taxation.
Participate in design discussions, providing expertise on the SAP S/4HANA Finance platform.
Work with business users to understand requirements and propose alternative design solutions across FI processes.
Develop a collaborative and cohesive team, working with a culture of a One Team mindset.
Hands-on experience in Finance and accounts, with the ability to translate accounting requirements into system configuration.
Hands-on experience across S/4HANA Finance features with ability to design, develop and customize solutions, including integration with other modules like MM/SD/PS/PP/PM/IM — particularly how procurement, sales, and production postings flow into FI.
Knowledge of CFIN, and understanding of the elimination of ETL tools to enable transactional-level matching in real time.
Understanding of AIF and field value mapping, centralized transaction processing, payments, intercompany reconciliation, and group consolidation using S/4HANA Group Reporting.
Working familiarity with the S/4HANA Intercompany Matching and Reconciliation (ICMR) tool, as well as a solid accounting and finance background.
Knowledge and experience in implementing SAP S/4HANA Group Reporting is an added advantage.

About Global Network:
Accenture Strategy shapes our clientsfuture, combining deep business insight with the understanding of how technology will impact industry and business models. Our focus on issues such as digital disruption, redefining competitiveness, operating and business models as well as the workforce of the future helps our clients find future value and growth in a digital world. This is our unique differentiator. We seek people who recognize and understand the impact that digital, and technology have on every industry and every sector, and share our passion to shape unique strategies that allow our clients to succeed in this environment.

Why Technology Consulting
The Technology Consulting business within Global Network invents the future for clients by providing them with the right guidance, design thinking and innovative solutions for technological transformation.
As technology rapidly evolves, its more important than ever to have an innovation advisor who can create a new vision or put one into place to solve the clients toughest business problems.
Specialize in management or technology consulting to transform the world''s leading organizations by building innovative business solutions as their trusted advisor by:

Helping Clients: Rethinking IT and Digital ecosystems and innovating to help clients keep pace with fast-changing, customer-driven environments.

Enhancing your Skillset: Building expertise and innovating with leading-edge technologies such as Blockchain, Artificial Intelligence and Cloud.

Transforming Businesses: Developing customized, next-generation products and services that help clients shift to new business models designed for today''s connected landscape of disruptive technologies

Principal Duties

And Responsibilities:
Project environment that offers multiple opportunities for career growth.
The opportunities to make a difference within exciting client initiatives are limitless in this ever-changing business landscape
Here are just a few of your day-to-day responsibilities.
Lead Hybrid Cloud Projects: Guide clients through application modernization and migration initiatives, designing strategies and roadmaps for hybrid environments.
Architect Hybrid Solutions: Develop cloud architectures integrating public cloud services with on-premises and private cloud platforms, using technologies such as OpenShift, Anthos, and VMware.
Application Modernization: Design composable architectures using microservices, event-driven architectures (EDA), and cloud-native technologies across hybrid environments.
Hybrid Cloud Integration: Implement solutions that enable seamless workload portability and management across on-premises, private, and public clouds.
DevOps & Automation: Establish CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code (Terraform, Deployment Manager, OpenShift templates), and automated operations across hybrid environments.
Data Integration & Analytics: Architect data platforms that span cloud and on-premises, enabling advanced analytics, machine learning, and secure data exchange.
Security & Compliance: Design secure hybrid architectures, ensuring compliance with industry standards and best practices for identity, access, and data protection.
Client Advisory: Serve as a trusted advisor, communicating hybrid cloud architecture, best practices, and transformation strategies to technical and business stakeholders.
Thought Leadership: Develop reusable assets, publish whitepapers, and contribute to the hybrid cloud community.
Business Case & ROI Analysis: Build financial models for cloud adoption, including TCO (Total Cost of Ownership) and ROI. Advise on cost optimization strategies and AWS pricing models.
Operating Model Design: Design cloud operating models for governance, security, and compliance. Recommend organizational changes for cloud adoption (e.g., Cloud Center of Excellence).
Resilience & DR Strategy: Define RTO/RPO tiers, multi-region patterns, backup/restore policies
Design Architecture Review Board charters, NFR baseline templates



Qualification

Qualifications:
Bachelors degree
MBA Degree from Tier-1 College (Preferable)
9-13 years of large-scale consulting experience and/or working with hi tech companies leading Projects on Cloud Strategy, Assessment, Cloud architecture, App Modernization, Containers, information security and information management.
Professional Cloud Architect Certification (GCP or AWS)

Experience:
We are seeking experienced professionals who have led large-scale engagements in application modernization, cloud architecture, and cloud strategy. The ideal candidates will have technical expertise in cloud strategy, assessments, cloud architecture, application modernization, and containers, across all stages of the innovation lifecycle, with a focus on shaping the future in real-time."
The candidate should have practical industry expertise in one of these areas - Financial Services, Retail, consumer goods, Telecommunications, Life Sciences, Transportation, Hospitality, Automotive/Industrial, Mining and Resources.

Key Competencies and Skills:
The right candidate should have competency and skills aligned to one or more of these archetypes
Expertise in hybrid cloud architecture, integration, and cloud-native development.
Strong knowledge of microservices, containers (Kubernetes, OpenShift), and event-driven design.
Experience with DevOps, CI/CD, and infrastructure automation across hybrid environments
Other desired skills -
Strong desire to work in technology-driven business transformation
Strong knowledge of technology trends across IT and digital and how they can be applied to companies to address real world problems and opportunities.
Comfort conveying both high-level and detailed information, adjusting the way ideas are presented to better address varying social styles and audiences.
Leading proof of concept and/or pilot implementations and defining the plan to scale implementations across multiple technology domains
Flexibility to accommodate client travel requirements
Published Thought leadership Whitepapers, POVs

Star Bucks is looking for Store Operations to join our dynamic team and embark on a rewarding career journey.

The Store Operations Specialist is responsible for overseeing and optimizing the daily operations of our retail stores. This role requires a detail-oriented individual with strong organizational and communication skills. Key Responsibilities : Customer Service : Provide exceptional customer service by addressing inquiries, resolving issues, and ensuring a positive shopping experience. Train and mentor store staff on customer service best practices. Inventory Management : Monitor and manage store inventory levels to prevent stockouts and overstock situations. Coordinate with suppliers for timely replenishment of inventory. Conduct regular stock audits and maintain accurate inventory records. Store Layout and Merchandising : Collaborate with the visual merchandising team to ensure attractive and effective product displays. Optimize store layout for a smooth flow of customers and improved product visibility. Operational Efficiency : Develop and implement operational procedures to streamline store processes and reduce operational costs. Monitor and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) related to store operations. Loss Prevention : Implement loss prevention strategies to minimize theft and ensure the security of store assets. Conduct periodic security audits and recommend improvements as needed. Employee Training and Development : Train and coach store staff on operational procedures, customer service, and product knowledge. Conduct performance evaluations and provide feedback to employees. Compliance and Safety : Ensure the store complies with all safety and regulatory requirements. Implement safety protocols and conduct regular safety drills.

Description:
Infrastructure Automation Engineer (DevSecOps) Azure, Kubernetes & Terraform
Experience: 48 years
Role Overview
We are seeking experienced and hands-on Senior Infrastructure Automation Engineers (DevSecOps) with strong proficiency in Azure and Kubernetes to design, provision, automate, secure, and support scalable multicloud infrastructure for enterprise workloads.
The role requires deep expertise in Infrastructure as Code with Terraform, container orchestration on Kubernetes, automated CI/CD pipeline engineering, Python-based infrastructure automation, and embedding security controls across the build, deploy, and run lifecycle, with a strong focus on reliability, compliance, cost-awareness, and delivery quality.
Key Responsibilities
Design, provision, and manage scalable multicloud infrastructure with Azure as the primary platform and AWS as the secondary platform.
Architect and operate production-grade Kubernetes clusters (AKS / EKS / self-managed) covering deployments, scaling, networking, ingress, secrets, RBAC, upgrades, and operational troubleshooting.
Implement and govern Infrastructure as Code using Terraform module design, remote state, workspaces, policy-as-code, and reusable platform components for repeatable, secure, and auditable deployments.
Build, maintain, and optimize end-to-end CI/CD pipelines for application and infrastructure delivery, including build, test, scan, approval, and progressive deployment workflows.
Develop Python-based automation, tooling, and operators to streamline provisioning, configuration, remediation, and day-2 operations across cloud platforms.
Embed DevSecOps practices across the SDLC — SAST, DAST, SCA, container image scanning, IaC scanning, secrets management, and policy-as-code (OPA / Sentinel / Kyverno).
Integrate cloud infrastructure with enterprise networking, IAM, security, monitoring, logging, and DevOps toolchains in line with enterprise standards.
Monitor platform health, lead incident response, perform root cause analysis, and drive continuous service and reliability improvements.
Ensure infrastructure is resilient, secure, compliant, cost-aware, and aligned with enterprise architecture, security baselines, and operational standards.
Mentor junior engineers, lead technical reviews, and contribute to platform engineering standards, runbooks, and reference architectures.
Required Skills and Experience
Strong hands-on experience with Azure services (AKS, VNet, Azure AD / Entra ID, Key Vault, Storage, Monitor, Policy, Azure DevOps);
Strong expertise in Terraform — module development, state management, multi-environment patterns, and integration with policy-as-code frameworks.
Proven experience designing and operating CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent, including pipeline security and supply-chain controls.
Strong proficiency in Python for infrastructure automation, tooling, and integration; working knowledge of Bash / Shell scripting.
Solid grounding in cloud security — IAM, network segmentation, encryption, secrets management, vulnerability management, and DevSecOps tooling (e.g., Trivy, Checkov, tfsec, SonarQube, Snyk, Aqua / Prisma Cloud).
Qualification and Certifications
B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
One or more relevant certifications strongly preferred — Microsoft Azure (AZ-104 / AZ-305 / AZ-400), CKA / CKAD / CKS, HashiCorp Terraform Associate, AWS Solutions Architect / DevOps Engineer, or recognized security certifications (CCSK, CompTIA Security+).
Strong commitment to continuous learning and staying current with cloud, DevSecOps, Kubernetes, and platform engineering practices.

.NET Developer Job Description

Job Title: .NET Developer


Experience: 5 to 8 Years


Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are looking for a skilled .NET Developer with experience in designing, developing, and maintaining scalable enterprise applications using Microsoft technologies. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in .NET Framework/.NET Core, C#, SQL Server, and web application development.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, test, and deploy applications using .NET technologies.
Develop and maintain web applications, RESTful APIs, and microservices.
Collaborate with business analysts, architects, and cross-functional teams to understand requirements and deliver solutions.
Write clean, scalable, and maintainable code following best practices.
Optimize application performance and troubleshoot production issues.
Develop database objects such as stored procedures, functions, and triggers.
Participate in code reviews, unit testing, and CI/CD implementations.
Work in Agile/Scrum development environments.
Required Skills
Strong experience in C#, ASP.NET, .NET Core/.NET
Experience with ASP.NET MVC, Web API, Entity Framework.
Strong knowledge of SQL Server, database design, and query optimization.
Experience in developing and consuming RESTful APIs.
Understanding of OOP, Design Patterns, SOLID Principles.
Experience with JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, jQuery.
Knowledge of Version Control Systems such as Git and Azure DevOps.
Familiarity with Unit Testing Frameworks (xUnit, NUnit, MSTest).
Preferred Skills
Experience with Microservices Architecture.
Exposure to Azure Cloud Services (App Services, Functions, Storage, Service Bus).
Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and containerization.
Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.
Hands-on experience with React.js or Angular.
Educational Qualification
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.
Nice to Have
Experience working in Banking, Healthcare, Retail, or Enterprise domains.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Good communication and stakeholder management skills.
Certification in Microsoft Azure or .NET technologies.
Keywords
C#, ASP.NET, .NET Core, .NET 6/7/8, MVC, Web API, Entity Framework, SQL Server, Azure, Microservices, Docker, Kubernetes, Azure DevOps, Git, REST API, LINQ, OOP, SOLID Principles.

Description:
Role Objective
To support front Retail forces via Store operation excellence programs to ensure increasing stores productivity and profitability.

On a typical day you will drive the following
To ensure the delivery of operational KPI, sales and profitability plan across stores and review KPI’s periodically. Effectively manage and review the P&L of all the stores to optimize store profitability.
Create and execute strategies on smooth and timely store roll outs, branding and advertisements. Optimize hiring of manpower in line with the business plans and store roll out.
Ensure standardization and brand essence is maintained at all stores.
To ensure that all stores adhere to compliance requirements in all areas of operational activity, brand standards, company policies and procedures.

Coaching the store manager and staff on performance improvement. Work on individual store – improvement plan.
Manage costs, overheads and all factors affecting the profitable performance of the business.
Plan and implement retail store merchandising, layout and customer traffic flow so as to maximize sales, customer satisfaction and appearance image.
Liaise with external agencies (brand principals) and authorities as necessary (Training, Marketing & PR)

Description:
The opportunity:

Risk management protects business performance and helps sustain results. Its about achieving a clear understanding of risks and developing plans to manage them.
As one of our risk professionals, youll work with multinational businesses and public sector organizations. You’ll help them develop an integrated, holistic approach to risk and benefit from their investments in internal controls.
You’ll deliver some of the most significant and class-leading internal audit and risk engagements globally. You’ll also team with our performance improvement professionals in multidisciplinary engagements, helping major global clients transform and sustain business performance.
By plugging into our market-leading global network, you’ll gain the experience you need to become an exceptional risk advisor.

Your key responsibilities:

Responsible for executing client-related engagements in the areas of governance, risk & compliance (GRC), internal audits, process reviews, standard operating procedures, enterprise risk management, revenue assurance, SOX 404 & Clause 49 assistance
Responsible for overall client service delivery in accordance with EY quality guidelines & methodologies
Manage accounts on a day-to-day basis & explore new business opportunity for the firm with new and existing clients
Actively establish & strengthen client (functional heads & key influencers) and internal relationships
Assist in developing new solutions, methodologies, and internal initiatives
Create a positive learning culture, coach, counsel, and develop junior team members
Market leadership related
Assist Partners & Senior Managers in driving the business development process on new/existing client engagements by gathering appropriate resources, gaining access to key contacts & supervising proposal preparation
Identify buyers, influencers & stakeholders in existing client engagements and build strong relationships
Create innovative insights for clients, adapt methods & practices to fit operational team needs & contribute to thought leadership documents
Practice secondment for developing new methodologies
Facilitate discussions / knowledge sharing with key client personnel and contribute to EY thought leadership
Service delivery related
Work with high-growth clients and other market leaders in industries such financial services, insurance etc
Establish audit objectives and scope of work; establish the engagement budget; and take responsibility for the overall execution of the audit project through wrap-up and final report delivery
Plan & schedule client engagements. Determine and deploy the right team with adequate skill sets for executing engagements and periodically review status of engagements and work products
Demonstrate strong project management skills
Maintain a strong client focus by effectively serving client needs and developing productive working relationships with client personnel. Stay abreast of current business and economic developments and new pronouncements/standards relevant to the client's business
Demonstrate industry expertise (deep understanding of the industry, emerging trends, issues/challenges, key players & leading practices)
Review status updates and prepare management presentations/audit committee presentations etc
Actively contribute to improving operational efficiency on projects & internal initiatives.
Drive timely billing of invoices & actively follow up on collections
People related
Display teamwork, integrity, and leadership. Work with team members to set goals and responsibilities for specific engagements. Foster teamwork and innovation
Drive performance management for self and team
Utilize technology & tools to continually learn and innovate, share knowledge with team members and enhance service delivery
Understand EY and its service lines. Actively encourage team members to contribute ideas
Conduct workshops and technical training sessions for team members. Contribute to the learning & development agenda

Skills and attributes for success

Demonstrate industry expertise (detailed understanding of the industry, trends, issues/challenges, and leading practices).

To qualify for the role, you must have
Chartered Accountant, Certified Internal Auditor, or master’s in business administration
Minimum 8+ years of post-qualification experience in risk advisory, related internal audit experience or external audit experience or related business experience.
Client-Facing Experience is must.
India Practice experience is must.

Ideally, you’ll also have
Strong communication, facilitation, relationship-building, presentation, and negotiation skills
Be highly flexible, adaptable, and creative
Comfortable interacting with senior executives (within the firm and at the client)
Strong leadership skills and supervisory responsibility

What we look for
We’re interested in versatile people with the ability to take on new responsibilities and listen to clients to get things done. We’re not just looking for technical accounting experience — we’re after genuinely interesting people with the ability to build relationships, negotiate and think in unique and creative news ways. If you’re a confident leader with a curious mind and the ability to solve complex issues, this role is for you.

What working at EY offers
EY is committed to being an inclusive employer and we are happy to consider flexible working arrangements. We strive to achieve the right balance for our people, enabling us to deliver excellent client service whilst allowing you to build your career without sacrificing your personal priorities. While our client-facing professionals can be required to travel regularly, and at times be based at client sites, our flexible working arrangements can help you to achieve a lifestyle balance.

About EY
As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we’re using the finance products, expertise and systems we’ve developed to build a better working world. That starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom to make things better. Whenever you join, however long you stay, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime. And with a commitment to hiring and developing the most passionate people, we’ll make our ambition to be the best employer by 2020 a reality.

Job Summary
We are looking for a skilled API Test Engineer to validate and ensure the quality, performance, and reliability of APIs. The candidate will be responsible for designing, executing, and automating API test cases using modern testing tools and frameworks.

Design, develop, and execute API test cases for REST and/or SOAP services
Perform functional, integration, regression, and performance testing of APIs
Validate API responses, status codes, headers, and payloads
Automate API test cases using tools such as Postman, RestAssured, or Karate
Work closely with developers and product teams to understand API requirements
Identify, report, and track defects using defect tracking tools (e.g., JIRA)
Validate data consistency across services and databases
Participate in CI/CD pipeline integration for automated tests
Ensure API security and authentication testing (OAuth, JWT, etc.)
Create and maintain test documentation and reports
Required Skills
Strong understanding of API testing concepts
Experience with REST APIs, JSON, XML
Hands-on experience with tools like:
Postman
SOAP UI
RestAssured / Karate / Newman
Knowledge of HTTP methods (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH)
Experience with automation frameworks
Understanding of status codes and API validations
Basic knowledge of databases (SQL queries)
Familiarity with Git, Jenkins, CI/CD pipelines
Strong analytical and debugging skills
Good to Have
Programming knowledge in Java, Python, or JavaScript
Experience with performance testing tools (JMeter, LoadRunner)
Understanding of microservices architecture
Knowledge of Docker/Kubernetes
Experience with BDD frameworks (Cucumber)
Education
Bachelors degree in Computer Science, IT, or related field
Soft Skills
Strong communication skills
Detail-oriented mindset
Ability to work in Agile/Scrum environment
Problem-solving attitude

Job Title: Java Spring Boot Microservices Developer

Experience: 5 to 8 Years

Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are seeking a highly motivated Java Spring Boot Microservices Developer to design, develop, and support scalable, high-performance enterprise applications. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Java, Spring Boot, Microservices Architecture, REST APIs, and cloud-native application development.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade applications using Java and Spring Boot.
Build scalable Microservices-based applications following industry best practices.
Develop and consume RESTful APIs and integrate with third-party systems.
Collaborate with architects, business analysts, QA teams, and stakeholders to deliver high-quality solutions.
Implement secure, reliable, and reusable services with proper exception handling and logging.
Participate in code reviews, unit testing, integration testing, and deployment activities.
Optimize application performance, scalability, and availability.
Troubleshoot production issues and provide timely resolutions.
Work in Agile/Scrum teams and contribute to sprint planning and estimations.
Required Skills
Strong experience in Java 8/11/17.
Expertise in Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA, and Spring Security.
Hands-on experience in Microservices Architecture.
Strong knowledge of RESTful Web Services and API development.
Experience with Hibernate/JPA and ORM frameworks.
Strong understanding of SQL databases such as Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL, or SQL Server.
Experience with Git, Maven, Gradle, and version control practices.
Knowledge of Design Patterns, OOP Concepts, and SOLID Principles.
Familiarity with JUnit, Mockito, and automated testing frameworks.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Spring Cloud, Eureka, Config Server, Feign Client, API Gateway.
Hands-on experience with Kafka, RabbitMQ, or other messaging systems.
Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and containerization technologies.
Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps.
Exposure to AWS, Azure, or GCP cloud platforms.
Understanding of distributed systems, resilience patterns, and service monitoring.
Nice to Have
Experience with NoSQL databases such as MongoDB or Cassandra.
Knowledge of ELK Stack, Splunk, Prometheus, and Grafana.
Experience in Banking, Financial Services, E-commerce, Healthcare, or Telecom domains.
Certification in Java, Spring, or Cloud Technologies.
Educational Qualification
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
Keywords
Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, Spring Cloud, REST API, Hibernate, JPA, Kafka, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Azure, Jenkins, Maven, Git, Oracle, PostgreSQL, JUnit, Mockito, CI/CD, Distributed Systems.

Description:
Job Description
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Job Description
Position: Receptionist / Front Office Executive
Department: Front Office
Industry: Hotel / Resort / Hospitality
Reporting To: General Manager
Location: Shimla


Job Purpose
The Hotel Receptionist Is Responsible For Providing A Warm And Professional Welcome To Guests, Managing Check-in And Check-out Procedures, Handling Guest Enquiries, Coordinating With Hotel Departments, And Ensuring A Smooth And Pleasant Guest Experience Throughout The Stay.


Key Responsibilities

A. Guest Reception Welcome
Welcome And Greet Guests Professionally And Courteously.
Create A Positive First Impression Of The Hotel.
Assist Guests With Their Requirements And Provide Accurate Information.
Maintain Professional Communication And Grooming Standards At All Times.


B. Check-In Check-Out
andle Guest Check-in And Check-out Procedures Efficiently.
Verify Guest Identification And Required Documents.
Allocate Rooms According To Reservations And Hotel Policies.
Provide Room Keys/cards And Explain Basic Hotel Facilities And Services.
Process Departures And Coordinate With The Relevant Departments.


C. Reservation Booking Coordination
Handle Room Reservation Enquiries Through Phone, Email, Online Platforms, And Walk-ins.
Verify Room Availability And Booking Details.
Update Reservation Information Accurately In The Hotel System.
Coordinate With The Reservations And Housekeeping Teams Regarding Room Status.


D. Guest Service
Handle Guest Requests, Questions, And Complaints Professionally.
Resolve Routine Guest Issues Or Escalate Them To The Appropriate Manager.
Provide Information About Hotel Facilities, Restaurants, Nearby Attractions, Transportation, And Local Destinations.
Maintain Excellent Guest Relations And Customer Service Standards.


E. Telephone Communication
Answer And Transfer Telephone Calls Professionally.
Respond To Guest Emails And Messages Promptly.
Maintain Proper Communication With Front Office, Housekeeping, FB, Accounts, Maintenance, And Management.
Take And Communicate Guest Messages Accurately.


F. Cash Billing Support
Handle Guest Payments And Basic Billing Procedures As Assigned.
Maintain Proper Records Of Cash And Transactions.
Coordinate With The Accounts Department Regarding Billing Or Payment-related Matters.
Follow Hotel Procedures For Cash Handling And Financial Documentation.


G. Front Office Administration
Maintain Guest Records And Registration Documents.
Maintain Accurate Shift Handover Records.
Prepare Daily Front-office Reports As Required.
Maintain Confidentiality Of Guest And Hotel Information.
Follow All Hotel Policies, SOPs, And Security Procedures.


Required Skills
Excellent Communication And Interpersonal Skills.
Good English And Hindi Communication Skills.
Pleasant Personality And Professional Appearance.
Good Customer-service And Problem-solving Skills.
Ability To Handle Guests Calmly And Professionally.
Basic Computer And MS Office Knowledge.
Knowledge Of Hotel PMS/software Will Be An Advantage.
Good Telephone Etiquette.
Ability To Work Effectively In A Team.


Qualification Experience
Qualification: 10+2 / Graduate / Diploma In Hotel Management, Hospitality, Tourism, Or A Related Field.
Experience: 0-3 Years Of Experience In Hotel, Resort, Hospitality, Front Office, Or Customer Service.
Freshers With Good Communication Skills And A Positive Attitude May Also Be Considered.


Personal Attributes
Well-groomed And Professional.
Polite, Friendly, And Customer-oriented.
Punctual And Disciplined.
Honest And Responsible.
Positive Attitude.
Able To Work Under Pressure.
Strong Attention To Detail.
Willingness To Learn And Improve.


Working Requirements
Willingness To Work In Rotational Shifts.
Willingness To Work On Weekends And Public Holidays As Per Hotel Requirements.
Maintain Proper Uniform And Grooming Standards.
Follow Hotel Attendance, Leave, Safety, Security, And Operational Policies.
Perform Additional Front-office Duties Assigned By Management.


Key Performance Indicators (KPI)
Guest Satisfaction And Feedback.
Accuracy Of Check-in/check-out Procedures.

Job Description: Assistant General Manager (AGM) Stores
Company Name: Bharat Green Recycling & Renewables Limited

Plant Location: Paonta Sahib, Himachal Pradesh

Corporate Head Office: New Delhi

Industry: Steel & Heavy Manufacturing (Stainless Steel Flats, Coils & Pipes)

Reporting To: AVP Commercial

Department: Stores & Inventory Management

Position Type: Full-Time, On-Site


Position Overview
Bharat Green Recycling & Renewables Limited is looking for an experienced and detail-oriented Assistant General Manager (AGM) Stores to lead inward storekeeping, engineering spares custody, consumable inventory, and yard storage operations at our Paonta Sahib manufacturing facility.

The AGM Stores will hold full operational ownership of inventory custody, storage optimization, material issuance, scrap segregation, and system stock reconciliation. The role requires close coordination with Plant Production, Maintenance, Quality, and Central/Local Procurement to eliminate production downtime caused by material shortages, maintain 100% stock accuracy in the ERP system, and implement robust material handling, preservation, and internal audit controls.


Key Responsibilities
1. Inward Logistics & Material Receipt
Direct gate entry verification, weighbridge reconciliation, unloading, and staging for all incoming consignments:


Raw Materials: Stainless steel melting scrap, ingots, billets, HR/CR master coils, and raw pipe shells.

Consumables & Spares: Refractories, mill rolls, lubricants/cutting oils, electrical/mechanical spares, pickling acids/chemicals, grinding wheels, and packaging materials.

Manage the Goods Receipt Note (GRN) workflow in ERP, ensuring physical inspection, chemical/physical test clearance from Quality Control (QC), and vendor delivery challan reconciliations are completed within defined turnaround times.

Coordinate rejected material handling, debits, vendor return gate passes, and replacement follow-ups in close coordination with Local and Corporate Procurement.

2. Inventory Control & ERP Reconciliation
Maintain real-time stock ledger accuracy across all plant sub-stores (Raw Material Yard, Engineering Spares Store, Consumables Store, Scrap Yard).

Enforce Min-Max levels, Reorder Points (ROP), and Safety Stock levels for critical plant operational spares and consumables to prevent stockouts while optimizing working capital.

Conduct continuous cycle counts, monthly reconciliations, and bi-annual/annual full physical stock verifications alongside Internal and Statutory Audit teams; investigate and resolve book-to-physical variances.

Categorize and review inventory using ABC, VED, and FSN analyses; identify and report slow-moving, non-moving, and obsolete (SLOB) items with concrete salvage or liquidation plans.

3. Material Storage, Preservation & Issuance

Job Description: AVP Commercial
Company Name: Bharat Green Recycling & Renewables Limited

Plant Location: Paonta Sahib, Himachal Pradesh

Corporate Head Office: New Delhi

Industry: Steel & Heavy Manufacturing (Stainless Steel Flats, Coils & Pipes)

Reporting To: Director Plant

Position Type: Full-Time, On-Site


Position Overview
Bharat Green Recycling & Renewables Limited is seeking an experienced, proactive, and commercially astute AVP Commercial to head commercial operations at our manufacturing facility in Paonta Sahib, Himachal Pradesh.

The GM Commercial will oversee plant accounting and financial controls, inventory and store operations, local procurement, logistics, and commercial statutory compliance. The role acts as the primary operational bridge between the manufacturing plant and the Corporate Head Office in New Delhi, ensuring cost efficiency, seamless supply chain execution, rigorous internal controls, and statutory compliance.


Key Responsibilities
1. Plant Accounts & Financial Controls
Direct and monitor day-to-day plant accounts, cost accounting, billing, invoicing, and petty cash management.

Oversee stainless steel manufacturing cost accounting (yield, conversion costs, scrap reconciliation, and power/fuel consumption).

Ensure strict internal financial controls, conduct regular internal audits, and coordinate with statutory auditors.

Manage plant-level GST, TDS, e-Way bills, TCS, and ensure timely filing in close coordination with the Corporate Finance team in New Delhi.

Monitor plant operational expenditures (OPEX) and capital expenditures (CAPEX), preparing monthly variance analyses against approved budgets.

2. Stores & Inventory Management
Oversee comprehensive store operations across raw materials (SS scrap, ingots, billets, flats, coils), consumables, spare parts, rolls, refractories, and finished goods (pipes, coils, flats).

Implement rigorous systems for material receipt (Gate Pass, Weighbridge, Inspection/GRN), issue, and bin card tracking.

Conduct periodic physical inventory audits, reconciliation against ERP/books, and minimize inventory shrinkage or carrying costs.

Identify and manage non-moving, slow-moving, and obsolete inventory; establish scrap handling and disposal protocols.

3. Local Procurement & Vendor Management
Formulate and execute local procurement strategies for mechanical and electrical spares, refractories, consumables, oils/lubricants, packaging materials, and general site services.

Evaluate local vendor proposals, negotiate commercial terms, pricing, payment schedules, and delivery timelines to optimize working capital.

Implement vendor evaluation metrics, fostering reliable local supplier networks while enforcing vendor compliance.

Coordinate with Central Corporate Procurement (New Delhi) for high-value raw material intake, ensuring smooth site delivery schedules.

4. Logistics, Dispatch & Weighbridge Commercial Operations
Supervise inbound raw material arrivals and outbound dispatches of finished flats, coils, and pipes.

Exercise commercial control over weighbridge operations, tare/gross weight verifications, and freight audits.

Manage transporter contracts, freight negotiation for local movements, vehicle turnaround times, and transit compliance.

5. Head Office Coordination & Reporting
Act as the nodal contact at the Paonta Sahib unit for all commercial matters directed from the Corporate Office in New Delhi.

Prepare and submit regular Management Information System (MIS) reports, including daily fund requirements, monthly commercial MIS, inventory valuations, and cost-variance reports.

Align plant commercial targets and working capital requirements with corporate business goals.

6. Commercial Statutory Compliance
Ensure adherence to state and central commercial regulations, including GST compliance, e-Way billing rules, and tax documentation.

Monitor commercial documentation related to interstate dispatches, raw material transit permits, and statutory commercial records.

Candidate Profile & Qualifications
Education:


Bachelors Degree in Commerce (B.Com) / Inter CA / Inter ICWA / MBA in Finance or Operations / B.Tech with an MBA. Full CA / ICWA (CMA) qualification is an added advantage.

Experience:


1520+ years of proven commercial management experience in a manufacturing environment, with at least 57 years in a senior leadership role (DGM/GM).

Direct experience in Steel Manufacturing, Stainless Steel, Rolling Mills, Tube Mills, or Heavy Industrial Fabrication is highly preferred.

Technical Skills:


Hands-on proficiency in ERP platforms (SAP, Oracle, or TallyPrime).

Strong mastery of GST, indirect taxation, inventory accounting, and Excel-based financial reporting.

Competencies:


Strong commercial negotiation and contract management skills.

Strong leadership with the ability to manage commercial, accounts, and stores teams.

Clear, structured communication skills for multi-location reporting and commercial coordination.

Position Title: Admin Support

Role Overview:
The Assignment Manager will be responsible for the end-to-end management of physical security operations across high-profile client sites in the South Zone of India. This includes ensuring effective deployment of personnel, compliance with client protocols, documentation accuracy, stakeholder engagement, crisis readiness, and operational audits. The Assignment Manager is expected to maintain high discipline standards, handle large-scale operations seamlessly, and serve as the bridge between the client, site security teams, and the G4S backend.
This role demands strong leadership, a proactive mindset, technical know-how, and non-negotiable communication excellence. Impeccable fluency in spoken English with the right accent, grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation is strictly mandatory.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Site Operations Oversight:
Plan and deploy daily security personnel as per shift schedules and site-specific SOPs.
Conduct briefing sessions across all shifts and ensure grooming, discipline, and attendance compliance.
Prepare and manage MDR, shift schedules, and site logs.
Carry out efficient patrolling of internal and perimeter areas.
Observe and respond to suspicious man/material movements.
Ensure access control compliance and critical access management (labs, restricted zones).
Maintain visitor/vendor records, key logs, badges, and lost & found registers.
Conduct weekly security training and refresher briefings.
Perform surprise night inspections to assess readiness of night staff.
2. Technical Systems & Documentation:
Ensure the uptime and functionality of CCTV, access control systems, and FAPA equipment.
Maintain workstations audit, badge audits, and access key audits.
Coordinate with facility teams for system rectification and AMC partner activities.
Take access approvals via eApproval portals.
3. Reporting & MIS:
Share daily, weekly, and monthly operations reports with G4S and designated site managers.
Maintain event trackers, alarms reports, RPM data, incident logs, and vendor performance records.
Support site managers in Hyderabad, Mumbai, Delhi, and Gurugram for consolidated reporting.
4. Emergency & Incident Management:
Act as the first escalation point for medical emergencies, duress alerts, or system-triggered alarms.
Liaise with EMEIA SOC for remote access control and video retrieval.
Prepare incident reports, investigate breaches, and implement CAPAs.
Conduct mock drills, shutdown protocols, and risk preparedness activities.
5. Client & Stakeholder Coordination:
Respond to client queries and share required reports (daily/weekly/monthly) within agreed SLAs.
Attend virtual coordination meetings with client-side managers to sync activities Pan India.
Coordinate closely with facilities and places teams for smooth operations, approvals, and events.
Handle onboarding/offboarding of employees with badge issuance and access revocation.
6. G4S Internal Coordination:
Share weekly duty rosters, attendance, and nominal rolls with G4S backend.
Coordinate on salary concerns, health insurance issues, and uniform issuance.
Maintain leave records and escalate absenteeism trends.
Work with Key Account Managers to resolve operations-related escalations.
Candidate Profile:
Minimum Requirements:
Graduate in any discipline (mandatory)
Minimum 5-10 years of experience in security operations management
Experience handling multi-location operations preferred
Prior exposure to multinational corporate environments in IT sector shall be very advantageous for the candidate.
Essential Competencies:
Communication: Fluent spoken and written English (mandatory); clarity, grammar, and pronunciation will be tested.
Operational Skills: Security deployment, documentation, SOPs, reporting tools.
Technical Proficiency: Familiar with access control, surveillance systems, e-portals, and Microsoft Office.
Leadership & Ethics: High integrity, team management skills, crisis-handling experience.
Behavioral Traits: Attention to detail, time-sensitive decision-making, calm under pressure.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
100% compliance in daily deployment & reporting
95% uptime for security equipment and systems
2 critical incidents per year (with timely CAPA)
SLA adherence for report submissions and audits
Staff discipline, grooming, and performance audit scores 90%

Responsible for operation and Maintenance of HVAC System & Water System (Purified Water Generation & Distribution System, WFI Generation & Distribution system, Distribution system, Pure Steam Generation). Responsible for monitoring consumption of spare parts and maintaining critical inventory related to HVAC system and water system.

100% Audit compliances by maintaining all cGMP documents and logbook as per respective SOPs.
Responsible to provide support in qualification activities of water system & HVAC system.
Responsible for requisition of logbooks or format issuance.
Responsible to execute all other activities assigned by HOD.

Job Summary
To create and updating the Standard Operating Procedures and their compliance.


Responsibilities
Responsible to use through knowledge of Water System Operation and Maintenance of all Utilities Equipments i.e. including Pre Treatment (MGF Softener), UF, RO, EDI, Purified Water supply and distribution, system and maintaining respective documentation (Whenever applicable).
Handling of Change Control Process (including Justifications, risk assessments and action plan).
Handling of Deviation Process.
Handling and Review of Incident and investigations.
Handling of CAPA.
Preparation of MQR data for execution.

To impart SOP trainings as per individual's profile as per training calendar.

Assist for Initial estimation of maintenance cost based on activity based costing and cost control for the annual budgeting.
Zero accident/ incident in factory premises.
100% statutory compliances.
100% Audit compliances by maintaining all cGMP documents, including SOPs and PM records.
Participate in regularly schedule maintenance staff meetings and coordinating by circulating Minutes of Meeting.
Maintain 100% on-time completion of PM's. Support new or modified equipment/ facility installations to include identifying purchasing initial spare parts and implementing new preventative maintenance procedures.
To carry out improvements in system for better efficient operations.
Responsible for accurate parts inventory and equipment specific usage control.
Implementation of cost improvement maintenance.
To perform any other work as and when assigned by Head of department

Main Purpose of Job:

To manage the Noodle or Chocolate Manufacturing lines of the factory with regard to Electrical & Automation Maintenance and ensuring No unplanned downtime. Supply (may include in-house generation) and distribution of electricity to ensure that it is at all times safe, reliable, secure and sustainable. It covers low, medium and high voltage installations. Provide factory/site engineering with the required competence on Factory Automation System (FAS), Process Control System and Manufacturing Execution System (MES) to effectively support manufacturing operational activities and continuously improve manufacturing performance. The role has a shared responsibility of tasks together with production, warehouse, QA and auxiliary services etc to ensure full requirement and customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities:
1. Management responsibilities:
Define, propose and monitor the plans and objectives of the electrical team in accordance with the Engineering Policy, Key Principles and the Electricity & Automation Manufacturing Execution System (E&AMES) Activity as outlined in the Nestl Engineering Excellence (NEE) master document.
Propose and implement work processes, procedures and technical resources relating to the electrical & automation team.
Lead and coordinate the electrical & automation team and maintain competencies, motivation and performance to achieve the teams mission and objectives.
Propose and control the electrical & automation component of the site M&I budget and any capital projects.
Propose and monitor electricity in accordance with the key performance indicators.
Demonstrate and promote the company's values within the electrical & automation team.
Ensure work place safety and effective communication of Safety, Health and Environment to all team members.

2. Functional responsibilities:
Ensuring line availability / healtiness of high-speed manufacturing lines and ensuring highest level of efficiency and performance from the lines. Ensure that all personnel performing electrical & automation related activities are legally trained and certified. Question the impact on product safety/quality, people safety and environmental during execution of any activity.
Ensure at all times the technical integrity/performance of the electrical energy supply and distribution.
Ensure at all times safe installations and operations through proper design, protection systems, procedures and training.
Liase with the site Safety Officer on electrical & automation matters relating to safety, electricity distribution, energy conservation, legal compliance, complaints etc.
Coordinate with Production, Quality Management and Engineering to resolve any electrical & automation issues.
Supervise and coordinate electrical & automation maintenance and project work by electricians, automation technicians and contractors.
Ensure proper management of electrical & automation documents (manuals, diagrams, instrument data sheet, software packages/licenses) through efficient filing and archiving procedures. Manage the capturing of electrical energy related information and the distribution of this information to the required stakeholder.

3. Maintenance and Improvement of electrical & automation assets.
Execute the maintenance of the electrical & automation equipment in accordance with the Nestl Maintenance Strategy using Consequence Driven Maintenance (CDM) as the multi-disciplined approach to proactively maintain/improve the fixed assets and Asset and Maintenance Management (AMM) as the process to manage the asset lifecycle. Adopt the Maintenance Excellence vision by striving for the M&I "Proactive Domain".Monitor plant and equipment to ensure optimal operation and reduction of planned and unplanned downtime. Develop and implement maintenance and inspection plans to ensure reliability, sustainability and security of electrical distribution infrastructure. Ensure technical integrity and performance of automation equipment.

4. Installation of new electrical & automation assets
Ensure that the justification, request for approval and reporting are in line with the Guidelines for Capital Investment. Ensure that new installations are designed with a high degree of flexibility to better enable the operations to adjust to a changing environment keeping in mind safety and the issues relating to the environment. Facilitate the introduction and implementation of new technologies in coordination with local, market, central technical and PTC engineering.

5. Continuous Improvement
Initiate and drive Continuous Improvement (CI) in electricity supply and distribution with the aim of achieving optimised plant performance. Ensure that all members of the team play an active role in assisting the client in improving the energy usage and reducing waste across the site through continual improvement initiatives.

Job Description
Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondel z International

Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It With Pride.
You will be responsible for coordinating and enabling the Site Asset & Technology Leader in driving asset reliability, maintenance, infrastructure and facilities performance to support the delivery of site SQCDSM targets.

The role will focus on ensuring reliable plant equipment, process technology, infrastructure and facilities, while driving effective MRO management, maintenance planning, budget utilization, inventory management and productivity initiatives. You will also ensure uninterrupted site operations through compliance with local legal regulations, Quality, Health, Safety & Environment standards and Mondel z manufacturing requirements.

How You Will Contribute
You will:
Asset, Maintenance & Infrastructure Management
Coordinate the execution of preventive, predictive and breakdown maintenance activities for plant equipment, process technology, infrastructure, buildings and facilities.
Drive maintenance of site infrastructure and facilities, ensuring timely execution of preventive maintenance (PM) and corrective actions.
Support asset reliability and loss prevention initiatives to minimize breakdowns, downtime and equipment-related losses.
Implement and sustain IL6S/TPM ways of working, including Progressive Maintenance, Autonomous Maintenance, Condition-Based Monitoring (CBM), lubrication management, calibration, visual controls and loss elimination.
Partner with the PM and operations teams to identify maintenance requirements, validate priorities and ensure timely closure of actions.
MRO & Inventory Management
Manage and track MRO requirements, consumption, availability and inventory, ensuring the right materials are available to support maintenance activities.
Review and validate MRO requirements raised by maintenance/PM teams based on business need, equipment criticality and inventory availability.
Participate in DMS (Daily Management System) routines and translate identified maintenance requirements into appropriate procurement actions.
Coordinate the PR/PO process for MRO requirements, including requirement validation, purchase order creation and follow-up with relevant stakeholders.
Monitor MRO spend, consumption and inventory levels to improve cost effectiveness and avoid excess/obsolete inventory.
Coordinate with suppliers/OEMs and service providers to ensure timely delivery of materials and services in line with agreed SLAs.
Budget & Cost Management
Support annual maintenance, MRO, infrastructure and facilities budget planning, including allocation and tracking of spend across various requirements.
Monitor OPEX/M&R and maintenance-related expenditure against budget and identify potential deviations and corrective actions.
Support prioritization of maintenance and infrastructure requirements based on business impact, asset criticality and available budget.
Identify opportunities for cost optimization and productivity improvement through effective MRO management, maintenance practices and supplier management.
Productivity & Continuous Improvement
Drive and support MRO productivity projects and cost-saving initiatives focused on reducing maintenance losses, improving asset reliability and optimizing MRO spend.
Identify opportunities for loss elimination and improve maintenance effectiveness through data-driven analysis and structured problem solving.
Apply PDCA, TPM/IL6S and other continuous improvement methodologies to address recurring equipment and maintenance issues.
Capability Building & Stakeholder Management
Coach and support operating and maintenance teams on routine maintenance, equipment care, breakdown prevention and CIL (Cleaning, Inspection & Lubrication) practices.
Support development of technical capability within operating teams and work process owners.
Interface with internal stakeholders including Operations, Engineering, Procurement, Finance, Quality, HSE and Supply Chain, as well as external service providers and OEMs.
Ensure adherence to manufacturing standards, governance, compliance requirements and applicable legal regulations.
What You Will Bring

A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career, along with the following experience and knowledge:
Experience in plant maintenance, asset management, engineering, facilities, infrastructure or MRO management, preferably within a manufacturing/FMCG environment.
Good understanding of preventive and predictive maintenance, breakdown maintenance, asset reliability and maintenance planning.
Knowledge of MRO management, inventory management, procurement processes and supplier/OEM coordination.
Experience in budget planning, cost tracking and OPEX/M&R management.
Understanding of TPM/IL6S, Progressive Maintenance, Autonomous Maintenance, CBM, loss elimination and PDCA-based problem solving.
Ability to evaluate and validate maintenance/MRO requirements and coordinate the DMS requirement validation PR/PO execution cycle.
Experience in driving or supporting productivity, cost-saving or continuous improvement projects.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to use data to identify opportunities and track performance.
Computer proficiency, including MS Excel, Word and PowerPoint, with experience in ERP systems such as SAP or similar platforms.
Strong communication, collaboration, stakeholder management and influencing skills.
Ability to coordinate multiple priorities across maintenance, MRO, infrastructure, facilities, inventory and budget management.
Within Country Relocation support available and for candidates voluntarily moving internationally some minimal support is offered through our Volunteer International Transfer Policy
Business Unit Summary
Mondelez India Foods Private Limited (formerly Cadbury India Ltd.) has been in India for over 70 years, making sure our mouth-watering and well-loved local and global brands such as Cadbury chocolates, Bournvita and Tang powdered beverages, Oreo and Cadbury Bournvita biscuits, and Halls and Cadbury Choclairs Gold candies get safely into our customers hands-and mouths. Headquartered in Mumbai, the company has more than 3,300 employees proudly working across sales offices in New Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata and Chennai and in manufacturing facilities at Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Himachal Pradesh and Andhra Pradesh, at our global Research & Development Technical Centre and Global Business Hub in Maharashtra and in a vast distribution network across the country. We are also proud to be recognised by Avatar as the Best Companies for Women in India in 2019 - the fourth time we ve received this award.

Troubleshoot and repair complex refrigeration and air conditioning systems.

Conduct routine maintenance and inspections to ensure optimal system performance.

Collaborate with other technicians to resolve technical issues.

Develop and implement effective solutions to improve system efficiency and reliability.

Strong knowledge of refrigeration and air conditioning principles and practices.

Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.

Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Good communication and interpersonal skills.

Familiarity with industry-standard tools and equipment.

Strong attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines.
