Job Summary
Job Title: Senior Consultant Subsurface (O&G Upstream)
Subsurface Subject Matter Expert (SME) embedded within a digital / AI use case delivery squad, acting as the functional bridge between upstream subsurface stakeholders and cross-functional technical teams (product, data science, data engineering, architecture). The role is non-coding and focuses on shaping, translating, validating, and governing subsurface analytics / AI solutions across the upstream value chain.
Desired Experience: 36 years
Mandatory Skill
Subsurface (Reservoir / Petroleum / Production Engineering domain depth)
Preferred Background
Experience with Integrated Oil Companies such as Exxon Mobil / Shell / BP
Operating Model & Reporting
Individual contributor role within an Agile / product-style delivery environment; supports functional delivery of subsurface use cases from discovery to deployment.
Works closely with upstream business teams (subsurface, production interface points) and technical delivery teams (product managers, data scientists, data engineers, solution architects).
Reports to Senior Manager / Manager Subsurface (O&G Upstream) and supports Consulting Delivery Leadership priorities for SC&O / Digital Ops engagements.
Key Responsibilities
Subsurface Use Case Discovery & Functional Support
Support discovery workshops with subsurface stakeholders to capture decision workflows, value drivers, pain points, uncertainties, and success criteria.
Draft and maintain structured documentation under Manager guidance: use case descriptions, functional requirements, assumptions, constraints, and acceptance criteria.
Support alignment of target outcomes and operational realism across subsurface-to-production workflows.
Digital / AI Use Case Delivery Support (Non-Coding)
Translate subsurface requirements into technical inputs for delivery teams (features, inputs, constraints, classifications), ensuring feasibility and traceability.
Support domain inputs across upstream analytics / AI solution areas such as:
Reservoir performance analytics and forecasting
Production surveillance / optimization linkages
Well performance diagnostics and root cause analysis
Decline analysis and anomaly detection
Field development planning decision support
Review and validate analytics / AI outputs and dashboards for domain realism and engineering alignment; escalate concerns and recommendations to the Manager.
Stakeholder Management & Client-Facing Delivery
Engage with subsurface teams, production interface stakeholders, and technical teams to gather structured feedback and convert it into actionable requirements/backlog items.
Support pilot deployments and phased rollouts by coordinating feedback cycles and tracking issue resolution with delivery teams.
Support preparation of stakeholder-ready narratives and inputs for proposals / solution articulation aligned to subsurface transformation priorities.
Governance, Quality & Assurance
Support definition and application of data quality checks, engineering assumptions, and validation checkpoints for subsurface datasets and model outputs.
Contribute to playbooks, solution documentation, and governance artifacts for deployed use cases.
Support UAT planning and execution; document findings and confirm outputs are credible and usable for engineering decision-making.
Required Experience & Qualifications
36 years of upstream Oil & Gas experience with strong subsurface depth (Reservoir / Production / Petroleum Engineering).
Practical understanding of subsurface workflows (not theory-only), including uncertainty handling and data quality considerations.
Strong communication and structured documentation skills; ability to translate engineering concepts clearly to non-engineers and technical teams.
Demonstrated cross-functional delivery experience spanning engineering / operations / digital teams.
Fluency in English (mandatory).
Engineering Degree in Chemical / Mechanical / Instrumentation / Petroleum disciplines
Experience from/with IOC environments and particularly Exxon Mobil / Shell / BP-type operating models.
Preferred / Nice-to-Have
Exposure to AI, advanced analytics, digital transformation, optimization, or surveillance initiatives in upstream contexts.
Familiarity with engineering / digital tools (surveillance systems, production databases, BI tools).
Arabic language capability (optional).

Senior Real Estate Hospitality & Tourism Valuation
We are looking for a Senior-level professional with expertise in Real Estate Hospitality & Tourism (RHT) Valuation to join EY-Ps Valuation Modeling & Economics sub-service line within Transactions Corporate Finance (TCF) team. TCF department is a unique nexus between the corporate finance and the M&A transactions landscape, with a focus on Transaction Diligence, Valuation, Modeling & Economics, M&A Advisory and Real Estate Advisory. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a prominent firm and develop your career through a broad range of engagements, mentoring, and learning & development.
Your key responsibilities
Lead RHT Valuation engagements primarily for financial reporting purposes, ensuring quality and timely delivery and high-quality results for all clients.
Develop and maintain financial and valuation models using tools like MS Excel, while guiding junior staff in model creation and improvement.
Participate in real estate advisory engagements, including financial analyses, cash flow modeling, property/portfolio modeling, analytical model reviews, market due diligence, asset valuations, real estate appraisals, and appraisal reviews.
Conduct fair value assessments for various property types, including multi-family residential, office, retail, hotel, warehouse, industrial, mixed-use, infrastructure, and special-use properties.
Contribute to report preparation, financial modeling, and identification of key issues, proposing solutions where necessary.
Conduct market information research and market studies, analyze real estate documents, and prepare comprehensive reports.
Utilize advanced tools and technologies or software to enhance the valuation process and ensure accuracy.
Stay updated on current business, economic trends and sector outlook, incorporating relevant information into valuation models and client engagements.
Supervise and collaborate with junior team members, mentoring and guiding them in modeling, analysis, and reporting tasks.
Manage relationships with MENA stakeholders, ensuring clear communication and understanding of valuation results.
Demonstrate strong written and verbal communication skills, presenting findings and recommendations to senior management and clients.
Take an active role in process improvement, suggesting strategies to optimize workflows and increase the efficiency of valuations and reporting.
To qualify for the role, you must have
A post graduate degree in Finance, Economics or CA / ACCA / CFA Charter holder or MBA Finance from a reputed top tier B-School shall also be considered
A minimum of 3 to 5 years direct experience in utilizing Valuation techniques and methodologies such as Discounted Cash Flow (DCF), Income Approach, market comparable etc. in a business valuation firm or practice or in venture capital, investment banking, commercial banking, financial research, national valuation firm or experience working in a corporate finance role for an organization, preferably for M&A activities. Experience in financial modelling including experience building models from scratch in MS Excel and related software preferred.
An innovative, dynamic, and outgoing personality. Memberships in professional associations like RICS would be a significant advantage.
Background in real estate valuation, acquisition due diligence, asset management, finance, or market research.
Ability to work across different areas, including M&A and Transaction Support.
Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills; experience with real estate databases and financial modeling is preferred.
Ideally, you'll also have
Project management skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills and presentation skills

Job Summary
We are seeking a DNA Monitoring Engineer to support monitoring, operational stability, and observability of Azure-based Data & Analytics (DnA) applications and data platforms. This role focuses on ensuring smooth execution of batch jobs through proactive monitoring, dashboarding, and timely incident handling. As a mid-level resource, you will work closely with senior engineers to enhance monitoring capabilities, support 24x7 operations, and ensure high data availability by following established observability and alerting practices.
You will be responsible for executing tasks with increasing autonomy, applying sound judgment within defined parameters, and contributing to team outcomes. You are expected to demonstrate initiative, resolve routine issues independently, and support junior colleagues.
You will anticipate and identify risks within engagements and share any issues with senior members of the team.
In line with EY commitment to quality, you'll confirm that work is of high quality and is reviewed by the next-level reviewer.
Your Key Responsibilities
Perform L1 monitoring and support for batch data pipelines and DnA applications on Azure, ensuring timely detection and resolution of issues
Execute standard recovery actions (job reruns, service restarts) based on approved runbooks
Participate in daily operational calls / stand-ups and provide status updates
Track recurring issues and highlight them to senior team members for permanent fixes
Support post-deployment monitoring to ensure stability after releases
Coordinate with upstream/downstream teams to track and resolve data delays or failures
Handle incident triage, perform initial diagnosis, provide timely updates, and escalate critical issues as per defined SLAs
Support 24x7 monitoring operations by working in shifts and ensuring proper coverage and handovers
Follow defined processes, governance guidelines, and ensure proper usage of tools and access controls
Continuously learn monitoring tools, troubleshooting techniques, and support best practices
Skills and attributes for success
Basic to good understanding of monitoring Azure-based DnA platforms (ADF, Data Lake, Databricks, Informatica CDI) with a focus on batch and application operations
Hands-on experience in working with monitoring dashboards and observability tools
Understanding of 24x7 support environments and ability to work in shift-based models
Good troubleshooting and analytical skills for initial diagnosis of issues and identifying recurring patterns
Basic understanding of batch processing workflows, job dependencies, and scheduling concepts
Ability to handle alerts, prioritize incidents, and follow escalation processes in a timely manner
Familiarity with monitoring tools, alerting systems, and basic log analysis
Good communication skills to coordinate with team members and stakeholders
Willingness to learn new tools, technologies, and support processes in a fast-paced environment
To qualify for the role, you must have
Bachelors degree in computer science, Data Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
2-4 years of experience in data operations, production support, or monitoring of DnA/data platforms
Hands-on or working experience with Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake, Databricks, or similar data platforms
Basic experience in monitoring and supporting batch workflows and data pipelines
Familiarity with monitoring tools, logging, and basic observability practices
Understanding of incident management, alert handling, and escalation processes
Exposure to working in 24x7 support models or willingness to work in shift-based environments
Basic understanding of batch job scheduling, dependencies, and production support processes
Basic scripting knowledge (Python/PySpark or similar) is a plus
Good communication skills for coordination with team members and stakeholders

Description:
Job Summary
Mobile Platform Engineer
The opportunity
As a Mobile Platform Engineer, you will play a crucial for the Mobile services at EY. By designing, testing, and implementing new mobile products and services within our Intune-based mobile environment, you will contribute to creating and maintaining a seamless experiences for our Mobile users. With over 400,000 users and 350,000 enrolled devices, your expertise will help ensure that our mobile solutions are not only innovative but also secure and aligned with our strategic goals.
Your key responsibilities
Design, test and implementation of new mobile products and services, ensuring they meet quality and security standards.
Proactively suggest new ideas and solutions, driving them to implementation with minimal guidance on technical delivery.
Collaborate closely with the Product Manager and Technical Lead to align on project goals and execution.
Provide input to the Mobile Roadmap and actively participate in bringing it to life.
Manage Intune policies and configurations to maintain a secure mobile platform.
Serve as the last level of support, troubleshooting and resolving issues that exceed the capabilities of the support organization.
Work with colleagues and customers all over the globe, ensuring effective communication and collaboration across different time zones.
Skills and attributes for success
Analytical Ability: Strong analytical skills in supported core technologies, particularly in managing large user bases, to effectively design, test, implement, troubleshoot and optimize mobile solutions.
Creative Problem-Solving: Ability to conceptualize innovative solutions that add value to end users, particularly in the context of mobile applications and services.
Self-Starter Mentality: A proactive and self-motivated approach to work, with the ability to take initiative and drive projects forward independently.
Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Proficiency in English is required.
Interpersonal Skills: Strong interpersonal skills, sound judgment, and tact to foster collaboration with colleagues and customers across diverse cultural backgrounds.
Documentation Skills: Clear and concise documentation skills, ensuring that all processes, solutions, and communications are well-documented for future reference.
Vendor Management: Ability to manage strategic vendors, such as Microsoft, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and effective service delivery.
Cross-Cultural Awareness: Awareness of and sensitivity to cross-cultural dynamics, enabling effective collaboration with global teams and clients.
Training and Knowledge Sharing: Willingness to share knowledge and provide training, both virtually and hands-on, to empower team members and enhance overall team capability.
User Experience Focus: Passionate about improving user experience, with an understanding of how to measure, monitor, and enhance user satisfaction through feedback and analytics.
To qualify for the role, you must have
Five or more years of hands-on experience in Microsoft Intune, Entra, Entra conditional access, Mobile Device and Application Management with a thorough understanding of its design and architecture.
Proven experience in mobile platform engineering or a related field.
Solution oriented mindset with the capability to design and implement creative Mobile solutions and the ability to suggest and implement solutions that meet EY's requirements
Strong understanding of mobile technologies and security protocols, particularly within an Intune-based environment.
Experience with iOS and Android operating systems.
Proficient in PowerShell scripting for automation and management tasks.
Ability to operate proactively and independently in a fast-paced environment.
Familiarity with the latest trends in mobile technology.
Ability to work UK working hours
Ideally, you'll also have
Strong communication skills to effectively liaise with various stakeholders.
A proactive approach to suggesting and implementing new ideas.
Ability to explain very technical topics to non-technical stakeholders
Experience in managing and supporting large mobile environments.
Testing and Quality Assurance ensure our mobile platform meets quality, performance and security standards.
Implementation of new products and/or service offerings.
Experience with working in a large global environment
What we look for
We are looking for people who are skilled in their work, can find solutions to technical challenges, and also love to be creative and do their best. The best candidates are those who work well with others, want to learn new things, and are committed to helping our clients and making a difference.

Description:
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
Todays world is fueled by vast amounts of information. Data is more valuable than ever before. Protecting data and information systems is central to doing business, and everyone in EY Information Security has a critical role to play. Join a global team of almost 900 people who collaborate to support the business of EY by protecting EY and client information assets! Our Information Security professionals enable EY to work securely and deliver secure products and services, as well as detect and quickly respond to security events as they happen. Together, the efforts of our dedicated team helps protect the EY brand and build client trust.
Within Information Security we blend risk strategy, digital identity, cyber defense, application security and technology solutions as we consider the entire security lifecycle. You will join a team of hardworking, security-focused individuals dedicated to supporting, protecting and enabling the business through innovative, secure solutions that provide speed to market and business value.
The opportunity
As an experienced Full Stack .Net Developer, within the Identity and Access Management (IAM) function you will:
Lead the delivery of solution or infrastructure development services for small to large size projects, using strong technical capabilities with exceptional hands on experience!
Designs, develops and is responsible for the maintenance of solutions or infrastructure work using standard methodologies and best practices for new features or modifications to existing features and functions.
Role is an individual contributor, though may be asked to manage project aligned teams in their collaborative efforts and provide informal mentoring/coaching to junior members of the team
Partners and collaborates with peers across Development & Engineering and Architecture teams, as well as external vendors such as Microsoft, as needed to understand, agree and plan the specific code modifications and enhancements vital to achieve the agreed development objectives.
Key responsibilities
Leads the delivery of high-quality solution or infrastructure work, setting project timelines and continuously reviewing and updating the specifications, in line with user requirements
Contributes to complex aspects of a project, performing coding, debugging, testing and troubleshooting throughout the development process
Resolves intensified production and system enhancement issues
Provides technical expertise to improve value from current solutions, infrastructure and emerging technologies and seeks to continuously improve internal processes
Fully understand user requirements and translates requirements into design specifications
Drives alignment to the relevant processes, procedures, standards, technical design
Communicates all the ongoing activities and results to business sponsors, stakeholders, and management as part of knowledge sharing and reporting
Work and provide expertise in developing applications in N Tier, MVC, and SOA Architectures using .NET Framework 4.5+ and Visual Studio 2015 or above.
Creates or collaborate in the creation of visual mockups, prototypes, and diagrams, as well as performs or directs testing for compatibility in order to achieve an integrated architecture across interdependent technologies
Skills and attributes for success
Experience in building web application with the ASP.NET framework and design/architectural patterns (e.g. Model-View-Controller (MVC)
Experience in Power Shell scripting
Experience in building Web services using REST, WEB API, WCF, ASMX.
Experience in writing stored procedures and complex queries. LINQ is a plus.
Experience in using ORM tool like Entity Framework or NHibernate.
Experience in building UI layer using client-side frameworks like jQuery, Angular.
Knowledge of SOLID principles and its implementation.
Knowledge of HTML, CSS, Bootstrap is a plus.
Understanding of Agile methodologies
Strong attention to detail
Excellent troubleshooting and communication skills
Able to work well in a team setting
To qualify for the role you must have
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT or equivalent work experience
5 years of development experience using C# .NET, MVC and Web API, jQuery and angular
Ideally, youll also have
Maintains a proactive approach to learning about Identity and Access Management aligned components within Information Security (IS) such as Microsoft Identity Management (MIM) and infrastructure such as the Active Directory technical environment, and Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP)
What we look for
Were looking for someone who can collaborate globally with different regions and cultures. Problem-solves, thinks creatively and has an open mind to new insights. Focus on customer service and building positive relationships with colleagues both across teams and globally. A highly motivated, diligent, and driven individual who seeks development and improvement opportunities and deliver quality services.

The opportunity
This role acts as a single point of contact providing financial information and analysis to stakeholders within a Global Function or Service Line. The FRO communicates with executive level business leaders and is expected to demonstrate an implicit understanding of their clients needs. In addition to Function/Service Line Executives, key customers are CFOs, their Deputies and teams who are involved in managing budgets. FROs interface and manage relationships between the Function/Service Line Team and Global Controlling.
Your key responsibilities
Communicates regularly with Function/Service Line Teams on financial operating performance and is responsible for identifying issues and supporting resolution of same.
Monitors and tracks financial results against goals and historical performance leveraging reports from the Reporting Center of Excellence (COE).
Explains critical upcoming Finance activities (Annual Financial Plan, Forecasting, Month/Year end closing).
Works with Functions/Service Lines to develop budgets, taking overall ownership of this budget process. Liaises with Sub Function/Service Line Leaders to define targets for Sub Function/Service Lines. Challenges, reviews and consolidates annual budgets and forecasts/projections for Functions/Service Lines.
With the support of their designated GDS based Analyst, manages all aspects of Global Entity engagement codes. This includes engagement code set up and maintenance, AP invoices, POs, billings, management of accruals, identifying time booked by people that are not in the budget, challenging and proposing corrective actions.
Provides technical financial advice, knowledge and counsel to Function/Service Line customers.
Manages the relationship with the Function/Service Line CFOs and their deputies on behalf of the Controlling function.
Drives key methods and processes at the direction of Global Controlling (e.g. financial planning).
Synthesizes, provides insight and communicates a clear and concise view of financial performance to Function/Service Line Leadership.
Advises on expected financial performance vs. plan/forecast based upon analytics such as trend analysis and modelling of forward-looking scenarios.
Assesses the drivers of financial results with a constant focus on improvement and rapid course correction where necessary.
Skills and attributes for success
Preferred candidates will have a bachelors degree in finance, economics, business administration or similar combined with minimum of 7+ years of relevant financial planning & analysis experience is required to perform this position.
Be able to work in a virtual global organization respecting international cultures and speaking/writing English fluently
Focused on analysis, advice and solutions that drive the continuous improvement of financial performance.
Have a deep understanding of the external services offered by the firm and the overall area/regional markets landscape would be beneficial.
Forms and communicates a clear and concise view of financial performance. Has a deep understanding of the drivers of financial performance and applies constantly to analyze and advise on progress against targets.
Synthesizes and communicates detailed financial information in support of effective decision making.
Able to analyze large volumes of data and spot where there is greatest financial opportunity and risk.
Utilizes sound financial practices and seeks leading practices to support operational excellence.
Demonstrates exceptional commercial awareness with respect to EY's position and ambitions in the marketplace will make a valued leader
What we look for
Were interested in hiring a professional with excellent finance knowledge. The ideal candidate will be an analytical thinker, comfortable taking initiative in situations where thought leadership is either absent or unclear.The success of this role also depends on the FRO successfully teaming with and leveraging other members of the Function/Service Line teams, other FROs and the Global Controlling Leadership Team.
Requirements Experience:
A minimum of 7+ years of relevant financial planning & analysis experience is required to perform this position.
A deep understanding of the external services offered by the firm and the overall area/regional markets landscape would be beneficial.
Professional services experience is preferred.
Leadership and coaching:
Able to work in a self-sufficient manner, operating across multiple projects and priorities.
A successful track record of implementing and leading key business change initiatives.
Effectively manages and coaches a small team of GDS based staff.
Demonstrates the ability to challenge assumptions and decisions in an appropriate manner.
Client service:
Able to embed ECS (Exceptional Client Service).
Drives interactions that build trust and manages expectations with all stakeholders.
Collaborates and teams with finance colleagues and other functions to enhance service to clients, and to leverage leading practices.
Analysis, modelling & advice:
Must be an analytical thinker, comfortable taking initiative in situations where thought leadership is either absent or unclear.
Understanding of the business:
Understands the Firms strategy and applies constantly to analyze and advise on financial performance
Knowledgeable of EY capabilities and services.

Description:
Job Summary
The Engagement Business Partner (EBP) is a finance professional with comprehensive knowledge of systems, processes, and policies. In this internal role, the EBP acts as the Finance single point of contact, collaborating closely with client-serving engagement teams to enable the successful delivery of engagements across the full engagement lifecycle, from opportunity creation to final record archiving. Please note: this is not a technical accounting role.
The opportunity
As a senior Engagement Business Partner, you will play a pivotal role in supporting client-serving teams by ensuring the accurate and timely execution of all engagement lifecycle activities. The main components of this role are:
Serving as the Finance single point of contact for Engagement Partners and Managers, offering guidance and overseeing all aspects of the Opportunity Engagement Lifecycle (OEL).
Overseeing the completion of OEL tasks by delegating to Centres of Excellence (CoEs), and monitoring progress to ensure timely delivery.
Proactively managing financial and quality related risks across your engagement portfolio, intervening where needed to provide strategic advice to uplift the compliance and revenue stability of your portfolio.
Ensure compliance with service line specific policies and parameters.
Supporting the annual external audit process.
This is a dynamic and rewarding role that contributes to profitable growth and high-quality client service.
Your key responsibilities
Manage a portfolio of client opportunities and engagements, acting as the Finance single point of contact for the Engagement Partners with complex portfolios.
Manage the professional development, coaching and upskilling of other EBPs in the team.
Oversee team resourcing, proactively tracking joiners, leavers, and movers, and ensuring coverage of Partner portfolios during periods of leave or absence.
Coordinate with client servers and CoEs to:
Apply knowledge of service line specific OEL policies and guidelines to ensure compliance across the OEL lifecycle.
Monitor and advise on risk assessment and compliance processes.
Advise on pricing models and engagement budgets.
Assess financial implications of engagement structures and budgets.
Support and challenge the Estimate-to-Complete (ETC) processes and related financial updates.
Support the portfolios working capital activity.
Provide challenge and best practice insights to client servers where required such as through optimal margin, pricing plans or engagement structures.
Upskill and share knowledge with client servers on OEL best practice, standards and tools.
Develop a diverse network of relationships across Finance and non-Finance stakeholders to provide holistic Finance support for Engagement Partners and escalate queries beyond remit to other functional experts within Finance (e.g. PFAs).
Review work performed by CoEs for accuracy and take ownership of OEL tasks when urgent needs arise.
Seek to understand client-server needs, demands, and the nuances of the specific Service Line to deepen insights and strategic thinking.
Share best practices across the EBP group to drive consistency and excellence.
Engage with CoE Managers to flag issues, trends or knowledge required for CoE upskilling.
Provide subject matter expertise in delivering training on OEL best practices for CoEs.
Support continuous improvement through identifying opportunities for innovation and automation.
Skills and attributes for success
Deliver with pace ensuring activities are executed accurately in a fast-moving environment.
Ability to engage proactively with Engagement Partners to anticipate upcoming needs and ensure OEL requirements are met on time.
Strong interpersonal skills with a good understanding of the client server perspective and ability to build relationships with them.
Confident communicator who can challenge constructively and influence outcomes.
Excellent analytical and commercial acumen, with high attention to detail.
Take ownership of monthly activities, driving progress and proactively managing business outcomes to meet deadlines and performance targets.
Quick learner with a proactive approach and eager to share knowledge with others.
Ability to translate complex technical system language into business-relevant terms.
Skilled listener with sound judgment and the ability to escalate appropriately.
Ability to lead others and support team development.
To qualify for the role, you must have
A minimum of two to three years experience in a client-facing or finance-related role within a professional services or corporate environment.
Experience managing stakeholders and delivering high-impact client service.
Ability to lead others in hybrid and fast-paced environments.
Used to working in a fast-paced environment with a strong work ethic.
Ability to build relationships with people at all levels within the firm.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, SharePoint).
Adaptability and resilience in fast-paced environments.
What we look for
Highly motivated, good communicators who can establish credibility with client servers and convey financial impacts in business language back to client servers. You will also need to be a team player who is not only looking to enhance their own career but recognises the value in strengthening the team.

Job Summary
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
EY- Risk Consulting Senior Consultant (Sanctions Screening and Transaction Monitoring Model Validation)
As part of our Risk Consulting FS team, we are looking for a Senior Consultant with strong consulting and technical skills to join the FS Risk team and to work with our clients on some of the most prestigious projects within the financial services sector across MENA region. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst contributing to the delivery of Risk Consulting FS domain service offerings and solutions thus creating authentic customer experiences.
The Opportunity
As a Senior Consultant, you will engage with clients to support the validation and enhancement of sanctions screening and transaction monitoring models, ensuring they are aligned with regulatory standards and operational requirements. You will work within different sized, multi-disciplinary teams and play a key role in delivering high quality outputs and service to our clients. You will support the validation and fine-tuning of models/tools used for sanctions screening and transaction monitoring. The role involves ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, enhancing model performance, developing subject matter knowledge and supporting the implementation of solutions to meet the ever-changing needs of our clients.
This position is based out of our offices in Kochi or Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala.
Responsibilities
Support sanctions screening and transaction monitoring model validation engagements including rule-based systems, anomaly detection and machine learning algorithms.
Perform qualitative and quantitative analysis to assess model design, effectiveness, performance and compliance with regulatory expectations.
Execute model testing activities including back-testing, threshold calibration, data analysis and performance assessments.
Analyse large volumes of transactional and customer data to identify trends, gaps and potential model improvements.
Assist in the development and enhancement of validation methodologies, frameworks and performance metrics.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support the integration of model outputs into business processes.
Participate in model implementation reviews, fine-tuning exercises and model performance monitoring activities.
Stay abreast of regulatory changes and advancements in sanctions screening, transaction monitoring and model validation techniques.
Support multiple client engagements and related initiatives while ensuring timely delivery and quality outcomes.
Good to have experience in Risk Management or other Risk Consulting engagements.
The job would require travel (Over 50%) to client locations in Middle East and North Africa such as Dubai, Kuwait, Riyadh, Doha etc.
Skills
Proficient in SQL and Python.
Familiarity with database management and data analysis tools.
Experience in system implementation/fine-tuning, cloud deployment and project delivery.
Familiarity with Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Counter-Terrorist Financing (CTF) regulations and screening tools.
Understanding of sanctions screening systems, transaction monitoring platforms and model validation methodologies.
Exceptional command over spoken and written English.
Globally mobile and flexible to travel to onsite locations at a short notice.
Highly analytical, organised, and meticulous consulting skills; attention to detail and quality assurance.
Ability to work collaboratively within engagement teams and contribute effectively to project delivery.
Ability to multi-task, work well under pressure with commitment to deliver under tight deadlines.
Strong organizational skills with ability to prioritize effectively.
Work experience in similar industry (Big 4 preferred).
Strong problem-solving, communication and stakeholder management skills.
Qualifications
Bachelors degree in engineering, Finance, Statistics, Economics or a related quantitative field; advanced degree preferred.
3 to 5 years of relevant experience working with business consulting firms.
A valid passport for travel.
Preferred Qualifications
AML, CTF Certification (CAMS, CAFP).
Experience / certifications in Cloud Data Architecture, Data Engineering.

Job Summary
Position: Instructional Designer Associate
Qualifications
Education: Any Graduate
Experience: 1 to 4 years of relevant experience
Job Overview
This position will support the design of individual learning items and blended learning programs. The instructional designer will work to agreed design quality standards and processes, using approved templates and tools, and will collaborate with other designers and learning professionals to support the continuous improvement of design and development speed, efficiency, and quality. In addition, the designer will develop and maintain strong relationships with content owners, Subject Matter Reviewers (SMRs), learning and performance consultants, developers, deployment teams, and vendors.
Key Responsibilities
Participate in Skills Needs Analysis (SNA) conversations and document key points.
Assist Senior IDs in leading SNA conversations and draft learning objectives based on completed SNA.
Assist in preparing Design Specifications and independently review learning design against EY Learning Design Quality Checklist.
Draft all deliverables (leader guides, participant materials, storyboards, video scripts, and other materials) based on Design specifications.
Write assessments and practice questions based on learning objectives and review all deliverables for content flow, accuracy, language, and adherence to standards.
Independently liaise with SMRs for technical reviews and review storyboards against EY Learning Design Quality Checklist.
Demonstrate basic to intermediate proficiency in creating and editing self-study programs using rapid authoring tools, such as Articulate Storyline and Rise, while learning and applying foundational eLearning tool skills under guidance.
Demonstrate exceptional writing skills while designing all types of learning materials/deliverables and good communication skills when liaising with graphic designers, Senior IDs, and SMRs.
Actively participate in team meetings and contribute to collaborative efforts, assisting with design tasks and learning to communicate effectively within the team.
Develop the ability to adapt to new design recommendations based on rationale, embracing learning opportunities and remaining open to feedback and guidance.
Develop leadership skills by taking on small responsibilities and seeking mentorship, while actively learning from senior team members.
Skills and Attributes for Success
Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with content owners, SMRs, deployment teams, and other members of the learning team.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to write effective instructional text and facilitator materials.
Ability to adapt to a constantly changing and growing business environment.
Good problem-solving skills and a customer service-focused mindset.
Proactive in seeking opportunities for growth and learning from senior team members.
Requirements
1 to 4 years of experience in designing courses and other learning items.
Experience in assisting with the design of effective learning solutions across different modalities.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools and basic knowledge of rapid authoring tools.
Ability to work in fast-paced, stressful environments to deliver required results.
What we look for
An emerging instructional designer who can support multiple projects concurrently and demonstrates resilience, is energized by working in a global environment, proactively seeking different opinions and valuing diverse perspectives.

Job Summary
The Senior Security Analyst in Cyber Defense CTF (Cyber Triage and Forensics) plays a pivotal role in enhancing EY's security posture by vigilantly monitoring, assessing, and managing incidents effectively. In collaboration with the team and leadership, to ensure strong security oversight and contribute to joint security monitoring and incident response initiatives. Key duties include triage, detailed investigations, clear communication, and comprehensive reporting, all contributing to the integrity and resilience of EY's cyber defenses.
Essential Functions of the Job
You will work collaboratively to detect and respond to information security incidents, develop, maintain, and follow procedures for security event alerting, and participate in security investigations.
Engage in proactive threat hunting and provide expert security assessments, utilizing EDR, SIEM, and other tools to understand and counteract the cybercrime landscape
Communicate with IT stakeholders during incident response activities, ensuring effective containment, remediation, and accurate identification of compromise indicators
Report on incident metrics, analyse findings, and develop reports to ensure comprehensive resolution and understanding of security events
Act as an escalation point for incident response, shift lead, mentor junior team members, and contribute to team skill enhancement
Analyse security events, provide feedback on security controls, and drive process improvements to strengthen the organization's security posture
Maintain and improve security incident processes, protocols, and standard operating procedures to reflect best practices in security incident response
Skills and attributes for success
Proficient in Cyber investigation including evidence management in line with best practices and using advanced tools for threat detection and incident management including advanced querying with KQL
Proficient in analyzing varied data sets, identifying malware, and conducting comprehensive security event analysis from network traffic attributes and host-based attributes to detect information security incidents and latent threats.
Proficient in conducting detailed forensic investigations across various operating systems, with a keen eye for obfuscation and the ability to clearly communicate findings
In-depth understanding of Active Directory security, with strong scripting abilities to automate response measures and improve operational effectiveness
To qualify for the role, you must have
Undergraduate or Postgraduate Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (MCA/MTech/BTech/BCA/BSc CS or BSc IT)
At least 7 years of overall experience with a minimum of 5 years specialized in incident response, computer forensics, and Security Operations.
Proficiency in operating within a Security Monitoring/Security Operations Center (SOC) environment, including experience with CSIRT and CERT operations
Demonstrated experience in investigating security events, threats, and vulnerabilities
Strong understanding of electronic investigation and forensic methodologies, including log correlation, electronic data handling, investigative processes, and malware analysis
In-depth knowledge of Windows and Unix/Linux operating systems, and experience with EDR solutions for threat detection and response
Ideally, you'll also
Desired certifications such as SSCP, CEH, GCIH, GCFA, GCIA, GSEC, GIAC, Security+.
Experience with security incident response in cloud environments, including Azure.
Knowledge of legal considerations in electronic discovery and analysis
Proficiency in scripting or programming (e.g., Shell scripting, PowerShell, C, C#, Python)
Solid understanding of security best practices for network architecture and server configuration
What we look for
Demonstrates integrity in a professional environment
Strong ethical behavior
Ability to work independently
Possesses a global mindset for working with diverse cultures and backgrounds
Knowledgeable in industry-standard security incident response processes, procedures, and lifecycle
Positive attitude and Excellent teaming skills
Excellent social, communication, and writing skills
Good presentation skills
Excellent investigative, analytical, and problem-solving skills
Supervising Responsibilities
Coordinate escalations and collaborate with internal technology teams to ensure timely resolution of issues
Provide mentoring and training to other team members as required, supporting their development and ensuring consistent team performance
Other Requirements
Should be willing to work in shifts

Description:
The Opportunity
We are seeking an experienced Manager Microsoft Purview to design, implement, and support enterprise data protection and compliance solutions. The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in Microsoft Purview Data Security services, including Data Loss Prevention (DLP), Data Classification and Sensitivity Labelling, Insider Risk Management, and Data Lifecycle Management. The candidate should also possess sound understanding of DSPM for AI and Data Governance. The professional will work closely with business stakeholders, compliance teams, and technical teams to protect sensitive information, reduce insider risks, and ensure regulatory compliance across the organization's data estate.
Your Key Responsibilities Data Loss Prevention (DLP)
Design, implement, and optimize Microsoft Purview DLP policies across Microsoft 365 services, endpoints, and supported third-party repositories.
Define detection logic using Sensitive Information Types (SITs), trainable classifiers, custom classifiers, and EDM.
Monitor DLP incidents and provide recommendations for policy tuning and risk reduction.
Support deployment of Endpoint DLP controls for data exfiltration prevention.
Data Classification & Labelling
Develop enterprise data classification frameworks aligned with business and regulatory requirements.
Configure and manage Sensitivity Labels, Label Policies, Auto-labelling, and Mandatory Labelling strategies.
Perform data discovery and classification workshops with business stakeholders.
Support protection technologies including encryption, content markings, and access controls.
DSPM for AI
Configure and manage Microsoft Purview DSPM for AI policies, assessments, and risk monitoring.
Investigate AI-related data exposure, oversharing, and compliance risks.
Develop AI governance use cases focused on responsible AI adoption and data protection.
Deliver AI risk insights, posture reports, and executive dashboards.
Data Governance
Configure and manage Microsoft Purview Data Governance capabilities and services.
Drive data discovery, classification, cataloguing, and lineage initiatives.
Develop governance frameworks for data quality, ownership, compliance, and lifecycle management.
Produce governance metrics, compliance reports, and executive dashboards.
Insider Risk Management
Configure and manage Insider Risk Management policies and analytics.
Investigate insider risk alerts and collaborate with security, legal, compliance, and HR teams during investigations.
Develop insider risk use cases focused on data theft, data leakage, security policy violations, and privilege misuse.
Produce risk reports and executive dashboards.
Data Lifecycle Management
Implement retention labels, retention policies, disposition reviews, and records management controls.
Support regulatory and compliance requirements through information governance processes.
Assist in defining data retention schedules and defensible data disposal strategies.
Collaborate with stakeholders to automate lifecycle management processes.
Consulting & Delivery
Conduct workshops, assessments, and requirement-gathering sessions.
Develop solution designs, implementation plans, and governance frameworks.
Support Proof of Concepts (PoCs), pilot deployments, and production rollouts.
Create technical documentation, operational runbooks, and knowledge-transfer materials.
Provide troubleshooting support and operational guidance for Purview solutions.
Stay current with Microsoft Purview roadmap, emerging data protection trends, and compliance requirements.

Assistant / Associate Manager: Decision Modelling & Economics (DME, VME)
Key Responsibilities
Leading a team of financial modellers who are engaged in the development and review of financial models. Managing client relationship with various user offices across MENA region and actively taking part in business development initiatives of the firm.
Liaising with the onshore team and acting as a single point of contact in project execution and delivery.

Work in a highly regarded team, which values collaboration, respect and knowledge sharing

You have an agile, growth-oriented mindset. What you know matters. But the right mindset is just as important in determining success. Were looking for people who are innovative, can work in an agile way and keep pace with a rapidly changing world.

You are inclusive. Were looking for people who seek out and embrace diverse perspectives, who value differences, and team inclusively to build safety and trust.

Strong financial modelling skills

Excellent interpersonal, leadership, and communication skills

A strong desire to continually develop themselves and others
Ability to successfully manage engagements including the work of team members, client interaction, quality of service and expenditures against budget and revenue
Ability to provide best practice financial modelling guidance to team members to ensure the completion of work deliverables at the highest level of quality
Superior skills in MS Excel with VBA skills
General PC proficiency including Word, and PowerPoint

Job Summary
The AI Engineer is responsible for building, deploying, and operating production-grade AI and Agentic AI solutions across the enterprise. This is a hands-on engineering role focused on implementing LLM-powered applications, orchestration and multi-agent workflows, and secure API-driven integrations using Azure AI Foundry and Azure-native services (compute, storage, messaging, data, security, and observability).
The role works across the full AI lifecycle from system design and development to production operations ensuring solutions are secure, scalable, observable, and governed. The AI Engineer partners closely with Engineering Leads, architects, data science teams, and platform/security stakeholders to translate AI use cases into reliable, enterpriseready systems, not isolated proofs of concept.
A key expectation of the role is to embed evaluation, quality monitoring, and runtime security into AI systems, including the use of LLM-as-Judge patterns and alignment to agent lifecycle governance and runtime protection controls (e.g., Agent 365-aligned environments).
Essential Functions of the Job
Build Agentic AI Solutions using Azure AI Foundry Core: Build and evolve AI applications and agents leveraging Azure AI Foundry-aligned capabilities used in the enterprise toolchain
Develop Orchestration & MultiAgent Systems Core: Implement orchestration layers to coordinate tools/agents across multi-step tasks, including multi-agent workflows for specialized sub-tasks and coordinated execution.
FullStack Engineering + API Development Core: Build end-to-end AI experiences UI where applicable, backend services, and integration layers. Design and implement RESTful APIs and microservices that expose AI/agent capabilities securely and reliably.
Serverless & Asynchronous Processing with Azure Functions Core: Build services using Azure Functions, including Durable Functions or equivalent for long-running and stateful orchestration patterns.
Messaging / Queues for Workflow Reliability Core: Use queue/event-driven patterns e.g. messaging, pub/sub to decouple services and improve reliability of multi-step AI pipelines and orchestration flows.
Data Engineering Foundations ADLS + Retrieval Core: Work with ADLS style data lake patterns for ingestion, storage, and processing to support AI workloads and grounding.
Use Azure Cognitive Services / Azure AI Services Where Appropriate Core: Leverage Azure Cognitive Services / Azure AI Services capabilities as part of end-to-end AI solutions.
Vector Databases & Knowledge Stores Core: Implement vector retrieval using enterprise options such as Azure AI Search and/or other vector DB patterns (e.g., Cosmos DB / PostgreSQL pgvector / Redis) based on operational needs.
Continuous Evaluation using LLM-as-a-Judge Core: Implement evaluation pipelines for LLM/agent outputs, including LLM-as-a-Judge patterns and structured scoring/assessment approaches where appropriate.
Agent Lifecycle Governance with Agent 365 A365 Awareness Core: Build solutions that align with enterprise lifecycle management and governance patterns such as:
Agent registry / inventory expectations
Access controls and telemetry/observability requirements
Monitoring and operational controls at agent scale
Runtime Security / Runtime Protection Core: Implement and support runtime protection expectations for agentic solutions, and participate in controls aligned to:
Runtime protection
Access controls (e.g., Entra ID patterns)
Threat detection and monitoring expectations
Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities
This role is critical to ensuring the enterprises AI ambition translates into real, reliable, and scalable systems not just innovation theater. You will define how AI is built, shipped, and operated across the organization.
Knowledge and Skills Requirements Core Software Engineering (Required)
Strong hands-on development in Python / C# / TypeScript/JavaScript (or similar).
Experience building API-driven services and integrating distributed systems. [Build agen...65 Copilot | SharePoint], [Agents in...65 Copilot | SharePoint]
Strong understanding of non-functional requirements: reliability, availability, scalability, performance, and cost.
Azure & Platform Engineering
Handson experience with Azure AI Foundry for delivering enterprise GenAI solutions in an enterprise context.
Experience building serverless and asynchronous workloads using Azure Functions (including Durable Functions or equivalent).
Experience using queues and eventdriven messaging for decoupled, reliable workflows.
Experience working with ADLS for data ingestion, storage, and processing.
Experience using Azure Cognitive Services / Azure AI Services as part of AI solutions.
Azure Functions + Queues/Eventing (Required)
Experience with Azure Functions (including Durable Functions or equivalent orchestration patterns).
Experience implementing asynchronous patterns with queues/eventing for scale and reliability.
Vector Databases (Required)
Hands-on experience with vector databases / vector search

Job Summary
Lead the preparation of comprehensive financial and management reports, providing detailed analysis on financial performance. Conduct in-depth variance analysis to identify discrepancies between actuals and forecasts, helping stakeholders understand the reasons behind financial variances. Perform competitor analysis to benchmark the company's performance against key players in the industry, offering insights into market positioning and strategic opportunities.
Responsibilities
Lead the preparation of comprehensive financial and management reports, providing detailed analysis on financial performance.
Conduct in-depth variance analysis to identify discrepancies between actuals and forecasts, helping stakeholders understand the reasons behind financial variances.
A deep understanding of financial reporting standards, performance metrics, and financial modeling is essential. You will need to interpret financial results and provide strategic recommendations based on your analysis of both internal data and external market conditions.
Manage large volumes of unstructured, complex financial data, transforming it into coherent, easy-to-understand formats that support decision-making. Extract meaningful patterns and trends from raw data and present these insights in a way that is actionable for business leaders.
Data Analytics & Insights Generation: Strong ability to analyze large and complex datasets to uncover trends, identify business drivers, and deliver actionable insights. Experience in transforming data into meaningful reports, dashboards, and recommendations that support strategic and operational decision-making.
Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, ensuring that their reporting needs are met efficiently and effectively. Regularly engage with stakeholders to provide updates on service delivery, gather feedback, and make necessary adjustments to improve reporting processes.
Establish clear timelines and set expectations for report delivery, ensuring all reports meet the necessary deadlines without sacrificing quality. You will be responsible for creating workflows that enable timely delivery of insights, adjusting to changing priorities, and coordinating with multiple stakeholders to ensure the accurate and efficient completion of reporting tasks.
Show agility in problem-solving, rapidly assessing and responding to challenges as they arise. You will need to apply quick thinking to troubleshoot data discrepancies, resolve issues under tight deadlines and deliver accurate results in high-pressure situations.
Prepare leadership dashboards and Ppt deck, executive presentations, and business review decks that provide clear insights into financial performance, key metrics, trends, risks, and opportunities. Present complex data in a concise and actionable format to support strategic decision-making by senior stakeholders.
Required Skills
Financial & Management Reporting: A deep understanding of financial reporting standards, performance metrics, and financial modeling is essential. You will need to interpret financial results and provide strategic recommendations based on your analysis of both internal data and external market conditions.
MS Excel Proficiency: Advanced proficiency with MS Excel is a must including Power Pivot, Lookups, and filters, to manage, manipulate, and analyze complex data sets. You will need to handle complex data manipulation, build robust financial models, and create dynamic, automated reporting tools that streamline the analysis and presentation of large data sets
Power BI Reporting: Design, develop and manage dynamic, user-friendly reports and dashboards using Power BI. Ensure the backend ETL processes are robust and efficient. This includes automating data pipelines, creating meaningful visualizations, and ensuring stakeholders have real-time access to performance metrics.
SQL Query: Write and execute SQL queries to retrieve data from various sources, ensuring that reporting databases are updated and accurate. Use SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS) to manage database queries and optimize reporting processes. You will be expected to maintain the integrity of large datasets, ensuring data consistency and reliability across reports.
Presentation Skills: You will need to convey complex financial data in a clear, concise manner, using presentations to provide insights to both technical and non-technical audiences. The ability to create professional, visually compelling PowerPoint presentations is essential.
Pressure Management: The ability to maintain a high level of accuracy while managing multiple reporting tasks under tight deadlines is crucial. You should be comfortable working under pressure and balancing competing priorities without compromising on quality.
Ownership & Initiative: A strong sense of ownership over your work, combined with a go-getter attitude, is required. You should be proactive in identifying areas for improvement, taking the initiative to implement changes that enhance the accuracy, efficiency, and overall quality of reporting processes.
Innovative Mindset: You should exhibit a curious and innovative mindset, constantly seeking ways to improve processes, automate reporting, and find creative solutions to complex problems.
PowerPoint Presentation Development: Strong expertise in developing executive-level PowerPoint presentations
Qualifications
Bachelors or masters degree in finance, reporting or related fields.
7 -10 years of experience in financial reporting and analytics, with to 2+ years of experience as data analyst with excellent track record. Power BI certifications are a plus.
Exceptional analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving abilities.
Detail-oriented with an unwavering commitment to accuracy and quality.
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Excellent leadership and team management skills, with the ability to motivate and guide a team towards achieving common goals.
Preferred Characteristics
A proactive, self-starter attitude with the initiative to seek out opportunities for improvement.
A collaborative mindset that thrives in a team-oriented environment.
A continuous learner who is passionate about staying current with industry best practices and emerging technologies.
A poised and thoughtful demeanor in high-pressure situations
A strategic thinker who can see the big picture while also diving into the details when necessary.
Continuous learning mindset and the ability to adapt to evolving reporting and analytics technologies

Job Title: GDS Alliances Operations Lead Analyst
Job Summary
The GDS Alliances Operations Lead Analyst will operate from the GDS Program Operations CoE and provide structured operations, governance, stakeholder coordination, reporting, content management and execution support across multiple alliances within the broader Global Alliances and Ecosystem Relationship Enablement function. The role may support selected alliances on an ongoing basis while providing flexible, needs-based support to others in response to changing business priorities. The incumbent will help alliance leadership teams run effective, insight-led and scalable operating models by tracking priorities, managing operational cadence, improving process discipline and enabling timely execution across sell, build and deliver motions. Working closely with alliance, market, finance, contracts, training, BMC and enablement stakeholders, the role will strengthen delivery consistency, improve data and reporting quality, simplify ways of working and identify automation opportunities, including the responsible use of AI-enabled tools to reduce manual effort, enhance reporting narratives and improve operational outcomes.
Essential Functions of the Job
Serve as the central operations and PMO support point for assigned alliance activities, ensuring priorities, workstreams, owners, timelines, risks, dependencies and follow-ups are clearly captured, tracked and progressed with discipline.
Provide assigned alliance leadership teams with timely business insights through structured reporting, dashboards and executive-ready narratives covering sales, pipeline, opportunity tagging, partner-sourced and co-sell activity, prospect tracking, key GTM wins, book of business movements, partner program measures and other relevant performance indicators.
Support governance cadence for leadership meetings, QBRs, planning forums and operational reviews by developing agendas, storyboarding content, coordinating inputs, preparing meeting materials, capturing actions and tracking closure.
Maintain and continuously refresh alliance reference materials, SharePoint content, leadership-ready presentations, internal updates and other enablement assets to improve findability, consistency, relevance and adoption across stakeholder groups.
Coordinate with Brand, Marketing and Communications teams to develop, review and maintain alliance-related content, ensuring alignment with messaging standards, stakeholder expectations and partner program requirements.
Program manage partner tools, portals and operational processes across assigned alliances, including access request tracking, issue resolution, adoption monitoring, certification and skills currency tracking, training coordination and tool administration support.
Work with alliance investment, finance, legal and enablement teams to support applicable market development fund, co-investment and related funding processes across assigned alliances, including investment tracking, compliance monitoring, periodic reviews, documentation readiness, claims support and process adherence.
Support alliance contract and governance activities, including initiation and tracking of localization of global agreements, program documentation, partner designation, distinction or specialization requirements, and related compliance actions in collaboration with the Ecosystem Contracts team and relevant business stakeholders.
Partner with onshore alliance leaders and enablement contacts across assigned alliances on strategic projects, transformation initiatives, stakeholder mapping, partner offering or marketplace coordination, event or sponsorship coordination, training interventions and other priority initiatives as required.
Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize and improve alliance operations processes through process mapping, documentation, issue analysis, control strengthening, data quality improvement and adoption of reusable templates and playbooks.
Leverage automation and responsible AI-enabled tools, where appropriate, to reduce repetitive manual activity, improve reporting turnaround time, support content drafting, enhance insight generation, improve follow-up tracking and enable scalable service delivery.
Manage stakeholder expectations, communication plans and delivery commitments with clarity, responsiveness and strong service orientation across global and regional teams.
Knowledge and Skill Requirements
Strong understanding of alliance, ecosystem or partner program operations, preferably in a professional services, technology, consulting, shared services, GCC or global capability center environment; exposure to multiple technology partners, enterprise software, cloud, data, CRM, workflow automation, low-code platforms or digital transformation ecosystems would be advantageous.
Working knowledge of sales, revenue, pipeline, opportunity lifecycle, partner program metrics, GTM motions, co-sell or referral activity, partner distinctions, specialization requirements and performance reporting, with the ability to interpret data and convert it into concise executive-ready insights.
Strong program and project management skills, including planning, tracking, governance cadence management, risk and dependency monitoring, action follow-up and management of multiple priorities with competing deadlines.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, with Power BI, Power Automate, SharePoint, workflow tools or other reporting and collaboration platforms considered an advantage.
Experience with continuous improvement, process simplification and operational excellence, including process mapping, SOP development, control documentation, audit readiness, root cause analysis and issue resolution.
Ability to identify automation opportunities and apply digital tools responsibly to improve productivity, reporting quality, follow-up discipline, knowledge management and stakeholder experience.
Practical exposure to generative AI tools for research, content development, summarization, insight generation, workflow support and productivity enhancement; preferable exposure to Agentic AI concepts, AI-enabled process automation, AI agents or Copilot-style productivity tools.
Strong stakeholder management capability, with the ability to engage senior onshore stakeholders, anticipate needs, manage expectations and build trusted advisor relationships across functions and geographies.
Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, including business writing, executive presentation development, narrative building and the ability to create high-quality content with limited initial guidance.
Strong analytical thinking, problem solving, research capability and attention to detail, with the ability to work across multiple teams to drive practical and timely resolution.
Experience working in virtual, matrixed and multi-geography environments with cultural sensitivity, collaboration discipline and a global mindset.
KNowledge of EY and GDS operations, organization structure, operating model, management information systems and independence concepts for internal candidates; Big 4, consulting, technology or leadership support exposure for external candidates would be preferred.
Job Requirements Academics
MBA, postgraduate qualification, or equivalent professional experience preferred.
Bachelors degree required; degree in business, technology, engineering, commerce, or a related discipline preferred.
Project/program management certification, process improvement certification, or relevant alliance, partner program, technology partner or enterprise software certification would be an added advantage.
Relevant certifications or digital badges in generative AI, responsible AI, AI-enabled productivity, prompt engineering, automation, analytics, or Agentic AI concepts would be highly desirable, particularly where they demonstrate practical application in business operations, reporting, process improvement, knowledge management, or stakeholder enablement.

At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
EY-ServiceNow Supervising Associate (Product Delivery Manager Now Assist & HRSD) Role Overview
The ServiceNow Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the end-to-end management and delivery of one or more ServiceNow technology solutions within EY. The role ensures that solutions are aligned with the overall EY ServiceNow strategy, integrate effectively within the enterprise technology ecosystem, and consistently deliver high-quality business outcomes.
As the primary representative and advocate of ET ServiceNow, the Product Delivery Manager is accountable for the success of assigned products and services. This includes ownership of product planning, roadmap development, backlog prioritization, stakeholder engagement, and delivery oversight throughout the product lifecycle. The Product Delivery Manager is accountable for evaluating emerging ServiceNow capabilities, aligning them with business objectives, driving stakeholder awareness and adoption through demonstrations and consultations, and establishing a prioritized roadmap and implementation backlog to maximize platform value.
The role of Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the end-to-end management and delivery of ServiceNow solutions focusing on HR Service Delivery as well as Now Assist capabilities (including AI agents, agentic workflows and now assist skills). In addition, this role would lead implementations to make ServiceNow as an orchestrator to call multiple AI agents within and outside of ServiceNow using Model Context Protocol (MCP) or Agent-to-Agent protocol (A2A) to allow ServiceNow agents to invoke external data sets and APIs.
The Product Delivery Manager ensures that solutions are delivered in accordance with governance standards, within agreed timelines and budgets, and meet quality, security, and user experience expectation.
Key Responsibilities Product Strategy & Lifecycle Management:
Ensure products align with the EY ServiceNow strategy and broader enterprise technology objectives.
Evaluate new ServiceNow platform capabilities and features, assess business value, and drive adoption opportunities.
Develop and maintain the product implementation backlog based on business priorities and platform capabilities.
Stakeholder Management:
Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor between ET ServiceNow and business stakeholders.
Collaborate with business teams to understand requirements, challenges, and strategic objectives.
Translate business needs into scalable ServiceNow solutions while promoting platform best practices and standardization.
Work with multiple stakeholders/ vendors to clear business/ technical impediments/ blockers
Product backlog and Planning:
Own and govern the product backlog, ensuring alignment with business priorities and strategic goals
Work closely with Product Owners to define, prioritize, and refine features, enhancements, and technical requirements
Balance business demands with platform capabilities, technical constraints, and long-term solution sustainability (strong functional understanding of ServiceNow is a must. Development experience expected).
Delivery Management:
Successfully execute the project to agreed schedule, budget and scope
Manage the demand process
Monitor risks, dependencies, and delivery milestones, implementing mitigation plans as required.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams, including architecture, development, testing, operations, and vendors.
Coordinate UAT and production go-live
Governance and Continuous improvement:
Establish and maintain governance processes for product performance, quality, and compliance.
Track product KPIs, adoption metrics, and customer satisfaction measures.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives to optimize business processes and maximize platform value.
Innovation and Platform enablement:
Stay current with ServiceNow roadmap developments and emerging platform capabilities.
Demonstrate new features and innovations to business stakeholders and leadership teams.
Identify opportunities to improve user experience, operational efficiency, and business outcomes through ServiceNow.
Knowledge and Skills Requirements:
Bachelors degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field
3+ years of hands-on experience in ServiceNow development.
Understanding of ITIL processes and HR Services
Understanding of conversational experiences, virtual agents, knowledge management, and self-service adoption strategies.
Implementation expertise of Now Assist capabilities (out of box and custom skills), agentic workflow and AI agents
Experience in configuring out of box agentic workflows and implementing custom AI agents
Understanding of A2A and MCP protocols
Deep functional knowledge of LLMs, agentic patterns and API integration paths (REST)
Advanced comprehension of agile SAFe project management methodology, tools and templates (includes project planning, schedule development, scope management and cost management)
Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills
ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification
What are we looking for?
A team player and leader with strong technical acumen and leadership capabilities
Proactive problem-solving mindset with a focus on operational excellence
Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities in a fast-paced environment
Passion to learn and adapt to new technologies
Strong functional/ technical understanding of HRSD and ITSM applications.
