Role Title
Learning Deployment Specialist
Role objectives and key accountabilities
Exciting opportunity to join the Talent Development function as a learning specialist. You will be responsible for the deployment of courses and learning based projects across Talent Development. The role includes managing the end-to-end deployment process, supporting learning budgets and monitoring compliance and attendance. Providing oversight of learning administration activities working alongside Senior Learning Associates and Learning Program Managers depending on portfolio.
Your key responsibilities Learning / Project Deployment
Build initial course scheduling offering schedule for review
Submit requests to Schedule Offerings and to publish content in SuccessFactors
Support the end-to-end execution of Learning course deployment plans and budgets, including conference and event management including:
Arranging training material
Monitoring of participant nominations working alongside Deployment Administration team
Management of learner cancellations, no shows and missed sessions, including coordinating training dates and nominations from different areas of the business (such as UKI UK, UKI ROI, UKFS, ROI FS, Channel Islands)
First point of contact for queries from the practice in relation to the courses assigned, in addition to ongoing management of learning mailboxes and referrals from Deployment Administration team
Prepare facilitators for delivery of Learning courses (logistics) and support in the management of facilitators
Provide oversight of Learning deployment administration activities, taking responsibility for the detailed review of work performed by the Deployment Administration team assigned.
Manage and maintain SharePoint sites and maintain content relevancy for SL, curriculum, program or course including joining instructions (if required), learner, facilitator information
Support the hosting and production of online modules, webcasts and virtual learning projects. Advise on best practice, for example interactivity during virtual classroom sessions.
vILT producer role where vILT team cant support
Learning on-site support (as required)
Realise operational excellence through maintaining thorough understanding of, and adherence to, the Learning Deployment Operating Model
Ideas generation and rollout of networking elements within virtual learning programmes
Venue booking, accommodation booking for residential courses and ongoing management
Ensure CE credits awarded to Learning participants and instructors where applicable
Supporting on projects across the Learning and/or Leadership Development TD team(s) as required
Financial Management
Support the budget, accruals, forecasts, and actual costs of courses/projects you are responsible for, supporting all Finance related activities as per the Deployment model
Support with monthly/annual finance activities/requests from Enablement/Operations team.
Stakeholder Relationships
Build and maintain close working relationships with onshore and offshore colleagues.
Build and maintain close working relationships with Deployment Administration team (where relevant). Coach and support the Deployment Administration team to increase their knowledge, skills and competence within their role along with their understanding of the region, by providing transparent and supportive feedback.
Develop and maintain relationships with key stakeholders relevant for courses and client group, to enable the successful deployment. Stakeholders may include Deployment Admininistration team, Portfolio Managers, Senior Learning Associates, Learning Associates, Enablement team, Service Line Talent Development Teams, Global deployment team, Facilitators, external suppliers.
Measure Learning
Access reports on Learning course L1 L3 evaluation feedback and analyse feedback from course participants to continually improve course offerings
Accurate reporting and tracking of course consumption and satisfaction reporting
Continuous Improvement
Document lessons learned and refine deployment processes.
Stay updated on SuccessFactors features and best practices in learning deployment
Generate new ideas/suggest improvements/possible solutions
Team
Contribute to other activities or projects across the wider Talent Development function
Support the induction of new team members
Skills and attributes for success To qualify for the role you must have
Proactive problem solver with solutions mindset
Flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and manage multiple tasks simultaneously
Strong IT skills Word, Excel, Outlook, SharePoint
Ability to learn new processes and skills quickly
Strong written and oral communication skills and ability to work effectively with multiple stakeholders across the organisation at all levels
Strong team worker, with enthusiastic, can-do approach, with ability to coordinate and work as one team
Commercial acumen and business awareness
Desire to deliver quality services
Experience in stakeholder management / business consulting
Ability to engage and influence others, desire to embrace and drive change
Strong project management skills to deliver and ensure seamless execution of portfolio tasks
Expertise in curating and maintaining knowledge resources, including documentation and SharePoint sites, to enhance accessibility and usability for participants.
Experience in establishing and managing key stakeholder relationships, including External Vendors and key internal stakeholders

Job Title: GDS Alliances Systems Integrator (SI) Ops Coordinator Job Summary
The GDS Systems Integrator (SI) Ops Coordinator will function out of the GDS Alliances Delivery Center and will be responsible for providing ongoing operations support for one or more Systems Integrator alliances as part of the broader Ecosystem Relationship Enablement function. The incumbent will help co-develop and thereafter operationalize the operations support delivery model for a single SI relationship or a combination of SI relationships, ensuring seamless service delivery for ongoing initiatives, governance, reporting, stakeholder coordination and special projects assigned from time to time. The role will partner with onshore alliance operations contacts, SI relationship leaders and cross-functional teams on strategic projects and initiatives as required.
Responsibilities
Provide operational support for strategic Systems Integrator alliances and ecosystem programs across planning, governance, reporting and execution activities.
Provide SI alliance leadership with effective dashboard reporting and business insights, including revenue, wins, pipeline, opportunities, investments, benefits utilization and ad-hoc data reporting requests.
Support recurring alliance governance forums, including pre-meeting, in-meeting and post-meeting support such as agenda formation, meeting deck collation, storyboarding, content curation/design, summary notes and action tracking.
Coordinate SI alliance business reviews, leadership meetings, workshops and operating reviews by managing logistics, content development, stakeholder follow-ups and closure of actions.
Support SI alliance annual planning, revenue planning, investment planning and benefits utilization tracking across area/region and global stakeholders.
Coordinate with client-serving teams and global alliance supporting teams on sales, pipeline tagging, reporting hygiene and opportunity tracking.
Maintain SI alliance reference material, playbooks, process documents and SharePoint repositories; facilitate and track access to key materials and tools.
Coordinate with Brand, Marketing and Communications (BMC) teams to develop, review and refresh relevant SI alliance content as required.
Support contracts initiation, tracking, supplier onboarding and operational workflows by coordinating with global alliance teams and relevant enabling teams.
Drive continuous process improvement by identifying opportunities for automation, standardization, simplification and improved operating rhythm across SI alliance operations.
Support executive leadership requests, special projects and strategic operational initiatives as assigned from time to time.
Knowledge and Skill Requirements
Strong understanding of alliance operations, ecosystem relationships, business operations and executive reporting processes.
Exposure to sales and pipeline reporting, opportunity life cycle concepts, revenue planning and alliance performance reporting.
Excellent MS Excel and PowerPoint skills; Power BI skills would be an added advantage.
Ability to create executive-ready dashboards, presentations, meeting materials and leadership summaries with limited guidance.
Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to work with senior onshore stakeholders and build trusted business advisor relationships.
Job Requirements
Academics: MBA, Business Administration, Commerce, Finance or related discipline; equivalent operational management experience may be considered.
Experience: 8-10 years of relevant work experience in alliance operations, business operations, program management, reporting, sales operations or strategic operations.
Working Hours: Flexibility to support global stakeholders and US/APAC business requirements.

Job Summary
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
Role
AI Governance Operations & Platform Lead
Role Purpose
The AI Governance Operations & Platform Lead is responsible for operationalizing EY's AI Governance framework across all AI and Generative AI solutions developed, deployed, or consumed within the organization. This role serves as the Product Owner and Operational Lead for the AI Governance platform, built on ServiceNow, ensuring governance requirements, risk assessments, controls, and compliance obligations are consistently implemented, monitored, and evidenced throughout the AI lifecycle.
Role Summary
Lead the operational execution of EY's AI Governance framework by owning the ServiceNow-based governance platform, ensuring AI solutions comply with governance requirements, controls, and risk management standards while enabling scalable, automated, and effective governance
Key Responsibilities AI Governance Operations
Operationalize EY's AI Governance framework across all AI, GenAI, Machine Learning, and intelligent automation solutions.
Ensure governance controls are embedded throughout the AI lifecycle, from ideation and development through deployment, monitoring, and retirement.
Drive onboarding of AI solutions into the governance platform and ensure compliance with mandatory governance requirements.
Facilitate execution of AI risk assessments, control evaluations, approvals, and periodic compliance reviews.
Monitor governance compliance metrics and identify control gaps, policy deviations, and remediation requirements.
Support audits, regulatory reviews, and internal compliance assessments related to AI governance.
AI Governance Platform Ownership
Serve as Product Owner for the ServiceNow-based AI Governance platform.
Define and prioritize platform roadmap, enhancements, user stories, and functional requirements.
Ensure governance workflows, approval processes, and control assessment mechanisms remain aligned to evolving business and regulatory requirements.
Manage platform configuration, testing, release planning, user adoption, and operational support.
Work with ServiceNow development teams to implement new governance capabilities and integrations.
Drive automation of governance activities wherever possible to improve operational efficiency and compliance monitoring.
AI Risk & Controls Management
Support management and execution of the AI Risk and Controls Matrix (RACM).
Ensure governance controls are mapped to applicable AI risks and regulatory obligations.
Monitor control implementation status and effectiveness across AI solutions.
Support implementation of Responsible AI principles, AI control standards, and compliance requirements.
Maintain governance evidence and reporting needed to demonstrate adherence to enterprise AI policies.
Stakeholder Engagement
Partner with AI product owners, engineering teams, architecture teams, across ET, CT and Info Sec, privacy, legal, risk management, and business stakeholders.
Translate governance policies and standards into practical platform workflows and operational processes.
Gather business requirements and convert them into governance platform capabilities.
Facilitate governance review meetings and provide guidance on compliance obligations and control requirements.
Act as the primary point of contact for platform-related governance inquiries.
Reporting & Continuous Improvement
Develop governance dashboards, metrics, and executive reporting.
Track platform adoption, governance coverage, control compliance, and remediation activities.
Drive continuous improvement of governance processes, controls, and platform functionality.
Benchmark governance practices against industry standards and emerging regulations.
Required Qualifications & Experience
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Risk Management, or related discipline.
20+ years of experience in governance, risk management, compliance, IT controls, ServiceNow, or enterprise platform management.
Experience working with enterprise governance, compliance, workflow, or GRC platforms.
Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Experience managing process implementation across large, complex organizations.
Preferred Knowledge
AI Governance and Responsible AI frameworks
AI Risk & Controls Matrix (RACM)
AI Control Frameworks and AI Control Plans (AICP)
AI risk assessment methodologies
AI lifecycle governance processes
Regulatory frameworks such as EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, and emerging AI regulations
ServiceNow platform capabilities, workflows, and integrations
Technology risk, cybersecurity, privacy, and compliance management
Key Competencies
Product Ownership
Governance & Controls Management
ServiceNow Platform Expertise
Stakeholder Management
Business Analysis
Risk & Compliance Management
Process Design & Automation
Data-Driven Decision Making
Communication & Influencing Skills

Description:
Job Summary
At EY, youll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And were counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
EY- Cyber Security Infrastructure Security Manager
As part of our EY Cyber Security team, you will manage infrastructure security engagements and support the design, integration and implementation of solutions that enhance service delivery and enable technology-driven transformation for our clients. You will coordinate delivery teams, manage engagement activities, maintain quality standards, and coach junior team members to support their professional development.
The opportunity
Were looking for an Infrastructure Security professional with a solution-oriented mindset, strong security engineering knowledge, and experience managing network security architecture and implementation engagements. The role requires the ability to translate client requirements into practical solutions, coordinate technical delivery, manage risks and stakeholders, and contribute to the rollout of next-generation, market-relevant security services.
Your key responsibilities
Manage the design, architecture, assessment and implementation of network security solutions across on-premises and cloud environments.
Gather business and technical requirements, develop solution approaches, and oversee preparation and review of high-level and low-level design documentation.
Lead workstreams covering next-generation firewalls, IPS/IDS, VPN, NAC, SD-WAN, DDoS protection, wireless security, WAF, secure web gateways and proxy solutions.
Provide technical oversight for solutions involving Palo Alto Networks, Check Point, Fortinet, Zscaler and comparable infrastructure security technologies.
Manage solution deployment, configuration, integration, testing, transition and operational-readiness activities in accordance with agreed scope and quality expectations.
Support Zero Trust architecture and implementation initiatives, including segmentation and micro-segmentation solutions such as Guardicore and Illumio.
Review network and platform security designs to confirm alignment with security principles, client standards, regulatory obligations and leading practices.
Manage engagement plans, delivery milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, budgets and status reporting, escalating material concerns when required.
Coordinate with client stakeholders, architects, engineers, vendors and other delivery teams to resolve technical and operational challenges.
Review network drawings, configuration standards, implementation procedures, test evidence and operational documentation for completeness and quality.
Contribute to proposals, statements of work, solution demonstrations, effort estimates and other business-development activities.
Coach team members, allocate work, review deliverables and promote consistent use of delivery methodologies, reusable assets and automation.
Skills and attributes for success
Strong technical knowledge of infrastructure and network security architecture, engineering and operations.
Ability to manage multiple workstreams and deliver high-quality outcomes within agreed scope, schedule and budget.
Sound understanding of infrastructure security services, governance models, operating models, controls and delivery methodologies.
Ability to build trusted relationships with client managers, technical leads, vendors and internal stakeholders.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, facilitation, presentation and decision-making skills.
Ability to communicate technical risks, architecture decisions and delivery concerns clearly to technical and business stakeholders.
Experience supervising technical teams, reviewing deliverables, providing constructive feedback and supporting capability development.
Commercial awareness and the ability to support scoping, effort estimation, resource planning and engagement financial management.
A proactive, adaptable and collaborative approach in a fast-paced consulting environment.
Ability to create and deliver domain-specific training and knowledge-sharing sessions.
Understanding of automation opportunities that improve security operations, service quality and delivery efficiency.
Willingness to travel and work flexibly when required by client or engagement needs.
To qualify for the role, you must have
12+ years of Information Technology experience, including significant experience in infrastructure or network security and at least 5 years leading technical workstreams or small delivery teams.
Strong experience in security engineering, architecture assessments, solution design and implementation.
Hands-on knowledge of firewalls, VPN, NAC, SD-WAN, WAF, proxy, IPS/IDS, DDoS protection, EDR/XDR and related controls.
Experience deploying, maintaining or operating one or more enterprise network security platforms.
Working knowledge of Zero Trust principles, segmentation, micro-segmentation and secure access architectures.
Understanding of cloud security architecture and hybrid infrastructure security considerations.
Demonstrated experience managing client expectations, project risks, delivery quality and technical documentation.
A consultative and pragmatic approach to solving security and technology challenges.
Ideally, youll also have
Excellent verbal and written communication, technical documentation and stakeholder-management skills.
Strong project management, negotiation, team leadership and interpersonal capabilities.
Prior experience in advisory, professional services, system integration or technology consulting.
Customer-focused mindset with experience contributing to proposals, estimations and solution presentations.
Relevant professional certification such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, SABSA, TOGAF, PRINCE2 or a leading vendor security certification.
What we look for
A manager with strong technical credibility, commercial awareness and the ability to lead teams in a fast-moving consulting environment.
A collaborative professional who can work effectively with multidisciplinary teams and global EY Consulting practices across industries.
A delivery-focused individual who takes ownership of engagement outcomes, quality, team performance and client satisfaction.
Someone able to contribute to go-to-market activities, RFP responses, solution development and effort estimation.
A confident facilitator who can lead cyber security discussions with subject-matter experts, client managers, senior stakeholders and enterprise architects.

Role Overview
The ServiceNow Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the end-to-end management and delivery of one or more ServiceNow technology solutions within EY. The role ensures that solutions are aligned with the overall EY ServiceNow strategy, integrate effectively within the enterprise technology ecosystem, and consistently deliver high-quality business outcomes.
As the primary representative and advocate of ET ServiceNow, the Product Delivery Manager is accountable for the success of assigned products and services. This includes ownership of product planning, roadmap development, backlog prioritization, stakeholder engagement, and delivery oversight throughout the product lifecycle. The Product Delivery Manager is accountable for evaluating emerging ServiceNow capabilities, aligning them with business objectives, driving stakeholder awareness and adoption through demonstrations and consultations, and establishing a prioritized roadmap and implementation backlog to maximize platform value.
The Moveworks Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the successful implementation, adoption, and ongoing evolution of the Moveworks platform across the enterprise. The role is responsible for evaluating new Moveworks features and innovations, assessing their applicability to business needs, driving stakeholder awareness and adoption, and prioritizing implementation initiatives that maximize value realization. Description:
The opportunity
The Incident Orchestrator is responsible for coordinating, driving, and governing the execution of security incidents identified by the SOC. The role ensures that incidents are triaged correctly, escalated appropriately, and resolved within defined SLAs, acting as the central coordination point between SOC analysts, threat detection teams, IT responders, and incident response leadership.
The role operates in accordance with the enterprise Incident Response Plan and Policy, supporting structured, repeatable, and auditable incident handling
Your key responsibilities
Own the end to end coordination of security incidents from initial escalation through containment, remediation, and closure.
Act as the single point of coordination between L1/L2 SOC analysts, threat detection teams, IT teams, and incident response stakeholders
Ensure incidents are classified, prioritized, and handled in line with the approved Incident Response Policy and severity model
Validate escalated alerts and incidents to confirm true positives and business impact before response actions are initiated
Drive containment and mitigation actions by coordinating with relevant resolver groups (endpoint, network, identity, cloud, etc.)
Manage incident bridges / war rooms during major incidents, ensuring clear ownership and timely updates.
Ensure all incident activities are accurately documented in the designated incident management / ticketing platform
Prepare and deliver incident status updates, timelines, and summaries for SOC leadership and stakeholders.
Support post incident reviews (PIRs) by compiling evidence, timelines, and response effectiveness inputs.
Ensure SOC incident handling follows defined playbooks, runbooks, and SOPs.
Identify process gaps, recurring issues, and response inefficiencies, and recommend improvements to SOC and IR leadership
Act as an escalation point for complex or ambiguous incidents that require senior operational judgment.
Review and improve incident response processes and playbooks.
Participate and/or lead incident response calls.
Participate in post-incident reviews to assess the effectiveness of the response and identify areas for improvement.
Provide guidance and mentorship to lower-level incident responders.
To qualify for the role, you must have
Experience with digital forensics tools and techniques to investigate incidents.
Proficient in utilizing SIEM solutions such as Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, LogScale, Google Chronicle, IBM QRadar, or equivalent tools for effective incident response and analysis.
Experienced in leveraging EDR/XDR solutions like CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender, SentinelOne, Cortex XSIAM, Carbon Black, or similar platforms
Understanding of security principles, techniques, and technologies such as SANS Top 20 Critical Security Controls and OWASP Top 10
Understanding of attack lifecycles and incident response phases (identify, contain, eradicate, recover).
In-depth knowledge of network protocols, operating systems, and security technologies.
Proficiency in incident detection and response tools
Familiarity with malware analysis and reverse engineering.
Proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., Python, PowerShell) for automating tasks and processes.
Ideal candidate will have 5+ years of security related experience in areas such Security Operations, Incident Response, and Forensic Investigation.
Analytical mindset & has the aptitude to learn on the fly.
Willingness to work in a 24/7 operations center (shift work required)
Strong problem-solving abilities to analyze complex incidents.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Ideally, youll also have
Bachelors Degree relevant to Information Technology
Related Certification such as CEH, CHFI, Sec+, ITILv3, GCFA, ECIH, GCIH, CySA+, etc

Job Summary
At EY, youll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And were counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
The opportunity
This role offers the opportunity to enhance, support, and scale AI agentic solutions built using Python, FastAPI, and LangGraph. As a Senior AI Automation Engineer, you will play also play a key role in identifying automation opportunities, improving existing agent workflows, and strengthening backend services that power intelligent, automated AI systems.
Your key responsibilities
Enhance, optimize, and maintain backend services supporting AI agentic workflows
Build scalable REST APIs using FastAPI with strong validation and async features
Develop, refine, and troubleshoot multi-step agent workflows using LangGraph
Identify automation opportunities across AI applications and implement scalable solutions
Containerize and deploy services using Docker and Docker Compose
Write clean, maintainable Python code with robust unit tests (pytest/unittest)
Design and manage database schemas and integrations for MongoDB and PostgreSQL
Investigate performance issues across backend and agentic systems
Skills and attributes for success
Strong analytical mindset with the ability to spot automation opportunities
Deep debugging capability across backend services and AI agent workflows
Ability to design modular, scalable backend components
Proactive ownership and strong collaboration skills
Comfort working in fast-paced, innovative AI environments
To qualify for the role, you must have
Degree in Engineering, IT, Computer Science
Core Python
Strong foundation in Lists, Dictionaries, Tuples, Sets, and OOP (classes, inheritance, composition).
Experience in writing modular, performant code with profiling and debugging skills.
Knowledge of virtual environments, dependency management, and unit testing.
Hands-on experience with MongoDB and PostgreSQL schema design.
FastAPI & Backend Development
Proven experience building production APIs with FastAPI.
Proficiency in async/await, Pydantic models, and token-based authentication.
Working knowledge of Docker, Docker Compose, YAML setups, and container networking.
LangGraph
Experience building multi-step agent workflows (nodes, edges, state management).
Ability to manage conversation state, context propagation, retries, and fallbacks.
Strong debugging capability for agent failures and execution tracing.
Ideally, youll also have
Experience with microservices architectures.
Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure).
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines.
Experience with LLM-based or AI automation products.
What we look for
A problem-solver passionate about AI-driven automation.
Someone who takes ownership and thrives in innovative environments.
A team player committed to building scalable AI systems with precision and quality.

Job Title
ECM Senior 1-2 Consulting
The opportunity
EY GDS Consulting digital is looking out for experienced web content management expert, especially on Microsoft Office365. Resource will be part of Enterprise Content Management team delivering to clients across regions.
Your key responsibilities
Produces high-quality solution or infrastructure deliverables in accordance with project timelines and specifications, using sound coding and programming skills
Performs coding, debugging, testing and troubleshooting throughout the development process contributing to moderately complex aspects of a project
Maintains and enhances systems by fixing complicated errors, raising risks and escalating issues where necessary
Works with users to capture detailed requirements, translating designs and solution architecture into design specifications
Monitors and reports on potential risks/opportunities of emerging technologies, and seeks areas for continuous improvement
Ensures all activities adhere to the relevant processes, procedures, standards and technical design
Develop and promote best practices for usage, operations and development
Strong analytical and communication skills with intense drive to learn and adopt.
Skills and attributes
4-7 years development in O365 implementation.
Must have strong analytical and technical skills using SharePoint SPFx, C#, ASP.Net with MVC, JavaScript, and a variety of tools to deliver client-side solutions within Office 365.
Strong knowledge in SharePoint Architecture Design (Extranet & Intranet).
Must have good experience in SharePoint Framework (SPFx) & Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate) solutions.
Good experience in JavaScript, TypeScript, React JS, AngularJS, Fluent UI, Knockout JS, HTML5, CSS, Ajax, JSON, jQuery etc.
Core Skills:
SharePoint: SPFx, PnP Framework, PowerShell
.net . React and azure functions
Power Platform: Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Power Virtual Agents
Dataverse: Data modeling, APIs, integration with Power Platform
Web API Integration: REST, SOAP, authentication (OAuth, OpenID Connect)
PCF Controls: React, TypeScript, PCF control framework
Desirable Skills:
Microsoft Purview: Data governance, DLP, information protection
Microsoft Syntex: AI-driven content processing, document understanding, classification, and generation
AI Builder: Custom AI models, integration with Power Platform
Microsoft 365 Copilot: Integration with M365 apps
Azure DevOps: CI/CD, source control
Microsoft Teams: App development, integration
Passion for the web, open source development, and for helping us build meaningful experiences.
Experience in consulting strongly preferred.
Strong problem-solving abilities, taking initiative, and the ability to thrive under pressure.
Maintain a positive and constructive outlook, focus on driving results, finding solutions / breakthroughs to solve problems and challenges; has a positive influence on peers.
Interpersonal and communication skills.
Respond positively to opportunities to be involved in brainstorming and iterative work. Handle times of change in a way that drives innovation and iteration.
Work in collaborative and supportive manner.
Listen carefully to provided information and ask clarifying questions. Actively listen as a learner rather than a passive recipient of information.
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or related discipline preferred.
Soft Skills
Excellent Communication Skills
Team Player
Self-starter and highly motivated
Ability to handle high pressure and fast paced situations
Excellent presentation skills
Ability to work with globally distributed teams
To qualify for the role
A bachelor's or master's degree
A minimum of 8+ years of experience, preferably background in a professional services firm.
Strong knowledge of SharePoint 2013/2016/2019/o365
Strong knowledge of SharePoint Framework (SPFx), Power Apps & Power Automate.
Strong knowledge of TypeScript, React JS, AngularJS & Fluent UI.
Strong knowledge of PowerShell & PnP.
Excellent communication skills with consulting experience preferred
Ideally, you'll also have
Analytical ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize tasks into manageable work products.
Can operate independently or with minimum supervision

Job Summary
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
Associate 66.2 USRM Enablement
This opportunity is in the global operations teams of EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) which is rapidly growing. As our efforts towards building a better working world, GDS operations need to create an evolving framework of CRM Operational excellence framework control in all processes, decision making and activities for GDS operations to enable our business teams across locations.
As an Associate Risk Management Analyst, you will take on a more advanced role in supporting the risk management department. Building on the foundational skills developed at the Associate level, you will have increased responsibilities in managing risk management tools, performing more complex tasks related to client and engagement acceptance, and contributing to the continuous improvement of risk management processes. You will also mentor junior team members and provide more in-depth analysis and reporting.
Your key responsibilities
Support CPA (Certified Public Accountant) Licensing Compliance operations through mailbox management, inquiry handling, and license validation activities.
Perform validation of CPA licenses and related compliance requirements using internal and external regulatory sources.
Process licensing requests, renewals, jurisdiction updates, and compliance-related documentation.
Monitor and maintain operational dashboards, reports, and trackers to ensure data accuracy and timely status reporting.
Investigate and resolve employee inquiries while escalating complex issues as appropriate.
Collaborate with onshore and offshore stakeholders to ensure service levels and quality standards are met.
Contribute to process improvement initiatives, documentation updates, and knowledge-sharing activities.
Support ad hoc projects and reporting requirements while maintaining compliance with established policies and procedures.
Ensure accurate record keeping, timely communication, and adherence to regulatory and internal compliance requirements
Qualification, Skills, and attributes for success
Bachelors degree in finance, business, risk management, or a related field.
1-3 years of experience in risk management, finance, or a related area.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel.
Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
Experience with risk management tools and systems is highly desirable.
Excellent communication and leadership skills.
This is a hybrid role.
What we look for
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
Proactive approach to identifying and solving problems.
Strong mentoring and leadership capabilities.
What we offer
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We'll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
Continuous learning: You'll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you: We'll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership: We'll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: You'll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
EY | Building a better working world
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

As the leading bank in Asia, DBS Consumer Banking Group is in a unique position to help our customers realise their dreams and ambitions. As a market leader in the consumer banking business, DBS has a full spectrum of products and services, including deposits, investments, insurance, mortgages, credit cards and personal loans, to help our customers realise their dreams and aspirations at every life stage. Our financial solutions are not only the best in the business they were made just right for you.
Job Purpose
Drive overall business of the branch by ensuring exceptional customer service, proactive sales environment, seamless back-office operations and overall profitable branch
Enhance existing relationships with customers and build new relationships to increase the customer base
Ensure compliance with all applicable external and internal regulations and guidelines
Key Accountabilities
Drive implementation of the overall Bank strategy at branch level (asset and liability, marketing, sales, operations) in consultation with the Cluster Head
Develop and implement branch specific marketing & communication strategies to build DBS brand and to achieve branch targets
Owner of Branch P&L, Cascade the branch scorecard to branch and sales employees to ensure achievement of targets
Develop and ensure adherence to the operating budget for the branch in line with the corporate and regional budget
Job Duties and Responsibilities
Generate sales through assets, liability and other banking products as well as TPP
Monitor on a regular basis the actual achievement of sales targets vis--vis plans for the branch; take necessary action to minimize deviations, if any
Build and manage effective customer relationship with key customers tagged to him/her; enable superior customer service to them; Advise them on making robust investment and financial decisions
Reduce customer dormancy and customer attrition
Ensure branch target achievement through effective upselling and cross selling
Develop the business prospects in the branch vicinity by scouting for avenues to expand overall branch book, both assets & liability portfolio qualitatively & quantitatively
Ensure effective execution of marketing campaigns and conversion of customer referrals
Drive Business growth through prospective high net worth individuals, along with Relationship managers to maintain positive relationships
Address customer queries and grievances escalated by the branch personnel in a timely manner
Ensure Lead sharing with respective Business like IBG for Assets etc.
Manage public relations and liaison with local government authorities / RBI/ other banks for day to day branch operations and reporting
Support the internal and external audit team in carrying out the periodic branch audit; Formulate action plans to address the deviations found in audit
Provide guidance to branch personnel on effective customer relationship management, sales, customer service and compliance to ensure achievement of individual targets.
Take overall responsibility for identification of training needs and completion of mandatory certifications for branch personnel
Drive a performance driven culture in the team by timely monitoring, review of performance parameters and feedback to the team members
Required Experience
6-8 years in handling Branch of a reputed Bank
Education / Preferred Qualifications
MBA
Core Competencies
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
Ability to build strong relationships with clients.
Responsible
Ability to meet deadlines.
Knowledge about internal/external regulations.
Technical Competencies
Good Computer Knowledge
Work Relationship
Effective communication between self and superior
Inter-personal skills & team player
Display of RED Attitude (Reliable, Easy to deal with & Dependable)
DBS India - Culture & Behaviors
DBS is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and their opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working, and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Expected value driven behaviors are:
Ensure Customer Focus by Delighting Customers & Reduce Complaints
Build Pride and Passion to Protect, Maintain and Enhance DBS’ Reputation
Enhance Self Knowledge, Skills and develop Competencies aimed at continuous improvement
Maintain the Highest Standards of Honesty and Integrity

US LD Compliance operations Project - Job Summary
EY- ES - LD Hub - US LD Compliance Operations Associate
As part of our ES - LD Hub, Learning Compliance Management Associate works to support and manage the various educational requirements for Firm professionals. The role has a deep understanding of Service Line (SL) Learning Framework. This role also supports the learner communications program and helps monitor adherence to the Firm s education policies to ensure its client serving professionals maintain a high degree of compliance.
The principal objectives will be to ensure that consistent, and high-quality service is provided by the team by taking end-to-end project ownership and accomplishing the define goals.
The opportunity
We re looking for candidates with knowledge and capability to ensure effective output of process requirements and protocols and eager to grow in the organization.
We re looking for incumbents who should continually look for improvement and opportunities to add value and follow a proactive approach.
Your Key Responsibilities:
Assists in monitoring compliance with the continuing education compliance process
Assist in requesting learning assignments, communicate learning requirements to individuals, Track registrations and completions based on reporting.
Deep knowledge of Service Line Learning Frameworks
Supports Learning Compliance communication process
Understands the need for change initiatives and is a positive advocate for necessary changes as relates to the process.
Identifies and leverages opportunities to enhance or develop the process in order to achieve stated goals.
Ability to build client relationships so that expectations are met or exceeded by advising what to expect and by when, and through listening and responding to client s needs.
Understands key requirements of rules and firm policies and is knowledgeable about other areas outside of own area.
Demonstrates general technical knowledge and keeps abreast of emerging knowledge, trends and lessons learned regarding learning compliance and related areas. Translates this knowledge into action plans and recommendations as appropriate.
Skills and attributes for success:
Strong written and verbal communications skills
Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint)
Excellent teaming and interpersonal skills.
Positive attitude and ability to excel under tight timelines.
Able to successfully handle multiple tasks
To qualify for the role, candidates must have:
Bachelors degree; or equivalent work experience with 1-3 plus years relevant work experience
Should be flexible to work in UK shift timings, including late evening hours.
Ideally, you ll also have
Good interpersonal, organizational, and responsive customer service skills with an attention to detail
Ability to manage and meet deadlines
Strong analytical skills to grasp complexities and perceive relationships between problems and issues
Flexibility
Position will interface with executive leaders and must be able to demonstrate expanded knowledge of learning Compliance functional area while communicating process/es, identifying, and providing solutions for mitigating risk factors
Knowledge of data visualization technologies such as Power BI preferred
Overtime will be required throughout the year and will vary based on volume of work in the pipeline.
What we look for:
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
An opportunity to be part of a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
Opportunity to work with EY GDS Enablement services practice globally with leading businesses across a range of industries
What we Offer:

Description:
JOB SUMMARY
Entry level management position that is responsible for leading and assisting with the successful completion of daily shift requirements. Front office areas include Bell/Door Staff, Switchboard and Guest Services/Front Desk. Strives to ensure guest and employee satisfaction and achieve the operating budget. Assists in completing ficial and administrative responsibilities.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the guest services, front desk, or related professional area.
OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Supporting Management of Front Desk Team
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound ficial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Encourages and building mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
- Serves as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
- Supports all day-to-day operations.
- Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
- Coaches, counsels and encourages employees.
- Handles employee questions and concerns.
- Supports all areas of the Front Office in the absence of the Front Office or Front Desk Manager.
- Guides daily Front Desk shift operations.
- Communicates performance expectations to employees in accordance with job descriptions for each position.
Monitoring and Supporting Progress Toward Guest Services and Front Desk Goals
- Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
- Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.
- Handles complaints, settling disputes, and resolving grievances and conflicts, or otherwise negotiating with others.
- Participates in department meetings and continually communicates a clear and consistent message regarding the Front Desk goals to produce desired results.
- Strives to improve service performance.
- Supervises staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and ficial objectives are met.
- Trains staff on adherence to all credit policies and procedures to reduce bad debts and rebates.
- Supervises same day selling procedures to maximize room revenue and property occupancy.
- Understands the impact of Front Desk operations on the overall property ficial goals and objectives.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service within guidelines.
- Handles guest problems and complaints seeking assistance from supervisor as necessary.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
Managing Projects and Policies
- Implementing the customer recognition/service program, communicating and ensuring the process.
- Assists in the review of comment cards and guest satisfaction results with employees.
- Ensures employees have the proper supplies and uniforms.
- Assists in the use of a guest information tracking system to ensure that a successful repeat guest recognition program is in use to recognize guest preferences and aid in problem resolution.
Supporting Handling of Human Resource Activities
- Identifying the developmental needs of others and coaching, mentoring, or otherwise helping others to improve their knowledge or skills.
- Providing guidance and direction to subordinates, including setting performance standards and monitoring performance.
- Provides feedback to individuals based on observation of service behaviors.
- Participates in an ongoing employee recognition program.
- Conducts training when appropriate.
- Participates in the employee performance appraisal process.
Additional Responsibilities
- Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Informs and/or updating the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner.
- Performs all duties at the Front Desk as necessary.
- Understands the functions of the Bell Staff, Switchboard and Concierge/Guest Services operations.
- Complies with loss prevention policies and procedures.

At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
EY- Assurance - Assistant Manager
As part of our EY-Assurance Team, you would be the main point of contact from GDS for the tasks assigned by the global client serving assurance teams and be responsible for the timeliness and quality of deliverables along with managing day to day operations of those engagements.
The opportunity
We re looking for candidates who possess technical knowledge, including ability to interpret reviews and accounting standards and strong project management skills along with excellent communication and leadership skills. GDS Assistant Manager s, would have Associate level or Senior level personnel to work with at GDS and get the tasks executed from them along with performing a review as an Assistant Manager , which is defined by the Global client serving assurance teams.
Your key responsibilities
Lead an engagement from the GDS front and ensure the team delivers timely and high-quality work, as per EY GAM and in line with the Global team expectations.
Demonstrate strong understanding of GAM while performing reviews of procedures performed by GDS staff, along with knowledge of EY tools to make reviews more efficient and meaningful.
Develop and maintain productive relationships with key EY Global counterparts like Assurance executives based out of Americas or Europe.
Develop an understanding of EY Quality and Risk Management procedures, and ensure these are embedded in to the engagement team s work.
Proactively discuss work flow management with the assurance teams, allocating resources to the assigned work and monitoring performance against standards. Monitor utilization for one s team, budget to actuals, and other operational matters.
Demonstrate professionalism, competence and clarity of communication when dealing with GDS and Global teams.
Establish expectations of value to be delivered to the respective GDS Global teams aligned.
Identify opportunities to improve the scope of work for GDS on one s own engagements.
Standardize review processes along with leveraging best practices across one s aligned engagements or beyond.
Motivate and lead one s GDS team members, identify and foster key talents, coach and supervise team members.
Be responsible for various operational matters related to engagements aligned.
Conduct timely performance reviews and provide performance feedback/training.
Ability to Lead by example.
Skills and attributes for success
Expert Knowledge of Indian accounting and assurance standards or knowledge of IFRS / UK GAAP / US GAAP and International review standards is an added advantage.
Excellent communication skills.
Effective interpersonal, risk management, facilitation and presentation skills
Ability to confidently lead conversations and discussions with key stakeholders
Project management, leadership, coaching, counselling and supervisory skills
Robust logical and reasoning skills.
Ability to spread positive work culture, teaming and live EY values.
The ability to quickly form strong working relationship with colleagues in India and global teams.
To qualify for the role, you must have
Qualified Chartered Accountant (ICAI) / ACCA / CPA
3-4 years post-qualification experience with either
a) Mid-or top-tier accounting firm focused on external or Assurance reviews
b) MNC or larger domestic Indian companies, preferably within a Shared Service
Environment.
Ideally, you ll also have
Proficiency in MS - MS office and Outlook.
Interest in business and commerciality.
What we look for
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
Opportunities to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries
What we Offer
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations - Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK - and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
Continuous learning : You ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you : We ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership: We ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture : You ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
About EY
EY | Building a better working world
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Description:
We are looking for a skilled Electrician with 2 to 7 years of experience to join our team at Jindal Saw Ltd, located in the steel plant. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in electrical systems and troubleshooting.

Roles and Responsibility


Troubleshoot and repair electrical issues in the steel plant.

Install, maintain, and test electrical equipment and systems.

Collaborate with other teams to ensure smooth operation of electrical systems.

Develop and implement preventive maintenance schedules for electrical equipment.

Ensure compliance with safety protocols and regulations.

Provide technical support and training to junior staff members.


Job Requirements


Diploma or degree in Electrical Engineering.

Minimum 2 years of experience as an electrician, preferably in a steel plant setting.

Strong knowledge of electrical systems, including wiring, circuits, and control panels.

Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.

Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Good communication and interpersonal skills.

Description:
Job Description - Agency Frontline Sales Role
Band- 1
CTC- Up to 3.5 lakh rupees
JOB SUMMARY: To create network of high performing agencies and promulgate initiatives within each agency to achieve sales productivity targets through sustainable partnership with Licensed Agents and partners. Recruit, Coach, Mentor, Support and Retain qualified agents and partners and Drive them to achieve New business productivity Renewal Targets.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Organize and run recruitment events (BOP) for Partner and Agents.
Identify the prospective Partners and Licensed Agents.
Selection to onboarding of the Partners/Agents and responsible for Partners/Agents income
Own the operational aspects of coding of a new Partner/Agent and other day to day interactions with support functions whenever required.
Plan goals performance needs for Partners and Agents in a periodic manner
Set weekly production target for team of agents and partners
Identify partner/ agents development needs and work with team to schedule appropriate technical, product and skills training and coaching. Develop agents in line with career development / training requirements of the Company.
Accompany agents on customer visits to support and improve sales skill. Help whenever needed in prospecting activity in the field by joint field work activity with Partners/Agents.
Responsible for the activation and productivity of the agents and partners on business month on month.
Motivate by providing support, recognizing good performers and arranging appropriate team-building activities.
Operate as a product Subject Matter Expert and run Train-Audit-Retrain cycle on skills of Partners and Agents.
Conduct weekly / monthly meeting to review performance, disseminate Company information, address common problems and concerns and rally the team to achieve goals.
Ensure Partners and agents work in accordance with Company standards, the regulation and ethics and maintain licensed status.
Make necessary decisions based on agent performance. Contact Partners and Agents who are falling short of Contract Maintenance criteria to re-activate them or arrange training.
Host events for customers to develop new and long-term relationship and promoting the brand.
Ensure submitting DSR through company's sales report management tool.
Maintain up to date knowledge of all insurance products and company regulations.
Stay informed about industry trends, competitors' offerings and regulatory updates
MINIMUM/SPECIFIC EXPERIENCE:
Graduate/ Post Graduate in any discipline
Good communication skills English regional language (mandatory)
Age group: 25-38 years
Minimum 2 years of Sales experience
Preferably has own conveyance
Previous experience of BFSI industry is preferred
Competencies and Skills
Competency- Result Orientation Definition- Encourages the team to set challenging yet achievable sales, recruitment and persistency goals (13th and 25th month)
Regularly reviews self and team performance on KPI, incentive targets and provides feedback to help them improve
Recognizes and rewards team members who consistently exceed their sales, recruitment and persistency targets (KPI)
Skillset required- Goal Setting, Time Management, Target Focus, Performance Review, Feedback Use
Competency - Sales Orientation Definition- Proactively researches and stays updated on new life insurance products and services
Identifies customer needs and recommends appropriate solutions
Develops strong relationships with existing distributors to drive repeat business
Meets or exceeds monthly/quarterly sales targets
Skillset required- Product Knowledge, Prospecting, Communication, Customer Understanding, Closing Skills
Competency- Customer Delight
Proactively identifies and addresses customer needs and concerns
Knows customer segments in the locality and develops strong relationships with customers to foster loyalty and trust
Provides product knowledge training to sales team to enhance customer experience
Analyzes customer feedback and implements improvements to processes and services
Skillset required- Customer Service, Relationship Building, Active Listening, Problem Solving, Feedback Handling
Competency- Work Ethics
Promotes a culture of integrity and ethical behavior within the team
Ensures sales practices comply with relevant laws, regulations, and industry standards
Provides guidance to sales representatives on ethical dilemmas and decision-making
Takes prompt action to address any unethical conduct or misconduct towards brand values
Skillset required- Integrity, Compliance, Fairness, Responsibility, Ethical Behavior
Competency - People and Team Leadership
Motivates and inspires the team to perform at a high level
Delegates tasks and responsibilities effectively to leverage team members' capabilities
Provides constructive feedback and coaching to help team members develop their skills
Skillset required- Motivation, Teamwork, Delegation, Coaching, Support
Competency - Recruitment/Distribution Skills
Definition- Proactively identifies and maintains a diverse pipeline of potential advisors and partners using established criteria, competitor mapping, and professional networking.

Job Summary
Role Overview The Field Officer is the frontline member of the KiDS project team, responsible for direct engagement with schools, teachers, students, parents, and communities in the assigned districts. The role reports to the District Coordinator or Programme Manager and requires consistent field presence and strong community engagement skills.
Location
Saharanpur, Chitrakoot, Jhansi, Lucknow, Kanpur
Organization
YR Gaitonde Medical Educational Research Foundation (YRGMERF)
Project
KiDS (Kids and Diabetes in Schools) - supported by Sanofi
Experience
Minimum 3 years of experience in development, health, education, or nutrition programmes at the district level.
Qualifications
Post-graduation in Home Science, Nutrition, Social Sciences, or a related discipline.
Working knowledge of the education department system in UP is required.
Key Responsibilities
Field Implementation Facilitate teacher training sessions using the KiDS manual in assigned schools.
Support trained teachers in conducting diabetes awareness sessions with students.
Organise and facilitate parent-teacher meetings in project schools.
Map the communities linked to each project school and conduct community awareness meetings.
Identify and support diabetes ambassadors within communities who can sustain awareness efforts beyond the project period.
Documentation and Reporting Document all field activities systematically and compile data for submission to the District Coordinator / Programme Manager.
Provide field data and inputs for programme reports in coordination with the ME Officer.
Maintain complete records of referrals to health facilities, forms, and related documentation.
Travel The role requires approximately 20 days of field travel per month. Travel and logistics support will be provided under the project.
Skills
Proficiency in MS Excel for data entry and reporting.
Strong written and oral communication skills in Hindi and English.
Self-motivated, with the ability to work independently in field settings with minimal supervision.

Description:
Job Summary
Technical Expert, Organisation YR Gaitonde Medical Educational & Research Foundation (YRGMERF) - Project Disha. Experience required: 5 years.
Responsibilities
The Technical Experts will provide mentoring and supportive supervision to DISHA cluster units, ensuring the effective implementation of the National AIDS Control Program (NACP) V.
Mentoring and Supervision: Based at the cluster level, provide mentoring support to 4 to 5 DISHA cluster units or DISHA single units.
Conduct monthly visits to all assigned DISHA units to provide on-site mentoring and supportive supervision.
Provide evidence-based technical guidance on all components of NACP V to the DISHA units.
Coordination and Collaboration: Strengthen coordination with allied health departments at the district level (NHM, NTEP, NVHCP) for enhanced referral linkages.
Make field visits to NACP facilities along with DISHA staff for supportive supervision and capacity building.
Reporting and Data Quality: Ensure the timely and quality submission of monthly reports for DISHA.
Verify data reported by at least 3 facilities per district each month and provide inputs to ensure data quality.
Guidance and Capacity Building: Guide the DISHA team on advocacy, stakeholder coordination, and coordination with other departments in the district.
Assist DISHA in developing district profiles, integrated action plans, and DISHA-specific IEC materials.
Orient and ensure optimal implementation of all component activities as per NACP V in the district/DISHA cluster.
Implementation of Strategies: Guide DISHA units on implementing new strategies of NACP V, such as CSS, SSS, SOA, use of virtual media, APN, index case, etc.
Provide component-wise inputs and guidance to enhance the overall performance of DISHA units.
Performance Improvement: Responsible for periodical improvement in the 95-95-95 performance targets of the DISHA cluster.
Field Visits: Conduct field visits for a minimum of 20 days per month to provide on-site support and supervision.
Requirements
Desirable Attributes: Master's Degree in Social Work, Sociology, Public Health, Humanities, or a related field.
Minimum of 5 years of experience in public health projects, particularly in HIV/AIDS programs.
Strong understanding of NACP V and public health systems.
Excellent mentoring, supervisory, and capacity-building skills.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Proficiency in data analysis and reporting.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Flexibility to travel extensively within the assigned region.

Description:
Bada Business Pvt Ltd is looking for Business Counselors to join our dynamic team and embark on a rewarding career journey
Must have good listening skills and be passionate about sales, with a keen interest in understanding and addressing client needs.
Ability to respond to sales queries promptly and effectively, demonstrating strong communication skills both over the phone and in person.
Engage with potential clients to understand their requirements and provide tailored solutions.
Act as a trusted advisor to clients, offering guidance and support throughout the sales process.
Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, ensuring their needs are met and expectations are exceeded.
Collaborate with the sales team to develop effective strategies for acquiring new clients and retaining existing ones.
Provide accurate and timely information to clients regarding products, services, and pricing.
Keep abreast of industry trends and competitor activities to identify opportunities for business growth.
Utilize CRM systems to track and manage client interactions and sales activities.
Meet or exceed sales targets while maintaining high levels of customer satisfaction.
Conduct follow-up calls and meetings to ensure customer satisfaction and identify opportunities for upselling or cross-selling.
Continuously seek feedback from clients to improve service delivery and enhance the overall customer experience.
Demonstrate empathy and understanding in addressing client concerns and objections.
Stay updated on product knowledge and sales techniques to enhance performance and productivity.

Description:
Project Name: Project for Establishment of Mizoram State Super-Specialty Cancer and Research Centre, Aizawl - Mizoram, India.
Functional Area: Equipment Management and Support (Specialized in Laboratory, Physiology, and Rehabilitation Equipment)
Location: Salem, Tamil Nadu/ Aizawl, Mizoram, India
Duration: 6 months (Intermittent Input)
Qualification:
-Bachelor s degree in Medical Electronic or Electronic or Biomedical Engineering.
-Certifications or training in laboratory or rehabilitation equipment preferred.
Overall Professional Experience:
-Minimum 15 years of professional experience in managing laboratory, physiology, or rehabilitation-related equipment, with at least 5 completed projects.
-Experience in medical equipment planning and/or procurement, having contributed to at least 3 projects.
-Hands-on experience in the installation, calibration, and basic maintenance of laboratory, physiology, and rehabilitation equipment.
-Work experience as a Clinical Engineer in healthcare or medical care facilities.
Role Responsibilities:
Equipment Installation Calibration:
-Lead the installation, setup, and calibration of laboratory, physiology, and rehabilitation equipment at MSSSCRC.
-Ensure that equipment is installed according to specifications and regulatory standards, meeting safety and performance requirements.
-Conduct initial testing to verify the functionality of newly installed equipment, making adjustments as necessary to optimize performance.
Compliance and Quality Assurance:
-Perform routine checks and inspections to ensure that equipment continues to meet operational standards and regulatory requirements.
-Monitor equipment performance, ensuring it adheres to safety and operational regulations in line with national and international standards.
-Assist in compliance audits and support the creation of reports to document adherence to health regulations.
Troubleshooting Technical Support:
-Provide technical troubleshooting support for any malfunctioning laboratory, physiology, or rehabilitation equipment.
-Offer quick resolutions for minor issues and escalate complex technical problems to senior specialists or vendors for further investigation and resolution.
-Diagnose equipment faults and recommend corrective actions to maintain optimal functionality.
Training MSSSCRC Staff on Equipment Use Maintenance:
-Develop and deliver training programs for MSSSCRC staff (clinical, technical, and administrative) on the correct use, handling, and safety protocols for laboratory, physiology, and rehabilitation equipment.
-Conduct hands-on training sessions to ensure staff are proficient in operating the equipment, including detailed instructions on how to maintain and troubleshoot the equipment.
-Create training materials and user manuals tailored to the equipment, ensuring that staff have clear, accessible guides for reference.
-Assess staff competency in operating the equipment and provide additional guidance or refresher courses as necessary to ensure staff confidence and safety in equipment handling.
-Provide specialized training in equipment calibration, regular maintenance tasks, and how to perform troubleshooting for common issues.
Record Maintenance Reporting:
-Maintain accurate and detailed records of equipment installation, servicing, and performance, ensuring that all equipment data is properly documented and accessible.
-Track service histories, calibration schedules, and any repairs or modifications made to the equipment.
-Assist in preparing periodic reports on equipment status, including any issues identified, actions taken, and overall performance evaluation.
-Coordination with Senior Specialists Vendors:
-Collaborate with senior specialists and vendors to manage upgrades, repairs, and replacements of equipment.
-Coordinate with vendors to procure spare parts and ensure that all equipment remains functional throughout the project duration.
-Ensure timely maintenance schedules are followed to minimize equipment downtime and avoid disruptions in medical services.
Project Support Management:
-Assist in the management of project timelines, ensuring that equipment-related tasks such as installation, calibration, and maintenance are completed on schedule.
-Support project teams in planning and procuring equipment, ensuring that equipment specifications meet the project s healthcare requirements.
-Provide guidance and technical input in the planning phase for procurement of new laboratory, physiology, and rehabilitation equipment.
Safety Operational Efficiency:
-Conduct regular safety checks to ensure that all equipment complies with health and safety regulations and operates efficiently.
-Evaluate the operational efficiency of equipment and recommend improvements or upgrades when necessary.
-Ensure that all equipment is safely decommissioned or disposed of at the end of its useful life.
Preferred Age: Below 50 years
Employment Type: Project Specific

Description:
Project Name: Project for Establishment of Mizoram State Super-Specialty Cancer and Research Centre, Aizawl - Mizoram, India.
Functional Area: Equipment Cost Expert
Location: Salem, Tamil Nadu/ Aizawl, Mizoram, India
Duration: 4 months (Intermittent Input)
Qualification:
-Bachelor s degree in Biomedical Engineering/Medical electronics or Electronic.
-Certifications in cost analysis or financial planning preferred.
Overall Professional Experience:
-Minimum of 15 years of experience in cost analysis of medical equipment or related fields.
-At least 7 years of experience in the medical or healthcare sector.
-Experience in medical equipment planning and/or procurement, having contributed to at least 2 projects.
-Experience working on Japanese ODA Loan Projects in any sector.
-At least 1 year of experience in SAARC or ASEAN regions (preferable).
-Work experience as a Clinical Engineer in healthcare or medical care facilities.
-Strong knowledge of procurement processes and cost optimization techniques.

Role Responsibilities:
Cost Estimation Budgeting:
-Lead the estimation of preliminary project equipment costs during the basic design phase, ensuring accurate forecasting of all associated costs.
-Develop cost models and prepare detailed cost estimates for medical equipment procurement and installation.
-Identify and quantify the costs related to equipment, components, consumables, transportation, and installation work, ensuring that the budget is comprehensive and aligned with project objectives.
Survey Data Collection:
-Conduct surveys of existing or similar healthcare facilities to gather information on operational and maintenance costs of medical equipment.
-Assess the existing equipment in operational facilities to understand their functionality, lifespan, and associated costs to make informed decisions.
-Collect data on the cost of spare parts, consumables, and other supplies necessary for the proper functioning of medical equipment.
Evaluation of Local Distributors Service Providers:
-Survey local distributors for warranty services, maintenance contract availability, and pricing.
-Evaluate the reliability and service offerings of local vendors, ensuring they meet the operational needs of the project and provide cost-effective maintenance solutions.
Cost Breakdown Analysis:
-Collect and analyze detailed data on equipment-related costs, including main components, consumables, transportation costs, turnkey work, maintenance contracts, and other related services.
-Ensure a thorough understanding of all cost components and provide a comprehensive cost breakdown for each equipment item.
-Collaborate with procurement teams to optimize cost-efficiency and select the best value options for the project.
Tender Evaluation Compliance:
-Assist the Project Management Unit (PMU) in evaluating financial documents related to equipment tenders, ensuring that the costs are in line with the project s financial goals.
-Review tender submissions for compliance with project specifications, budget constraints, and cost-effectiveness.
-Provide recommendations on cost optimization and value for money, ensuring that all financial aspects of the tender align with project needs.
Cost Reporting Documentation:
-Prepare and maintain detailed reports on cost estimations, budgets, and financial evaluations related to medical equipment.
-Ensure that all cost reports are accurately documented and available for review by the project team and stakeholders.
-Track and report any changes in cost projections, identifying areas where cost savings or adjustments can be made.
Collaboration with Project Stakeholders:
-Work closely with the project team, including procurement specialists and clinical engineers, to align equipment cost management with overall project goals.
-Provide regular updates on cost estimations, procurement strategies, and cost optimization efforts to senior management and stakeholders.
Preferred Age: Below 50 years
Employment Type: Project Specific

Excellent interpersonal skills
Customer handling and relationship-building abilities; Result-oriented and self-motivated
Strong negotiation and influencing skills
Educational Qualifications
Minimum: Graduate in any discipline (Bachelors degree required)
Having a two-wheeler will be an added advantage
