Description:
(i) To advise the concerned departments in planning and organizing measures necessary for Safe Work Practices for all employees thus prevent personal injuries.
(ii) To implement Work Permit System across the Plant and create awareness on importance adhering to Safe Work Practices.
(iii) To carry our Safety Audit periodically and evaluate the effectiveness of the action taken or proposed to be taken to prevent personal injuries.
(iv) To ensure availability of personal protective equipment and usage appropriately.
(v) To advise on matters relating to carrying out of plant safety inspections.
(vi) To carry out plant safety inspections in order to observe the physical conditions of work and the work practices and procedures followed by workers and to render advise on measures to be adopted for removing the unsafe physical conditions and preventing unsafe actions by workers.
(vii) To render assistance on matters relating to reporting and investigation of industrial accidents and occupational diseases.
(viii) To encourage reporting of Near Miss and Potential hazard and address all those observations to prevent incident/accident.
(ix) To render assistance for the cases of industrial diseases contracted and in respect of dangerous occurrences reportable under rule 106 of the Pondicherry Factories Rules, 1964.
(x) To render assistance on the maintenance of such records as are necessary relating to accidents, dangerous occurrences and industrial diseases.
(xi) To conduct safety committee meeting periodically and address all such observation.
(xii) To organize in association with the concerned departments, campaigns, competitions, contests and other activities which will develop and maintain the interest of the workers in establishing and maintaining safe conditions of work and procedure; and
(xiii) to design and conduct either independently or in collaboration with the training department, suitable training and educational programs for the prevention of personal injuries and for the propagation of safety awareness.
xiv) To work for obtaining the certification of EOHS, ESG and GreenCo.
The Safety Officer will be responsible for ensuring the safety and health of all employees within the organization. This role includes developing, implementing, and overseeing safety programs and policies to maintain compliance with local, state, and federal regulations. The Safety Officer will conduct regular safety inspections, risk assessments, and audits to identify potential hazards in the workplace. This position requires the development and delivery of safety training programs to enhance employee awareness and compliance. The Safety Officer will also investigate accidents and incidents, prepare reports, and recommend corrective actions to prevent future occurrences.

Description:
Job Summary
Associate Analyst: The position is a full-time data entry job. The associate will undergo RCM domain training and basic functional/operative training in Billing/Charge Posting at the time of joining. Post training, responsible for Data entry/reviewing/validating billing fee slips as per the process guidelines. Performs work requiring analysis, data maintenance and reporting to immediate supervisor.
Responsibilities
Enter / Validate Charges accurately to collect claims money at first instance.
Create/validate patient's demographics in PMS. Demographics include Patients Name, DOB, Address, Phone numbers, Insurance details etc.
Enter/validate ICD and CPTs in PMS within 24 hours of turnaround time of 24 hours of receipt of documents.
Clear all edits which pop up while scrubbing charges.
Follow all client specific updates and billing guidelines published in-order to send clean claim.
Follow HIPAA guidelines when accessing and sharing patient information.
Skills
Basic knowledge of computer, Microsoft Office
Communication Skills - English (Verbal/Written)
Experience
No experience required. Associate will undergo RCM training, quick grasping/learning skills are required and expected to clear assessments during training.

Description:
About the Role:
The role involves coordinating activities related to new product introductions within the organization. It emphasizes ensuring that components are ready for production and managing the overall process of product rollouts. The position will require active engagement with cross-functional teams to facilitate smooth transitions from development to manufacturing.

About the Team:
You will be working with a dynamic and collaborative cross-functional team consisting of members from engineering, production, and quality assurance. The team is focused on driving innovation and efficiency in product development, ensuring that all members actively contribute their expertise to achieve common goals.

You are Responsible for:
Coordinating all aspects of new product introduction activities and ensuring that all parts are ready on time. Conducting production tryouts and addressing any manufacturing line issues that arise during the process. Securing necessary approvals at each stage of the product rollout and working in collaboration with the cross-functional team to resolve any challenges encountered.

To succeed in this role - you should have the following:
A strong background in electronics products such as Sensors, ECUs, DC-DC converters, Ignition coil and Rectifier and regulator. Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams. Problem-solving abilities to quickly address manufacturing issues and the capability to adapt to changing project requirements. Experience in coordinating product introduction activities will be highly beneficial.
Job Title: Senior Engineer - NPI

Company Name: India Nippon Electricals


The successful candidate will be responsible for coordinating new product introduction activities in the organization. This includes ensuring part readiness for production, conducting production tryouts to validate processes, obtaining necessary approvals, and effectively resolving any manufacturing line issues in collaboration with the cross-functional team (CFT). The role requires a strong focus on detail and the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.

Responsibilities:
- Coordinate new product introduction activities to ensure timely and efficient rollout.
- Ensure all parts are ready for production and meet quality standards.
- Conduct production tryouts to assess the manufacturing process and product functionality.
- Obtain necessary approvals from relevant stakeholders at each phase of the product introduction.
- Work closely with the cross-functional team to resolve any issues that arise on the manufacturing line.
- Monitor and report on the progress of new product initiatives and provide updates as required.
- Collaborate with engineering and quality assurance teams to ensure adherence to specifications.

Skills and Tools Required:
- Strong knowledge of electronics products, including Sensors, Electronic Control Units (ECU), DC-DC converters, and regulators (RR).
- Excellent project management skills to oversee multiple product introductions simultaneously.
- Strong problem-solving abilities to address manufacturing line issues effectively.
- Familiarity with manufacturing processes and standards in the electronics industry.
- Proficient in using tools for project tracking, data analysis, and reporting.
- Effective communication skills to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams.
- Attention to detail and a systematic approach to tasks and responsibilities.

This role is crucial for ensuring that new products are introduced successfully and efficiently into production, maintaining high standards of quality and performance.

Description:
Key Responsibilities
1. Teaching & Academic Responsibilities
Deliver lectures and practical sessions as per the prescribed curriculum.
Prepare lesson plans, teaching materials, and academic schedules.
Develop innovative teaching methodologies to enhance student learning.
Conduct internal assessments, examinations, and evaluate student performance.
Maintain academic records and documentation.
2. Research & Publications
Conduct independent and collaborative research activities.
Publish research papers in reputed national and international journals.
Present research findings at conferences, seminars, and workshops.
Apply for research grants and funding opportunities.
Encourage and guide students in research and innovation activities.
3. Student Mentoring & Guidance
Mentor and guide undergraduate and postgraduate students.
Provide academic counselling and career guidance.
Support students in projects, internships, and research activities.
Monitor student progress and provide necessary academic support.
4. Departmental & Administrative Responsibilities
Participate in departmental meetings and academic committees.
Assist in curriculum development and academic planning.
Coordinate departmental activities, events, seminars, and workshops.
Contribute to accreditation and quality assurance activities (NAAC/NBA).
Maintain departmental reports and statutory documentation.
5. Institutional Development
Participate in faculty development programmes and professional training.
Collaborate with industries and academic institutions.
Contribute to institutional initiatives and continuous improvement.
Perform other duties assigned by the Head of the Department or Management.
Qualification & Experience
Masters Degree in Agriculture / relevant discipline from a recognised institution.
Ph.D. in Agriculture / relevant discipline preferred.
Minimum 10 years of teaching/research experience, including significant experience in academic administration.
Minimum 5 years of experience as a Professor is mandatory.
Experience as Associate Professor / Professor / HOD / Dean / Academic Coordinator in a reputed institution preferred.
Strong record of research publications, academic leadership, faculty mentoring, and student development.

Description:
1. Customer Complaint Management
- Receive, analyze, and respond to customer complaints within the agreed timeline.
- Coordinate containment, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions.
- Prepare and submit 8D reports, 5-Why analysis, and other customer-required reports.
- Ensure effectiveness verification and obtain customer closure approval.
2. Customer Quality Assurance
- Ensure products meet customer drawings, specifications, standards, and quality requirements.
- Monitor PPM, rejection rates, warranty claims, and field failure trends.
- Establish containment and corrective actions to prevent defective parts reaching customers.
- Ensure compliance with customer-specific requirements and quality agreements.
3. Customer Audits and Visits
- Plan and coordinate customer audits, assessments, and plant visits.
- Ensure audit readiness, documentation availability, and closure of audit findings.
- Present quality performance, improvement activities, and corrective action status.
- Coordinate cross-functional teams to address customer observations.
4. New Product Development (NPD) and Launch Quality
- Review customer quality requirements during new product development.
- Coordinate APQP, PPAP, FMEA, Control Plan, MSA, SPC, and validation activities, as applicable.
- Ensure process readiness, product validation, traceability, and error-proofing before launch.
- Coordinate safe launch and enhanced inspection until the required approval and stability criteria are met.
5. Cross-Functional and Supplier Coordination
- Coordinate with Production, Engineering, Materials, Supplier Quality, RD, and Marketing.
- Drive supplier corrective actions for customer-related component issues.
- Ensure defective material segregation, replacement, traceability, and disposition.
- Monitor action owners and timelines until effective closure.
6. Quality Performance and Continuous Improvement
- Track customer PPM, complaints, rejection costs, warranty, and repeat failures.
- Prepare monthly quality performance reports and management reviews.
- Identify recurring issues and implement horizontal deployment across similar products and processes.
- Drive lessons learned, defect prevention, and continual improvement initiatives.

Manage the research, design, and development of critical components for Medium Voltage (MV) Switchgear. Drive innovation, compliance, and industrialization to strengthen the competitiveness of MV Switchgear portfolio.
"-Supervise VCB, RMU, AIS and GIS design activities for MV Switchgear
-Define and approve type and prototype test plans covering MV Switchgear components
-Coordinate type testing with accredited labs (KEMA, CESI, GCC Lab) and oversee in-house prototype validation.

-Guarantee compliance with IEC / 100 / 102 / 103 / 200 standards as well as customer-specific and utility requirements.

-Coordinate with manufacturing, supply chain, electrical, and quality teams to ensure industrialization of components for both MV Switchgear.
-Collaborate with suppliers and RD institutions to localize and qualify components, reducing costs and lead times across both product lines.
-Able to anticipate problems and make the necessary proactive steps to prevent them
-Ability to take necessary and proper timely decisions.
-Deliver the required results in timely manner with required quality and cost.
-Must make a tangible difference to his area of operation. and exceed business expectations."

On time service planning with ZERO pending services every month
Monitoring SCP active devices & Usage on weekly basis
Minimum expectancy on SCP active device(100%) & usage >95%
Achieving progressive improvement in State of Service (SOS) and meet SOS targets assigned by the branch
Minimizing service backlog (meet our contractual obligations)

Be decisive
Attention to details and accuracy
Planning & organizing
Analytical skills
Customer oriented
Negotiation skills
Ability to work patiently in a dynamic service environment

Minimum graduation with 1 to 3 years of relevant experience of managing team
Basic computer skills - for reporting/work management (Advanced computer skills would be an added advantage)
Communication - speaking on phone to external customers & internally with technicians, other Operations colleagues.
Knowledge of territory which is handled for planning
Occasional Travel required within the Division

Communicate all service issues in a timely manner to the ABM/BM, Operations Manager

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Firmware Development: Design, write, and test low-level firmware in Embedded C for bare-metal architectures and Real-Time Operating Systems (FreeRTOS).
Peripheral Drivers: Develop and maintain low-level drivers and Board Support Packages (BSP) for timers, ADC/DAC, DMA, GPIO, and external Flash/EEPROM.
Wired Protocols: Implement, configure, and troubleshoot wired serial and fieldbus interfaces including UART, SPI, I2C, and CAN / RS-485.
Hardware Bring-Up: Lab Debugging: Bring up prototype boards and troubleshoot firmware-hardware issues using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, multimeters, and JTAG/SWD debuggers.

Communication Interfaces: Direct experience configuring and debugging wired buses: UART/USART, SPI, I2C, and CAN.
OS &Execution Models: Practical understanding of RTOS concepts (FreeRTOS tasks, queues, semaphores, mutexes) and bare-metal superloops.
Lab Instrumentation:
Hands-on experience using in-circuit debuggers (J-Link, ST-Link, E2) and diagnostic
tools (logic analyzers, digital oscilloscopes).

Bachelor degree in Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE),
Electrical & Electronics Engineering, (EEE),
Computer Engineering, or related technical field.

To create network of high performing Partner and promulgate initiatives within each Partner to achieve sales productivity targets through sustainable partnership. Recruit, Coach, Mentor, Support and Retain Partner and Drive them to achieve New business productivity Renewal Targets
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Identify and Recruit the prospective Partner.
Selection to on boarding of the Partner and responsible for Partner income
Own the operational aspects of coding of a new Partner and other day to day interactions
with support functions whenever required.
Engage initiatives to ensure Managing Partner - PO productivity
To achieve the assigned recruitment target of partner office; assigned through various
Recruitment activities
Actively involve the PPs in activities pertaining to Recruitment and New Agent Activation
Responsible for Advisor Activation, Creation and Retention
Ensure compliance to all internal processes and other compliance standards as set by the
Company or the Regulator.
Plan goals performance needs for Partner in a periodic manner
Set weekly production target for Partner Office
Identify development needs and work with team to schedule appropriate technical,
product and skills training and coaching. Develop Partner in line with career development
training requirements of the Company.
Help whenever needed in prospecting activity in the field by joint field work activity with
Partner.
Motivate by providing support, recognizing good performances and arranging appropriate
team-building activities.
Operate as a product Subject Matter Expert and run Train-Audit-Retrain cycle on skills
of Partners.
Conduct weekly / monthly meeting to review performance, disseminate Company
information, address common problems and concerns and rally the Partner to achieve
goals.
Make necessary decisions based on Partner performance.
Ensure submitting DSR through companys sales report management tool.
Maintain up to date knowledge of all insurance products and company regulations.
Stay informed about industry trends, competitors offerings and regulatory updates
MINIMUM/SPECIFIC EXPERIENCE :
Graduate/ Post Graduate in any discipline
Good communication skills English regional language (mandatory)
Age group: 25-38 years
Min 2 years of sales experience
Preferably has own conveyance
Previous experience of Insurance industry is preferred
Competencies and Skills
Competency- Result Orientation
Definition-
Encourages the team to set challenging yet achievable sales, recruitment and persistency goals (13th and 25th month)
Regularly reviews self and team performance on KPI, incentive targets and provides feedback to help them improve
Recognizes and rewards team members who consistently exceed their sales, recruitment and persistency targets (KPI)

Skillset required-
Goal Setting, Time Management, Target Focus, Performance Review, Feedback Use
Competency - Sales Orientation
Definition-
Proactively researches and stays updated on new life insurance products and services
Identifies customer needs and recommends appropriate solutions
Develops strong relationships with existing customers to drive repeat business
Meets or exceeds monthly/quarterly sales targets

Skillset required-
Product Knowledge, Prospecting, Communication, Customer Understanding, Closing Skills
Competency- Customer Delight
Definition-
Proactively identifies and addresses customer needs and concerns
Knows customer segments in the locality and develops strong relationships with customers to foster loyalty and trust
Provides product knowledge training to sales team to enhance customer experience
Analyzes customer feedback and implements improvements to processes and services

Skillset required-
Customer Service, Relationship Building, Active Listening, Problem Solving, Feedback Handling
Competency- Work Ethics
Definition-
Promotes a culture of integrity and ethical behavior within the team
Ensures sales practices comply with relevant laws, regulations, and industry standards
Provides guidance to sales representatives on ethical dilemmas and decision-making
Takes prompt action to address any unethical conduct or misconduct towards brand values

Skillset required-
Integrity, Compliance, Fairness, Responsibility, Ethical Behavior

Competency - People and Team Leadership
Definition-
Communicates a clear vision and strategy for the team to achieve organizational objectives
Motivates and inspires the team to perform at a high level
Delegates tasks and responsibilities effectively to leverage team members' capabilities
Provides constructive feedback and coaching to help team members develop their skills
Skillset required-
Motivation, Teamwork, Delegation, Coaching, Support
Competency - Recruitment/Distribution Skills
Definition-
Proactively identifies and maintains a diverse pipeline of potential advisors and partners using established criteria, competitor mapping, and professional networking.
Develops and delivers a compelling value proposition that clearly articulates the career opportunity, compensation, and support structure, effectively influencing and convincing high-potential advisors and partners to join the team.
Skillfully anticipates and manages advisor objections through clear communication, factual evidence, and motivational techniques.
Effectively leverages existing networks, professional referrals, and natural market opportunities to consistently generate quality leads for distribution expansion.
Demonstrates the ability to attract established and high-performing distributors or teams from competitor organizations by highlighting the unique advantages and growth opportunities the company offers.
Ensures a good selection process is followed, and successful recruits are smoothly integrated by providing initial training and necessary resources to facilitate a fast start in the role.
Skillset required-
Lead Generation, Networking, Prospecting, Communication, Interviewing

Host events for customers to develop new and long-term relationship and promoting the brand.
Ensure submitting DSR through companys sales report management tool.
Maintain up to date knowledge of all insurance products and company regulations.
Stay informed about industry trends, competitors offerings and regulatory updates
MINIMUM/SPECIFIC EXPERIENCE :
Graduate/ Post Graduate in any discipline
Good communication skills English & regional language (mandatory)

Minimum 2 years of Sales experience
Preferably has own conveyance
Previous experience of BFSI industry is preferred
Competencies and Skills -
Competency- Result Orientation
Definition-
Encourages the team to set challenging yet achievable sales, recruitment and persistency goals (13th and 25th month)
Regularly reviews self and team performance on KPI, incentive targets and provides feedback to help them improve
Recognizes and rewards team members who consistently exceed their sales, recruitment and persistency targets (KPI)

Skillset required-
Goal Setting, Time Management, Target Focus, Performance Review, Feedback Use
Competency - Sales Orientation
Definition-
Proactively researches and stays updated on new life insurance products and services
Identifies customer needs and recommends appropriate solutions
Develops strong relationships with existing distributors to drive repeat business
Meets or exceeds monthly/quarterly sales targets

Skillset required-
Product Knowledge, Prospecting, Communication, Customer Understanding, Closing Skills
Competency- Customer Delight
Definition-
Proactively identifies and addresses customer needs and concerns
Knows customer segments in the locality and develops strong relationships with customers to foster loyalty and trust
Provides product knowledge training to sales team to enhance customer experience
Analyzes customer feedback and implements improvements to processes and services

Skillset required-
Customer Service, Relationship Building, Active Listening, Problem Solving, Feedback Handling
Competency- Work Ethics
Definition-
Promotes a culture of integrity and ethical behavior within the team
Ensures sales practices comply with relevant laws, regulations, and industry standards
Provides guidance to sales representatives on ethical dilemmas and decision-making
Takes prompt action to address any unethical conduct or misconduct towards brand values

Skillset required-
Integrity, Compliance, Fairness, Responsibility, Ethical Behavior

Competency - People and Team Leadership
Definition-
Communicates a clear vision and strategy for the team to achieve organizational objectives
Motivates and inspires the team to perform at a high level
Delegates tasks and responsibilities effectively to leverage team members' capabilities
Provides constructive feedback and coaching to help team members develop their skills
Skillset required-
Motivation, Teamwork, Delegation, Coaching, Support

Competency - Recruitment/Distribution Skills
Definition-
Proactively identifies and maintains a diverse pipeline of potential advisors and partners using established criteria, competitor mapping, and professional networking.
Develops and delivers a compelling value proposition that clearly articulates the career opportunity, compensation, and support structure, effectively influencing and convincing high-potential advisors and partners to join the team.
Skillfully anticipates and manages advisor objections through clear communication, factual evidence, and motivational techniques.
Effectively leverages existing networks, professional referrals, and natural market opportunities to consistently generate quality leads for distribution expansion.
Demonstrates the ability to attract established and high-performing distributors or teams from competitor organizations by highlighting the unique advantages and growth opportunities the company offers.
Ensures a good selection process is followed, and successful recruits are smoothly integrated by providing initial training and necessary resources to facilitate a fast start in the role.
Skillset required-
Lead Generation, Networking, Prospecting, Communication, Interviewing

Job description
Gold Plus Group Company Profile
Gold Plus Group is the second-largest glass manufacturing company in India, headquartered at Kings Mall, Rohini, Delhi. The Group operates Float Glass and Solar Glass manufacturing plants at Roorkee (Uttarakhand) and Kanagala, Belagavi (Karnataka), along with a processing plant at Kala Amb (Himachal Pradesh).
With a strong sales presence across India, the Group has an annual turnover of approximately INR 3,500 crore and a workforce of over 4,000 employees.

Website: goldplusgroup.com

Position Details:
Designation: Area Sales Manager (ASM)
Department: Sales & Marketing
Qualification: MBA (Regular)
Experience: Relevant experience in Sales / Channel Sales / Business Development
Location: Puducherry, Tirunelveli, Mangaluru, Trichy, Tirupati

Role & Responsibilities:
Manage and strengthen relationships with existing business associates and channel partners.
Identify, onboard, and develop new business associates within the assigned territory.
Drive business development and achieve assigned sales targets in tonnage.
Ensure timely collection of receivables and maintain healthy outstanding levels.
Coordinate with the Accounts team for reconciliation and resolution of discrepancies.
Build strong customer relationships and strengthen the company's brand presence.
Handle customer queries, complaints, and service-related issues effectively.
Guide and monitor the performance of Marketing Executives (MEs) reporting to the role.
Work closely with the RM/GM and take up additional responsibilities as required.

Requirements:
MBA (Regular) is mandatory.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Experience in channel sales, dealer/distributor management or business development preferred.
Strong customer relationship and negotiation skills.
Good understanding of the assigned market/territory.
Leadership and team-management abilities.
Target-oriented and result-driven approach.
Willingness to travel within the assigned territory.

Interested candidates can share their updated resume at:

Gold Plus started its operation in 1985 with trading in various glasses has now earned the distinction of manufacturing all types of processed glasses under one roof.

Salary shall commensurate with experience

This position is a mechanical integrity technical position for fixed equipment in support of petrochemical facility

Troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and integrity recommendation stewardship.
Bad actor identification and analysis to reduce equipment downtime.

Role & Responsibilities:
Purification Execution: Process optimization and execution of downstream unit operations including clarification (filtration, centrifugation), chromatography (affinity, ion-exchange, multimodal, size-exclusion), and tangential flow filtration (TFF / UF-DF).

Ability to work cross-functionally with Upstream Processing (USP), Analytical, QA, and Manufacturing teams.

Proficiency in operating chromatography systems (e.g., Cytiva KTA avant/pure/pilot) and tangential flow filtration (TFF/UF-DF).
Experience handling sensitive viral modalities (e.g., live-attenuated, inactivated, viral vectors, or VLPs) and maintaining aseptic/closed-system processing.
Familiarity with Design of Experiments (DoE) and data analysis.

Strong business planning, presentation, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work independently and engage directly with company leadership.
Verifiable examples or references from previous SAP partnership engagements.

Experience supporting Indian IT consulting companies through SAP partnership onboarding.
Experience working within SAPs partner ecosystem.
Exposure to manufacturing customers and SAP implementation services.

Partnership business plan and application documentation.
Certification and enablement roadmap.

Description:
Job Summary
The role will be responsible to drive sales and customer acquisition for home loan and mortgage products, and contribute to the organizations revenue growth through direct sourcing and strategic networking. This role involves generating leads, managing customer relationships, conducting field visits, and ensuring end-to-end loan processing with a focus on delivering a seamless customer experience.


Responsibilities
Go on field visits to meet customers and explain loan products
Work to achieve sales targets and help grow the companys business
Build good relationships with customers by meeting them regularly and following up for more business
Meet new customers and ask happy customers to refer others who may need a home loan
Coordinate with credit team for smooth processing and disbursal of loans
Maintain credit quality
Onboard new channel partners
Find and add new housing projects (APFs) and agents to bring in more loan applications.


Required Qualifications and Skills
1-5 years of experience in Home Loan or Mortgage Sales within the BFSI/NBFC sector
Prior experience in direct customer acquisition and channel sales preferred; Freshers with strong sales aptitude may also be considered
Strong local market knowledge and established network in the region
Excellent interpersonal skills
Customer handling and relationship-building abilities
Strong negotiation and influencing skills


Educational Qualifications
Minimum: Graduate in any discipline (Bachelors degree required)
Having a two-wheeler will be an added advantage

Location: Ludhiana, Mumbai, Pune, Bangalore

Position Overview:

Radiowalla Network Limited is seeking a dedicated and detail-oriented Field Quality Control Executive to oversee the quality of our audio and visual content delivery across various platforms. Required Skills and Qualifications:

- Freshers in any field, +2 or 10th who can join immediately
- Being multilingual would be an added advantage
- Willingness to travel extensively and work flexible hours as needed
- Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot under pressure.
- Strong communication skills to work effectively with both internal teams and clients
- Attention to detail and a proactive approach to maintaining quality standards.

Interested candidates can share their updated CVs at careers@radiowalla.in.

Description:
GST Compliance & Taxation

To ensure accurate and timely GST compliance, return filing, reconciliations, refund monitoring, and statutory reporting in accordance with applicable GST laws and regulations.

Key Responsibilities

1. GST Return Filing: Preparation, review, reconciliation, and timely filing of GST Returns, including GSTR-1, GSTR-3B and GSTR-4, as applicable.
2. ECL Reconciliation: Regular reconciliation of the Electronic Cash Ledger (ECL) with GST records, payments, and books of accounts to ensure accuracy.
3. CMP-08 Compliance: Preparation, verification, and timely filing of CMP-08 statements, ensuring accurate reporting of tax liabilities and payments.
4. Annualised Reversal: Calculation, monitoring, reconciliation, and adjustment of annualised ITC reversals in accordance with applicable GST provisions.
5. Annual GST Returns: Preparation, reconciliation, review, and filing of Annual GST Returns in GSTR-9 and GSTR-9C, ensuring consistency with financial statements and periodic GST returns.
6. IGST Refund Monitoring: Monitoring and tracking of IGST refund claims, ensuring timely processing, documentation, follow-ups, and resolution of pending refund matters.
7. Monthly GST Review: Conducting monthly GST reviews to identify discrepancies, compliance gaps, tax liabilities, input tax credit mismatches, and opportunities for corrective action.

Job Title: Manager - Sales (Assistant Store Manager Grade)
Location: New Delhi / Zirakpur, Punjab
Industry: B2B Wholesale & Retail
Reports to: Store Business Head (Store Manager)

Job Purpose
The Manager - Sales will oversee sales growth, customer acquisition, and team management across various customer channels, including Traders, HoReCa, and Offices & Institutions. Responsible for driving business development and repeat billing from tagged customers.

Key Responsibilities
Drive overall sales growth and market penetration in target segments.
Lead the customer acquisition strategy to expand the client base.
Manage, mentor, and motivate a team of 15-20 Sales Executives through Department Managers or Team Leaders.
Drive sales across multiple customer channels (Traders, HoReCa, Offices & Institutions).
Lead business development initiatives to increase market share and sales volume.
Ensure repeat billing from tagged customers and enhance customer retention strategies.
Monitor and adjust strategies to achieve sales targets and customer satisfaction.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure operational efficiency and sales alignment.
Evaluate market trends and competition to develop proactive sales strategies.
Maintain regular reporting to the Store Business Head on sales performance and team progress.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Sales Growth: Achieving growth in sales revenue across key customer segments.
Repeat Billing: Maximizing the frequency of repeat sales from tagged customers.
HVS vs NHVS Sales Proportion: Managing the balance between High-Value Sales (HVS) and Non-High-Value Sales (NHVS).
Increasing Share of Wallet: Growing the sales contribution from existing clients.
Achieving Top Line and Bottom Line Business Limits: Meeting financial targets and profitability goals.

Functional Competencies
Strong sales management and team leadership skills.
Ability to develop and execute strategic business development plans.
Proficiency in customer acquisition and retention strategies.
In-depth knowledge of B2B wholesale and retail industry dynamics.
Experience in handling sales across multiple channels.
Knowledge of the respective local market to understand customer preferences and trends.

Behavioural Competencies
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.
High level of empathy and emotional intelligence in team management.
Results-oriented, with a focus on achieving business objectives.

Requirements
Area Sales Manager level experience in FMCG sales.
Background in Processed Food, Commodities, and DnT product range within the FMCG industry.
Minimum Graduate qualification, with preference for PGDBM in Sales & Marketing specialization.
Knowledge of the local market to cater to customer needs effectively.

METRO India started operations in India in 2003 and was the first company to introduce cash-and-carry business format in India. Currently, METRO Cash & Carry India Ltd. operates large format stores under the brand. 'METRO Wholesale' across the country. In 2023, Reliance Retail Ventures Ltd. Description:
We are hiring for Sales Officer \ Senior Sales Officer.


We seek a dynamic and result-driven Sales Officer to join our team. to help us meet our customer acquisition and revenue growth targets. As a Sales Officer, you will represent the organization in the assigned market as its Brand Ambassador and shall be the custodian of its Brand Equity.

Role & Responsibilities:

Setting up a network of Channel Partners (Distributors, Dealers, and Subdealers as required) for optimum reach and penetration of NCL Tile Adhesives & allied products in the assigned market. Ensure an optimum stock level of all product items with our channel partners.

Devise and Execute a Demand Generation Campaign to create awareness, and interest among buyers and influencers (Applicators / Masons, Contractors, End Customers, Builders / Developers, Architects & Designer) through multiple activities (product presentations & demonstrations, content creation & distribution, masons meet at Retail Outlet, Nakka Meet, Contractors Meet, Architect Meet, etc.)

Devise and execute Lead Generation & Conversion campaigns for accurate sales projections and improved sales (interested prospects into customers) by tracking and visiting construction sites, developing effective engagement by providing solutions and objection handling.

Maintain sales volume, product mix, selling price, and credit periods if any by keeping current with supply and demand, changing trends, economic indicators and competitors.

Conduct market research at regular intervals to gain market intelligence, gauge selling possibilities, and evaluate customer needs with a good geographical understanding.

Implement a strategic business plan that helps expand the company's customer base and ensures its strong presence with regular updates on competitors' activities.

Complete compliance with the company's reporting requirements in both online and offline formats.

Requirements and skills:

Candidate with prior experience in the Building Material Industry at the same level and geography shall be preferred.

Minimum graduate, post-graduation in business administration will be preferred.

Must possess good communication, negotiation, and persuasion skills with an ability to work independently and as a part of a team.

Ability to launch a similar product in the market, having good relationships with Dealers, Contractors, and applicators, and experience in conducting Mason/In-Shop, Naaka Meet, and Contractor meet and generating consistent sales of tile adhesive products shall be given utmost preference.

Demonstrated ability to communicate, negotiate, present, and influence credibly and effectively at all levels of the organization.

Proven ability to drive sales.

Valid driver's license and willingness to travel within assigned territories.

Description:
JOB SUMMARY
Accountable for overall success of the daily kitchen operations. Exhibits culinary talents by personally performing tasks while leading the staff and managing all food related functions. Works to continually improve guest and employee satisfaction while maximizing the financial performance in all areas of responsibility. Supervises all kitchen areas to ensure a consistent, high quality product is produced. Responsible for guiding and developing staff including direct reports. Must ensure sanitation and food standards are achieved. Areas of responsibility comprise overseeing all food preparation areas (e.g., banquets, room service, restaurants, bar/lounge and employee cafeteria) and all support areas (e.g., dish room and purchasing).
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 6 years experience in the culinary, food and beverage, or related professional area.
OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Culinary Arts, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 4 years experience in the culinary, food and beverage, or related professional area.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Leading Kitchen Operations for Property
- Leads kitchen management team.
- Provides direction for all day-to-day operations.
- Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence or determine appropriate replacement to fill gaps.
- Provides guidance and direction to subordinates, including setting performance standards and monitoring performance.
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound financial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
- Serving as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
- Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently.
- Reviews staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and financial objectives are met.
- Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.
- Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an "open door" policy and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
- Supervises and coordinates activities of cooks and workers engaged in food preparation.
- Demonstrate new cooking techniques and equipment to staff.
Setting and Maintaining Goals for Culinary Function and Activities
- Develops and implements guidelines and control procedures for purchasing and receiving areas.
- Establishes goals including performance goals, budget goals, team goals, etc.
- Communicates the importance of safety procedures, detailing procedure codes, ensuring employee understanding of safety codes, monitoring processes and procedures related to safety.
- Manages department controllable expenses including food cost, supplies, uniforms and equipment.
- Participates in the budgeting process for areas of responsibility.
- Knows and implements the brands safety standards.
Ensuring Culinary Standards and Responsibilities are Met
- Provides direction for menu development.
- Monitors the quality of raw and cooked food products to ensure that standards are met.
- Determines how food should be presented, and create decorative food displays.
- Recognizes superior quality products, presentations and flavor.
- Ensures compliance with food handling and sanitation standards.
- Follows proper handling and right temperature of all food products.
- Ensures employees maintain required food handling and sanitation certifications.
- Maintains purchasing, receiving and food storage standards.
- Prepares and cooks foods of all types, either on a regular basis or for special guests or functions.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides and supports service behaviors that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
- Displays leadership in guest hospitality, exemplifies excellent customer service and creates a positive atmosphere for guest relations.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
- Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service. Establishes guidelines so employees understand expectations and parameters. Ensures employees receive on-going training to understand guest expectations.
- Reviews comment cards, guest satisfaction results and other data to identify areas of improvement.
Managing and Conducting Human Resource Activities
- Identifies the developmental needs of others and coaching, mentoring, or otherwise helping others to improve their knowledge or skills.
- Ensures employees are treated fairly and equitably.
- Trains kitchen associates on the fundamentals of good cooking and excellent plate presentations.
- Administers the performance appraisal process for direct report managers.
- Interacts with the Banquet Chef and Catering department on training regarding food knowledge and menu composition.
- Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals and or managers.
- Manages employee progressive discipline procedures for areas of responsibility.
- Ensures disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and supports the Peer Review Process.
Additional Responsibilities
- Provides information to executive teams, managers and supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

CompanyCredila Financial Services Limited
Location Aurangabad
DepartmentSales - Institutional Funding

Job DescriptionA self-driven target oriented individual role with a mix of both Direct and Channel sourcing, involved in building and setting up a network of Channel partners. This involves visiting and building a pipeline of prospective Institutional lending customers seeking loan for the purpose of Institutional development and meeting the channel partners on a regular basis.
Key roles and responsibilities Daily visits to and follow-up with the Educational Institutions falling within the target segment, desirous of seeking a loan.
1. Building a healthy pipeline of logins and sanctions w.r.t the assigned sales target for both Direct and Channel Sourcing.
2. Achieving the target assigned on a month-on-month basis.
3. Understanding the Customers loan requirement and helping them as a SPOC in the end-to-end loan journey from login to disbursement.
4. Coordinating with the customer/s or channel partners and collecting all the required documents mentioned in the policy to ensure a hassle-free loan approval process for the customer.
5. Meet the assigned Channel partners on a regular basis and generate leads/referrals for New Business Acquisition.
6. Maintaining high levels of integrity at all times while engaging with the prospective / existing customers, Channel partners and the various support teams (Credit, Operations, Service, legal etc) within Credila.
7. Training and supporting the Channel partners in understanding the process & policies, joint customer visits and timely release of payouts.
8. Active involvement in fulfilment of the required documents by the Credit and Operations team during the login, approval and disbursement / post disbursement process.
9. Scouting and onboarding potential Channel partners to source business for Credila.
10.Maintaining the portfolio quality at all times by sourcing quality logins as per the defined product and credit policy and ensuring customers regularly pay the EMI dues in time.
11. Active involvement in collection of overdue EMIs from the customers.
12.Building a healthy relationship with all the Customers in the mapped portfolio to fulfill their future loan requirements and prevent them from going to the competition i.e. retention.
13. Deliver quality Customer Service and generate referrals from existing customers.
14. Cross-selling of Insurance & other allied products

Strong Negotiation skills
Team Worker
Creative (we thrive on this)
Analytical skills
Good communication skills
Perseverance
Nimble-footed
Self-motivated

Description:
Overview
A Growth Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurantslearning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative & On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners' success. You'll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.

Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy’s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner

Job Title: International Recruiter
Industry: Recruitment / Staffing

Job Summary
We are looking for dynamic, target-driven, and result-oriented professionals to join our International Recruitment Team. The ideal candidate should have excellent communication and negotiation skills, a proactive approach, and the ability to manage end-to-end recruitment activities for international job requirements.
Candidates should be confident in engaging with potential applicants, explaining overseas job opportunities, recruitment processes, migration-related costs, and payment milestones while ensuring a smooth candidate experience.
Key Roles & Responsibilities
Source and identify suitable candidates through job portals, social media, databases, and other recruitment channels.
Screen and evaluate candidates based on job requirements, qualifications, experience, and communication skills.
Coordinate and schedule interviews between candidates and employers.
Manage the complete end-to-end recruitment process for international job openings.
Handle bulk hiring requirements for overseas clients across various industries.
Conduct regular candidate follow-ups and facilitate the onboarding process.
Create and publish job advertisements across recruitment portals and social media platforms.
Communicate international job opportunities, recruitment procedures, migration-related costs, and payment milestones to prospective candidates.
Build strong candidate relationships and ensure timely follow-ups to achieve recruitment targets.
Salary: Up to 35,000 per month

Requirements
Excellent verbal and written communication skills with strong negotiation abilities.
Ability to work in a target-driven environment and achieve recruitment goals.
Strong interpersonal skills and confidence in engaging with candidates.
Interest in international recruitment and overseas placement processes.
Ability to clearly explain recruitment procedures, migration costs, and payment milestones.
Proactive attitude with strong ownership and accountability.
Good coordination, follow-up, and relationship management skills.
Ability to handle multiple recruitment requirements simultaneously.

Benefits
Salary: Up to 35,000 per month.
Opportunity to work in the international recruitment domain.
Exposure to overseas hiring and bulk recruitment projects.
Performance-driven and growth-oriented work environment.

Candidates who have completed Intermediate, Graduation or Post Graduation can apply.
Age: Up to 26 years.
Good communication and interpersonal skills.
Willingness to work in a field sales role and interact with customers.
Interest in sales, business development and customer acquisition.
Two-wheeler and valid driving licence preferred.
Male candidates only.

Compensation & Job Details

CTC: 2.30 LPA
Location: Vijayawada
Experience: 01 Years (Freshers Welcome to apply)
Employment Type: Full Time
Industry: Banking / Financial Services

Description:
CustomerCare Executive IIFL Gold Loan (Detailed JD)

RoleOverview
A CustomerCare Executive (CCE) at IIFLFinance (Gold Loan division) is responsible for handlingcustomers at the branch, supporting loan processing, and ensuringsmooth service experience .
Insimple terms:
Youare the first point of contact for customers and the support systemfor the branch team.




CoreResponsibilities

1. Customer Handling & Service
Welcome and assist walk-in customers
Understand customer requirements (loan, renewal, closure)
Explain:
Gold loan process
Interest rates
Repayment options
Ensure excellent customer experience and quick service




2. Documentation & KYC Processing
Collect and verify:
Aadhaar / PAN
Address proof
Photographs
Ensure proper KYC compliance as per RBI norms
Fill and process loan application forms
Maintain accurate customer records




3. Loan Processing Support
Coordinate with:
Gold Appraiser
Branch Manager
Assist in:
Loan entry in system
Documentation completion
Ensure fast turnaround time (TAT) for disbursement




4. Customer Follow-ups & Telecalling
Call customers for:
Loan renewals
Interest payments
Overdue reminders
Handle inbound customer queries
Maintain relationship with existing customers




5. Data Entry & MIS Management
Enter customer and loan details into company systems
Maintain:
Daily transaction records
Customer database
Generate basic reports for branch operations




6. Cash Handling Support (in some branches)
Assist in:
Cash collection (interest/repayment)
Receipt generation
Ensure proper cash reconciliation at end of day




7. Branch Coordination
Support smooth coordination between:
Customers
Appraisers
Sales staff
Help manage:
Customer queue
Branch workflow




8. Compliance & Process Adherence
Follow:
Company policies
RBI guidelines
Ensure error-free documentation
Support audits and verification processes




KeySkills Required

FunctionalSkills
Basic knowledge of:
Banking/NBFC processes
Documentation & KYC
Computer skills (MS Excel, data entry systems)


BehavioralSkills
Good communication (Hindi/English + local language)
Customer handling & patience
Attention to detail
Multitasking ability




EligibilityCriteria
Graduate (preferred) or 12th pass
03 years of experience in:
Customer service
Banking/NBFC
Retail or telecalling
Freshers are often hired




KPIs(Performance Metrics)
Customer satisfaction levels
Accuracy of documentation
Turnaround time (TAT)
Number of customer interactions handled
Follow-up conversion (renewals, payments)




RealisticNature of the Role
Entry-level role in NBFC structure
Repetitive but fast-paced work
High interaction with customers
Moderate pressure during peak business hours
Important support role but not core decision-making




Day-to-DayWork
Typicalday includes:
Handling walk-in customers
Completing KYC and documentation
Coordinating loan processing
Calling customers for follow-ups
Updating system records




CareerPath
Growthopportunities in **IIFL Finance Gold Loan:
Customer Care Executive
Senior CCE / Operations Executive
Assistant Branch Manager
Branch Manager
Territory Manager

Description:
Purpose of the Role
The role is responsible for driving sales of Spare Parts by increasing penetration in assigned territory. It involve ensuring the availability of genuine parts throughout designated territories and by closely working with retail network. It also involves creating awareness and educating the channel on benefits of genuine spare parts.

Job Responsibility
Sales Execution and Planning
Drive sales strategy through innovative activities and relationship building to garner maximum market share of Tata Genuine Parts.
Drive achievement of retail sales, institutional sales, product range and total sales targets by demand generating schemes and initiatives
Achieve distributor targets for primary and secondary sales by driving order generation activites
Develop and plan appropriate stock levels with distributers and execute plans for order generations. Monitor fulfilment of orders to ensure targets are achieved. Ensure distributers have the proper funding to support sales
Ensure the timely handling of channel partners and customer complaints including resolving payment issues, claims settlements and product availability
Actively coordinate with channel partner and procurement, warehouse & finance team to achieve high fill rates
Actively explore growth opportunities to increase market share and expanded the network to meet business objectives

Develop market potential matrix of Tata Genuine Parts through different methods: retailer wise, product group wise, district wise potential
Financial Management
Coordinate and monitor the availability of finances for distributors in assigned territory
Ensure competitive customer pricing by negotiating with channel partners to creating a win-win distribution pricing.
Monitor over dues of dealers and distributers in assigned area and take actions when required
Relationship Management
Deliver sales targets by working collaboratively with channel partners, participate in customer contact programs to capture voice of the customers, and providing timely solutions to the market, dealers, distributors and customers
People Management
Maintain up to date product knowledge and actively provide training and educate to the retailers, mechanics, fleet operators and channel partners regarding product and the usage of genuine spare parts.
Instilling the importance of resolving customer complaints received by distributors and guiding them on best practices for handling tricky situations in a timely manner. Also training them on importance of stock keeping and timely ordering of parts

Description:
Job Summary
The NPD Projects System Integrator (Room AC) will be responsible for leading the end-to-end design integration, prototyping, testing, and transition of new Room Air Conditioner (RAC) platforms from concept to mass production.
Responsibilities
New Product Development (NPD) System Integration-Own the system integration of Room AC units (Window/Split), ensuring structural integrity, optimal airflow, and aesthetic alignment.
Apply DFM (Design for Manufacturing) and DFA (Design for Assembly) principles during the early design stages to minimize production bottlenecks.
Lead and execute DFMEA (Design Failure Mode and Effects Analysis) sessions to identify risk, implement mitigation plans, and capture lessons learned.
Mockup, Prototyping CFT Inspection-Supervise the fabrication of mockups and engineering prototypes for physical verification.
Coordinate Proto CFT (Cross-Functional Team) Inspections and assembly trials to evaluate fitment, component clearances, and harness routing.
Document and track prototype build issues, driving root-cause analysis for any interference or assembly deviations.
Psychrometric Lab Testing Validation-Collaborate with the performance team to schedule and oversee Psychrometric Lab Testing (Capacity, EER/ISEER, Max Operating Conditions).
Analyze test data against target specifications and troubleshoot system-level performance gaps (e.g., airflow bypass, sweat/condensate issues).
New Part Development Quality Support-Support the sourcing team in New Part Development, providing technical clarity to vendors for plastics, sheet metal, and outsourced electrical components.
Assist Quality Assurance (QA) in component verification, ensuring part-readiness for QA Clearance Support prior to pilot builds.
Pilot Trials Project Execution-Develop and manage comprehensive Project Scheduling timelines using Gantt charts or project management software to ensure critical milestones are met.
Lead Pilot Trial Execution on the manufacturing line, monitoring first-run assembly processes.
Own the Pilot Lot Observation Closure process, ensuring all assembly, quality, and performance snags are resolved before final tooling kickoff.

M/s Kumar Rajiv & Co. is a 46 years old Chartered Accountancy (CA) Firm with PAN India presence with major focus around Audit and Assurance, Finance and Management Consultancy. Conduct surprise and scheduled physical cash verification at branches/ATMs
Reconcile physical cash with system balances and report discrepancies
Verify cash handling processes and adherence to internal control procedures

Coordinate with branch staff for timely resolution of audit findings

Excellent learning opportunities with practical training
Collaborative and dynamic work environment
Experience in KYC, compliance, or audit (Banking/NBFC preferred)
Strong understanding of KYC/AML regulations and audit processes
Good analytical and documentation skills
Proficiency in MS Excel and reporting tools
Attention to detail and ability to work under deadlines
Knowledge of RBI guidelines and banking regulations

Compensation:
Competitive salary/stipend Rs. 15,000 per month

Education:
Pursuing degree in Commerce, Finance, or related field

Shift Time:
9 AM to 6 PM

How to Apply:
If you're a motivated individual who meets the above requirements, please submit your resume to hr@cakrc.com

Role Summary
The Sales Manager - Logistics Services is responsible for driving new business acquisition through structured lead funnel management while ensuring a high-quality onboarding experience for new SME and B2B clients. Beyond acquisition, this role owns account health during the critical first two months post-onboarding, setting the foundation for long-term retention and growth.
1. Lead Funnel Management & New Client Acquisition
Identify, qualify, and pursue SME and B2B prospects.
Maintain a healthy lead pipeline across stages: Prospect Qualified Proposal Negotiation Closed
Conduct discovery meetings to understand prospect shipping volumes, pain points, and service requirements
Present customized logistics proposals including pricing, SLAs, and VAS offerings
Coordinate with operations and pricing teams to ensure commercially viable deal structures
Achieve monthly targets for new client activations and revenue from new accounts
2. Client Onboarding
Lead end-to-end onboarding for newly signed clients including system setup, account configuration, and first-shipment coordination
Conduct a formal onboarding kick-off call within 48 hours of contract signing
Share onboarding documentation: SOPs, escalation matrices, rate cards, and tracking portals
Coordinate with operations, IT, and customer service teams to ensure smooth Day 1 experience
Monitor first 10 shipments closely flag TAT breaches, address NDR issues, and resolve any documentation gaps
Schedule a Week 2 and Week 4 check-in call to review initial performance data and client satisfaction
3. Account Stabilization & Growth
Conduct a formal Month 1 performance review with each new client covering delivery rates, TAT compliance, and delay metrics
Identify opportunities to improve shipment volumes and client engagement.
Resolve operational issues by coordinating with internal stakeholders.
Ensure the account is stabilized and positioned for long-term growth and retention.
Hand over the account to the Account Management team with complete documentation and a smooth transition.

Description:
Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone s day. When you join our Hotels team, that s exactly what you ll do every time you come to work! You are responsible for the general work order maintenance work assigned by your superior, or assisting the Engineering department s maintenance team in completing other maintenance work. As an Engineering Technician, you re not just responsible for ensuring the normal operation of hotel equipment - you re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
In addition, this role requires the following minimum qualifications:
Familiar with the operation principle and fault judgment method of large data centre infrastructure (power supply, air conditioning, fire control, security, monitoring, network, etc.).
Willing to be engaged in the monitoring post for day shift and night shift for a long period, and have enough time to study.
Strong sense of responsibility, teamwork, professionalism, and learning ability.
Active and motivated in work, with a good sense of service.
Good analytical and problem-solving skills, able to work independently.
Here s what you ll do during a typical day:
Regulatory Compliance: Strictly adhere to staff rules, regulations, and management commands, ensuring careful operation and safe equipment use.
Operational Management: Ensure the normal operation of the hotel s power, water, gas, heating, and cooling equipment.
Record Keeping: Promptly and accurately inspect equipment operation records and shift handover records.
Equipment Maintenance: Inspect and maintain equipment and facilities under your jurisdiction, ensuring they are in good working condition.
Energy Management: Save energy and control energy consumption, implementing measures to enhance efficiency.
Event Support: Follow up on maintenance works for banquets and meetings, ensuring all related equipment functions well.
Emergency Preparedness: Regularly test-run the generator to ensure power generation and transmission during power failures.
Fire Safety Supervision: Supervise and inspect the hotel s fire preventive works, taking measures to stop any violations.
Training & Development: Supervise and train technicians and apprentices, developing their skills.
Tool Management: Manage working tools, registering team members names upon usage, and recommend disciplinary actions for subordinates as needed.

Achieves personal and team related revenue goals.
Verifies business is turned over properly and in a timely fashion for proper service delivery.
Responsible for driving customer/guest loyalty by delivering service excellence throughout each customer/guest experience.
Provides service to customers in order to grow the account on behalf of the company.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the sales and marketing, guest services, front desk, or related professional area.
OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Understanding Market Opportunities Driving Revenue
- Targets group/catering accounts, markets, or segments with heavy emphasis on proactive solicitation and account saturation.
- Partners with group/catering counterpart to effectively manage the business opportunity.
- Responds to incoming group/catering opportunities for the property that are outside parameters of the .
- Handles all opportunities if property does not participate in an EBC.
- Identifies, qualifies and solicits new group/catering business to achieve personal and each property s revenue goals.
- Focuses efforts on group/catering accounts with significant potential sales revenue.
- Develops effective group/catering sales plans and actions.
- Designs, develops and sells creative catered events.
- Maximizes revenue by upselling packages and creative food and beverage.
- Understands the overall market - competitors strengths and weaknesses, economic trends, supply and demand etc and knows how to sell against them.
- Closes the best opportunities for each property based on market conditions and individual property needs.
- Uses negotiating skills and creative selling abilities to close on business and negotiate contracts.
Providing Exceptional Customer Service
- Handles complex business with significant revenue potential as well as significant customer expectations.
- Builds and strengthens relationships with existing and new customers to enable future bookings.
Activities include sales calls, entertainment, FAM trips, trade shows, etc
- Develops relationships within community to strengthen and expand customer base for group/catering sales opportunities.
- Supports brand s Service and Relationship Strategy, driving customer loyalty by delivering service excellence throughout each customer experience.
- Provides excellent customer service in order to grow share of the account.
- Executes brand s Customer Service Standards and property s Brand Standards.
- Executes and supports the business Customer Service Standards and property s Brand Standards.
- Participates in and practices daily service basics of the brand.

- Serves the customer by understanding their needs and recommending the appropriate features and services that best meet their needs and exceed their expectations, while building a relationship and loyalty to the property and brand.

Building Successful Relationships

- Manages and develops relationships with key internal and external stakeholders.
- Uses sales resources and administrative/support staff.
Additional Responsibilities
- Utilizes intranet for resources and information.
- Conducts site inspections.
- Creates contracts as required.
- Executes and supports the operational aspects of business booked (eg, generating proposal, writing contract, customer correspondence).

Description:
Job Description:
The Customer Service Associate at Delhivery will be responsible to provide exceptional service and support to customers and rider partners, ensuring their satisfaction with Delhivery's products and services. You will handle inquiries, complaints, and requests through various communication channels, including phone, email, and chat. Your role involves understanding customer needs, resolving issues, and delivering accurate and timely information.
Key Responsibilities:
Providing assistance with shipment tracking and delivery inquiries
Resolving issues related to shipments (missing or damaged packages, customs delays, or delivery exceptions)
Assisting with billing inquiries such as explaining charges, resolving disputes and/or claims, or providing information on payment options
Providing support for shipping services and delivery options available, regulatory compliance, documentation requirements
Analyze and support with insights to improve the process and internal operations and service levels
Handling customer and rider partner escalations-preparing RCA and providing the solution
Collaborate with internal stakeholders to maintain and increase performance of client accounts
Designing SOP, mapping and freezing requirements and providing best solutions to the business
Required Skills and competencies
Excellent communication skills: You should possess strong verbal and written communication abilities to effectively interact with customers and rider partners and convey information clearly and concisely.
Customer-centric approach: A deep understanding of customer needs and the ability to keep focus on their issue is a fast paced and complex environment - this is applicable for our rider partners as well
Problem-solving skills: You must be adept at analyzing customer and rider partner issues, identifying root causes, and providing appropriate solutions or escalating matters as needed.
Time management: The ability to prioritize tasks, manage multiple inquiries simultaneously, and meet deadlines is essential for efficient customer service delivery.
Familiarity with customer-relationship management (CRM) software programs
Problem-solving and critical thinking: You will encounter complex customer and rider related issues that require effective problem-solving skills and the ability to think critically. You should be able to analyze situations, evaluate available options, and propose viable solutions to ensure customer satisfaction.
Flexible with the working schedule; may be expected to work weekends, holidays and events where there is increased service demand.
AboutCompany: Delhivery is India's leading e-commerce fulfillment company, where we use technology to drive supply chain solutions. Delhivery provides an array of products and services for online businesses - including online channel integration services, sourcing, catalogue management, inventory management, multi-city fulfillment, express shipping, same day delivery services, reverse logistics, offline payment collection and processing, customer support, social media engagement and channel analytics.5 years into the industry, Delhivery handles over 250,000 shipments per day for over 100,000+ merchants, 25000 clients and 1800+ retailers across 450+ cities. We provide a modular set of e-commerce technologies and logistics solutions to over 5000+ pin codes.

Description:
About the Role

We are looking for a results-driven Performance Marketing Manager to lead customer acquisition and performance marketing initiatives across digital channels. The role will involve owning the paid acquisition funnel end-to-end, from campaign strategy and execution to optimization and conversion, with a strong focus on scaling efficiently while improving CAC, ROAS and overall marketing performance.
The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience across Google Ads, Meta Ads, Apple Search Ads, SEO, ASO, analytics and experimentation, along with the ability to translate business objectives into measurable performance marketing strategies.
Key Responsibilities
Own and drive the overall performance marketing strategy across paid digital channels.
Manage significant monthly marketing budgets across Google Ads, Meta Ads, Apple Search Ads, affiliates and other performance channels.
Drive customer acquisition while optimizing CAC, CPA, ROAS, conversion rates and overall marketing efficiency.
Develop, launch and scale campaigns across the acquisition funnel, including app installs, leads, first transactions/orders and other business conversion goals.
Lead Google Ads, Meta Ads, Apple Search Ads and app acquisition campaigns, including campaign structure, targeting, bidding, budget allocation and optimization.
Identify opportunities to scale campaigns while maintaining target acquisition costs and business outcomes.
Analyze campaign, audience and funnel performance to identify growth opportunities and improve unit economics.
Design and execute A/B tests and performance marketing experiments across campaigns, audiences, creatives, landing pages and conversion flows.
Work closely with product, engineering and analytics teams to improve tracking, attribution and conversion measurement.
Define and implement conversion events and signals through GA4, GTM, Adjust and other analytics platforms.
Develop dashboards and recurring performance reports covering spend, CAC, conversions, ROAS, customer quality and channel performance.
Work closely with creative teams to develop, test and scale performance-oriented ad creatives, messaging and landing pages.
Own and drive SEO and ASO initiatives to improve organic acquisition, app discoverability and overall digital performance.
